1689 Boston revolt.headline: Bostonski upor leta 1689
paragraphs: Bostonski upor leta 1689 je bila ljudska vstaja 18. aprila 1689 proti vladavini sira Edmunda Androsa, guvernerja Dominiona Nova Anglija. V Bostonu, prestolnici dominiona, se je zbrala dobro organizirana »drhal« provincialne milice in meščanov, ki je aretirala uradnike dominiona. Pridržali so tudi člane anglikanske cerkve, za katere so menili, da so naklonjeni upravi dominiona. Med uporom nobena stran ni imela žrtev. Voditelji nekdanje kolonije Massachusettskega zaliva so nato znova prevzeli vlado, v drugih kolonijah pa so se na oblast vrnili člani vlad, ki jih je dominion odstavil.

source.title: 1689 Boston revolt
paragraphs: The 1689 Boston revolt was a popular uprising on April 18, 1689, against the rule of Sir Edmund Andros, the governor of the Dominion of New England. A well-organized "mob" of provincial militia and citizens formed in the town of Boston, the capital of the dominion, and arrested dominion officials. Members of the Church of England were also taken into custody if they were believed to sympathize with the administration of the dominion. Neither faction sustained casualties during the revolt. Leaders of the former Massachusetts Bay Colony then reclaimed control of the government. In other colonies, members of governments displaced by the dominion were returned to power.

1943 Argentine Revolution.headline: Argentinska revolucija leta 1943
paragraphs: Argentinska revolucija leta 1943 (znana tudi kot argentinski državni udar leta 1943, junijska revolucija ali revolucija '43) je bil državni udar 4. junija 1943, ki je končal vlado Ramóna Castilla. Castillo je bil z goljufijo izvoljen za podpredsednika, leta 1942 pa je nasledil predsednika v obdobju, imenovanem razvpito desetletje. Udar je sprožila loža »Skupina združenih častnikov« (GOU), tajna vojaška organizacija nacionalistične narave, čeprav so njeni pripadniki nacionalizem razumeli različno: med njimi so bili katoliški nacionalisti, radikali, bolj pragmatični vojaki in celo fašisti. Vojska je nasprotovala guvernerju Robustianu Patrónu Costasu, ki ga je Castillo izbral za naslednika, velikemu zemljiškemu posestniku v provinci Salta in glavnemu delničarju sladkorne industrije. Edini resni odpor proti udaru je pokazala argentinska vojna mornarica, ki se je napredujočim vojaškim kolonam postavila po robu pri mornariški šoli za podčastnike mehanike.

source.title: 1943 Argentine Revolution
paragraphs: The 1943 Argentine Revolution (also known as the 1943 Argentine coup d'état, the June Revolution or the Revolution of '43) was a coup d'état on 4 June 1943 that ended the government of Ramón Castillo, who had been fraudulently elected to the office of vice-president before succeeding to the presidency in 1942 as part of the period known as the Infamous Decade. The coup d'état was launched by the lodge "United Officers' Group" (GOU), a secret military organization of nationalist nature. Although its soldiers shared different views of nationalism: there were Catholic nationalists, Radicals, military with a more pragmatic approach, and even fascists. The military was opposed to Governor Robustiano Patrón Costas, Castillo's hand-picked successor, a major landowner in Salta Province and a primary stockholder in the sugar industry. The only serious resistance to the military coup came from the Argentine Navy, which confronted the advancing army columns at the Navy Petty-Officers School of Mechanics.

1954 Guatemalan coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Gvatemali leta 1954
paragraphs: Demokratično izvoljenega gvatemalskega predsednika Jacoba Árbenza so leta 1954 odstavili z državnim udarom, s katerim se je končala gvatemalska revolucija. Udar je na oblast postavil vojaško diktaturo Carlosa Castilla Armasa, prvega v vrsti avtoritarnih vladarjev Gvatemale, ki so jih podpirale ZDA. Udar je sprožila tajna operacija Cie s kodnim imenom PBSuccess.

source.title: 1954 Guatemalan coup d'état
paragraphs: The democratically elected Guatemalan president Jacobo Árbenz was deposed in a coup d'état in 1954, marking the end of the Guatemalan Revolution. The coup installed the military dictatorship of Carlos Castillo Armas, the first in a series of U.S.-backed authoritarian rulers in Guatemala. The coup was precipitated by a CIA covert operation code-named PBSuccess.

1964 Brazilian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Braziliji leta 1964
paragraphs: Brazilski državni udar leta 1964 (portugalsko: Golpe de estado no Brasil em 1964) je bila odstavitev brazilskega predsednika Joãa Goularta z vojaškim udarom od 31. marca do 1. aprila 1964, s katero se je končala četrta brazilska republika (1946–1964) in začela brazilska vojaška diktatura (1964–1985). Udar je potekal kot vojaški upor, nacionalni kongres je 2. aprila razglasil, da je predsedniško mesto prazno, sestavila se je vojaška hunta (Vrhovno poveljstvo revolucije), predsednik pa je 4. aprila odšel v izgnanstvo. Namesto njega je oblast prevzel predsednik poslanske zbornice Ranieri Mazzilli, dokler kongres ni izvolil generala Humberta de Alencarja Castela Branca, enega od voditeljev udara.

source.title: 1964 Brazilian coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1964 Brazilian coup d'état (Portuguese: Golpe de estado no Brasil em 1964) was the overthrow of Brazilian president João Goulart by a military coup from March 31 to April 1, 1964, ending the Fourth Brazilian Republic (1946–1964) and initiating the Brazilian military dictatorship (1964–1985). The coup took the form of a military rebellion, the declaration of vacancy in the presidency by the National Congress on April 2, the formation of a military junta (the Supreme Command of the Revolution) and the exile of the president on April 4. In his place, Ranieri Mazzilli, the president of the Chamber of Deputies, took over until the election by Congress of general Humberto de Alencar Castelo Branco, one of the leaders of the coup.

Čilski državni udar leta 1973 (špansko: Golpe de Estado en Chile de 1973) je bila vojaška odstavitev socialističnega čilskega predsednika Salvadorja Allendeja in njegove koalicijske vlade Ljudske enotnosti. Allende, prvi marksist, ki je bil v kateri od latinskoameriških liberalnih demokracij demokratično izvoljen za predsednika, se je soočal z velikimi družbenimi nemiri in političnimi napetostmi z narodnim kongresom, v katerem je imela večino opozicija. Skupina vojaških častnikov pod vodstvom generala Augusta Pinocheta je 11. septembra 1973 z udarom prevzela oblast in končala civilno vladavino.

source.title: 1973 Chilean coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1973 Chilean coup d'état (Spanish: Golpe de Estado en Chile de 1973) was a military overthrow of the socialist president of Chile Salvador Allende and his Popular Unity coalition government. Allende, who was the first Marxist to be democratically elected president in a Latin American liberal democracy, faced significant social unrest and political tension with the opposition-controlled National Congress of Chile. On 11 September 1973, a group of military officers, led by General Augusto Pinochet, seized power in a coup, ending civilian rule.

1973 Uruguayan coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Urugvaju leta 1973
paragraphs: Urugvajski državni udar leta 1973 se je zgodil 27. junija 1973 in je pomenil začetek civilno-vojaške diktature, ki je trajala do leta 1985.

Predsednik Juan María Bordaberry je razpustil parlament in vladal s pomočjo hunte vojaških generalov. Uradni razlog je bil zatreti Tupamarose, marksistično mestno gverilsko gibanje. Komunistične sindikalne zveze so razglasile splošno stavko in zasedbo tovarn. Stavka je trajala nekaj več kot dva tedna, končala pa se je tako, da je bila večina sindikalnih voditeljev zaprtih, mrtvih ali izgnanih v Argentino. Z udarom so vsa združenja, tudi sindikate, razglasili za nezakonita in jih prepovedali, urugvajska ustava iz leta 1967 pa je bila dejansko razveljavljena.

source.title: 1973 Uruguayan coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1973 Uruguayan coup d'état took place in Uruguay on 27 June 1973 and marked the beginning of the civic-military dictatorship which lasted until 1985.

President Juan María Bordaberry closed parliament and ruled with the assistance of a junta of military generals. The official reason was to crush the Tupamaros, a Marxist urban guerrilla movement. The communist trade union federations called a general strike and occupation of factories. The strike lasted just over two weeks. It ended with most of the trade union leaders in jail, dead, or exiled to Argentina. As part of the coup all associations including trade unions were declared illegal and banned; the Constitution of Uruguay of 1967 was practically voided.

1976 Argentine coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Argentini leta 1976
paragraphs: Z državnim udarom 24. marca 1976 so argentinsko predsednico Isabel Perón vrgli z oblasti. Nadomestila jo je vojaška hunta, ki so jo vodili generalporočnik Jorge Rafael Videla, admiral Emilio Eduardo Massera in brigadni general Orlando Ramón Agosti. Politični proces, ki se je začel 24. marca 1976, je dobil uradno ime »proces nacionalne reorganizacije«; različne hunte so bile na oblasti do vrnitve demokracije 10. decembra 1983.

Vojaški udar so načrtovali od oktobra 1975; Perónova vlada je za priprave izvedela dva meseca pred njegovo izvedbo. Henry Kissinger se je po udaru večkrat sestal z voditelji argentinskih oboroženih sil in jih spodbujal, naj nasprotnike uničijo hitro, preden bi se v Združenih državah okrepilo ogorčenje nad kršitvami človekovih pravic.
Ker je šlo za sistematično preganjanje družbene manjšine, nekateri to obdobje označujejo za »genocidni proces«. Pri tem se sklicujejo na sodbe na sojenjih storilcem za zločine proti človečnosti.

source.title: 1976 Argentine coup d'état
paragraphs: A coup d'état overthrew Isabel Perón as President of Argentina on 24 March 1976. A military junta was installed to replace her; this was headed by Lieutenant General Jorge Rafael Videla, Admiral Emilio Eduardo Massera, and Brigadier-General Orlando Ramón Agosti. The political process initiated on 24 March 1976 took the official name of "National Reorganization Process", and different juntas remained in power until the return to democracy on 10 December 1983.

The military coup had been planned since October 1975; the Perón government learned of the preparations two months before its execution. Henry Kissinger met several times with Argentine Armed Forces leaders after the coup, urging them to destroy their opponents quickly before outcry over human rights abuses grew in the United States.

Given the systematic persecution of a social minority, the period has been claimed by some as a ‘genocidal process’. They point to the sentences of the trials of the perpetrators for crimes against humanity.

2002 Venezuelan coup attempt.headline: Poskus državnega udara v Venezueli leta 2002
paragraphs: Z neuspelim državnim udarom 11. aprila 2002 so venezuelskega predsednika Huga Cháveza za 47 ur odstavili, nato pa se je vrnil na oblast. K vrnitvi so mu pomagali ljudska podpora in zvesti deli vojske, ki so se mobilizirali proti udaru. Do začetka leta 2002 je Chávezova priljubljenost padla na okoli 30 %; mnogi voditelji gospodarstva, cerkve in medijev so nasprotovali temu, da je z izrednimi pooblastili obšel narodno skupščino in uvedel velike spremembe v vladi, ki so bile po njihovem vse bolj avtoritarne. Hkrati je v vojski naraščalo nezadovoljstvo s Chávezom zaradi njegovega napadalnega nastopa ter zavezništev s Kubo in paravojaškimi skupinami, zato je več častnikov zahtevalo njegov odstop. Država se je vse bolj delila, demonstracije in protidemonstracije so si sledile vsak teden. Upokojeni vojaški častniki, nekdanji politiki, sindikalni voditelji in govorniki katoliške cerkve so trdili, da imajo za odstavitev Cháveza podporo vojske; obveščevalno poročilo Cie s 6. aprila je opozarjalo, da bodo zarotniki za njegovo odstavitev skušali izkoristiti družbene nemire ob bližnjih demonstracijah opozicije.

source.title: 2002 Venezuelan coup attempt
paragraphs: A failed coup d'état on 11 April 2002 saw Venezuelan President Hugo Chávez, ousted from office for 47 hours before being restored to power. Chávez was aided in his return to power by popular support and mobilization against the coup by loyal ranks in the military. By early 2002, Chávez's approval rating had dropped to around 30%, with many business, church and media leaders being opposed to Chávez's use of emergency powers to bypass the National Assembly and institute significant government changes, arguing they were increasingly authoritarian. Meanwhile, the growing dissatisfaction with Chávez among those in the military due to his aggressive manner and alliances with Cuba and paramilitaries led multiple officers to call on Chávez to resign. Demonstrations and counter-demonstrations took place on a weekly basis as the country became increasingly divided. Retired military officers, former politicians, union leaders, and spokespeople for the Catholic Church claimed they had military support to remove Chávez from power, with an April 6 CIA intelligence report warning that plotters would try to exploit social unrest from upcoming opposition demonstrations for his removal.

2004 Haitian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar na Haitiju leta 2004
paragraphs: Državni udar na Haitiju 29. februarja 2004 je po več tednih spopadov odstavil predsednika Jean-Bertranda Aristida. Uporniška skupina, imenovana Narodna revolucionarna fronta za osvoboditev in obnovo Haitija, je 5. februarja zavzela četrto največje haitijsko mesto Gonaïves. Do 22. februarja so uporniki zavzeli drugo največje mesto, Cap-Haïtien, konec februarja pa so oblegali prestolnico Port-au-Prince. Zjutraj 29. februarja je Aristide v spornih okoliščinah odstopil, ameriško vojaško in varnostno osebje pa ga je z letalom odpeljalo s Haitija. Odšel je v izgnanstvo, najprej naravnost v Srednjeafriško republiko, nazadnje pa se je naselil v Južni Afriki. Po njegovem odhodu so postavili začasno vlado, ki sta jo vodila predsednik Boniface Alexandre in predsednik vlade Gérard Latortue, na Haiti pa so v okviru operacije Varen jutri (Secure Tomorrow) pod vodstvom ZDA napotili 2700 tujih vojakov, da bi preprečili razpad javnega reda. Operacijo je pozneje nadomestila stabilizacijska misija Združenih narodov na Haitiju.

source.title: 2004 Haitian coup d'état
paragraphs: A coup d'état in Haiti on 29 February 2004, following several weeks of conflict, resulted in the removal of President Jean-Bertrand Aristide from office. On 5 February, a rebel group, called the National Revolutionary Front for the Liberation and Reconstruction of Haiti, took control of Haiti's fourth-largest city, Gonaïves. By 22 February, the rebels had captured Haiti's second-largest city, Cap-Haïtien and were besieging the capital, Port-au-Prince by the end of February. On the morning of 29 February, Aristide resigned under controversial circumstances and was flown from Haiti by U.S. military and security personnel. He went into exile, being flown directly to the Central African Republic, before eventually settling in South Africa. Following Aristide's departure, an interim government led by President Boniface Alexandre and Prime Minister Gérard Latortue was installed, and 2,700 foreign troops were deployed to Haiti under the U.S.-led Operation Secure Tomorrow to stop the breakdown of public order. The operation was later replaced by the United Nations Stabilisation Mission in Haiti.

2005 Belize unrest.headline: Nemiri v Belizeju leta 2005
paragraphs: V srednjeameriški državi Belize sta se januarja in aprila zgodila dva ločena, a povezana izbruha državljanskih nemirov.

source.title: 2005 Belize unrest
paragraphs: Two separate but related incidents of civil unrest in the Central American country of Belize occurred in January and April.

2009 Honduran coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Hondurasu leta 2009
paragraphs: Hondurški državni udar leta 2009 se je zgodil med hondurško ustavno krizo istega leta. Sprožilo ga je to, da se predsednik Manuel Zelaya ni hotel podrediti odločitvi hondurškega vrhovnega sodišča. Hondurška vojska je 28. junija 2009 Zelayo odstavila in ga poslala v izgnanstvo.

Zelaya je hotel razpisati nezavezujoče glasovanje o sklicu ustavodajne skupščine, ki bi napisala novo ustavo (referendum o četrti žari). Ker se ni ravnal po sodnih odredbah, naj ga ustavi, je vrhovno sodišče 26. junija izdalo tajni zaporni nalog. Dva dni pozneje so vojaki vdrli v predsedniško rezidenco, pridržali Zelayo in ustavili glasovanje. Namesto da bi ga postavili pred sodišče, ga je vojska z letalom odpeljala v Kostariko. Pozneje istega dne je hondurški kongres, potem ko so predstavili odstopno pismo dvomljive pristnosti, izglasoval Zelayevo odstavitev in za dokončanje njegovega mandata imenoval predsednika kongresa Roberta Michelettija, ustavnega naslednika. To je bil prvi državni udar v Hondurasu po letu 1978.

source.title: 2009 Honduran coup d'état
paragraphs: The 2009 Honduran coup d'état occurred during the 2009 Honduran constitutional crisis. It was triggered after President Manuel Zelaya refused to comply with a Honduran Supreme Court ruling. On 28 June 2009, the Honduran Army ousted Zelaya and sent him into exile.

Zelaya had sought to schedule a non-binding poll on convening a constituent assembly to write a new constitution (the fourth ballot box referendum). After he defied court orders to cease, the Supreme Court issued a secret arrest warrant on 26 June. Two days later, soldiers stormed the presidential residence, detained Zelaya, and halted the poll. Rather than putting him on trial, the army flew him to Costa Rica. Later that day, after presenting a resignation letter of disputed authenticity, the Honduran Congress voted to remove Zelaya from office and appointed congressional head Roberto Micheletti, the constitutional successor, to complete his term. This was the first coup in Honduras since 1978.

Tedanji perujski predsednik Pedro Castillo je 7. decembra 2022, ko mu je grozil postopek za odstavitev, poskušal razpustiti kongres. Pri tem je takoj uvedel policijsko uro, poskušal vzpostaviti izredno vlado in pozval k oblikovanju ustavodajne skupščine. Pred tem ga je generalna državna tožilka Patricia Benavides obtožila vodenja hudodelske združbe in kongres pozvala, naj ga odstavi, kar je pripeljalo do tretjega poskusa ustavne obtožbe proti Castillu. Castillo je ravnanje zagovarjal s trditvijo, da je kongres oviral številne njegove politike in se z ustavnim sodiščem dogovarjal za spodkopavanje izvršne oblasti ter tako ustvaril »kongresno diktaturo«. Zavzemal se je tudi za takojšnjo izvolitev ustavodajne skupščine, zahtevo, ki je odmevala že od perujskih protestov leta 2020.

source.title: 2022 Peruvian self-coup attempt
paragraphs: On 7 December 2022, Pedro Castillo, the then-President of Peru, made an attempt to dissolve the Congress amidst looming removal proceedings. This move included the immediate imposition of a curfew, an attempt to establish an emergency government, and a call for the formation of a constituent assembly. Prior to this, Attorney General Patricia Benavides had accused Castillo of leading a criminal organization. She had urged the Congress to remove him from office, leading to the third impeachment attempt against Castillo. Castillo defended his actions by arguing that the Congress had obstructed many of his policies and had colluded with the Constitutional Court to undermine the executive branch, thereby creating a "congressional dictatorship". He also advocated for the immediate election of a constituent assembly, a demand that had been echoed since the 2020 Peruvian protests.

2022–2023 Brazilian coup plot.headline: Zarota za državni udar v Braziliji 2022–2023
paragraphs: Med brazilskimi splošnimi volitvami leta 2022 in po njih je mreža članov vlade nekdanjega predsednika Jaira Bolsonara in brazilskih oboroženih sil načrtovala, da bi preprečila predajo oblasti novoizvoljenemu predsedniku Luizu Ináciu Luli da Silvi, aretirala sodnika zveznega vrhovnega sodišča (STF) Alexandra de Moraesa in predsednika zveznega senata Rodriga Pacheca ter zaprla več državnih ustanov, kot so nacionalni kongres, višje volilno sodišče in STF, da bi Bolsonaro ostal na oblasti in utrdil nadzor nad zvezno vlado. Načrte, dokaze in udeležence pri pripravi državnega udara so v letih 2023 in 2024 postopoma razkrile preiskave državnih organov in tiska.

source.title: 2022–2023 Brazilian coup plot
paragraphs: During and after the 2022 Brazilian general election, a network of members of former president Jair Bolsonaro's government and of the Brazilian Armed Forces planned to subvert the transition of power to newly elected president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, arrest Supreme Federal Court (STF) justice Alexandre de Moraes and Federal Senate president Rodrigo Pacheco, and shut down several government institutions, such as the National Congress, the Superior Electoral Court and the STF, in an attempt to keep Bolsonaro in power and consolidate his control over the federal government. The plans, evidence, and individuals involved in planning a coup d'état were gradually revealed in investigations conducted by public agencies and the press in 2023 and 2024.

V Boliviji je 26. junija 2024 prišlo do poskusa vojaškega udara, ki so ga pripravili uporniški častniki oboroženih sil pod vodstvom generala Juana Joséja Zúñige. Oboroženi vojaki so zasedli trg Plaza Murillo v La Pazu, politično srce države, a so se pod domačim in mednarodnim pritiskom ter po imenovanju novega vrhovnega vojaškega poveljstva umaknili.

Udar je sledil tednom politične in gospodarske negotovosti, ko je razkol v vladajoči stranki med nekdanjim predsednikom Evom Moralesom in sedanjim predsednikom Luisom Arcejem oviral vlado pri spopadanju z grozečo finančno krizo. Nekaj dni pred udarom je general Zúñiga izjavil, da bo vojska aretirala Moralesa, če bo kandidiral na predsedniških volitvah leta 2025. Škandal, ki je sledil, se je končal z Zúñigovo razrešitvijo.

source.title: 2024 Bolivian coup attempt
paragraphs: On 26 June 2024, an attempted military coup occurred in Bolivia, orchestrated by dissident officers of the Armed Forces led by General Juan José Zúñiga. Armed troops occupied the Plaza Murillo in La Paz, the political heart of the country, but withdrew amid domestic and international pressure and after the appointment of a new military high command.

The coup followed weeks of political and economic unease, as a split in the ruling party between former president Evo Morales and incumbent Luis Arce hampered the government's ability to address a looming financial crisis. Days before the coup, General Juan José Zúñiga declared that the military would arrest Morales if he ran in the 2025 presidential election. The resulting scandal ended in Zúñiga's dismissal.

Acre War.headline: Akrska vojna
paragraphs: Akrska vojna, v Braziliji znana kot akrska revolucija (portugalsko: Revolução Acreana), v španščini pa kot Guerra del Acre (»vojna za Acre«), je bil mejni spor med Bolivijo in prvo brazilsko republiko za pokrajino Acre, bogato s kavčukom in nahajališči zlata. Spopad je imel med letoma 1899 in 1903 dve fazi, končal pa se je z zmago Akrčanov in nato s pogodbo iz Petrópolisa, s katero je Acre pripadel Braziliji. Izid je vplival tudi na ozemlja, za katera je potekal spor s Perujem.

source.title: Acre War
paragraphs: The Acre War, known in Brazil as Acrean Revolution (Portuguese: Revolução Acreana) and in Spanish as Guerra del Acre ("War of the Acre") was a border conflict between Bolivia and the First Brazilian Republic over the Acre Region, which was rich in rubber and gold deposits. The conflict had two phases between 1899 and 1903, and ended with an Acrean victory and the subsequent Treaty of Petrópolis, which ceded Acre to Brazil. The outcome also affected territories disputed with Peru.

Adams–Onís Treaty.headline: Pogodba Adams–Onís
paragraphs: Pogodba Adams–Onís je bil sporazum med Španijo in Združenimi državami, ki sta ga 22. februarja 1819 podpisala John Quincy Adams in Luis de Onís. Združene države so pridobile Florido, se odpovedale zahtevam po španskem Teksasu in določile svojo prvo mejo čez celino.

Določila pogodbe so v celoti veljala le do 24. avgusta 1821, ko je pogodba iz Córdobe priznala neodvisnost Mehike od Španije. Mejna pogodba med Mehiko in Združenimi državami iz leta 1828 je meja, določena s pogodbo Adams–Onís, priznala za mejo med državama, po priključitvi Teksasa leta 1845 pa jo je znova spremenila pogodba iz Guadalupe Hidalga. Pogodbo Adams–Onís so formalno odpravili leta 1902.

source.title: Adams–Onís Treaty
paragraphs: The Adams–Onís Treaty was an agreement between Spain and the United States, signed February 22, 1819, by John Quincy Adams and Luis de Onís respectively. The United States acquired Florida while renouncing claims to Spanish Texas and establishing its first transcontinental boundary.

The provisions of the treaty remained in full effect only until August 24, 1821, when the Treaty of Córdoba acknowledged Mexican independence from Spain. In the 1828 Treaty of Limits (Mexico–United States), the border defined by the Adams–Onís Treaty was recognized as the boundary between Mexico and the US, although following the 1845 Texas annexation, it was amended again by the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo. The Adams–Onís Treaty was formally terminated in 1902.

Ais people.headline: Ljudstvo Ais
paragraphs: Ais ali Ays so bili indijansko ljudstvo vzhodne Floride. Njihovo ozemlje je obsegalo obalna območja in otoke približno od rta Canaveral do reke Indian River. Poglavarstvo Ais je sestavljalo več mest, vsako s svojim poglavarjem, ki je bil podrejen vrhovnemu poglavarju Aisov; Španci so reko Indian River imenovali »reka Aisov«. Aisi so bili lovci in nabiralci, hrane pa so imeli v izobilju: jedli so ribe, želve, školjke, plodove kokosove slive, jagode palme sabal in drugo nabrano sadje.

Najboljši posamezni vir o Aisih ob koncu 17. stoletja je dnevnik Jonathana Dickinsona (Journal), v katerem opisuje njihov videz, prehrano in običaje. Dickinson in njegovi spremljevalci so doživeli brodolom in leta 1696 preživeli več tednov med Aisi. Po Dickinsonovem pričevanju je bil poglavar mesta Jece blizu današnjega Sebastiana nadrejen vsem obalnim mestom, od jaegovskega mesta Jobe (pri zalivu Jupiter Inlet) na jugu do približno rta Canaveral na severu, torej vzdolž vse reke Aisov.

source.title: Ais people
paragraphs: The Ais or Ays were a Native American people of eastern Florida. Their territory included coastal areas and islands from approximately Cape Canaveral to the Indian River. The Ais chiefdom consisted of a number of towns, each led by a chief who was subordinate to the paramount chief of Ais; the Indian River was known as the "River of Ais" to the Spanish. The Ais were hunter-gatherers and food was plentiful. They ate fish, turtle, shellfish, cocoplums, sabal palm berries and other gathered fruits.

The best single source for information on the Ais at the end of the 17th century is Jonathan Dickinson's Journal, in which he makes observations on their appearance, diet, and customs. Dickinson and his party were shipwrecked, and spent several weeks among the Ais in 1696. By Dickinson's account, the chief of the town of Jece, near present-day Sebastian, was paramount to all of the coastal towns from the Jaega town of Jobe (at Jupiter Inlet) in the south to approximately Cape Canaveral in the north (that is, the length of the River of Ais).

Z nakupom Aljaske leta 1867 je Ruska Amerika za 7,2 milijona dolarjev (kar je leta 2024 ustrezalo 132 milijonom dolarjev) prešla v roke Združenih držav. Senat Združenih držav je 9. aprila tega leta ratificiral dvostransko pogodbo, podpisano 30. marca, ameriška suverenost na ozemlju pa je pravno začela veljati 18. oktobra.

Rusko cesarstvo je v prvi polovici 19. stoletja kolonialno prodrlo v dele Severne Amerike, a na Aljasko se je naselilo malo Rusov. Ruski car Aleksander II. je po katastrofalnem porazu v krimski vojni začel razmišljati o prodaji aljaških posesti, ki bi jih bilo v morebitni prihodnji vojni težko braniti pred Združenim kraljestvom. Zato se je tedanji ameriški zunanji minister William H. Seward po ameriški državljanski vojni z ruskim diplomatom Eduardom de Stoecklom začel pogajati o ameriškem nakupu Aljaske. Seward in Stoeckl sta se o pogodbi o prodaji dogovorila 30. marca 1867.
notes: The source spells the diplomat both Stoeckl and Steckel; Stoeckl is used throughout.

source.title: Alaska Purchase
paragraphs: The Alaska Purchase in 1867 resulted in the transfer of Russian America to the United States for $7.2 million (equivalent to $132 million in 2024). On April 9 of that year, the United States Senate ratified a bilateral treaty that had been signed on March 30, and American sovereignty became legally effective across the territory on October 18.

During the first half of the 19th century, the Russian Empire had established a colonial presence in parts of North America, but few Russians ever settled in Alaska. Alexander II of Russia, having faced a catastrophic defeat in the Crimean War, began exploring the possibility of selling the state's Alaskan possessions, which, in any future war, would be difficult to defend from the United Kingdom. To this end, William H. Seward, the U.S. secretary of state at the time, entered into negotiations with Russian diplomat Eduard de Stoeckl towards the United States' acquisition of Alaska after the American Civil War. Seward and Steckel agreed to a treaty for the sale on March 30, 1867.

Aleutian tradition.headline: Aleutska tradicija
paragraphs: Aleutska tradicija je arheološka kultura, ki se je začela okoli leta 2500 pr. n. št. in končala leta 1800 n. št. Aleutski izdelki so iz odbitega kamna, za razliko od orodja iz brušenega skrilavca, ki so ga uporabljale arheološke kulture na aljaški celini. Aleuti so pozimi živeli v napol vkopanih hišah iz naplavljenega lesa, kitovih kosti in šote. S kajaki, metalci kopja in harpunami so lovili morske sesalce, s katerimi so se preživljali. Okoli leta 1150 n. št. so se aleutske hiše precej povečale, hrano so shranjevali v posebnih prostorih v hiši, okoli teh najdišč pa je bilo vse več orožja. Namesto morskih sesalcev so začeli jesti predvsem losose. Z rastjo trgovine na velike razdalje so se okrepile tudi vezi z drugimi krajevnimi skupinami.

source.title: Aleutian tradition
paragraphs: The Aleutian Tradition is an archaeological culture which began around 2500 BC and ended in AD 1800. Aleutian artifacts are made out of chipped stone, unlike the ground slate tools used by archaeological cultures on the mainland of Alaska. The Aleutian people lived in semi-subterranean winter houses made from driftwood, whale bone, and peat. They used kayaks, atlatls and harpoons to kill sea mammals for sustenance. Around AD 1150, Aleutian houses increased considerably in size, food was stored in special chambers inside the house, and weaponry was becoming more common around these sites. The sustenance pattern changed from relying on sea mammals to eating mostly salmon. Long-distance trade also started increasing community with other local groups.

Ameriške indijanske vojne, znane tudi kot ameriške mejne vojne ali indijanske vojne, so sprva bojevali evropski kolonialni imperiji, Združene države ter za kratek čas Konfederativne države Amerike in Republika Teksas proti različnim indijanskim plemenom v Severni Ameriki. Spopadi so potekali od prvih kolonialnih naselbin v 17. stoletju do konca 19. stoletja. Vzrokov je bilo veliko, najpogostejši pa je bila želja naseljencev in vlad po plemenski zemlji. Evropske sile in njihove kolonije so si za vojne proti kolonialnim naselbinam tekmecev pridobivale zavezniška indijanska plemena. Po ameriški revoluciji so bili mnogi spopadi omejeni na posamezne zvezne države ali pokrajine in so pogosto zadevali spore o rabi zemlje; mnogi so vključevali povračilno nasilje.

source.title: American Indian Wars
paragraphs: The American Indian Wars, also known as the American Frontier Wars, and the Indian Wars, were initially fought by European colonial empires, the United States, and briefly the Confederate States of America and Republic of Texas against various American Indian tribes in North America. These conflicts occurred from the time of the earliest colonial settlements in the 17th century until the end of the 19th century. The various conflicts resulted from a wide variety of factors, the most common being the desire of settlers and governments for tribal lands. The European powers and their colonies enlisted allied Indian tribes to help them conduct warfare against each other's colonial settlements. After the American Revolution, many conflicts were local to specific states or regions and frequently involved disputes over land use; many involved retaliatory violence.

Ameriška revolucija (1765–1789) je bila politično gibanje v trinajstih kolonijah Velike Britanije. Začela se je kot kolonialni upor in prerasla v revolucijo, iz katere so nazadnje nastale Združene države, kar je bil izid z njo povezane ameriške osamosvojitvene vojne (1775–1783). Drugi celinski kongres je kot začasna vlada leta 1775 ustanovil celinsko vojsko in za njenega vrhovnega poveljnika imenoval Georgea Washingtona. Naslednje leto je kongres 2. julija sprejel Leejevo resolucijo, 4. julija pa soglasno deklaracijo o neodvisnosti. Izid vojne je bil večino časa negotov, a po zmagi Washingtona in celinske vojske pri obleganju Yorktowna leta 1781 sta se kralj Jurij III. in vladna koalicija Fox–North začela pogajati o koncu britanske kolonialne oblasti in priznanju ameriške suverenosti, kar so formalno potrdili s pariško pogodbo, podpisano 3. septembra 1783. Druga ameriška ustava je začela veljati leta 1789, listino pravic pa so ratificirali leta 1791.

source.title: American Revolution
paragraphs: The American Revolution (1765–1789) was a political movement in the Thirteen Colonies of Great Britain. It began as a colonial rebellion and turned into a revolution eventually resulting into the creation of the United States, which was the outcome of the associated American Revolutionary War (1775–1783). The Second Continental Congress, as the provisional government, established the Continental Army and appointed George Washington as its commander-in-chief in 1775. The following year, the Congress passed the Lee Resolution on July 2nd and unanimously adopted the Declaration of Independence on July 4th. Throughout most of the war, the outcome appeared uncertain, but a 1781 victory by Washington and the Continental Army in the Siege of Yorktown led King George III and the Fox–North coalition in government to negotiate the cessation of British colonial rule and the acknowledgment of American sovereignty, which was formalized in the Treaty of Paris, signed on September 3, 1783. The second U.S. Constitution took effect in 1789 and the Bill of Rights was ratified in 1791.

Angleško-povhatanske vojne so bile tri vojne, ki so jih v začetku 17. stoletja bojevali naseljenci kolonije Virginija in povhatanska konfederacija Tsenacommacah. Prva vojna se je začela leta 1609 in se leta 1614 končala z mirovnim sporazumom. Druga je trajala od leta 1622 do 1632, tretja pa od leta 1644 do 1646 in se je končala, ko so Opechancanougha ujeli in ubili. Po tej vojni je med Indijanci in kolonialno zemljo nastala določena meja, ki so jo smeli prestopiti le po uradnih opravkih s posebnim dovoljenjem. To stanje je trajalo do leta 1677 in pogodbe iz Middle Plantationa, ki je po Baconovem uporu ustanovila indijanske rezervate.

source.title: Anglo-Powhatan Wars
paragraphs: The Anglo–Powhatan Wars were three wars fought between settlers of the Colony of Virginia and the Powhatan Confederacy of Tsenacommacah in the early 17th century. The first war started in 1609 and ended in a peace settlement in 1614. The second war lasted from 1622 to 1632. The third war lasted from 1644 until 1646 and ended when Opechancanough was captured and killed. That war resulted in a defined boundary between the Native Americans and colonial lands that could only be crossed for official business with a special pass. This situation lasted until 1677 and the Treaty of Middle Plantation which established Indian reservations following Bacon's Rebellion.

Apache Wars.headline: Apaške vojne
paragraphs: Apaške vojne so bile vrsta oboroženih spopadov med vojsko Združenih držav in različnimi apaškimi plemenskimi zvezami, ki so med letoma 1849 in 1886 potekali na jugozahodu, manjši spopadi pa so se nadaljevali celo do leta 1924. Po mehiško-ameriški vojni leta 1846 so Združene države od Mehike priključile sporno ozemlje, kjer so živeli tako naseljenci kot apaška plemena. Spopadi so se nadaljevali, ko so ameriški naseljenci prihajali na tradicionalno apaško zemljo, da bi redili živino, gojili poljščine in kopali rude.

source.title: Apache Wars
paragraphs: The Apache Wars were a series of armed conflicts between the United States Army and various Apache tribal confederations fought in the southwest between 1849 and 1886, though minor hostilities continued until as late as 1924. After the Mexican–American War in 1846, the United States annexed conflicted territory from Mexico which was the home of both settlers and Apache tribes. Conflicts continued as American settlers came into traditional Apache lands to raise livestock and crops and to mine minerals.

Kampanja Appomattox je bila vrsta bitk ameriške državljanske vojne, ki so od 29. marca do 9. aprila 1865 potekale v Virginiji. Končala se je z vdajo Severnovirginijske armade konfederacijskega generala Roberta E. Leeja silam vojske Unije (Potomaški, Jamesovi in Shenandoaški armadi) pod vrhovnim poveljstvom generalporočnika Ulyssesa S. Granta, s čimer se je vojna dejansko končala.

source.title: Appomattox campaign
paragraphs: The Appomattox campaign was a series of American Civil War battles fought March 29 – April 9, 1865, in Virginia that concluded with the surrender of Confederate General Robert E. Lee's Army of Northern Virginia to forces of the Union Army (Army of the Potomac, Army of the James and Army of the Shenandoah) under the overall command of Lieutenant General Ulysses S. Grant, marking the effective end of the war.

Araukanska vojna je bil dolgotrajen spopad med kolonialnimi Španci in ljudstvom Mapuče, ki je večinoma potekal v čilski pokrajini Araukanija. Sprva so se Mapuči z njim odzvali na poskuse španskih osvajalcev, da bi ustanavljali mesta in domačine prisilili v podložništvo. Sčasoma se je vojna razvila v faze dolgotrajnih obleganj, pohodov za lov na sužnje, roparskih vpadov, kazenskih pohodov in novih španskih poskusov, da bi si zagotovili izgubljena ozemlja. Ugrabljanje žensk in vojna posilstva so bili pogosti na obeh straneh.

Španci so na ozemlje Mapučev prodrli med osvajanjem Čila v 16. stoletju. Zaustavila sta jih bitka pri Curalabi leta 1598 in uničenje sedmih mest. Nato sta strani vzpostavili jasno mejo med španskimi posestmi in deželo neodvisnih Mapučev. Od 17. do konca 18. stoletja so mapuški poglavarji (lonkos) in španski kraljevi guvernerji imeli vrsto parlamentov. Vojna se je izrodila v občasne roparske pohode obeh strani.

source.title: Arauco War
paragraphs: The Arauco War was a long-running conflict between colonial Spaniards and the Mapuche people, mostly fought in the Araucanía region of Chile. The conflict began at first as a reaction by the Mapuche to the Spanish conquerors attempting to establish cities and force the natives into servitude. It subsequently evolved over time into phases comprising drawn-out sieges, slave-hunting expeditions, pillaging raids, punitive expeditions, and renewed Spanish attempts to secure lost territories. Abduction of women and war rape was common on both sides.

The Spaniards penetrated into Mapuche territory during the conquest of Chile in the 16th century. They were stopped at the Battle of Curalaba in 1598 and the destruction of the Seven Cities. Afterward the two forces established a clear frontier between the Spanish domains and the land of the independent Mapuche. From the 17th to the late 18th century the Mapuche lonkos and Spanish royal governors held a series of parliaments. The war devolved to sporadic pillaging carried out by both sides.

Arctic Small Tool tradition.headline: Arktična tradicija drobnega orodja
paragraphs: Arktična tradicija drobnega orodja (ASTt) je bila široka kulturna skupnost, ki se je okoli leta 2500 pr. n. št. razvila ob Aljaškem polotoku, okoli Bristolskega zaliva in na vzhodni obali Beringove ožine. Njene skupine so bile prvi prebivalci arktične Kanade in Grenlandije. Šlo je za kopensko kulturo z zelo značilnim orodjem, ki je temeljilo na tehnologiji mikrorezil. Med tipičnimi orodji so strgala, vbadala ter stranska in konična rezila, ki so jih vstavljali v sestavljene puščice ali sulice iz drugih snovi, na primer kosti ali rogovja. Mnogi raziskovalci domnevajo tudi, da so prav te skupine na Arktiko prinesle lok in puščico, iz katerih se je pozneje razvila eskimska lokostrelska kultura. Tabore te tradicije pogosto najdejo ob obalah in potokih, kjer so lovili tjulnje in losose. Nekatere skupine so bile precej nomadske, na najdiščih pa so odkrili tudi trajnejša bivališča s strehami iz ruše.

source.title: Arctic Small Tool tradition
paragraphs: The Arctic Small Tool tradition (ASTt) was a broad cultural entity that developed along the Alaska Peninsula, around Bristol Bay, and on the eastern shores of the Bering Strait around 2500 BC. ASTt groups were the first human occupants of Arctic Canada and Greenland. This was a terrestrial entity that had a highly distinctive toolkit based on microblade technology. Typically tool types include scrapers, burins and side and end blades used in composite arrows or spears made of other materials, such as bone or antler. Many researchers also assume that it was Arctic Small Tool populations who first introduced the bow and arrow to the Arctic, that eventually became the Eskimo archery material culture. ASTt camps are often found along coasts and streams, to take advantage of seal or salmon populations. While some of the groups were fairly nomadic, more permanent, sod-roofed homes have also been identified from Arctic Small Tool tradition sites.

Argentinske državljanske vojne (špansko: Guerras civiles argentinas) so bile vrsta državljanskih spopadov različne jakosti, ki so od leta 1814 do 1853 potekali na ozemlju Argentine. Začele so se hkrati z argentinsko osamosvojitveno vojno (1810–1818) in preprečevale nastanek stabilne vlade vse do podpisa argentinske ustave leta 1853, nato pa so sledili redki spopadi, ki so se končali s federalizacijo Buenos Airesa leta 1880.

source.title: Argentine Civil Wars
paragraphs: The Argentine Civil Wars (Spanish: Guerras civiles argentinas) were a series of civil conflicts of varying intensity that took place from 1814 to 1853 in the territories of Argentina. Beginning concurrently with the Argentine War of Independence (1810 to 1818), the conflicts prevented the formation of a stable governing body until the signing of the Argentine Constitution of 1853, followed by low-frequency skirmishes that ended with the Federalization of Buenos Aires in 1880.

Argentinska konfederacija (špansko: Confederación Argentina) je bila zadnja predhodnica sodobne Argentine; njeno ime je po 35. členu argentinske ustave še vedno eno od uradnih imen države. Tako se je država imenovala od leta 1831 do 1852, ko so bile province povezane v konfederacijo brez voditelja države. Zunanje odnose je tedaj vodil guverner province Buenos Aires, večino obdobja Juan Manuel de Rosas. Pod njegovo vladavino se je konfederacija zapletla v spore z Brazilijo, Bolivijo, Urugvajem, Francijo in Združenim kraljestvom ter z drugimi argentinskimi frakcijami v argentinskih državljanskih vojnah.

Rosasa je leta 1852 po bitki pri Caserosu vrgel z oblasti Justo José de Urquiza, ki je leta 1853 sklical ustavodajno skupščino, da bi napisala državno ustavo. Buenos Aires se je Urquizi uprl, se leta 1852 odcepil od konfederacije in postal Država Buenos Aires; v Argentino se je provinca vrnila leta 1861.

source.title: Argentine Confederation
paragraphs: The Argentine Confederation (Spanish: Confederación Argentina) was the last predecessor state of modern Argentina; its name is still one of the official names of the country according to the Argentine Constitution, Article 35. It was the name of the country from 1831 to 1852, when the provinces were organized as a confederation without a head of state. The governor of Buenos Aires Province (Juan Manuel de Rosas during most of the period) managed foreign relations during this time. Under his rule, the Argentine Confederation engaged in conflicts with Brazil, Bolivia, Uruguay, France and the United Kingdom, as well as other Argentine factions during the Argentine Civil Wars.

Rosas was ousted from power in 1852 by Justo José de Urquiza, after the battle of Caseros. Urquiza convened the 1853 Constituent Assembly to write a national constitution. Buenos Aires resisted Urquiza and seceded from the Confederation in 1852, becoming the State of Buenos Aires; the province would return to Argentina in 1861.

Argentine War of Independence.headline: Argentinska osamosvojitvena vojna
paragraphs: Argentinska osamosvojitvena vojna (špansko: guerra de la independencia argentina) je bila vrsta vojaških dogodkov od leta 1810 do 1825, s katerimi se je Argentina utrdila kot država, neodvisna od španske oblasti. Zgodovinopisni izraz zajema bitke in vojaške podvige, kot je prečkanje Andov. Kongres v Tucumánu je formalno neodvisnost razglasil leta 1816.

source.title: Argentine War of Independence
paragraphs: The Argentine War of Independence (Spanish: guerra de la independencia argentina) was a set of military events from 1810 to 1825 which resulted in the consolidation of Argentina as an independent country from Spanish rule. The historiographical term encompasses battles and military feats such as the Crossing of the Andes. Formal independence was declared in 1816 by the Congress of Tucumán.

Arms Trade Treaty.headline: Pogodba o trgovini z orožjem
paragraphs: Pogodba o trgovini z orožjem (ATT) je večstranska pogodba, ki ureja mednarodno trgovino s konvencionalnim orožjem.
Veljati je začela 24. decembra 2014. Ratificiralo jo je 116 držav, nadaljnjih 26 pa jo je podpisalo, ne pa ratificiralo.

S pogodbo skušajo urediti mednarodno trgovino s konvencionalnim orožjem, da bi prispevali k mednarodnemu in regionalnemu miru, zmanjšali človeško trpljenje ter spodbujali sodelovanje, preglednost in odgovorno ravnanje držav in med njimi.

source.title: Arms Trade Treaty
paragraphs: The Arms Trade Treaty (ATT) is a multilateral treaty that regulates the international trade in conventional weapons.
It entered into force on 24 December 2014. 116 states have ratified the treaty, and a further 26 states have signed but not ratified it.

The ATT is an attempt to regulate the international trade of conventional weapons for the purpose of contributing to international and regional peace; reducing human suffering; and promoting co-operation, transparency, and responsible action by and among states.

Armstrong culture.headline: Kultura Armstrong
paragraphs: Kultura Armstrong je bila hopewellska skupina, ki je od leta 1 do 500 n. št. živela v dolini reke Big Sandy na severovzhodu Kentuckyja in zahodu Zahodne Virginije.

source.title: Armstrong culture
paragraphs: The Armstrong culture were a Hopewell group in the Big Sandy River Valley of Northeastern Kentucky and Western West Virginia from 1 to 500 CE.

Aroostook War.headline: Vojna za Aroostook
paragraphs: Vojna za Aroostook (včasih imenovana vojna svinjine in fižola) ali vojna za Madawasko je bila konfrontacija v letih 1838–1839, v kateri so sodelovali vojaki in civilisti, med Združenimi državami in Združenim kraljestvom za mednarodno mejo med britanskima kolonijama New Brunswick in Spodnja Kanada ter ameriško zvezno državo Maine. Izraz »vojna« je bil retoričen: krajevne enote milice so sicer vpoklicali, a se niso nikoli zares bojevale. Dogodek najbolje opiše oznaka mednarodni incident.

Spor so razrešila pogajanja med britanskim diplomatom lordom Ashburtonom in ameriškim zunanjim ministrom Danielom Webstrom. Pogodba Webster–Ashburton iz leta 1842 je določila dokončno mejo med državama: večino spornega ozemlja je dobil Maine, ohranila pa se je kopenska povezava med Spodnjo Kanado in pomorskimi kolonijami.

source.title: Aroostook War
paragraphs: The Aroostook War (sometimes called the Pork and Beans War), or the Madawaska War, was a military and civilian-involved confrontation in 1838–1839 between the United States and the United Kingdom over the international boundary between the British colonies of New Brunswick and Lower Canada and the U.S. state of Maine. The term "war" was rhetorical; local militia units were called out but never engaged in actual combat. The event is best described as an international incident.

Negotiations between British diplomat Lord Ashburton and US Secretary of State Daniel Webster settled the dispute. The Webster–Ashburton Treaty of 1842 established the final boundary between the countries, giving most of the disputed area to Maine while preserving an overland connection between Lower Canada and the Maritime colonies.

Atlanta campaign.headline: Kampanja za Atlanto
paragraphs: Kampanja za Atlanto je bila vrsta bitk na zahodnem bojišču ameriške državljanske vojne, ki so poleti 1864 potekale po severozahodni Georgii in okolici Atlante. Generalmajor Unije William T. Sherman je maja 1864 iz okolice Chattanooge v Tennesseeju vdrl v Georgio, nasproti pa mu je stal konfederacijski general Joseph E. Johnston.

Johnstonova Tennesseejska armada se je pred zaporednimi Shermanovimi obkoljevalnimi manevri umikala proti Atlanti. Julija je konfederacijski predsednik Jefferson Davis Johnstona zamenjal z bojevitejšim generalom Johnom B. Hoodom, ki je vojski Unije začel nasprotovati z vrsto dragih čelnih napadov. Hoodovo vojsko so nazadnje obkolili v Atlanti, mesto je padlo 2. septembra, kar je pripravilo pot Shermanovemu pohodu do morja in pospešilo konec vojne.

source.title: Atlanta campaign
paragraphs: The Atlanta campaign was a series of battles fought in the western theater of the American Civil War throughout northwest Georgia and the area around Atlanta during the summer of 1864. Union Major General William T. Sherman invaded Georgia from the vicinity of Chattanooga, Tennessee, beginning in May 1864, opposed by the Confederate general Joseph E. Johnston.

Johnston's Army of Tennessee withdrew toward Atlanta in the face of successive flanking maneuvers by Sherman's group of armies. In July, the Confederate president, Jefferson Davis, replaced Johnston with the more aggressive General John B. Hood, who began challenging the Union Army in a series of costly frontal assaults. Hood's army was eventually besieged in Atlanta and the city fell on September 2, setting the stage for Sherman's March to the Sea and hastening the end of the war.

Ko je demokratski kandidat Joe Biden zmagal na ameriških predsedniških volitvah leta 2020, se je republikanski kandidat in tedanji predsednik Donald Trump s podporo svoje kampanje, posrednikov, političnih zaveznikov in mnogih privržencev lotil brezprimernega poskusa, da bi volitve razveljavil. Ta prizadevanja so dosegla vrhunec z napadom na Kapitol 6. januarja, ki ga več virov opisuje kot poskus samoudara. Trump in zavezniki so s propagandno tehniko »velike laži« širili lažne trditve in teorije zarote, da so bile volitve ukradene s prirejenimi volilnimi napravami, volilnimi goljufijami in mednarodno zaroto. Trump je pritiskal na vodstvo pravosodnega ministrstva, naj izpodbija izid in javno izjavi, da so bile volitve pokvarjene. Generalni državni tožilec, direktor nacionalne obveščevalne službe, direktor agencije za kibernetsko varnost in varnost infrastrukture, sodniki zveznih držav in zvezni sodniki, volilni uradniki in guvernerji zveznih držav so te trditve že tedaj zavrnili.

source.title: Attempts to overturn the 2020 United States presidential election
paragraphs: After Democratic nominee Joe Biden won the 2020 United States presidential election, Republican nominee and then-incumbent president Donald Trump pursued an unprecedented effort to overturn the election, with support from his campaign, proxies, political allies, and many of his supporters. These efforts culminated in the January 6 Capitol attack, described by multiple sources as a self-coup d'état attempt. Trump and his allies used the "big lie" propaganda technique to promote false claims and conspiracy theories asserting that the election was stolen by means of rigged voting machines, electoral fraud and an international conspiracy. Trump pressed Department of Justice leaders to challenge the results and publicly state the election was corrupt. The attorney general, director of national intelligence, director of the cybersecurity and infrastructure security agency, state and federal judges, election officials, and state governors dismissed these claims at the time.

Aymara lordships.headline: Ajmarska gospostva
paragraphs: Ajmarska gospostva, imenovana tudi ajmarska kraljestva ali kraljestva ob jezeru, so bila skupina domorodnih političnih skupnosti, ki so se razcvetele proti poznemu vmesnemu obdobju, po padcu Tiahunaškega imperija, v pokrajini Qullaw. Razvijala so se med letoma 1150 in 1477, nato pa so izginila, ko jih je vojaško osvojil Inkovski imperij. Današnje ajmarsko prebivalstvo v Boliviji, Peruju, Čilu in Argentini kljub temu šteje približno dva milijona ljudi. Govorili so ajmarščino in puquinščino.

source.title: Aymara lordships
paragraphs: The Aymara lordships, Aymara kingdoms, or lake kingdoms were a group of native polities that flourished towards the Late Intermediate Period, after the fall of the Tiwanaku Empire, whose societies were geographically located in the Qullaw. They were developed between 1150 and 1477, before the kingdoms disappeared due to the military conquest of the Inca Empire. But the current Aymara population is estimated at two million located in the countries of Bolivia, Peru, Chile and Argentina. They used the Aymara and Puquina languages.

Bahrain–Israel normalization agreement.headline: Sporazum o normalizaciji odnosov med Bahrajnom in Izraelom
paragraphs: Sporazum o normalizaciji odnosov med Bahrajnom in Izraelom, uradno Abrahamovi sporazumi: deklaracija o miru, sodelovanju ter konstruktivnih diplomatskih in prijateljskih odnosih, je sporazum o normalizaciji diplomatskih in drugih odnosov med državama. Napovedal ga je predsednik Donald Trump 11. septembra 2020, sledil pa je skupni izjavi Združenih držav, Izraela in Združenih arabskih emiratov (ZAE) z dne 13. avgusta 2020, uradno imenovani Abrahamovi sporazumi. Formalno so ga podpisali 15. septembra 2020 v Beli hiši v Washingtonu; Bahrajn je tako postal četrta arabska država, ki je priznala Izrael, in druga v enem mesecu.

source.title: Bahrain–Israel normalization agreement
paragraphs: The Bahrain–Israel normalization agreement, officially Abraham Accords: Declaration of Peace, Cooperation, and Constructive Diplomatic and Friendly Relations, is an agreement to normalize diplomatic and other relations between Bahrain and Israel. The agreement was announced by President Donald Trump on September 11, 2020, and followed on from a joint statement, officially referred to as the Abraham Accords, by the United States, Israel and the United Arab Emirates (UAE) on August 13, 2020. It was formally signed on September 15, 2020, at the White House in Washington, D.C., and made Bahrain the fourth Arab state to recognize Israel and the second within a month.

Baptistična vojna je bil enajstdnevni upor, ki se je začel 25. decembra 1831 in v katerem je sodelovalo do 60.000 od 300.000 sužnjev v koloniji Jamajka. Upor je vodil temnopolti baptistični diakon Samuel Sharpe, bojevali pa so se predvsem njegovi privrženci. Čeprav je bil vojaško neuspešen, je odločilno prispeval k odpravi suženjstva v vsem Britanskem imperiju.
Znan je tudi kot upor Sama Sharpa, božični upor, božična vstaja in veliki jamajški upor sužnjev v letih 1831–1832.

source.title: Baptist War
paragraphs: The Baptist War was an eleven-day rebellion that started on 25 December 1831 and involved up to 60,000 of the 300,000 slaves in the Colony of Jamaica. The uprising was led by a black Baptist deacon, Samuel Sharpe, and waged largely by his followers. The revolt, though militarily unsuccessful, played a major part in the abolition of slavery throughout the British Empire.
It is also known as the Sam Sharp Rebellion, the Christmas Rebellion, the Christmas Uprising and the Great Jamaican Slave Revolt of 1831–32.

Battle of Acosta Ñu.headline: Bitka pri Acosta Ñu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Acosta Ñu (v gvaranščini: Acosta Ñu ñorairõ), v Paragvaju znana tudi kot bitka otrok (Batalla de los Niños), v Braziliji pa kot bitka pri Campo Grande (Batalha de Campo Grande), je potekala 16. avgusta 1869. Bila je zadnji večji spopad paragvajske vojne med trojno zvezo in Paragvajem. Nasproti 20.000 brazilskim in argentinskim veteranom je stalo 3500 slabo oboroženih Paragvajcev, večinoma dečkov med devetim in petnajstim letom, starcev in ranjenih borcev.

source.title: Battle of Acosta Ñu
paragraphs: The Battle of Acosta Ñu (Guarani: Acosta Ñu ñorairõ), also known as the Children's Battle (Spanish: Batalla de los Niños) in Paraguay and the Battle of Campo Grande (Portuguese: Batalha de Campo Grande) in Brazil, took place on 16 August 1869. It was the last major engagement of the Paraguayan War between the Triple Alliance and Paraguay. The 3,500 poorly armed Paraguayans, mostly boys between nine and fifteen years old, old men and wounded combatants, confronted 20,000 Brazilian and Argentine veteran soldiers.

Bitka pri Antietamu, imenovana tudi bitka pri Sharpsburgu (zlasti na jugu Združenih držav), je potekala med ameriško državljansko vojno 17. septembra 1862 pri potoku Antietam in kraju Sharpsburg v Marylandu, med Severnovirginijsko armado konfederacijskega generala Roberta E. Leeja in Potomaško armado generalmajorja Unije Georgea B. McClellana. Bila je del marylandske kampanje in prvi spopad na ravni poljskih armad na vzhodnem bojišču ameriške državljanske vojne, ki je potekal na ozemlju Unije. Še vedno je najbolj krvavi dan v ameriški zgodovini, saj je bilo na obeh straneh skupaj 22.726 mrtvih, ranjenih ali pogrešanih. Čeprav je imela vojska Unije večje izgube kot konfederacijska, je bila bitka velika prelomnica v korist Unije.
notes: The pronunciation respelling is left out.

source.title: Battle of Antietam
paragraphs: The Battle of Antietam ( an-TEE-təm), also called the Battle of Sharpsburg (particularly in the Southern United States) took place during the American Civil War on September 17, 1862, near Antietam Creek and Sharpsburg, Maryland, between the Army of Northern Virginia, led by Confederate General Robert E. Lee, and the Army of the Potomac, led by Union Major General George B. McClellan. Part of the Maryland Campaign, it was the first field army–level engagement in the Eastern Theater of the American Civil War to take place on Union soil. It remains the bloodiest day in American history, with a tally of 22,726 dead, wounded, or missing on both sides. Although the Union army suffered heavier casualties than the Confederates, the battle was a major turning point in the Union's favor.

Battle of Appomattox Court House.headline: Bitka pri Appomattox Court House
paragraphs: Bitka pri Appomattox Court House, bojevana zjutraj 9. aprila 1865 v okrožju Appomattox v Virginiji, je bila ena zadnjih in navsezadnje ena najusodnejših bitk ameriške državljanske vojne (1861–1865). Bil je zadnji poskus vrhovnega poveljnika konfederacijske vojske Roberta E. Leeja in njegove Severnovirginijske armade, preden sta se vdala Potomaški armadi Unije pod poveljstvom poveljujočega generala vojske Združenih držav Ulyssesa S. Granta.

source.title: Battle of Appomattox Court House
paragraphs: The Battle of Appomattox Court House, fought in Appomattox County, Virginia, on the morning of April 9, 1865, was one of the last, and ultimately one of the most consequential, battles of the American Civil War (1861–1865). It was the final push of Confederate general in chief Robert E. Lee and his Army of Northern Virginia before they surrendered to the Union Army of the Potomac under the Commanding General of the United States Army, Ulysses S. Grant.

Battle of Arkansas Post.headline: Bitka pri Arkansas Postu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Arkansas Postu, znana tudi kot bitka pri utrdbi Hindman, je od 9. do 11. januarja 1863 potekala ob reki Arkansas pri kraju Arkansas Post v Arkansasu, v okviru kampanje za Vicksburg v ameriški državljanski vojni. Konfederacijske sile so utrdbo Hindman pri Arkansas Postu zgradile konec leta 1862. Konec istega leta je generalmajor John A. McClernand iz vojske Unije (kot so med vojno imenovali vojsko Združenih držav) dobil dovoljenje, da na Srednjem zahodu nabere vojake za pohod po Misisipiju navzdol proti Vicksburgu v Misisipiju. Generalmajor Unije Ulysses S. Grant je novembra začel kopenski pohod proti Vicksburgu ob železnici Mississippi Central. Z vrhovnim poveljnikom Unije Henryjem Halleckom McClernandu nista zaupala, zato sta s spletkami dosegla, da je začetek rečnega pohoda proti Vicksburgu prevzel generalmajor William T. Sherman, še preden je McClernand prispel. Shermanov pohod so konec decembra porazili v bitki pri Chickasaw Bayou, konfederacijski konjeniški vpadi pa so Granta prisilili, da je kopenski pohod opustil.

source.title: Battle of Arkansas Post
paragraphs: The Battle of Arkansas Post, also known as the Battle of Fort Hindman, was fought from January 9 to 11, 1863, along the Arkansas River at Arkansas Post, Arkansas, as part of the Vicksburg campaign of the American Civil War. Confederate forces constructed Fort Hindman near Arkansas Post in late 1862. Also in late 1862, Major General John A. McClernand of the Union army (as the United States Army was known during the war) was authorized to recruit troops in the Midwest for an expedition down the Mississippi River against Vicksburg, Mississippi. Union Major General Ulysses S. Grant began an overland campaign against Vicksburg along the Mississippi Central Railroad in November. He and Union General-in-Chief Henry Halleck did not trust McClernand, and through machinations placed the start of the riverine movement against Vicksburg under the command of Major General William T. Sherman before McClernand could arrive. Sherman's movement was defeated at the Battle of Chickasaw Bayou in late December, and Confederate cavalry raids forced Grant to abandon his overland campaign.

Battle of Atlanta.headline: Bitka pri Atlanti
paragraphs: Bitka pri Atlanti je potekala med kampanjo za Atlanto v ameriški državljanski vojni 22. julija 1864, tik jugovzhodno od Atlante v Georgii. Sile Unije pod poveljstvom Williama T. Shermana so v poletnem pohodu za zavzetje Atlante, pomembnega železniškega in oskrbovalnega vozlišča, premagale konfederacijske sile Johna B. Hooda, ki so branile mesto. V bitki je padel generalmajor Unije James B. McPherson, drugi najvišji častnik Unije, ki je padel v tej vojni. Čeprav ime namiguje na odločilni spopad, je bitka potekala sredi kampanje, mesto pa je padlo šele 2. septembra 1864, po obleganju Unije in več poskusih, da bi zavzeli železnice in oskrbovalne poti do Atlante. Po zavzetju mesta so Shermanove čete s pohodom do morja krenile proti jugu-jugovzhodu, proti glavnemu mestu zvezne države Milledgeville in naprej proti Savannahu.

source.title: Battle of Atlanta
paragraphs: The Battle of Atlanta took place during the Atlanta campaign of the American Civil War on July 22, 1864, just southeast of Atlanta, Georgia. Continuing their summer campaign to seize the important rail and supply hub of Atlanta, Union forces commanded by William T. Sherman overwhelmed and defeated Confederate forces defending the city under John B. Hood. Union Major General James B. McPherson was killed during the battle, the second-highest-ranking Union officer killed in action during the war. Despite the implication of finality in its name, the battle occurred midway through the Atlanta campaign, and the city did not fall until September 2, 1864, after a Union siege and various attempts to seize railroads and supply lines leading to Atlanta. After taking the city, Sherman's troops headed south-southeastward toward Milledgeville, the state capital, and on to Savannah with the March to the Sea.

Battle of Ayacucho.headline: Bitka pri Ayacuchu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ayacuchu (špansko: Batalla de Ayacucho) je bil odločilni vojaški spopad perujske osamosvojitvene vojne. Zagotovila je neodvisnost Peruja in tudi drugih vojskujočih se južnoameriških držav. V Peruju velja za konec hispanskoameriških osamosvojitvenih vojn, vendar se je pohod Antonia Joséja de Sucreja v Gornjem Peruju nadaljeval do leta 1825, obleganje utrdb Chiloé in Callao pa se je končalo šele leta 1826.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Battle of Ayacucho
paragraphs: The Battle of Ayacucho (Spanish: Batalla de Ayacucho, IPA: [baˈtaʎa ðe aʝaˈkutʃo]) was a decisive military encounter during the Peruvian War of Independence. This battle secured the independence of Peru and ensured independence for the rest of belligerent South American states. In Peru, it is considered the end of the Spanish American wars of independence. However, the campaign of Antonio José de Sucre continued through 1825 in Upper Peru, and the siege of the fortresses Chiloé and Callao eventually ended in 1826.

Bitka pri Baltimoru je potekala med britanskimi in ameriškimi silami od 12. do 14. septembra 1814, med vojno leta 1812. Ameriški branilci so odbili britanske vdore z morja in kopnega pri živahnem velikem pristaniškem mestu Baltimore v Marylandu, s čimer so preprečili, da bi tedaj tretje največje mesto Združenih držav padlo v britanske roke, in končali britansko kampanjo v zalivu Chesapeake.

Britanci in Američani so se najprej spopadli v bitki pri North Pointu. Američani so bili taktično poraženi in so se morali umakniti, a je bitka uspešno zavlekla britansko napredovanje: Britancem je prizadejala velike izgube, med drugim je padel poveljujoči general Robert Ross, ustavila je njihov pohod, branilci Baltimora pa so se lahko pripravili na napad.

Odpor baltimorske utrdbe McHenry med obstreljevanjem kraljeve mornarice je Francisa Scotta Keya navdihnil za pesem »Defence of Fort M'Henry« (»Obramba utrdbe M'Henry«), ki je pozneje postala besedilo ameriške državne himne »The Star-Spangled Banner« (»Z zvezdami posuta zastava«).

source.title: Battle of Baltimore
paragraphs: The Battle of Baltimore took place between British and American forces on September 12–14, 1814, during the War of 1812. Defending American forces repulsed sea and land invasions off the busy major port city of Baltimore, Maryland, by British forces preventing the United States' third largest city at the time from falling to British forces and ending the British Chesapeake campaign.

The British and Americans first met at the Battle of North Point. Though the Americans were tactically defeated and forced to retreat, the battle was a successful delaying action that inflicted significant casualties on the British including the commanding general Robert Ross, halted their advance, and allowed the defenders at Baltimore to prepare for an attack.

The resistance of Baltimore's Fort McHenry during bombardment by the Royal Navy inspired Francis Scott Key to compose the poem "Defence of Fort M'Henry", which later became the lyrics for "The Star-Spangled Banner," the national anthem of the United States.

Battle of Beauport.headline: Bitka pri Beauportu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Beauportu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Montmorencyju, bojevana 31. julija 1759, je bila pomemben spopad med britanskimi in francoskimi oboroženimi silami med sedemletno vojno (znano tudi kot francosko-indijanska vojna in osvajalna vojna) za francosko provinco Kanado. Britanski napad na francosko obrambno črto pri Beauportu, okoli 5 kilometrov vzhodno od Quebeca, so zaustavili, vojska generala Jamesa Wolfa pa se je umaknila s 443 mrtvimi, ranjenimi in pogrešanimi.

source.title: Battle of Beauport
paragraphs: The Battle of Beauport, also known as the Battle of Montmorency, fought on 31 July 1759, was an important confrontation between the British and French armed forces during the Seven Years' War (also known as the French and Indian War and the War of Conquest) of the French province of Canada. The attack conducted by the British against the French defense line of Beauport, some 5 kilometres (3.1 mi) east of Quebec was checked, and the army of General James Wolfe retreated with 443 casualties and losses.

Battle of Belmont.headline: Bitka pri Belmontu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Belmontu je potekala 7. novembra 1861 v okrožju Mississippi v Missouriju. Bila je prva bojna preizkušnja v ameriški državljanski vojni za brigadnega generala Ulyssesa S. Granta, poznejšega vrhovnega poveljnika vojske Unije in nazadnje predsednika ZDA, ki se je bojeval proti generalmajorju Leonidasu Polku. Grantove čete v tej bitki so bile »jedro« poznejše Tennesseejske armade Unije.

source.title: Battle of Belmont
paragraphs: The Battle of Belmont was fought on November 7, 1861, in Mississippi County, Missouri. It was the first combat test in the American Civil War for Brig. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant, the future Union Army general in chief and eventual U.S. president, who was fighting Major General Leonidas Polk. Grant's troops in this battle were the "nucleus" of what would become the Union Army of the Tennessee.

Battle of Bentonville.headline: Bitka pri Bentonvillu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bentonvillu (19.–21. marca 1865) je potekala v okrožju Johnston v Severni Karolini blizu vasi Bentonville, v okviru zahodnega bojišča ameriške državljanske vojne. Bila je zadnja bitka med zahodnima poljskima armadama Williama T. Shermana in Josepha E. Johnstona.

source.title: Battle of Bentonville
paragraphs: The Battle of Bentonville (March 19–21, 1865) was fought in Johnston County, North Carolina, near the village of Bentonville, as part of the Western Theater of the American Civil War. It was the last battle between the western field armies of William T. Sherman and Joseph E. Johnston.

Battle of Big Bethel.headline: Bitka pri Big Bethelu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Big Bethelu, znana tudi kot bitka pri cerkvi Bethel ali Great Bethel, je bila ena najzgodnejših kopenskih bitk ameriške državljanske vojne. Potekala je 10. junija 1861 na Virginijskem polotoku blizu Newport Newsa.

Odločitev Virginije, da se odcepi od Unije, so volivci potrdili 23. maja, konfederacijskega polkovnika (pozneje generalmajorja) Johna B. Magruderja pa so poslali na polotok, da bi odvrnil morebitno napredovanje čet Unije iz dobro branjene utrdbe Monroe proti prestolnici zvezne države Richmondu. Garniziji je poveljeval generalmajor Benjamin Butler, nekdanji odvetnik in politik iz Massachusettsa, ki je postavil nov tabor v bližnjem Hamptonu in še enega v Newport Newsu. Magruder je v dosegu črt Unije postavil dva tabora, pri Big Bethelu in Little Bethelu, da bi nasprotnika zvabil v prenagljen spopad.

source.title: Battle of Big Bethel
paragraphs: The Battle of Big Bethel, also known as the Battle of Bethel Church or Great Bethel, was one of the earliest land battles of the American Civil War. It took place on the Virginia Peninsula, near Newport News, on June 10, 1861.

Virginia's decision to secede from the Union had been ratified by popular vote on May 23, and Confederate colonel (later major general) John B. Magruder was sent down the peninsula to deter any advance on the state capital Richmond by Union troops based at the well-defended post of Fort Monroe. This garrison was commanded by Major General Benjamin Butler, a former Massachusetts lawyer and politician, who established a new camp at nearby Hampton and another at Newport News. Magruder had also established two camps within range of the Union lines, at Big Bethel and Little Bethel, to lure his opponent into a premature action.

Battle of Blair Mountain.headline: Bitka na gori Blair
paragraphs: Bitka na gori Blair je bila največja delavska vstaja v zgodovini Združenih držav in največja oborožena vstaja po ameriški državljanski vojni. Spopad je potekal v okrožju Logan v Zahodni Virginiji v okviru premogovnih vojn, vrste delavskih sporov v Apalačih v začetku 20. stoletja.

Pet dni, od konca avgusta do začetka septembra 1921, se je 10.000 oboroženih rudarjev spopadalo s 3000 policisti in stavkokazi (imenovanimi branilci Logana), ki so jih podpirali lastniki premogovnikov, ko so rudarji ob zaostrenih odnosih z vodstvom rudnikov skušali sindikalno organizirati premogovna polja na jugozahodu Zahodne Virginije. Bitka se je končala, ko so izstrelili približno milijon nabojev in je po predsednikovem ukazu posredovala vojska Združenih držav, ki jo je zastopala nacionalna garda Zahodne Virginije pod vodstvom Williama Eubanksa iz okrožja McDowell.

source.title: Battle of Blair Mountain
paragraphs: The Battle of Blair Mountain was the largest labor uprising in United States history and is the largest armed uprising since the American Civil War. The conflict occurred in Logan County, West Virginia, as part of the Coal Wars, a series of early-20th-century labor disputes in Appalachia.

For five days, from late August to early September 1921, 10,000 armed coal miners confronted 3,000 lawmen and strikebreakers (called the Logan Defenders) who were backed by coal mine operators during the miners' attempt to unionize the southwestern West Virginia coalfields when tensions rose between workers and mine management. The battle ended after approximately one million rounds were fired, and the United States Army, represented by the West Virginia National Guard, which was led by McDowell County native William Eubanks, intervened by presidential order.

Battle of Boyacá.headline: Bitka pri Boyacáju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Boyacáju (1819), znana tudi kot bitka pri mostu Boyacá, je bila odločilna zmaga združene vojske venezuelskih in novogranadskih čet ter britanske legije pod vodstvom generala Simóna Bolívarja nad III. divizijo španske ekspedicijske vojske Costa Firme, ki ji je poveljeval španski polkovnik José María Barreiro. Zmaga je zagotovila uspeh Bolívarjevega pohoda za osvoboditev Nove Granade. Velja za prelomno točko v osamosvojitvi severa Južne Amerike, saj je omogočila nadaljnje zmage domoljubov v bitkah pri Caraboboju v Venezueli, Pichinchi v Ekvadorju ter Junínu in Ayacuchu v Peruju. Nova Granada je dokončno postala neodvisna od španske monarhije, čeprav so se boji z rojalističnimi silami nadaljevali še leta.

source.title: Battle of Boyacá
paragraphs: The Battle of Boyacá (1819), also known as the Battle of Boyacá Bridge, was a decisive victory by a combined army of Venezuelan and New Granadan troops along with a British Legion led by General Simon Bolivar over the III Division of the Spanish Expeditionary Army of Costa Firme commanded by Spanish Colonel José María Barreiro. This victory ensured the success of Bolívar's campaign to liberate New Granada. The battle of Boyacá is considered a crucial point in the independence of the north of South America, as it allowed further patriot victories at the battles of Carabobo in Venezuela, Pichincha in Ecuador, and Junín and Ayacucho in Peru. New Granada acquired its definitive independence from the Spanish Monarchy, although fighting with royalist forces would continue for years.

Battle of Brandy Station.headline: Bitka pri Brandy Stationu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Brandy Stationu, imenovana tudi bitka pri Fleetwood Hillu, je bila največji pretežno konjeniški spopad ameriške državljanske vojne in največji, kar jih je bilo kdaj na ameriških tleh. Potekala je 9. junija 1863 okoli Brandy Stationa v Virginiji, na začetku kampanje za Gettysburg, med konjenico Unije pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Alfreda Pleasontona in konfederacijsko konjenico generalmajorja J. E. B. Stuarta.

Poveljnik Unije Pleasonton je ob zori presenetljivo napadel Stuartovo konjenico pri Brandy Stationu. Po celodnevnem boju, v katerem se je sreča večkrat obrnila, so se zvezni umaknili, ne da bi odkrili pehoto generala Roberta E. Leeja, utaborjeno blizu Culpeperja. Bitka je pomenila konec premoči konfederacijske konjenice na vzhodu; od tedaj se je zvezna konjenica krepila in pridobivala samozavest.

source.title: Battle of Brandy Station
paragraphs: The Battle of Brandy Station, also called the Battle of Fleetwood Hill, was the largest predominantly cavalry engagement of the American Civil War, as well as the largest ever to take place on American soil. It was fought on June 9, 1863, around Brandy Station, Virginia, at the beginning of the Gettysburg campaign by the Union cavalry under Maj. Gen. Alfred Pleasonton against Maj. Gen. J. E. B. Stuart's Confederate cavalry.

Union commander Pleasonton launched a surprise dawn attack on Stuart's cavalry at Brandy Station. After an all-day fight in which fortunes changed repeatedly, the Federals retired without discovering Gen. Robert E. Lee's infantry camped near Culpeper. This battle marked the end of the Confederate cavalry's dominance in the East. From this point in the war, the Federal cavalry gained strength and confidence.

Bitka pri Bueni Visti (22.–23. februarja 1847), v Mehiki znana kot bitka pri La Angosturi, včasih pa kot bitka pri Bueni Visti/La Angosturi, je bila bitka mehiško-ameriške vojne. Bojevale so se ameriške sile, večinoma prostovoljci, pod poveljstvom generala Zacharyja Taylorja in precej večja mehiška vojska pod poveljstvom generala Antonia Lópeza de Santa Anne. Potekala je blizu vasi Buena Vista v zvezni državi Coahuila, okoli 12 km južno od Saltilla v Mehiki; La Angostura (»ožina«) je bilo krajevno ime za to mesto. Izida ni bilo mogoče predvideti: nekateri dejavniki bi Mehičanom kljub splošni ameriški premoči lahko prinesli pravo zmago na bojišču. Po prvem dnevu je »veliko Američanov … verjelo, da bo ameriška vojska kmalu razpadla, ko se bo naslednji dan boj nadaljeval«.

source.title: Battle of Buena Vista
paragraphs: The Battle of Buena Vista (February 22–23, 1847), known as the Battle of La Angostura in Mexico, and sometimes as Battle of Buena Vista/La Angostura, was a battle of the Mexican–American War. It was fought between U.S. forces, largely volunteers, under General Zachary Taylor, and the much larger Mexican Army under General Antonio López de Santa Anna. It took place near Buena Vista, a village in the state of Coahuila, about 12 km (7.5 mi) south of Saltillo, Mexico. La Angostura ("the narrow place") was the local name for the site. The outcome of this battle was unforeseeable: there were factors that could grant Mexicans a proper victory on the battlefield, despite the US overall superiority. After the first day "many Americans … believed that the American army would soon collapse when the fighting began the next day".

Battle of Cajamarca.headline: Bitka pri Cajamarci
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cajamarci, pisano tudi Cajamalca (mnogi današnji raziskovalci jo raje imenujejo pokol v Cajamarci), je bila zaseda, v kateri je majhna španska enota pod vodstvom Francisca Pizarra 16. novembra 1532 zajela inkovskega vladarja Atahualpo. Španci so na velikem trgu v Cajamarci pobili na tisoče Atahualpovih svetovalcev, poveljnikov in neoboroženih spremljevalcev, njegovo oboroženo vojsko zunaj mesta pa pognali v beg. Z Atahualpovim ujetjem se je začela osvojitev predkolumbovske civilizacije Peruja.

source.title: Battle of Cajamarca
