paragraphs: The Battle of Cajamarca, also spelled Cajamalca (though many contemporary scholars prefer to call it the Cajamarca massacre), was the ambush and seizure of the Incan ruler Atahualpa by a small Spanish force led by Francisco Pizarro, on November 16, 1532. The Spanish killed thousands of Atahualpa's counselors, commanders, and unarmed attendants in the great plaza of Cajamarca, and caused his armed host outside the town to flee. The capture of Atahualpa marked the opening stage of the conquest of the pre-Columbian civilization of Peru.

Battle of Camarón.headline: Bitka pri Camarónu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Camarónu (francosko: Bataille de Camerone) je bil zadnji obupni spopad 30. aprila 1863 med francosko tujsko legijo in mehiško vojsko, med drugo francosko intervencijo v Mehiki (1861–1867). Majhen francoski odred s 65 možmi pod vodstvom stotnika Jeana Danjouja je spremljal oskrbovalni konvoj, ko ga je pri vasi Camarón de Tejeda v Veracruzu obkolilo okoli 2000 mehiških vojakov. Legionarji so večkrat zavrnili poziv k vdaji in se odločno branili na posestvu Hacienda Camarón, kjer so zdržali skoraj enajst ur, dokler niso bili vsi mrtvi, ranjeni ali ujeti.

Čeprav je bil spopad taktični poraz, je postal slavna epizoda francoske vojaške zgodovine. Nesorazmerni odpor, ki je Mehičane stal več kot 800 mrtvih in ranjenih, so v Franciji imeli za moralno zmago in simbol discipline, žrtvovanja in moštvenega duha. Danjou, ki je padel v boju, je postal trajni simbol vrednot legije, njegova lesena proteza roke pa je danes njena najbolj čaščena relikvija.

source.title: Battle of Camarón
paragraphs: The Battle of Camarón (French: Bataille de Camerone) was a last stand engagement fought on 30 April 1863 between the French Foreign Legion and the Mexican Army, during the Second French intervention in Mexico (1861–1867). A small French detachment of 65 men, led by Captain Jean Danjou, was escorting a supply convoy when it was surrounded near the village of Camarón de Tejeda in Veracruz by a force of around 2,000 Mexican troops. Refusing repeated calls to surrender, the legionnaires made a determined defensive stand at the Hacienda Camarón, holding out for nearly eleven hours until they were either killed, wounded, or captured.

Although a tactical defeat, the action became a celebrated episode in French military history. The disproportionate resistance, which resulted in over 800 Mexican casualties, was regarded in France as a moral victory and a symbol of discipline, sacrifice, and esprit de corps. Danjou, who was killed in action, became an enduring symbol of the Legion's values, and his wooden prosthetic hand is now its most venerated relic.

Battle of Carabobo.headline: Bitka pri Caraboboju
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Caraboboju (špansko: Batalla de Carabobo) je 24. junija 1821 potekala med borci za neodvisnost pod vodstvom venezuelskega generala Simóna Bolívarja in rojalističnimi silami pod vodstvom španskega feldmaršala Miguela de la Torreja. Bolívarjeva odločilna zmaga pri Caraboboju je pripeljala do neodvisnosti Venezuele in ustanovitve Republike Velika Kolumbija.

source.title: Battle of Carabobo
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Carabobo (Spanish: Batalla de Carabobo), on 24 June 1821, was fought between independence fighters, led by Venezuelan General Simón Bolívar, and the Royalist forces, led by Spanish Field Marshal Miguel de la Torre. Bolívar's decisive victory at Carabobo led to the independence of Venezuela and establishment of the Republic of Gran Colombia.

Battle of Carillon.headline: Bitka pri Carillonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Carillonu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Ticonderogi, je potekala 8. julija 1758 med francosko-indijansko vojno (ki je bila del sedemletne vojne). Bojevali so se pri utrdbi Carillon (danes Fort Ticonderoga) na obali jezera Champlain, na obmejnem območju med britansko kolonijo New York in francosko kolonijo Nova Francija.

Bitka je potekala predvsem na vzpetini približno kilometer od same utrdbe. Francoska vojska s približno 4000 možmi pod poveljstvom generala markiza de Montcalma in viteza de Lévisa je premagala številčnejše britanske čete generala Jamesa Abercrombieja, ki so brez poljskega topništva čelno napadle utrjeni francoski položaj; ta pomanjkljivost je Britance in njihove zaveznike pustila ranljive in Francozom omogočila popolno zmago. Bitka je bila najbolj krvava na ameriškem bojišču te vojne, z več kot 3000 mrtvimi in ranjenimi: francoske izgube so znašale okoli 400 mož, britanske več kot 2000.

source.title: Battle of Carillon
paragraphs: The Battle of Carillon, also known as the Battle of Ticonderoga, was fought on July 8, 1758, during the French and Indian War (which was part of the Seven Years' War). It was fought near Fort Carillon (now known as Fort Ticonderoga) on the shore of Lake Champlain in the frontier area between the British colony of New York and the French colony of New France.

In the battle, which took place primarily on a rise about three-quarters of a mile (one km) from the fort itself, a French army of about 4,000 men under General Marquis de Montcalm and the Chevalier de Lévis defeated a numerically superior force of British troops under General James Abercrombie, which frontally assaulted an entrenched French position without using field artillery, a lack that left the British and their allies vulnerable and allowed the French to win a complete victory. The battle was the bloodiest of the American theater of the war, with over 3,000 casualties suffered. French losses were about 400, while more than 2,000 were British.

Bitka pri Cartagena de Indias (špansko: Sitio de Cartagena de Indias, dobesedno »obleganje Cartagene de Indias«) je potekala med vojno za Jenkinsovo uho med Španijo in Veliko Britanijo v letih 1739–1748. Vojna, posledica dolgotrajnih trgovinskih napetosti, je potekala predvsem na Karibih, kjer so Britanci skušali zavzeti ključna španska pristanišča, med drugim Porto Bello in Chagres v Panami, Havano in Cartageno de Indias v današnji Kolumbiji.

source.title: Battle of Cartagena de Indias
paragraphs: The Battle of Cartagena de Indias (Spanish: Sitio de Cartagena de Indias, lit. 'Siege of Cartagena de Indias') took place during the 1739 to 1748 War of Jenkins' Ear between Spain and Great Britain. The result of long-standing commercial tensions, the war was primarily fought in the Caribbean; the British tried to capture key Spanish ports in the region, including Porto Bello and Chagres in Panama, Havana, and Cartagena de Indias in present-day Colombia.

Battle of Caseros.headline: Bitka pri Caserosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Caserosu (špansko: Batalla de Caseros, portugalsko: Batalha de Caseros) je potekala 3. februarja 1852 blizu kraja El Palomar v Argentini med silami Argentinske konfederacije pod poveljstvom Juana Manuela de Rosasa in koalicijo argentinskih provinc Entre Ríos in Corrientes, Brazilskega cesarstva in Urugvaja.

Zavezniške sile, imenovane Velika vojska (Ejército Grande), so premagale Rosasa, ki je pobegnil v Združeno kraljestvo. Poraz je pomenil ostro prelomnico v zgodovini Argentine. Po bitki je caudillo in guverner province Entre Ríos Justo José de Urquiza postal začasni direktor Argentinske konfederacije in spodbudil nastanek državne ustave leta 1853, leta 1854 pa je postal prvi ustavni predsednik Argentine.

source.title: Battle of Caseros
paragraphs: The Battle of Caseros (Spanish: Batalla de Caseros; Portuguese: Batalha de Caseros) was fought near the town of El Palomar, Argentina, on 3 February 1852, between forces of the Argentine Confederation, commanded by Juan Manuel de Rosas, and a coalition consisting of the Argentine provinces of Entre Ríos and Corrientes, the Empire of Brazil, and Uruguay.

The allied forces, known as the Grand Army (Ejército Grande), defeated Rosas, who fled to the United Kingdom. This defeat marked a sharp division in the history of Argentina. After the battle, Justo José de Urquiza, a caudillo and governor of Entre Ríos, became the provisional Director of the Argentine Confederation and sponsored the creation of the country's constitution in 1853, later becoming the first constitutional president of Argentina in 1854.

Battle of Cedar Creek.headline: Bitka pri Cedar Creeku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cedar Creeku ali bitka pri Belle Grovu je potekala 19. oktobra 1864 med ameriško državljansko vojno, v dolini Shenandoah v severni Virginiji, blizu Cedar Creeka, Middletowna in ceste Valley Pike. Zjutraj je kazalo, da je generalporočnik Jubal Early s konfederacijsko vojsko zmagal: zajel je več kot 1000 ujetnikov in več kot 20 topov ter sedem sovražnikovih pehotnih divizij prisilil k umiku. Vojska Unije pod vodstvom generalmajorja Philipa Sheridana pa se je pozno popoldne zbrala in Earlyjeve može pregnala. Sheridanove sile so ne le znova zavzele vse svoje topove, ki so jih izgubile zjutraj, temveč zajele tudi večino Earlyjevih topov in vozov.

source.title: Battle of Cedar Creek
paragraphs: The Battle of Cedar Creek, or Battle of Belle Grove, was fought on October 19, 1864, during the American Civil War. The fighting took place in the Shenandoah Valley of Northern Virginia, near Cedar Creek, Middletown, and the Valley Pike. During the morning, Lieutenant General Jubal Early appeared to have a victory for his Confederate army, as he captured over 1,000 prisoners and over 20 artillery pieces while forcing seven enemy infantry divisions to fall back. The Union army, led by Major General Philip Sheridan, rallied in late afternoon and drove away Early's men. In addition to recapturing all of their own artillery seized in the morning, Sheridan's forces captured most of Early's artillery and wagons.

Bitka na Cedar Mountain, znana tudi kot Slaughter's Mountain ali Cedar Run, je potekala 9. avgusta 1862 v okrožju Culpeper v Virginiji, med ameriško državljansko vojno. Sile Unije pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Nathaniela P. Banksa so pri Cedar Mountain napadle konfederacijske sile generalmajorja Thomasa J. »Stonewalla« Jacksona, ko so konfederacijske čete korakale proti Culpeper Court Housu, da bi preprečile napredovanje Unije v osrednjo Virginijo. Konfederalce so v začetku bitke skoraj pregnali z bojišča, nato pa je njihov protinapad prebil črte Unije in jim prinesel zmago. Bitka je bila prvi spopad severnovirginijske kampanje.

source.title: Battle of Cedar Mountain
paragraphs: The Battle of Cedar Mountain, also known as Slaughter's Mountain or Cedar Run, took place on August 9, 1862, in Culpeper County, Virginia, as part of the American Civil War. Union forces under Maj. Gen. Nathaniel P. Banks attacked Confederate forces under Maj. Gen. Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson near Cedar Mountain as the Confederates marched on Culpeper Court House to forestall a Union advance into central Virginia. After nearly being driven from the field in the early part of the battle, a Confederate counterattack broke the Union lines resulting in a Confederate victory. The battle was the first combat of the Northern Virginia campaign.

Battle of Cerro Corá.headline: Bitka pri Cerro Corá
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cerro Corá je bila zadnja velika bitka paragvajske vojne, bojevana 1. marca 1870 v bližini Cerro Corá, 454 kilometrov severovzhodno od paragvajske prestolnice Asunción. Znana je po tem, da je v njej paragvajski predsednik Francisco Solano López padel od rok brazilske cesarske vojske.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Battle of Cerro Corá
paragraphs: The Battle of Cerro Corá (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsero koˈɾa]) was the last major battle of the Paraguayan War, fought on 1 March 1870, in the vicinity of Cerro Corá, 454 kilometres (280 mi) northeast of Paraguay's capital Asunción. It is known for being the battle in which Francisco Solano López, Paraguayan president, was killed at the hands of the Imperial Brazilian Army.

Battle of Chacabuco.headline: Bitka pri Chacabucu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Chacabucu je med čilsko osamosvojitveno vojno potekala 12. februarja 1817. Andska vojska iz Združenih provinc Río de la Plata pod vodstvom generalkapitana Joséja de San Martína je premagala špansko vojsko, ki ji je poveljeval Rafael Maroto. Zmaga je bila hud poraz za Generalno kapitanijo Čile, rojalistično oblast, vzpostavljeno po razdelitvi Podkraljestva Peru.

source.title: Battle of Chacabuco
paragraphs: The Battle of Chacabuco, fought during the Chilean War of Independence, took place on February 12, 1817. The Army of the Andes, from the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata and led by Captain–General José de San Martín, defeated a Spanish force commanded by Rafael Maroto. This victory was a significant defeat for the Captaincy General of Chile, the royalist government established after the division of the Viceroyalty of Peru.

Battle of Champion Hill.headline: Bitka pri Champion Hillu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Champion Hillu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Champion's Hillu ali bitka pri Baker's Creeku, 16. maja 1863, je bila odločilna bitka kampanje za Vicksburg v ameriški državljanski vojni (1861–1865). Poveljnik vojske Unije generalmajor Ulysses S. Grant je s Tennesseejsko armado zasledoval umikajočo se vojsko Konfederativnih držav pod poveljstvom generalporočnika Johna C. Pembertona in jo dvajset milj vzhodno od Vicksburga v Misisipiju premagal, kar je neizogibno pripeljalo do obleganja Vicksburga in njegove vdaje.

Sidney S. Champion, rojen leta 1824 v okrožju Guilford v Severni Karolini, je prišel v Misisipi in se naselil na velikem zemljišču med Boltonom in Edwardsom. Stotnik Champion je bil izkušen konfederacijski vojak že dolgo pred bitko pri Champion Hillu. V noči na 15. maja je bil v bližini bojišča kot pomemben član štaba generala Pembertona.

source.title: Battle of Champion Hill
paragraphs: The Battle of Champion Hill, also known as the Battle of Champion's Hill and the Battle of Baker's Creek, of May 16, 1863, was the pivotal battle in the Vicksburg campaign of the American Civil War (1861–1865). Union Army commander Major General Ulysses S. Grant and the Army of the Tennessee pursued the retreating Confederate States Army under Lieutenant General John C. Pemberton and defeated it twenty miles to the east of Vicksburg, Mississippi, leading inevitably to the Siege of Vicksburg and surrender.

Sidney S. Champion, born in Guilford County, North Carolina, in 1824, came to Mississippi and settled on a large tract of land located between Bolton and Edwards. Captain Champion was a seasoned Confederate soldier long before the outbreak of the Battle of Champion Hill. The night of May 15 found Captain Champion within range of the battle site and serving as a vital member of General Pemberton's staff.
Bitka pri Chancellorsvillu od 30. aprila do 6. maja 1863 je bila velika bitka ameriške državljanske vojne (1861–1865) in glavni spopad kampanje za Chancellorsville.

Tvegana odločitev konfederacijskega generala Roberta E. Leeja, da svojo vojsko razdeli pred precej večjo sovražnikovo silo, je Konfederaciji prinesla pomembno zmago, ki jo nekateri zgodovinarji opisujejo kot Leejevo »popolno bitko«. Zmago, sad Leejeve drznosti in plahega odločanja generala Unije Josepha Hookerja, so zasenčile hude izgube, med drugim generalporočnik Thomas J. »Stonewall« Jackson. Jacksona je zadel ogenj lastnih vojakov in so mu morali amputirati levo roko. Osem dni pozneje je umrl za pljučnico, izgubo pa je Lee primerjal z izgubo svoje desne roke.

source.title: Battle of Chancellorsville
paragraphs: The Battle of Chancellorsville, April 30 – May 6, 1863, was a major battle of the American Civil War (1861–1865), and the principal engagement of the Chancellorsville campaign.

Confederate General Robert E. Lee's risky decision to divide his army in the presence of a much larger enemy force resulted in a significant Confederate victory, described by some historians as Lee's "perfect battle". The victory, a product of Lee's audacity and Union general Joseph Hooker's timid decision-making, was tempered by heavy casualties, including Lt. Gen. Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson. Jackson was hit by friendly fire, requiring his left arm to be amputated. He died of pneumonia eight days later, a loss that Lee likened to losing his right arm.

Bitka pri Chantillyju (ali Ox Hill, kot so jo imenovali konfederalci) je potekala 1. septembra 1862 v okrožju Fairfax v Virginiji kot sklepna bitka severnovirginijske kampanje ameriške državljanske vojne. Korpus Stonewalla Jacksona iz Severnovirginijske armade je po drugi bitki pri Bull Runu skušal odrezati umik Virginijski armadi Unije, a sta ga napadli dve diviziji Unije. V bitki sta padla oba poveljnika divizij Unije, Isaac Stevens in Philip Kearny, napad Unije pa je Jacksonovo napredovanje ustavil.

source.title: Battle of Chantilly
paragraphs: The Battle of Chantilly (or Ox Hill, the Confederate name) happened on September 1, 1862, in Fairfax County, Virginia, as the concluding battle of the Northern Virginia Campaign of the American Civil War. Stonewall Jackson's corps of the Army of Northern Virginia attempted to cut off the line of retreat of the Union Army of Virginia following the Second Battle of Bull Run, but was attacked by two Union divisions. During the ensuing battle, Union division commanders Isaac Stevens and Philip Kearny were both killed, but the Union attack halted Jackson's advance.

Battle of Chapultepec.headline: Bitka pri Chapultepecu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Chapultepecu je 13. septembra 1847, med mehiško-ameriško vojno, potekala med ameriškimi četami in mehiškimi silami, ki so branile strateško postavljeni grad Chapultepec na obrobju Ciudad de Méxica. Grad so leta 1783 zgradili na vrhu 61 metrov visokega griča, leta 1833 pa so ga preuredili v vojaško akademijo in skladišče smodnika. Grič je obdajal 1600 jardov dolg zid.

source.title: Battle of Chapultepec
paragraphs: The Battle of Chapultepec took place between U.S. troops and Mexican forces holding the strategically located Chapultepec Castle on the outskirts of Mexico City on September 13, 1847 during the Mexican–American War. The castle was built atop a 200-foot (61 m) hill in 1783, and in 1833 it was converted into a military academy and a gunpowder storage facility. The hill was surrounded by a wall 1,600 yards long.

Bitka pri Chickamaugi, bojevana od 18. do 20. septembra 1863 med vojsko Združenih držav ali vojsko Unije in konfederacijskimi silami v ameriški državljanski vojni, je končala ofenzivo vojske Združenih držav, kampanjo za Chickamaugo, na jugovzhodu Tennesseeja in severozahodu Georgie. Bila je prva velika bitka vojne v Georgii, najhujši poraz Unije na zahodnem bojišču in po bitki pri Gettysburgu bitka z drugim največjim številom žrtev.

V bitki sta se spopadli Cumberlandska armada vojske Združenih držav pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Williama Rosecransa in konfederacijska Tennesseejska armada pod poveljstvom generala Braxtona Bragga, ime pa je dobila po potoku Chickamauga. Zahodni Chickamauga vijuga v bližini in tvori jugovzhodno mejo bojišča in parka v severozahodni Georgii. (Južni Chickamauga se nazadnje izliva v reko Tennessee okoli 5,6 km severovzhodno od središča Chattanooge.)

source.title: Battle of Chickamauga
paragraphs: The Battle of Chickamauga, fought on September 18–20, 1863, between the United States Army, or Union Army, and Confederate forces in the American Civil War, marked the end of a U.S. Army offensive, the Chickamauga Campaign, in southeastern Tennessee and northwestern Georgia. It was the first major battle of the war fought in Georgia and the most significant Union defeat in the Western Theater, and it involved the second-highest number of casualties after the Battle of Gettysburg.

The battle was fought between the U.S. Army's Army of the Cumberland under Maj. Gen. William Rosecrans and the Confederate Army of Tennessee under Gen. Braxton Bragg, and was named for Chickamauga Creek. The West Chickamauga Creek meanders near and forms the southeast boundary of the battle area and the park in northwest Georgia. (The South Chickamauga ultimately flows into the Tennessee River about 3.5 miles (5.6 km) northeast of downtown Chattanooga).

Battle of Churubusco.headline: Bitka pri Churubuscu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Churubuscu je potekala 20. avgusta 1847, ko se je Santa Annova vojska med mehiško-ameriško vojno umikala iz bitke pri Contrerasu. V njej se je bataljon San Patricio, sestavljen večinoma iz ameriških dezerterjev, zadnjič uprl ameriškim silam. Ameriška vojska, ki je bila mehiške branilce po številu več kot šestkrat močnejša, je zmagala in je bila po bitki le še 8 km od Ciudad de Méxica. Ameriška vojska je petdeset mož bataljona sv. Patrika uradno usmrtila, vse razen dveh z obešanjem. Skupaj je bila to največja množična usmrtitev v zgodovini Združenih držav.

source.title: Battle of Churubusco
paragraphs: The Battle of Churubusco took place on August 20, 1847, while Santa Anna's army was in retreat from the Battle of Contreras during the Mexican–American War. It was the battle where the San Patricio Battalion, made up largely of US deserters, made their last stand against U.S. forces. The U.S. Army was victorious, outnumbering more than six-to-one the defending Mexican troops. After the battle, the U.S. Army was only 5 miles (8 km) away from Mexico City. Fifty men of Saint Patrick's Battalion were officially executed by the U.S. Army, all but two by hanging. Collectively, this was the largest mass execution in United States history.

Bitka za Cold Harbor je med ameriško državljansko vojno potekala pri Mechanicsvillu v Virginiji od 31. maja do 12. junija 1864, najhujši boji pa so bili 3. junija. Bila je ena zadnjih bitk kopenske kampanje generalporočnika Unije Ulyssesa S. Granta. V čelnem napadu 3. junija na utrjene položaje vojske konfederacijskega generala Roberta E. Leeja je bilo na tisoče vojakov Unije ubitih ali ranjenih, kar je okrepilo kritike domnevne Grantove brezbrižnosti do velikih izgub.

Ko je Grantova vojska 31. maja znova obšla desno krilo Leejeve vojske, je konjenica Unije zavzela križišče Old Cold Harbor, okoli 10 milj (16 km) severovzhodno od konfederacijske prestolnice Richmonda v Virginiji, in ga branila pred konfederacijskimi napadi, dokler ni prispela pehota Unije. Tako Grant kot Lee, katerih vojski sta v kopenski kampanji utrpeli ogromne izgube, sta dobila okrepitve. Zvečer 1. junija sta prispela VI. in XVIII. korpus Unije in z nekaj uspeha napadla konfederacijske utrdbe zahodno od križišča.

source.title: Battle of Cold Harbor
paragraphs: The Battle of Cold Harbor was fought during the American Civil War near Mechanicsville, Virginia, from May 31 to June 12, 1864, with the most significant fighting occurring on June 3. It was one of the final battles of Union Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's Overland Campaign. Thousands of Union soldiers were killed or wounded in the frontal assault of June 3 against the fortified positions of Confederate Gen. Robert E. Lee's army—an action that intensified criticism of Grant's perceived indifference to heavy casualties.

On May 31, as Grant's army once again swung around the right flank of Lee's army, Union cavalry seized the crossroads of Old Cold Harbor, about 10 miles northeast of the Confederate capital of Richmond, Virginia, holding it against Confederate attacks until the Union infantry arrived. Both Grant and Lee, whose armies had suffered enormous casualties in the Overland Campaign, received reinforcements. On the evening of June 1, the Union VI Corps and XVIII Corps arrived and assaulted the Confederate works to the west of the crossroads with some success.

Battle of Curupayty.headline: Bitka pri Curupaytyju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Curupaytyju je bila ključna bitka paragvajske vojne. Zjutraj 22. septembra 1866 so združene brazilska, argentinska in urugvajska vojska napadle paragvajske utrjene jarke pri Curupaytyju. Paragvajce je vodil general José Eduvigis Díaz. Položaj je branilo 5000 mož in 49 topov, nekateri skriti pred pogledi napadalcev. Brazilska cesarska mornarica je podpirala 20.000 napadalcev, a so se morale ladje držati na razdalji od topov trdnjave Humaitá, zato je bil njihov ogenj nenatančen in neučinkovit. Neuspeh mornarice je bil ključen za izid poznejše kopenske bitke.

source.title: Battle of Curupayty
paragraphs: The Battle of Curupayty was a key battle in the Paraguayan War. On the morning on 22 September 1866, the joint force of Brazilian, Argentine, and Uruguayan armies attacked Paraguayan fortified trenches on Curupayty. The Paraguayans were led by general José Eduvigis Díaz. This position was held by 5,000 men and 49 cannons, some of them in hidden places out of the attackers view. The Imperial Brazilian Navy gave support to the 20,000 assailants, but the ships had to keep some distance from the guns at the fortress of Humaitá, which led to the lack of accuracy and impact of the ship's fire. The navy's failure was crucial at the later ground battle result.

Battle of Dutch Harbor.headline: Bitka pri Dutch Harborju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dutch Harborju je potekala 3. in 4. junija 1942, ko je japonska cesarska mornarica z letalonosilk dvakrat napadla pomorsko oporišče Dutch Harbor in utrdbo vojske ZDA Fort Mears v Dutch Harborju na otoku Amaknak; s tem se je začela aleutska kampanja druge svetovne vojne. Bombardiranje je bilo prvi sovražnikov zračni napad na Severno Ameriko, čeprav otok Amaknak ne spada k celinskim ZDA in tedaj ni bil zvezna država, temveč ozemlje Aljaska. Bilo je drugič v zgodovini, da je Severno Ameriko bombardiral nekdo v službi tuje sile; prvič so po nesreči bombardirali Naco v Arizoni leta 1929.

source.title: Battle of Dutch Harbor
paragraphs: The Battle of Dutch Harbor took place on 3-4 June 1942, when the Imperial Japanese Navy launched two aircraft carrier raids on the Dutch Harbor Naval Operating Base and U.S. Army Fort Mears at Dutch Harbor on Amaknak Island, opening the Aleutian Islands campaign of World War II. The bombing marked the first aerial attack by an enemy on North America, though Amaknak island is not part of the continental US and was not a state but the Alaska Territory at the time. This was the second time in history that North America was bombed by someone working for a foreign power, the first being the accidental bombing of Naco, Arizona, in 1929.

Bitka pri Podrtem drevju (Fallen Timbers, 20. avgusta 1794) je bila zadnja bitka severozahodne indijanske vojne, boja med Severozahodno konfederacijo in Združenimi državami za nadzor nad Severozahodnim ozemljem. Potekala je med drevesi, ki jih je podrl tornado, blizu reke Maumee na severozahodu Ohia, na mestu današnjega mesta Maumee v Ohiu.

Legija Združenih držav generalmajorja Anthonyja Wayna je ob podpori kentuckyjske milice generala Charlesa Scotta premagala združene indijanske sile Šonijev pod vodstvom Blue Jacketa, Otav pod vodstvom Egushawe in mnogih drugih. Bitka je bila kratka, trajala je le nekaj več kot uro, a je razpršila združene indijanske sile.

Ameriška zmaga je končala večje sovražnosti v pokrajini. Pogodba iz Greenvilla in Jayjeva pogodba, ki sta sledili, sta Indijance prisilili, da so zapustili večji del današnjega Ohia, ki se je odprl belim ameriškim naseljencem, Britanci pa so se umaknili z južnega območja Velikih jezer v Združenih državah.

source.title: Battle of Fallen Timbers
paragraphs: The Battle of Fallen Timbers (20 August 1794) was the final battle of the Northwest Indian War, a struggle between the Northwestern Confederacy and United States for control of the Northwest Territory. The battle took place amid trees toppled by a tornado near the Maumee River in northwestern Ohio at the site of the present-day city of Maumee, Ohio.

Major General Anthony Wayne's Legion of the United States, supported by General Charles Scott's Kentucky militia, were victorious against a combined Native American force of Shawnee under Blue Jacket, Ottawas under Egushawa, and many others. The battle was brief, lasting little more than one hour, but it scattered the confederated Native American forces.

The U.S. victory ended major hostilities in the region. The following Treaty of Greenville and Jay Treaty forced Native American displacement from most of modern-day Ohio, opening it to White American settlement, along with withdrawal of the British presence from the southern Great Lakes region of the United States.

Battle of Fort Beauséjour.headline: Bitka za Fort Beauséjour
paragraphs: Bitka za utrdbo Fort Beauséjour je potekala na prevlaki Chignecto in je pomenila konec vojne očeta Le Loutra ter
začetek britanske ofenzive na akadijskem oziroma novoškotskem bojišču sedemletne vojne, ki je nazadnje pripeljala do konca francoskega kolonialnega imperija v Severni Ameriki.

Britanska vojska pod poveljstvom podpolkovnika Roberta Moncktona je 3. junija 1755 krenila iz bližnje utrdbe Fort Lawrence in oblegala majhno francosko posadko v utrdbi Beauséjour, da bi prevlako Chignecto spravila pod britanski nadzor. Nadzor nad prevlako je bil za Francoze ključen, saj je bila v zimskih mesecih edini prehod med Quebecom in Louisbourgom. Po dveh tednih obleganja se je poveljnik utrdbe Louis Du Pont Duchambon de Vergor 16. junija vdal.

source.title: Battle of Fort Beauséjour
paragraphs: The Battle of Fort Beauséjour was fought on the Isthmus of Chignecto and marked the end of Father Le Loutre's War and
the opening of a British offensive in the Acadia/Nova Scotia theatre of the Seven Years' War, which would eventually lead to the end of the French colonial empire in North America.

Beginning June 3, 1755, a British army under Lieutenant-Colonel Robert Monckton staged out of nearby Fort Lawrence, besieged the small French garrison at Fort Beauséjour with the goal of opening the Isthmus of Chignecto to British control. Control of the isthmus was pivotal to the French because it was the only gateway between Quebec and Louisbourg during the winter months. After two weeks of siege, Louis Du Pont Duchambon de Vergor, the fort's commander, capitulated on June 16.

Battle of Fort Bull.headline: Bitka za Fort Bull
paragraphs: Bitka za Fort Bull je bil francoski napad na britansko utrdbo Fort Bull 27. marca 1756, na začetku francosko-indijanske vojne. Utrdba je bila zgrajena za obrambo dela vodne poti, ki je po reki Mohawk povezovala Albany v New Yorku z jezerom Ontario.

Poročnik Gaspard-Joseph Chaussegros de Léry je 27. marca 1756 povedel enote mornariških čet (Troupes de la Marine), kanadske milice in indijanskih zaveznikov v napad na utrdbo. Pod zaščito dreves so se prikradli do 91 metrov od utrdbe. Léry je ukazal juriš z bajoneti. Napadalci so muškete potisnili v ozke odprtine utrdbe in streljali na branilce. Léry je branilce večkrat pozval, naj se vdajo. Nazadnje so vdrli skozi vrata, Francozi in Indijanci so planili v utrdbo in pobili vse, ki so jih videli. Francoski vojaki so pobrali, kar so mogli, in zažgali skladišča smodnika. Utrdba je pogorela do tal.

source.title: Battle of Fort Bull
paragraphs: The Battle of Fort Bull was a French attack on the British-held Fort Bull on 27 March 1756, early in the French and Indian War. The fort was built to defend a portion of the waterway connecting Albany, New York to Lake Ontario via the Mohawk River.

Lt. Gaspard-Joseph Chaussegros de Léry led his command consisting of forces from the Troupes de la Marine, Canadien militia, and Indian allies on an attack against Fort Bull on 27 March 1756. Shielded by trees they sneaked up to within 100 yards (91 m) of the fort. Léry ordered a charge at the fort with bayonets. They stuck their muskets into the narrow openings in the fort and shot the defenders. Léry repeatedly asked for their surrender. Finally, the gate was crashed in and the French and Indians swarmed in, killing everyone they saw. The French soldiers looted what they could and set the powder magazines on fire. The fort was burned to the ground.

Bitka za Fort Donelson je potekala od 11. do 16. februarja 1862 na zahodnem bojišču ameriške državljanske vojne. Ko je Unija zavzela konfederacijsko utrdbo blizu meje med Tennesseejem in Kentuckyjem, je odprla reko Cumberland, pomembno pot za vdor na jug. Uspeh je brigadnega generala Ulyssesa S. Granta iz neznanega in večinoma nepreizkušenega poveljnika povzdignil v generalmajorja in mu prinesel vzdevek »Brezpogojna vdaja« Grant.

Potem ko je 6. februarja zavzel utrdbo Fort Henry, je Grant od 11. do 13. februarja svojo vojsko (pozneje Tennesseejsko armado Unije) po kopnem premaknil 19 km do utrdbe Fort Donelson in izvedel več manjših izvidniških napadov. Topnjače Unije pod poveljstvom poveljnika flotilje Andrewa H. Foota so 14. februarja skušale utrdbo uničiti s topovskim ognjem, a so se morale umakniti, ker so jih obrežne baterije utrdbe hudo poškodovale.

source.title: Battle of Fort Donelson
paragraphs: The Battle of Fort Donelson was fought from February 11–16, 1862, in the Western Theater of the American Civil War. The Union capture of the Confederate fort near the Tennessee–Kentucky border opened the Cumberland River, an important avenue for the invasion of the South. The Union's success also elevated Brig. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant from an obscure and largely unproven leader to the rank of major general, and earned him the nickname of "Unconditional Surrender" Grant.

Following his capture of Fort Henry on February 6, Grant moved his army (later to become the Union's Army of the Tennessee) 12 miles (19 km) overland to Fort Donelson, from February 11 to 13, and conducted several small probing attacks. On February 14, Union gunboats under Flag Officer Andrew H. Foote attempted to reduce the fort with gunfire, but were forced to withdraw after sustaining heavy damage from the fort's water batteries.

Battle of Fort Duquesne.headline: Bitka za Fort Duquesne
paragraphs: Bitka za Fort Duquesne je bil britanski napad na francosko utrdbo Fort Duquesne (pozneje mesto Pittsburgh) 14. septembra 1758, med francosko-indijansko vojno. Francozi in njihovi indijanski zavezniki pod vodstvom Françoisa-Marieja Le Marchanda de Lignery so britanske sile izmanevrirali, obkolili in večinoma uničili.

source.title: Battle of Fort Duquesne
paragraphs: The Battle of Fort Duquesne was a British assault on the French-controlled Fort Duquesne (later the site of Pittsburgh) on 14 September 1758, during the French and Indian War. This force was out-maneuvered, surrounded, and largely destroyed by the French and their native allies led by François-Marie Le Marchand de Lignery.

Battle of Fort Henry.headline: Bitka za Fort Henry
paragraphs: Bitka za Fort Henry je potekala 6. februarja 1862 v okrožju Stewart v Tennesseeju, med ameriško državljansko vojno. Bila je prva pomembna zmaga Unije in brigadnega generala Ulyssesa S. Granta na zahodnem bojišču.

Grant je 4. in 5. februarja izkrcal dve diviziji tik severno od utrdbe Fort Henry ob reki Tennessee. (Čete pod Grantovim poveljstvom so bile jedro uspešne Tennesseejske armade Unije, čeprav tega imena še niso uporabljali.) Grant je nameraval utrdbo napasti 6. februarja, hkrati z napadom topnjač Unije pod poveljstvom poveljnika flotilje Andrewa Hulla Foota. Natančen in učinkovit ogenj z ladij, močan dež in neugodna lega utrdbe, ki jo je naraščajoča reka skoraj poplavila, so poveljnika brigadnega generala Lloyda Tilghmana prisilili, da se je Footu vdal, še preden je prispela vojska Unije.

source.title: Battle of Fort Henry
paragraphs: The Battle of Fort Henry was fought on February 6, 1862, in Stewart County, Tennessee, during the American Civil War. It was the first important victory for the Union and Brig. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant in the Western Theater.

On February 4 and 5, Grant landed two divisions just north of Fort Henry on the Tennessee River. (The troops serving under Grant were the nucleus of the Union's successful Army of the Tennessee, although that name was not yet in use.) Grant's plan was to advance upon the fort on February 6 while it was being simultaneously attacked by Union gunboats commanded by Flag Officer Andrew Hull Foote. A combination of accurate and effective naval gunfire, heavy rain, and the poor siting of the fort, nearly inundated by rising river waters, caused its commander, Brig. Gen. Lloyd Tilghman, to surrender to Foote before the Union Army arrived.

Bitka za Fort Necessity, znana tudi kot bitka na Great Meadows, je potekala 3. julija 1754 v današnjem Farmingtonu v okrožju Fayette v Pensilvaniji. Skupaj s spopadom 28. maja, znanim kot bitka pri Jumonville Glen, je bila prva bojna izkušnja Georgea Washingtona, ki ga je drugi celinski kongres v Filadelfiji pozneje izbral za poveljnika celinske vojske v ameriški osamosvojitveni vojni.

Z bitko za Fort Necessity se je začela francosko-indijanska vojna, ki je pozneje prerasla v svetovni spopad, znan kot sedemletna vojna. Washington je utrdbo zgradil na gorskem travniku zahodno od vrha prelaza čez Laurel Highlands v Aleganijskem gorovju. Drug bližnji prelaz vodi do Confluencea v Pensilvaniji, na zahodu pa se Nemacolinova pot spušča proti Uniontownu v Pensilvaniji in drugim delom okrožja Fayette na razmeroma nizki Aleganijski planoti.

source.title: Battle of Fort Necessity
paragraphs: The Battle of Fort Necessity, also known as the Battle of the Great Meadows took place on July 3, 1754, in present-day Farmington in Fayette County, Pennsylvania. The engagement, along with a May 28 skirmish known as the Battle of Jumonville Glen, was the first military combat experience for George Washington, who was later selected as commander of the Continental Army during the American Revolutionary War by the Second Continental Congress in Philadelphia.

The Battle of Fort Necessity began the French and Indian War, which later spiraled into the global conflict known as the Seven Years' War. Washington built Fort Necessity on an alpine meadow west of the summit of a pass through the Laurel Highlands of the Allegheny Mountains. Another pass nearby leads to Confluence, Pennsylvania; to the west, Nemacolin's Trail begins its descent to Uniontown, Pennsylvania, and other parts of Fayette County along the relatively low altitudes of the Allegheny Plateau.

Battle of Fort Oswego.headline: Bitka za Fort Oswego
paragraphs: Bitka za Fort Oswego je bila ena od vrste zgodnjih francoskih zmag na severnoameriškem bojišču sedemletne vojne, ki jih je Nova Francija dosegla kljub svoji vojaški ranljivosti. V tednu po 10. avgustu 1756 so redne enote in kanadska milica pod poveljstvom generala Montcalma zavzele in zasedle britanske utrdbe Fort Oswego na mestu današnjega Oswega v New Yorku.

Montcalmove sile so poleg 1700 ujetnikov zaplenile tudi 121 topov iz utrdbe. Padec utrdbe Fort Oswego je dejansko prekinil britansko navzočnost na jezeru Ontario in odpravil grožnjo za bližnjo francosko utrdbo Fort Frontenac. Bitka je pokazala, da je tradicionalna evropska oblegovalna taktika v Severni Ameriki uporabna, če jo pravilno uporabijo v pravih okoliščinah in na pravem terenu.

source.title: Battle of Fort Oswego
paragraphs: The Battle of Fort Oswego was one in a series of early French victories in the North American theatre of the Seven Years' War won in spite of New France's military vulnerability. During the week of August 10, 1756, a force of regulars and Canadian militia under General Montcalm captured and occupied the British fortifications at Fort Oswego, located at the site of present-day Oswego, New York.

In addition to 1,700 prisoners, Montcalm's force seized the fort's 121 cannons. The fall of Fort Oswego effectively interrupted the British presence on Lake Ontario and removed it as a threat to the nearby French-controlled Fort Frontenac. The battle was notable for demonstrating that traditional European siege tactics were viable in North America when applied properly in the right circumstances and terrain.

Battle of Fort Pillow.headline: Bitka za Fort Pillow
paragraphs: Bitka za Fort Pillow, znana tudi kot pokol v Fort Pillowu, je potekala 12. aprila 1864 pri utrdbi Fort Pillow ob Misisipiju v Henningu v Tennesseeju, med ameriško državljansko vojno. Končala se je tako, da so konfederacijski vojaki pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Nathana Bedforda Forresta pobili vojake Unije (med njimi mnoge iz temnopoltih enot vojske ZDA), ki so se skušali vdati. Vojaški zgodovinar David J. Eicher je sklenil: »Fort Pillow je bil eden najbolj mračnih in žalostnih dogodkov ameriške vojaške zgodovine.«

source.title: Battle of Fort Pillow
paragraphs: The Battle of Fort Pillow, also known as the Fort Pillow Massacre, was fought on April 12, 1864, at Fort Pillow on the Mississippi River in Henning, Tennessee, during the American Civil War. The battle ended with Confederate soldiers commanded by Major General Nathan Bedford Forrest massacring Union soldiers (many of them U.S. Colored Troops) attempting to surrender. Military historian David J. Eicher concluded: "Fort Pillow marked one of the bleakest, saddest events of American military history."

Battle of Fort Sumter.headline: Bitka za Fort Sumter
paragraphs: Bitka za Fort Sumter (tudi napad na Fort Sumter ali padec Fort Sumtra; 12.–13. aprila 1861) je bilo obstreljevanje utrdbe Fort Sumter pri Charlestonu v Južni Karolini, ki ga je izvedla milica Južne Karoline. Končala se je z vdajo utrdbe, ki jo je branila vojska Združenih držav, in z njo se je začela ameriška državljanska vojna.

Ko je Južna Karolina 20. decembra 1860 razglasila odcepitev, so njene oblasti zahtevale, naj vojska ZDA zapusti svoje objekte v charlestonskem pristanišču. Major Robert Anderson iz vojske ZDA je 26. decembra skrivaj premaknil svojo majhno enoto iz ranljive utrdbe Fort Moultrie na Sullivanovem otoku v Fort Sumter, mogočno trdnjavo na otoku, ki je nadzorovala vhod v charlestonsko pristanišče. Predsednik ZDA James Buchanan je skušal Andersona okrepiti in oskrbeti z neoboroženo trgovsko ladjo Star of the West, a poskus je spodletel, ko so nanjo 9. januarja 1861 streljale obrežne baterije. Ladjo so zadeli trikrat; večje škode niso povzročili, a zaloge niso prišle do Andersona.

source.title: Battle of Fort Sumter
paragraphs: The Battle of Fort Sumter (also the Attack on Fort Sumter or the Fall of Fort Sumter) (April 12–13, 1861) was the bombardment of Fort Sumter near Charleston, South Carolina, by the South Carolina militia. It ended with the surrender of the fort by the United States Army, beginning the American Civil War.

Following the declaration of secession by South Carolina on December 20, 1860, its authorities demanded that the U.S. Army abandon its facilities in Charleston Harbor. On December 26, Major Robert Anderson of the U.S. Army surreptitiously moved his small command from the vulnerable Fort Moultrie on Sullivan's Island to Fort Sumter, a substantial fortress built on an island controlling the entrance of Charleston Harbor. An attempt by U.S. President James Buchanan to reinforce and resupply Anderson using the unarmed merchant ship Star of the West failed when it was fired upon by shore batteries on January 9, 1861. The ship was hit three times, which caused no major damage but kept the supplies from reaching Anderson.

Battle of Franklin.headline: Bitka pri Franklinu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Franklinu je potekala 30. novembra 1864 v Franklinu v Tennesseeju, v okviru kampanje Franklin–Nashville v ameriški državljanski vojni. Bila je ena najhujših katastrof vojne za vojsko Konfederativnih držav. Tennesseejska armada konfederacijskega generalporočnika Johna Bella Hooda je izvedla številne čelne napade na utrjene položaje sil Unije pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Johna Schofielda, a ji ni uspelo preprečiti, da bi Schofield izvedel načrtovan, urejen umik v Nashville.

source.title: Battle of Franklin
paragraphs: The Battle of Franklin was fought on November 30, 1864, in Franklin, Tennessee, as part of the Franklin–Nashville Campaign of the American Civil War. It was one of the worst disasters of the war for the Confederate States Army. Confederate Lieutenant General John Bell Hood's Army of Tennessee conducted numerous frontal assaults against fortified positions occupied by the Union forces under Major General John Schofield and was unable to prevent Schofield from executing a planned, orderly withdrawal to Nashville.

Bitka za Fredericksburg je od 11. do 15. decembra 1862 potekala v Fredericksburgu v Virginiji in okolici, na vzhodnem bojišču ameriške državljanske vojne. V spopadu med Potomaško armado Unije pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Ambrosa Burnsida in konfederacijsko Severnovirginijsko armado generala Roberta E. Leeja je vojska Unije 13. decembra jalovo čelno napadala utrjene konfederacijske črte in se zaganjala ob del bojišča na vzpetini nad mestom, ki je ostal v spominu kot »pogreznjeni zid«. Velja za eno najbolj enostranskih bitk vojne, saj so bile izgube Unije več kot dvakrat večje od konfederacijskih. Neki obiskovalec bojišča je bitko ameriškemu predsedniku Abrahamu Lincolnu opisal kot »klanje«.

source.title: Battle of Fredericksburg
paragraphs: The Battle of Fredericksburg was fought December 11–15, 1862, in and around Fredericksburg, Virginia, in the eastern theater of the American Civil War. The combat between the Union Army of the Potomac commanded by Maj. Gen. Ambrose Burnside and the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia under Gen. Robert E. Lee included futile frontal attacks by the Union army on December 13 against entrenched Confederate lines, hurling themselves against a feature of the battlefield that came to be remembered as the 'sunken wall' on the heights overlooking the city. It is remembered as one of the most one-sided battles of the war, with Union casualties more than twice as heavy as those suffered by the Confederates. A visitor to the battlefield described the battle as a "butchery" to U.S. president Abraham Lincoln.

Battle of Glorieta Pass.headline: Bitka pri prelazu Glorieta
paragraphs: Bitka pri prelazu Glorieta je med ameriško državljansko vojno od 26. do 28. marca 1862 potekala na severu ozemlja Nova Mehika med silami Unije in Konfederacije. Ni bila največja bitka novomehiške kampanje, a je končala prizadevanja Konfederacije, da bi zavzela to ozemlje in druge dele zahoda Združenih držav.

Bitka je potekala na istoimenskem gorskem prelazu v gorovju Sangre de Cristo, v današnjem okrožju Santa Fe v Novi Mehiki. Konfederacijske sile so hotele zlomiti oblast Unije na zahodu ob vznožju Skalnega gorovja, s končnim ciljem nadzorovati strateško dragocene rudnike, železnice in mesta po vsej pokrajini. Vdor je bil najzahodnejša vojaška operacija vojne in edini resni poskus juga, da bi osvojil in zasedel ozemlje Unije.

source.title: Battle of Glorieta Pass
paragraphs: The Battle of Glorieta Pass was fought March 26–28, 1862, in the northern New Mexico Territory, by Union and Confederate forces during the American Civil War. While not the largest battle of the New Mexico campaign, the Battle of Glorieta Pass ended the Confederacy's efforts to capture the territory and other parts of the western United States.

The battle took place at the eponymous mountain pass in the Sangre de Cristo Mountains, in what is now Santa Fe County, New Mexico. Confederate forces sought to break the Union's possession of the West along the base of the Rocky Mountains, with the ultimate aim of controlling strategically valuable mines, railroads, and cities throughout the region. The invasion was the westernmost military operation of the war, and the South's only real attempt to conquer and occupy Union territory.

Battle of Goliad.headline: Bitka za Goliad
paragraphs: Bitka za Goliad je bila drugi spopad teksaške revolucije. V zgodnjih jutranjih urah 9. oktobra 1835 so teksaški naseljenci napadli vojake mehiške vojske v posadki Presidio La Bahía, utrdbi blizu naselja Goliad v mehiškem Teksasu. La Bahía je ležala na pol poti med edino drugo veliko posadko mehiških vojakov (v Presidiu San Antonio de Béxar) in tedaj pomembnim teksaškim pristaniščem Copano.

Septembra so Teksijci začeli kovati načrt, da bi ugrabili mehiškega generala Martína Perfecta de Cosa, ki je bil na poti v Goliad, da bi zatrl nemire v Teksasu. Osrednji odbor, ki je usklajeval upor, je načrt sprva zavrnil. Nekaj dni po zmagi Teksijcev v bitki za Gonzales pa so stotnik George Collinsworth in pripadniki teksaške milice iz Matagorde krenili proti Goliadu. Kmalu so izvedeli, da so Cos in njegovi možje že odšli v San Antonio de Béxar, a so pohod nadaljevali.

source.title: Battle of Goliad
paragraphs: The Battle of Goliad was the second skirmish of the Texas Revolution. In the early-morning hours of October 9, 1835, Texas settlers attacked the Mexican Army soldiers garrisoned at Presidio La Bahía, a fort near the Mexican Texas settlement of Goliad. La Bahía lay halfway between the only other large garrison of Mexican soldiers (at Presidio San Antonio de Béxar) and the then-important Texas port of Copano.

In September, Texians began plotting to kidnap Mexican General Martín Perfecto de Cos, who was en route to Goliad to attempt to quell the unrest in Texas. The plan was initially dismissed by the central committee coordinating the rebellion. However, within days of the Texian victory at the Battle of Gonzales, Captain George Collinsworth and members of the Texian militia in Matagorda began marching towards Goliad. The Texians soon learned that Cos and his men had already departed for San Antonio de Béxar but continued their march.

Bitka za Gonzales je bila prvi vojaški spopad teksaške revolucije. Potekala je 2. oktobra 1835 pri Gonzalesu v Teksasu med uporniškimi teksijskimi naseljenci in odredom mehiške vojske. Green DeWitt je leta 1831 mehiške oblasti prosil, naj kolonistom v Gonzalesu posodijo top za obrambo pred pogostimi komanškimi vpadi. Top so dobili s pogojem, da ga na zahtevo vrnejo Mehičanom. V naslednjih štirih letih so se politične razmere v Mehiki poslabšale in leta 1835 se je uprlo več zveznih držav. Ko so se nemiri širili, se je poveljniku vseh mehiških čet v Teksasu, polkovniku Domingu de Ugartechei, zdelo nespametno pustiti prebivalcem Gonzalesa orožje, zato je zahteval vrnitev topa.

source.title: Battle of Gonzales
paragraphs: The Battle of Gonzales was the first military engagement of the Texas Revolution. It was fought near Gonzales, Texas, on October 2, 1835, between rebellious Texian settlers and a detachment of Mexican Army soldiers. In 1831, Green DeWitt asked the Mexican authorities to lend the Gonzales colonists a cannon to help protect them from frequent Comanche raids. One was supplied, on the condition that the cannon would be returned to the Mexicans on request. Over the next four years, the political situation in Mexico deteriorated, and in 1835 several states revolted. As the unrest spread, Colonel Domingo de Ugartechea, the commander of all Mexican troops in Texas, felt it unwise to leave the residents of Gonzales with a weapon and requested the return of the cannon.

Battle of Hampton Roads.headline: Bitka pri Hampton Roadsu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hampton Roadsu, imenovana tudi bitka med Monitorjem in Merrimackom ali bitka oklepnic, je bila pomorska bitka ameriške državljanske vojne.

Potekala je dva dni, 8. in 9. marca 1862, v Hampton Roadsu, sidrišču v Virginiji, kjer se reki Elizabeth in Nansemond stekata v reko James, tik preden se ta pri mestu Norfolk izlije v zaliv Chesapeake. Bitka je bila del prizadevanj Konfederacije, da bi prebila blokado Unije, ki je največji mesti in glavni industrijski središči Virginije, Norfolk in Richmond, odrezala od mednarodne trgovine.

Bitka je pomembna, ker je bila prvi spopad med oklepnimi vojnimi ladjami, USS Monitor in CSS Virginia. Konfederacijsko floto so sestavljali oklepni ladijski oven Virginia (zgrajen iz ostankov pogorele parne fregate USS Merrimack) in več podpornih plovil. Prvi dan bitke so ji stale nasproti različne običajne ladje mornarice Unije z lesenim trupom.

source.title: Battle of Hampton Roads
paragraphs: The Battle of Hampton Roads, also referred to as the Battle of the Monitor and Merrimack or the Battle of Ironclads, was a naval battle during the American Civil War.

The battle was fought over two days, March 8 and 9, 1862, in Hampton Roads, a roadstead in Virginia where the Elizabeth and Nansemond rivers meet the James River just before it flows into Chesapeake Bay by the city of Norfolk. The battle was a part of the effort of the Confederacy to break the Union blockade, which had cut off Virginia's largest cities and major industrial centers, Norfolk and Richmond, from international trade.

This battle was significant in that it was the first combat between ironclad warships, the USS Monitor and CSS Virginia. The Confederate fleet consisted of the ironclad ram Virginia (built from remnants of the burned steam frigate USS Merrimack) and several supporting vessels. On the first day of battle, they were opposed by several conventional, wooden-hulled ships of the Union Navy.

Bitka za Harpers Ferry je potekala od 12. do 15. septembra 1862 v okviru marylandske kampanje ameriške državljanske vojne. Ko je konfederacijska vojska generala Roberta E. Leeja vdrla v Maryland, je del njegove vojske pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Thomasa J. »Stonewalla« Jacksona obkolil, obstreljeval in zajel posadko Unije v Harpers Ferryju v Virginiji (danes Zahodna Virginija).

source.title: Battle of Harpers Ferry
paragraphs: The Battle of Harpers Ferry was fought September 12–15, 1862, as part of the Maryland Campaign of the American Civil War. As Confederate Army General Robert E. Lee's Confederate army invaded Maryland, a portion of his army under Major General Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson surrounded, bombarded, and captured the Union garrison at Harpers Ferry, Virginia (now West Virginia).

Battle of Horseshoe Bend.headline: Bitka pri Horseshoe Bendu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Horseshoe Bendu je potekala na ozemlju Misisipi, v današnji osrednji Alabami. Sile Združenih držav in njihovi indijanski zavezniki pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Andrewa Jacksona so 27. marca 1814 premagali Rdeče palice, del plemena Krik, ki je nasprotoval ameriški širitvi, in s tem dejansko končali kriško vojno.

source.title: Battle of Horseshoe Bend
paragraphs: The Battle of Horseshoe Bend was fought in the Mississippi Territory, now central Alabama. On March 27, 1814, United States forces and Native American allies under Major General Andrew Jackson defeated the Red Sticks, a part of the Creek Indian tribe who opposed American expansion, effectively ending the Creek War.

Battle of Iquique.headline: Bitka pri Iquiqueju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Iquiqueju je bil pomorski spopad 21. maja 1879 med pacifiško vojno, v katerem se je čilska korveta pod poveljstvom Artura Prata Chacóna spopadla s perujsko oklepnico pod poveljstvom Miguela Graua. Bitka je potekala pred pristaniščem Iquique v Peruju in se je po štirih urah boja končala s potopitvijo čilske lesene korvete Esmeralda, ki jo je potopila perujska oklepnica Huáscar; zmagal je Peru.

source.title: Battle of Iquique
paragraphs: The Battle of Iquique was a naval engagement on 21 May 1879, during the War of the Pacific, where a Chilean corvette commanded by Arturo Prat Chacón faced a Peruvian ironclad under Miguel Grau. The battle occurred off the port of Iquique, Peru, and ended with the sinking of the Chilean wooden corvette Esmeralda by the Peruvian ironclad Huáscar after four hours of combat, marking a victory for Peru.

Bitka pri Jumonville Glen, znana tudi kot afera Jumonville, je bila uvodna bitka francosko-indijanske vojne, bojevana 28. maja 1754 blizu današnjih krajev Hopwood in Uniontown v okrožju Fayette v Pensilvaniji. Četa provincialnih vojakov iz Virginije pod poveljstvom podpolkovnika Georgea Washingtona in manjša skupina bojevnikov Mingo pod vodstvom poglavarja Tanacharisona (znanega tudi kot »Polkralj«) je iz zasede napadla 35 francoskih Kanadčanov pod poveljstvom Josepha Coulona de Jumonvilla.

source.title: Battle of Jumonville Glen
paragraphs: The Battle of Jumonville Glen, also known as the Jumonville affair, was the opening battle of the French and Indian War, fought on May 28, 1754, near present-day Hopwood and Uniontown in Fayette County, Pennsylvania. A company of provincial troops from Virginia under the command of Lieutenant Colonel George Washington, and a small number of Mingo warriors led by the chieftain Tanacharison (also known as the "Half King"), ambushed a force of 35 French Canadians under the command of Joseph Coulon de Jumonville.

Battle of Junín.headline: Bitka pri Junínu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Junínu je bil velik konjeniški spopad perujske osamosvojitvene vojne, bojevan 6. avgusta 1824 v visokogorju regije Junín. Februarja tega leta so rojalisti znova zavzeli Limo, Simón Bolívar pa je po ponovnem zbiranju v Trujillu junija povedel uporniške sile proti jugu, nad Špance pod poveljstvom feldmaršala Joséja de Canteraca. Vojski sta se srečali na ravnini Junín na planoti Bombón, severozahodno od doline Jauja.

source.title: Battle of Junín
paragraphs: The Battle of Junín was a large cavalry engagement of the Peruvian War of Independence, fought in the highlands of the Junín Region on 6 August 1824. The preceding February the royalists had regained control of Lima, and having regrouped in Trujillo, Simón Bolívar in June led his rebel forces south to confront the Spanish under Field Marshal José de Canterac. The two armies met on the Plain of Junín in the Bombon Plateau, northwest of the Jauja Valley.

Battle of Lake Erie.headline: Bitka na jezeru Erie
paragraphs: Bitka na jezeru Erie, znana tudi kot bitka pri Put-in-Bayu, je potekala 10. septembra 1813 na jezeru Erie pred obalo Ohia, med vojno leta 1812. Devet ladij mornarice Združenih držav je premagalo in zajelo šest ladij britanske kraljeve mornarice. Američani so si tako zagotovili nadzor nad jezerom do konca vojne, kar jim je omogočilo, da so znova zavzeli Detroit v Michiganu in zmagali v bitki pri reki Thames ter razbili Tecumsehovo indijansko konfederacijo. Bila je ena največjih pomorskih bitk vojne leta 1812.

source.title: Battle of Lake Erie
paragraphs: The Battle of Lake Erie, also known as the Battle of Put-in-Bay, was fought on 10 September 1813, on Lake Erie off the shores of Ohio during the War of 1812. Nine vessels of the United States Navy defeated and captured six vessels of the British Royal Navy. This ensured American control of the lake for the rest of the war, which in turn allowed the Americans to recover Detroit, Michigan and win the Battle of the Thames to break the Indian confederation of Tecumseh. It was one of the largest naval battles of the War of 1812.

Battle of Lake George.headline: Bitka pri jezeru George
paragraphs: Bitka pri jezeru George je potekala 8. septembra 1755 na severu province New York. Bila je del britanske kampanje za izgon Francozov iz Severne Amerike med francosko-indijansko vojno.

General Jean Erdman, baron Dieskau, je povedel francoske redne enote ter kanadske in kahnawaške neredne enote proti siru Williamu Johnsonu in njegovi vojski, ki so jo sestavljali le kolonialni neredni vojaki in bojevniki Haudenosaunee (irokeška zveza šestih narodov) pod vodstvom Hendricka Theyanoguina. Bitka se je končala z zmago Britancev in njihovih zaveznikov.
Bitka je morda najbolj znana po smrti Hendricka Theyanoguina, sir William Johnson pa je za uspeh dobil naziv baroneta. Johnson je nato zgradil utrdbo Fort William Henry, da bi utrdil pridobljeno.

source.title: Battle of Lake George
paragraphs: The Battle of Lake George was fought on 8th of September 1755, in the north of the Province of New York. It was part of a campaign by the British to expel the French from North America, during the French and Indian War.

General Jean Erdman, Baron Dieskau led a force of French regulars and Canadian and Caughnawaga irregulars against Sir William Johnson and his army consisting solely of colonial irregulars and Haudenosaunee (Six Nations Iroquois) warriors under Hendrick Theyanoguin. The battle ended in victory for the British and their allies.

The battle is perhaps best known for the death of Hendrick Theyanoguin, and its success led to the creation of a baronetcy for Sir William Johnson. Afterward, Johnson built Fort William Henry in order to consolidate his gains.

Battle of Los Angeles.headline: Bitka za Los Angeles
paragraphs: Bitka za Los Angeles, znana tudi kot veliki zračni napad na Los Angeles, je ime, ki so ga sodobni viri dali domnevnemu napadu cesarske Japonske na celinske Združene države in protiletalskemu ognju, ki je sledil od poznega 24. do zgodnjega 25. februarja 1942 nad Los Angelesom v Kaliforniji. Med ognjem je umrlo pet civilistov, napačno pa so poročali, da so sestrelili štiri japonska letala. Dogodek se je zgodil manj kot tri mesece po vstopu ZDA v drugo svetovno vojno, ki je sledil presenetljivemu napadu japonske cesarske mornarice na Pearl Harbor, in dan po obstreljevanju Ellwooda pri Santa Barbari 23. februarja. Sprva so menili, da je bila tarča protiletalskega ognja napadalna sila z Japonske, mornariški minister Frank Knox pa je kmalu zatem na novinarski konferenci domnevni napad označil za »lažni preplah«. Takratni časopisi so objavili več poročil in ugibanj o prikrivanju resničnega vdora sovražnih letal.

source.title: Battle of Los Angeles
paragraphs: The Battle of Los Angeles, also known as the Great Los Angeles Air Raid, is the name given by contemporary sources to a rumored attack on the continental United States by Imperial Japan and the subsequent anti-aircraft artillery barrage which took place from late February 24, to early February 25, 1942, over Los Angeles, California. Five civilians died during the barrage and four Japanese aircraft were erroneously reported shot down. The incident occurred less than three months after the U.S. entered World War II in response to the Imperial Japanese Navy's surprise attack on Pearl Harbor, and one day after the bombardment of Ellwood near Santa Barbara on 23 February. Initially, the target of the aerial barrage was thought to be an attacking force from Japan, but speaking at a press conference shortly afterward, Secretary of the Navy Frank Knox called the purported attack a "false alarm". Newspapers of the time published a number of reports and speculations of a cover-up to conceal an actual invasion by enemy airplanes.

Battle of Malvern Hill.headline: Bitka pri Malvern Hillu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Malvern Hillu, znana tudi kot bitka na Poindexterjevi kmetiji, je potekala 1. julija 1862 med konfederacijsko Severnovirginijsko armado pod vodstvom generala Roberta E. Leeja in Potomaško armado Unije pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Georgea B. McClellana. Bila je zadnja bitka sedemdnevnih bitk ameriške državljanske vojne in je potekala na 40 metrov visoki vzpetini Malvern Hill blizu konfederacijske prestolnice Richmonda v Virginiji, le 1,6 km od reke James. Vključno z nedejavnimi rezervami je na vsaki strani sodelovalo več kot petdeset tisoč vojakov, ki so uporabljali več kot dvesto topov in tri vojne ladje.

source.title: Battle of Malvern Hill
paragraphs: The Battle of Malvern Hill, also known as the Battle of Poindexter's Farm, was fought on July 1, 1862, between the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia, led by Gen. Robert E. Lee, and the Union Army of the Potomac under Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan. It was the final battle of the Seven Days Battles during the American Civil War, taking place on a 130-foot (40 m) elevation of land known as Malvern Hill, near the Confederate capital of Richmond, Virginia and just one mile (1.6 km) from the James River. Including inactive reserves, more than fifty thousand soldiers from each side took part, using more than two hundred pieces of artillery and three warships.

Battle of Mobile Bay.headline: Bitka v zalivu Mobile
paragraphs: Bitka v zalivu Mobile 5. avgusta 1864 je bil pomorski in kopenski spopad ameriške državljanske vojne, v katerem je flota Unije pod poveljstvom kontraadmirala Davida G. Farraguta s pomočjo odreda vojakov napadla manjšo konfederacijsko floto admirala Franklina Buchanana in tri utrdbe, ki so varovale vhod v zaliv Mobile: Morgan, Gaines in Powell. Farragutov morda izmišljeni ukaz »Prekleti torpedi! Štirje zvonci. Kapitan Drayton, naprej! Jouett, s polno hitrostjo!« je zaslovel v predelani obliki »Prekleti torpedi, s polno paro naprej!«.

source.title: Battle of Mobile Bay
paragraphs: The Battle of Mobile Bay of August 5, 1864, was a naval and land engagement of the American Civil War in which a Union fleet commanded by Rear Admiral David G. Farragut, assisted by a contingent of soldiers, attacked a smaller Confederate fleet led by Admiral Franklin Buchanan and three forts that guarded the entrance to Mobile Bay: Morgan, Gaines and Powell. Farragut's perhaps apocryphal order of "Damn the torpedoes! Four bells. Captain Drayton, go ahead! Jouett, full speed!" became famous in paraphrase, as "Damn the torpedoes, full speed ahead!"

V bitki pri Monterreyju (21.–24. septembra 1846) med mehiško-ameriško vojno je zasedbena vojska, sestavljena iz rednih enot, prostovoljcev in teksaških rangerjev Združenih držav pod poveljstvom generala Zacharyja Taylorja, premagala generala Pedra de Ampudio in mehiško Severno armado.
Ogorčeni ulični boji so na obeh straneh zahtevali velike izgube. Bitka se je končala s pogajanji o dvomesečnem premirju, mehiške sile pa so se v zameno za predajo mesta smele urejeno umakniti.

source.title: Battle of Monterrey
paragraphs: In the Battle of Monterrey (September 21–24, 1846) during the Mexican–American War, General Pedro de Ampudia and the Mexican Army of the North was defeated by the Army of Occupation, a force of United States Regulars, Volunteers, and Texas Rangers under the command of General Zachary Taylor.

The hard-fought urban combat led to heavy casualties on both sides. The battle ended with both sides negotiating a two-month armistice and the Mexican forces being allowed to make an orderly evacuation in return for the surrender of the city.

Battle of Nashville.headline: Bitka pri Nashvillu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nashvillu je bila dvodnevna bitka kampanje Franklin–Nashville, ki je pomenila konec obsežnih bojev zahodno od obalnih držav v ameriški državljanski vojni. Potekala je pri Nashvillu v Tennesseeju 15. in 16. decembra 1864 med konfederacijsko Tennesseejsko armado pod poveljstvom generalporočnika Johna Bella Hooda in Cumberlandsko armado Unije (Cumberlandsko okrožje, AoC) pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Georgea H. Thomasa. V eni največjih zmag vojske Unije v tej vojni je Thomas napadel in razbil Hoodovo vojsko ter jo kot bojno silo večinoma uničil.

source.title: Battle of Nashville
paragraphs: The Battle of Nashville was a two-day battle in the Franklin–Nashville campaign that represented the end of large-scale fighting west of the coastal states in the American Civil War. It was fought at Nashville, Tennessee, on December 15–16, 1864, between the Confederate Army of Tennessee under Lieutenant General John Bell Hood and the Union Army of the Cumberland (Dept. of the Cumberland) (AoC) under Major General George H. Thomas. In one of the largest victories achieved by the Union army during the war, Thomas attacked and routed Hood's army, largely destroying it as an effective fighting force.

Bitka za New Orleans je potekala 8. januarja 1815 med britansko vojsko pod poveljstvom generalmajorja sira Edwarda Pakenhama in vojsko Združenih držav pod poveljstvom brevetnega generalmajorja Andrewa Jacksona, približno 8 km jugovzhodno od francoske četrti New Orleansa, v današnjem predmestju Chalmette v Louisiani.

Bitka je bila vrhunec petmesečne britanske zalivske kampanje (september 1814–februar 1815) za zavzetje New Orleansa, Zahodne Floride in morda ozemlja Louisiana, ki se je začela s prvo bitko za Fort Bowyer. Britanija je kampanjo za New Orleans začela 14. decembra 1814 z bitko na jezeru Borgne, v tednih pred odločilno bitko pa so si sledili številni spopadi in topniški dvoboji.

source.title: Battle of New Orleans
paragraphs: The Battle of New Orleans was fought on January 8, 1815, between the British Army under Major General Sir Edward Pakenham and the United States Army under Brevet Major General Andrew Jackson, roughly 5 miles (8 km) southeast of the French Quarter of New Orleans, in the current suburb of Chalmette, Louisiana.

The battle was the climax of the five-month Gulf Campaign (September 1814 to February 1815) by Britain to try to take New Orleans, West Florida, and possibly the Louisiana Territory which began at the First Battle of Fort Bowyer. Britain started the New Orleans campaign on December 14, 1814, at the Battle of Lake Borgne and numerous skirmishes and artillery duels happened in the weeks leading up to the final battle.

Battle of North Anna.headline: Bitka pri reki North Anna
paragraphs: Bitka pri reki North Anna je potekala od 23. do 26. maja 1864 v okviru kopenske kampanje generalporočnika Unije Ulyssesa S. Granta proti Severnovirginijski armadi konfederacijskega generala Roberta E. Leeja. Namesto splošnega spopada med armadama jo je sestavljala vrsta manjših spopadov ob reki North Anna v osrednji Virginiji. Posamezne spopade včasih imenujejo ločeno: Telegraph Road Bridge in Jericho Mills (spopadi 23. maja) ter Ox Ford, Quarles Mill in Hanover Junction (23. maja).

source.title: Battle of North Anna
paragraphs: The Battle of North Anna was fought May 23–26, 1864, as part of Union Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's Overland Campaign against Confederate Gen. Robert E. Lee's Army of Northern Virginia. It consisted of a series of small actions near the North Anna River in central Virginia rather than a general engagement between the armies. The individual actions are sometimes separately known as: Telegraph Road Bridge and Jericho Mills (for actions on May 23); Ox Ford, Quarles Mill, and Hanover Junction (May 23).

Battle of Otumba.headline: Bitka pri Otumbi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Otumbi je bila velika bitka, bojevana 7. julija 1520 med Azteškim imperijem in njegovimi zavezniki pod vodstvom cihuacoatla Matlatzincátzina ter španskimi konkvistadorji Hernána Cortésa, ki jih je podpirala konfederacija Tlaxcala. Potekala je na ravnini Temalcatitlán blizu današnje Otumbe med špansko osvojitvijo Azteškega imperija. Španci so se uspešno ubranili, kar je Cortésu omogočilo, da je reorganiziral vojsko, ki je nekaj dni prej utrpela hude izgube med umikom iz azteške prestolnice Tenochtitlan, danes znanim kot La Noche Triste (»žalostna noč«). Leto pozneje je Cortés z novimi možmi in zalogami ter v zavezništvu s konfederacijo Tlaxcala našel pot nazaj v Tenochtitlan.

source.title: Battle of Otumba
paragraphs: The Battle of Otumba was a major battle fought on 7 July 1520 between the Aztec Empire and its allies led by the Cihuacoatl Matlatzincátzin, and Spanish conquistadors under Hernán Cortés, alongside support from the Confederacy of Tlaxcala. The battle was fought on the plain of Temalcatitlán, near modern-day Otumba during the conquest of the Aztec Empire by Spain. The result of the battle was a successful defense for the Spanish, which allowed Cortés to reorganize his army, having suffered heavy casualties a few days before during his army's retreat from the Aztec capital Tenochtitlan, now known as La Noche Triste. A year later, by reinforcing his army with new men and supplies, and starting an alliance with the Tlaxcala Confederacy, Cortés found a way to reenter Tenochtitlan.

Battle of Palo Alto.headline: Bitka pri Palo Altu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Palo Altu (špansko: Batalla de Palo Alto) je bila prva velika bitka mehiško-ameriške vojne, bojevana 8. maja 1846 na spornem ozemlju 8 km od današnjega mesta Brownsville v Teksasu. Okoli 3700 mehiških vojakov, večina Severne armade, pod vodstvom generala Mariana Ariste se je spopadlo s približno 2300 vojaki Združenih držav, zasedbeno vojsko generala Zacharyja Taylorja.

source.title: Battle of Palo Alto
paragraphs: The Battle of Palo Alto (Spanish: Batalla de Palo Alto) was the first major battle of the Mexican–American War and was fought on May 8, 1846, on disputed ground five miles (8 km) from the modern-day city of Brownsville, Texas. A force of some 3,700 Mexican troops – most of the Army of The North – led by General Mariano Arista engaged a force of approximately 2,300 United States troops – the Army of Occupation led by General Zachary Taylor.

Battle of Pavón.headline: Bitka pri Pavónu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pavónu, ključna bitka argentinskih državljanskih vojn, je potekala 17. septembra 1861 v Pavónu v provinci Santa Fe v Argentini med vojsko Države Buenos Aires (pod poveljstvom Bartoloméja Mitreja) in vojsko Republike Argentinske konfederacije (pod poveljstvom Justa Joséja de Urquize). Ko se je Urquiza umaknil, je bojišče pripadlo Mitreju.

Zmaga je privedla do razpustitve državne vlade in ponovne priključitve province Buenos Aires Argentinski republiki, v kateri je postala prevladujoča članica. Guverner Bartolomé Mitre je postal začasni predsednik, kar je potrdil narodni kongres, nato pa prvi predsednik združene Argentinske republike.

source.title: Battle of Pavón
paragraphs: The Battle of Pavón, a key battle of the Argentine Civil Wars, was fought in Pavón, Santa Fé Province, Argentina on 17 September 1861 between the Army of the State of Buenos Aires (commanded by Bartolomé Mitre) and the Army of Republic of the Argentine Confederation (commanded by Justo José de Urquiza). The withdrawal of Urquiza left the field to Mitre.

The victory led to the dissolution of the national government and the reincorporation of Buenos Aires Province into the Argentine Republic as a dominant member of the nation. Governor Bartolomé Mitre would act as interim president, ratified by the National Congress, and then as the first president of a unified Argentine Republic.

Battle of Pea Ridge.headline: Bitka pri Pea Ridgeu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pea Ridgeu (7.–8. marca 1862), znana tudi kot bitka pri gostilni Elkhorn, je potekala med ameriško državljansko vojno blizu Leetowna severovzhodno od Fayettevilla v Arkansasu. Zvezne sile pod vodstvom brigadnega generala Samuela R. Curtisa so se iz osrednjega Missourija pomikale proti jugu in potiskale konfederacijske sile v severozahodni Arkansas. Generalmajor Earl Van Dorn je sprožil konfederacijsko protiofenzivo v upanju, da bo znova zavzel severni Arkansas in Missouri. Konfederacijske sile so se zbrale pri Bentonvillu in postale po številu topov in mož najmočnejša uporniška sila na območju zahodno od Misisipija. Curtis je proti pričakovanjem prvi dan odbil konfederacijski napad, drugi dan pa Van Dornove sile pregnal z bojišča. S tem je Unija vzpostavila zvezni nadzor nad večino Missourija in severnim Arkansasom.

source.title: Battle of Pea Ridge
paragraphs: The Battle of Pea Ridge (March 7–8, 1862), also known as the Battle of Elkhorn Tavern, took place during the American Civil War near Leetown, northeast of Fayetteville, Arkansas. Federal forces, led by Brigadier General Samuel R. Curtis, moved south from central Missouri, driving Confederate forces into northwestern Arkansas. Major General Earl Van Dorn had launched a Confederate counteroffensive, hoping to recapture northern Arkansas and Missouri. Confederate forces met at Bentonville and became the most substantial Rebel force, by way of guns and men, to assemble in the Trans-Mississippi. Against the odds, Curtis held off the Confederate attack on the first day and drove Van Dorn's force off the battlefield on the second. By defeating the Confederates, the Union forces established Federal control of most of Missouri and northern Arkansas.

Battle of Perryville.headline: Bitka pri Perryvillu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Perryvillu, znana tudi kot bitka v gričevju Chaplin, je potekala 8. oktobra 1862 v gričevju Chaplin zahodno od Perryvilla v Kentuckyju kot vrhunec konfederacijske ofenzive Heartland (kentuckyjska kampanja) med ameriško državljansko vojno. Misisipijska armada konfederacijskega generala Braxtona Bragga je sprva taktično zmagala nad večinoma enim samim korpusom Ohijske armade Unije generalmajorja Dona Carlosa Buella. Bitka velja za strateško zmago Unije, imenovano tudi bitka za Kentucky, saj se je Bragg kmalu zatem umaknil v Tennessee. Unija je ključno obmejno zvezno državo Kentucky obdržala do konca vojne.

source.title: Battle of Perryville
paragraphs: The Battle of Perryville, also known as the Battle of Chaplin Hills, was fought on October 8, 1862, in the Chaplin Hills west of Perryville, Kentucky, as the culmination of the Confederate Heartland Offensive (Kentucky Campaign) during the American Civil War. Confederate Gen. Braxton Bragg's Army of Mississippi initially won a tactical victory against primarily a single corps of Maj. Gen. Don Carlos Buell's Union Army of the Ohio. The battle is considered a strategic Union victory, sometimes called the Battle for Kentucky, since Bragg withdrew to Tennessee soon thereafter. The Union retained control of the critical border state of Kentucky for the remainder of the war.

Battle of Pichincha.headline: Bitka pri Pichinchi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pichinchi je potekala 24. maja 1822 na pobočjih ognjenika Pichincha, 3500 metrov nad morjem, tik ob mestu Quito v današnjem Ekvadorju.

V spopadu, ki je potekal v okviru hispanskoameriških osamosvojitvenih vojn, se je domoljubna vojska pod poveljstvom generala Antonia Joséja de Sucreja spopadla z rojalistično vojsko pod poveljstvom feldmaršala Melchorja Aymericha. Poraz rojalističnih sil, zvestih Španiji, je osvobodil Quito in zagotovil neodvisnost provinc Kraljeve avdience Quito (Real Audiencia de Quito) ali predsedstva Quito, španskega kolonialnega upravnega območja, iz katerega je pozneje nastala Republika Ekvador.

source.title: Battle of Pichincha
paragraphs: The Battle of Pichincha took place on 24 May 1822, on the slopes of the Pichincha volcano, 3,500 meters above sea-level, right next to the city of Quito, in modern Ecuador.

The encounter, fought in the context of the Spanish American wars of independence, pitted a Patriot army under General Antonio José de Sucre against a Royalist army commanded by Field Marshal Melchor Aymerich. The defeat of the Royalist forces loyal to Spain brought about the liberation of Quito, and secured the independence of the provinces belonging to the Real Audiencia de Quito, or Presidencia de Quito, the Spanish colonial administrative jurisdiction from which the Republic of Ecuador would eventually emerge.

Battle of Plattsburgh.headline: Bitka pri Plattsburghu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Plattsburghu, znana tudi kot bitka na jezeru Champlain, je končala zadnji britanski vdor v severne zvezne države ZDA med vojno leta 1812. Dve britanski sili, vojska generalporočnika sira Georgea Prevosta in pomorska eskadra kapitana Georgea Downieja, sta se zgrnili na obrežno mesto Plattsburgh v New Yorku. Mesto so branile milice New Yorka in Vermonta ter odredi rednih enot vojske Združenih držav, vse pod poveljstvom brigadnega generala Alexandra Macomba, ter ladje pod poveljstvom poveljnika Thomasa Macdonougha.

Downiejeva eskadra je napadla kmalu po zori 11. septembra 1814, a je bila po hudem boju, v katerem je Downie padel, poražena. Prevost je nato opustil kopenski napad na Macombovo obrambo in se umaknil v Kanado, češ da britanskih čet v Plattsburghu, tudi če bi ga zavzeli, brez nadzora nad jezerom ne bi mogli oskrbovati.

source.title: Battle of Plattsburgh
paragraphs: The Battle of Plattsburgh, also known as the Battle of Lake Champlain, ended the final British invasion of the northern states of the United States during the War of 1812. Two British forces, an army under Lieutenant General Sir George Prevost and a naval squadron under Captain George Downie converged on the lakeside town of Plattsburgh, New York.
