Plattsburgh was defended by New York and Vermont militia and detachments of regular troops of the United States Army, all under the command of Brigadier General Alexander Macomb, and ships commanded by Master Commandant Thomas Macdonough.

Downie's squadron attacked shortly after dawn on 11 September 1814, but was defeated after a hard fight in which Downie was killed. Prevost then abandoned the attack by land against Macomb's defences and retreated to Canada, stating that even if Plattsburgh was captured, any British troops there could not be supplied without control of the lake.

Battle of Puebla.headline: Bitka pri Puebli
paragraphs: Bitka pri Puebli (špansko: Batalla de Puebla, francosko: Bataille de Puebla), znana tudi kot bitka petega maja (Batalla del Cinco de Mayo), je potekala 5. maja 1862 pri mestu Puebla de los Ángeles med drugo francosko intervencijo v Mehiki. Francoskim četam pod poveljstvom Charlesa de Lorenceza večkrat ni uspelo zavzeti utrdb Loreto in Guadalupe na vrhu gričev nad mestom Puebla, zato so se nazadnje umaknile v Orizabo, da bi počakale na okrepitve. Lorenceza so odstavili, francoske čete pod poveljstvom Élieja Frédérica Foreyja so mesto nazadnje zavzele, a je mehiška zmaga pri Puebli nad bolje opremljeno vojsko Mehičanom vlila domoljubni navdih.

source.title: Battle of Puebla
paragraphs: The Battle of Puebla (Spanish: Batalla de Puebla; French: Bataille de Puebla), also known as the Battle of the Fifth of May (Spanish: Batalla del Cinco de Mayo) took place on 5 May 1862, near Puebla de los Ángeles, during the second French intervention in Mexico. French troops under the command of Charles de Lorencez repeatedly failed to storm the forts of Loreto and Guadalupe situated on top of the hills overlooking the city of Puebla, and eventually retreated to Orizaba in order to await reinforcements. Lorencez was dismissed from his command, and French troops under Élie Frédéric Forey eventually took the city, but the Mexican victory at Puebla against a better equipped force provided patriotic inspiration to the Mexicans.

Battle of Quebec (1690).headline: Bitka za Quebec (1690)
paragraphs: Bitka za Quebec je oktobra 1690 potekala med kolonijama Nova Francija in Massachusettski zaliv, ki sta jima tedaj vladali kraljestvi Francija oziroma Anglija. Obramba mesta Quebec je bila takrat prvič preizkušena. Po zavzetju Port Royala v Akadiji med vojno kralja Viljema so Novoangleženi upali zavzeti tudi sam Quebec, prestolnico Nove Francije. Izguba akadijske utrdbe je Kanadčane pretresla, generalni guverner Louis de Buade de Frontenac pa je ukazal mesto takoj pripraviti na morebitno obleganje.

source.title: Battle of Quebec (1690)
paragraphs: The Battle of Quebec was fought in October 1690 between the colonies of New France and Massachusetts Bay, then ruled by the kingdoms of France and England, respectively. It was the first time Quebec City's defences were tested. Following the capture of Port Royal in Acadia, during King William's War, the New Englanders hoped to seize Quebec City itself, the capital of New France. The loss of the Acadian fort shocked the Canadiens, and Governor-General Louis de Buade de Frontenac ordered the immediate preparation of the city for a possible siege.

Battle of Queenston Heights.headline: Bitka pri Queenston Heightsu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Queenston Heightsu je bila prvi večji spopad vojne leta 1812. Potekala je 13. oktobra 1812 pri Queenstonu v Gornji Kanadi (danes Ontario) in se je končala z odločilno britansko zmago. Redne enote Združenih držav in milica New Yorka pod vodstvom generalmajorja Stephena Van Rensselaerja so iz Lewistona prečkale reko Niagaro in se spopadle z britanskimi rednimi enotami in kanadsko milico pod vodstvom generalmajorja Isaaca Brocka. Ko je Brock padel, je poveljstvo britanskih sil prevzel generalmajor Roger Hale Sheaffe. Britance so v bitki podpirali mohavški bojevniki pod vodstvom Johna Nortona.

source.title: Battle of Queenston Heights
paragraphs: The Battle of Queenston Heights was the first major engagement of the War of 1812. The battle took place on 13 October 1812, at Queenston in Upper Canada (now Ontario) and was a decisive British victory. United States regulars and New York militia led by Major General Stephen Van Rensselaer crossed the Niagara River from Lewiston and engaged British regulars and Canadian militia led by Major General Isaac Brock. Major General Roger Hale Sheaffe took command of British forces after Brock was killed. Mohawk warriors led by John Norton supported the British during the battle.

Battle of Rancagua.headline: Bitka pri Rancagui
paragraphs: Bitka pri Rancagui, v Čilu znana tudi kot katastrofa pri Rancagui, je potekala od 1. do 2. oktobra 1814, ko je španska vojska pod poveljstvom Mariana Osoria premagala čilske sile pod vodstvom Bernarda O'Higginsa. S tem se je končalo čilsko obdobje Patria Vieja (»stara domovina«), bitka pa je bila odločilni korak španske vojaške ponovne osvojitve Čila.

source.title: Battle of Rancagua
paragraphs: The Battle of Rancagua, also known in Chile as the Disaster of Rancagua, occurred on October 1, 1814, to October 2, 1814, when the Spanish Army under the command of Mariano Osorio defeated the Chilean forces led by Bernardo O’Higgins. This put an end to the Chilean Patria Vieja and it was the decisive step of the Spanish military Reconquest of Chile.

Battle of Riachuelo.headline: Bitka pri Riachuelu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Riachuelu je bila velika in odločilna pomorska bitka paragvajske vojne med Paragvajem in Brazilskim cesarstvom. Do konca leta 1864 je Paragvaj v vojni dosegel vrsto zmag, a je pomorski poraz, ki so mu ga Brazilci 11. junija 1865 zadali na reki Parani, začel obračati tok vojne v korist zaveznikov.

source.title: Battle of Riachuelo
paragraphs: The Battle of Riachuelo (or Battle of the Riachuelo) was a large and decisive naval battle of the Paraguayan War between Paraguay and the Empire of Brazil. By late 1864, Paraguay had scored a series of victories in the war, but on 11 June 1865, its naval defeat by the Brazilians on the Paraná River began to turn the tide in favor of the allies.

Bitka pri Sainte-Foyju (francosko: Bataille de Sainte-Foy), včasih imenovana bitka za Quebec (Bataille du Quebec), je potekala 28. aprila 1760 blizu mesta Quebec, ki so ga držali Britanci, v francoski provinci Kanadi med sedemletno vojno (v Združenih državah imenovano francosko-indijanska vojna). Francozi pod poveljstvom viteza de Lévisa so premagali britansko vojsko generala Murrayja. Bitka je bila precej bolj krvava od bitke na Abrahamovi planoti prejšnjega septembra: Francozi so imeli 833 mrtvih in ranjenih, Britanci 1124.

Britanci so bili sprva nekoliko uspešni, a je napredovanje zakrilo njihovo topništvo, pehota pa je obtičala v blatu in kopnečih snežnih zametih pozne pomladi. Bitka se je sprevrgla v dveurni boj od blizu; ko se je v spopad vključevalo vse več francoskih vojakov, so Francozi nazadnje obšli britanski krili. Murray je spoznal svojo napako in Britance poklical nazaj v Quebec, brez topov, ki jih je Lévis nato obrnil proti mestu.

source.title: Battle of Sainte-Foy
paragraphs: The Battle of Sainte-Foy (French: Bataille de Sainte-Foy) sometimes called the Battle of Quebec (French: Bataille du Quebec), was fought on April 28, 1760, near the British-held town of Quebec in the French province of Canada during the Seven Years' War (called the French and Indian War in the United States). It was a victory for the French under the Chevalier de Lévis over the British army under General Murray. The battle was notably bloodier than the Battle of the Plains of Abraham of the previous September, with 833 French casualties to 1,124 British casualties.

At first the British had some success, but the advance masked their artillery, while the infantry became bogged down in the mud and melting snowdrifts of the late spring. The battle turned into a two-hour fight at close range; eventually, as more French soldiers joined the fray, the French turned the British flanks, forcing Murray to realize his mistake and to recall the British back to Quebec without their guns, which Lévis then turned on the city.

Battle of San Patricio.headline: Bitka pri San Patriciu
paragraphs: Bitka pri San Patriciu je potekala 27. februarja 1836 med teksijskimi uporniki in mehiško vojsko med teksaško revolucijo. Izšla je iz teksijske odprave na Matamoros. Z njo se je začela kampanja za Goliad, mehiška ofenziva za ponovno osvojitev teksaške zalivske obale. Potekala je v San Patriciu in okolici.

Do konca leta 1835 so iz Teksasa pregnali vse mehiške čete. Poveljnik prostovoljske vojske v Teksasu Frank W. Johnson in James Grant sta zbirala prostovoljce za načrtovani vdor v mehiško pristaniško mesto Matamoros. Februarja 1836 sta Johnson in okoli 40 mož v pripravah na odpravo prignala čredo konj v San Patricio. Johnson je del vojakov poslal na ranč 6,4 km zunaj mesta, da bi varovali konje, preostali pa so se razporedili na treh krajih v mestu.

source.title: Battle of San Patricio
paragraphs: The Battle of San Patricio was fought on February 27, 1836, between Texian rebels and the Mexican army, during the Texas Revolution. The battle occurred as a result of the outgrowth of the Texian Matamoros Expedition. The battle marked the start of the Goliad Campaign, the Mexican offensive to retake the Texas Gulf Coast. It took place in and around San Patricio.

By the end of 1835, all Mexican troops had been driven from Texas. Frank W. Johnson, the commander of the volunteer army in Texas, and James Grant gathered volunteers for a planned invasion of the Mexican port town of Matamoros. In February 1836, Johnson and about 40 men led a herd of horses to San Patricio in preparation for the expedition. Johnson assigned some of his troops to a ranch 4 miles (6.4 km) outside town to guard the horses, while the rest of his men garrisoned in three different locations in town.

Battle of Santa Clara.headline: Bitka za Santa Claro
paragraphs: Bitka za Santa Claro je bila vrsta dogodkov konec decembra 1958, v katerih so uporniške sile pod poveljstvom Cheja Guevare ob koncu kubanske revolucije zavzele kubansko mesto Santa Clara. Bitka je bila odločilna zmaga upornikov, ki so se borili proti režimu generala Fulgencia Batiste, in je dosegla vrhunec z zmagoslavjem revolucije. V 12 urah po zavzetju mesta je Batista pobegnil s Kube, sile Fidela Castra pa so razglasile popolno zmago.

source.title: Battle of Santa Clara
paragraphs: The Battle of Santa Clara was a series of events in late December 1958 that led to the capture of the Cuban city of Santa Clara by rebel forces under the command of Che Guevara at the end of the Cuban Revolution. A decisive victory for the rebels who fought against the regime of General Fulgencio Batista, the battle culminated in the Triumph of the Revolution. Within 12 hours of the city's capture, Batista fled Cuba, and Fidel Castro's forces claimed overall victory.

Bitka pred Santiagom de Cuba je potekala 3. julija 1898 med špansko-ameriško vojno, med eskadro mornarice Združenih držav pod vodstvom kontraadmirala Williama T. Sampsona in komodorja Winfielda Scotta Schleyja ter eskadro španske mornarice pod poveljstvom kontraadmirala Pascuala Cervere y Topeteja. Precej močnejša ameriška eskadra s štirimi bojnimi ladjami in dvema oklepnima križarkama je odločilno premagala slabše oboroženo špansko eskadro s štirimi oklepnimi križarkami in dvema rušilcema ter potopila vse Cervereve ladje, sama pa ni izgubila nobene. Ta uničujoči poraz je zapečatil ameriško zmago na kubanskem bojišču vojne in Kubi zagotovil neodvisnost od španske oblasti.

source.title: Battle of Santiago de Cuba
paragraphs: The Battle of Santiago de Cuba was fought on July 3, 1898, between a United States Navy squadron led by Rear Admiral William T. Sampson and Commodore Winfield Scott Schley and a Spanish Navy squadron under Counter-admiral Pascual Cervera y Topete during the Spanish–American War. The significantly more powerful American squadron, comprising four battleships and two armored cruisers, decisively defeated the outgunned Spanish squadron, which consisted of four armored cruisers and two destroyers, sinking all of Cervera's ships while losing none of their own. The crushing defeat sealed the American victory in the Cuban theater of the war, ensuring Cuba's independence from Spanish rule.

Battle of Seven Pines.headline: Bitka pri Seven Pinesu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Seven Pinesu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Fair Oaksu ali Fair Oaks Stationu, je potekala 31. maja in 1. junija 1862 v okrožju Henrico v Virginiji, v okviru polotoške kampanje ameriške državljanske vojne.

Potomaška armada Unije pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Georgea B. McClellana je napredovala po Virginijskem polotoku in dosegla obrobje Richmonda, konfederacijske prestolnice. Konfederacijski general Joseph E. Johnston je 31. maja skušal premagati dva zvezna korpusa, ki sta bila, kot je kazalo, južno od reke Chickahominy osamljena.

Konfederacijski napadi so bili slabo usklajeni, a so vseeno potisnili IV. korpus nazaj in mu prizadejali hude izgube. Prispele so okrepitve in obe strani sta v boj pošiljali vse več vojakov. Ob podpori III. korpusa in divizije generalmajorja Johna Sedgwicka iz II. korpusa generalmajorja Edwina V. Sumnerja (ki je narasla reko prečkala po mostu Grapevine) so zvezni položaj nazadnje utrdili.

source.title: Battle of Seven Pines
paragraphs: The Battle of Seven Pines, also known as the Battle of Fair Oaks or Fair Oaks Station, took place on May 31 and June 1, 1862, in Henrico County, Virginia, as part of the Peninsula campaign of the American Civil War.

The Union's Army of the Potomac, commanded by Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan, had moved up the Virginia Peninsula, reaching the outskirts of Richmond, the Confederate capital. On May 31, Confederate General Joseph E. Johnston attempted to overwhelm two Federal corps that appeared isolated south of the Chickahominy River.

The Confederate assaults, although poorly coordinated, succeeded in driving back the IV Corps and inflicting heavy casualties. Reinforcements arrived, and both sides fed more and more troops into the action. Supported by the III Corps and Maj. Gen. John Sedgwick's division of Maj. Gen. Edwin V. Sumner's II Corps (which crossed the rain-swollen river on Grapevine Bridge), the Federal position was finally stabilized.

Bitka pri Shilohu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Pittsburg Landingu, je bila velika bitka ameriške državljanske vojne, bojevana 6. in 7. aprila 1862. Boji so potekali na jugozahodu Tennesseeja, na zahodnem bojišču vojne. Bojišče leži med majhno, neopazno cerkvijo Shiloh in pristajališčem Pittsburg Landing ob reki Tennessee. Dve armadi Unije sta skupaj premagali konfederacijsko Misisipijsko armado. Poveljnik Unije je bil generalmajor Ulysses S. Grant, konfederacijski pa general Albert Sidney Johnston, dokler ni padel na bojišču in ga je nadomestil njegov namestnik, general P. G. T. Beauregard.

source.title: Battle of Shiloh
paragraphs: The Battle of Shiloh, also known as the Battle of Pittsburg Landing, was a major battle in the American Civil War fought on April 6–7, 1862. The fighting took place in southwestern Tennessee, which was part of the war's western theater. The battlefield is located between a small, undistinguished church named Shiloh and Pittsburg Landing on the Tennessee River. Two Union armies combined to defeat the Confederate Army of Mississippi. Major General Ulysses S. Grant was the Union commander, while General Albert Sidney Johnston was the Confederate commander until his battlefield death, when he was replaced by his second-in-command, General P. G. T. Beauregard.

Battle of Signal Hill.headline: Bitka pri Signal Hillu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Signal Hillu, bojevana 15. septembra 1762, je bila zadnja bitka francosko-indijanske vojne. Britanske sile pod poveljstvom podpolkovnika Williama Amhersta so znova zavzele St. John's, ki so ga Francozi zgodaj istega leta zasedli z nenadnim napadom, ki ga nekateri viri opisujejo kot zasedo.

source.title: Battle of Signal Hill
paragraphs: The Battle of Signal Hill, fought on 15 September 1762, was the last battle of the French and Indian War. A British force under Lieutenant-colonel William Amherst recaptured St. John's, which the French had seized earlier that year in a surprise attack described in some accounts as an ambush.

Battle of Sitka.headline: Bitka pri Sitki
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sitki (rusko: Сражение при Ситке) leta 1804 je bil zadnji večji oboroženi spopad med Rusi in aljaškimi staroselci, sprožili pa so jo kot odgovor na uničenje ruske trgovske postojanke dve leti prej. Glavni strani v spopadu sta bili klan Kiks.ádi (»tisti iz Kíksa«, Žaba/Krokar) z otoka Sheetʼká Xʼáatʼi (Baranof) iz tlingitskega naroda ter predstavniki Rusko-ameriške družbe, ki jim je pomagala ruska cesarska mornarica.

source.title: Battle of Sitka
paragraphs: The Battle of Sitka (Russian: Сражение при Ситке) in 1804 was the last major armed conflict between the Russians and Alaska Natives, and was initiated in response to the destruction of a Russian trading post two years before. The primary combatant groups were the Kiks.ádi ("Ones of Kíks", Frog/Raven) clan of Sheetʼká Xʼáatʼi (Baranof Island) of the Tlingit nation and agents of the Russian-American Company assisted by the Imperial Russian Navy.

Battle of South Mountain.headline: Bitka pri South Mountainu
paragraphs: Bitka pri South Mountainu, v več zgodnjih južnjaških poročilih znana kot bitka pri prelazu Boonsboro, je potekala 14. septembra 1862 v okviru marylandske kampanje ameriške državljanske vojne. Za tri prelaze čez South Mountain, Crampton's, Turner's in Fox's Gap, so se bile tri bitke.

Generalmajor George B. McClellan, poveljnik Potomaške armade Unije, je moral skozi te prelaze, da bi zasledoval nevarno razdeljeno Severnovirginijsko armado konfederacijskega generala Roberta E. Leeja.

Čeprav mu je zamuda, pridobljena pri South Mountainu, omogočila, da je vojsko znova združil in preprečil, da bi jo sovražnik premagal po delih, je Lee ob mraku razmišljal o koncu marylandske kampanje.

source.title: Battle of South Mountain
paragraphs: The Battle of South Mountain, known in several early Southern accounts as the Battle of Boonsboro Gap, was fought on September 14, 1862, as part of the Maryland campaign of the American Civil War. Three pitched battles were fought for possession of three South Mountain passes: Crampton's, Turner's, and Fox's Gaps.

Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan, commanding the Union Army of the Potomac, needed to pass through these gaps in his pursuit of Confederate General Robert E. Lee's precariously divided Army of Northern Virginia.
Although the delay bought at South Mountain would allow him to reunite his army and forestall defeat in detail, Lee considered termination of the Maryland Campaign at nightfall.

Bitka pri Spotsylvania Court House, včasih krajše bitka pri Spotsylvaniji (v zapisu iz 19. stoletja Spottsylvania), je bila druga velika bitka kopenske kampanje generalporočnika Ulyssesa S. Granta in generalmajorja Georgea G. Meada leta 1864 v ameriški državljanski vojni. Po krvavi, a neodločeni bitki v Wildernessu se je Grantova vojska odlepila od vojske konfederacijskega generala Roberta E. Leeja in se pomaknila proti jugovzhodu, da bi Leeja zvabila v boj v ugodnejših razmerah. Deli Leejeve vojske so prehiteli vojsko Unije do ključnega križišča pri Spotsylvania Court House v okrožju Spotsylvania v Virginiji in se začeli utrjevati. Boji so se z vmesnimi premori vrstili od 8. do 21. maja 1864, ko je Grant z različnimi načrti skušal prebiti konfederacijsko črto. Bitka je bila nazadnje taktično neodločena, a sta obe strani razglasili zmago: Konfederacija, ker je obdržala obrambne položaje, Združene države pa, ker se je ofenziva Unije nadaljevala, Leejeva vojska pa je utrpela izgube, ki jih ni mogla nadomestiti. S skoraj 32.000 mrtvimi, ranjenimi in pogrešanimi na obeh straneh je bila najdražja bitka kampanje.

source.title: Battle of Spotsylvania Court House
paragraphs: The Battle of Spotsylvania Court House, sometimes more simply referred to as the Battle of Spotsylvania (or the 19th-century spelling Spottsylvania), was the second major battle in Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant and Maj. Gen. George G. Meade's 1864 Overland Campaign of the American Civil War. Following the bloody but inconclusive Battle of the Wilderness, Grant's army disengaged from Confederate General Robert E. Lee's army and moved to the southeast, attempting to lure Lee into battle under more favorable conditions. Elements of Lee's army beat the Union army to the critical crossroads of the Spotsylvania Court House in Spotsylvania County, Virginia, and began entrenching. Fighting occurred on and off from May 8 through May 21, 1864, as Grant tried various schemes to break the Confederate line. In the end, the battle was tactically inconclusive, but both sides declared victory. The Confederacy declared victory because they were able to hold their defenses. The United States declared victory because the Union offensive continued and Lee's army suffered losses that could not be replaced. With almost 32,000 casualties on both sides, Spotsylvania was the costliest battle of the campaign.

Bitka pri reki Stones, znana tudi kot druga bitka pri Murfreesboru, je potekala od 31. decembra 1862 do 2. januarja 1863 v srednjem Tennesseeju kot vrhunec kampanje ob reki Stones na zahodnem bojišču ameriške državljanske vojne. Med velikimi bitkami vojne je imela največji delež žrtev na obeh straneh. Končala se je z zmago Unije, ko se je konfederacijska vojska 3. januarja umaknila, predvsem zaradi vrste taktičnih napak konfederacijskega generala Braxtona Bragga, a je zmaga vojsko Unije drago stala. Kljub temu je bila za Unijo pomembna, saj je po nedavnem porazu pri Fredericksburgu močno dvignila moralo, predsedniku Abrahamu Lincolnu pa je utrdila temelje za razglasitev proklamacije o osvoboditvi sužnjev, ki je evropske sile nazadnje odvrnila od posredovanja v korist Konfederacije.

source.title: Battle of Stones River
paragraphs: The Battle of Stones River, also known as the Second Battle of Murfreesboro, was fought from December 31, 1862, to January 2, 1863, in Middle Tennessee, as the culmination of the Stones River Campaign in the Western Theater of the American Civil War. Of the major battles of the war, Stones River had the highest percentage of casualties on both sides. The battle ended in Union victory after the Confederate army's withdrawal on January 3, largely due to a series of tactical miscalculations by Confederate Gen. Braxton Bragg, but the victory was costly for the Union army. Nevertheless, it was an important victory for the Union because it provided a much-needed boost in morale after the Union's recent defeat at Fredericksburg and also reinforced President Abraham Lincoln's foundation for issuing the Emancipation Proclamation, which ultimately discouraged European powers from intervening on the Confederacy's behalf.

Battle of the Crater.headline: Bitka pri kraterju
paragraphs: Bitka pri kraterju je potekala med ameriško državljansko vojno, v okviru obleganja Petersburga. Zgodila se je v soboto, 30. julija 1864, med konfederacijsko Severnovirginijsko armado pod poveljstvom generala Roberta E. Leeja in Potomaško armado Unije pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Georgea G. Meada, pod neposrednim nadzorom vrhovnega poveljnika, generalporočnika Ulyssesa S. Granta.

Po tednih priprav so sile Unije 30. julija nasproti sektorja IX. korpusa generalmajorja Unije Ambrosa E. Burnsida razstrelile mino in v konfederacijski obrambi Petersburga v Virginiji razstrelile vrzel. Namesto da bi Uniji prinesla odločilno prednost, je eksplozija sprožila hitro poslabšanje njenega položaja. Enota za enoto je jurišala v krater in okoli njega, kjer se je večina vojakov zmedeno gnetla na dnu. Grant je neuspeli napad označil za »najbolj žalostno zadevo, kar sem jih videl v tej vojni«.

source.title: Battle of the Crater
paragraphs: The Battle of the Crater took place during the American Civil War, part of the Siege of Petersburg. It occurred on Saturday, July 30, 1864, between the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia, commanded by General Robert E. Lee, and the Union Army of the Potomac, commanded by Major General George G. Meade under the direct supervision of the general-in-chief, Lieutenant General Ulysses S. Grant.

After weeks of preparation, on July 30 Union forces exploded a mine across from Union Major General Ambrose E. Burnside's IX Corps sector, blowing a gap in the Confederate defenses of Petersburg, Virginia. Instead of being a decisive advantage to the Union, this precipitated a rapid deterioration in the Union position. Unit after unit charged into and around the crater, where most of the soldiers milled in confusion in the bottom of the crater. Grant considered this failed assault as "the saddest affair I have witnessed in this war."

Bitka v Danskem prelivu je bil pomorski spopad druge svetovne vojne, ki je 24. maja 1941 potekal med ladjami britanske kraljeve mornarice in nemške vojne mornarice (Kriegsmarine). Britanska bojna ladja HMS Prince of Wales in bojna križarka HMS Hood sta se spopadli z nemško bojno ladjo Bismarck in težko križarko Prinz Eugen, ki sta skušali skozi Danski preliv med Grenlandijo in Islandijo prodreti v severni Atlantik in napadati zavezniški trgovski ladijski promet (operacija Rheinübung).

Manj kot 10 minut po tem, ko so Britanci odprli ogenj, je granata z Bismarcka zadela Hood blizu zadnjih skladišč streliva. Kmalu zatem je Hood eksplodiral in se v treh minutah potopil; preživeli so le trije člani posadke. Prince of Wales je še naprej izmenjeval ogenj z Bismarckom, a so mu odpovedovali glavni topovi. Britanska bojna ladja je bila dokončana šele konec marca 1941 in je imela nove, nezanesljive četverne topovske stolpe. Prince of Wales je kmalu prekinil spopad.

source.title: Battle of the Denmark Strait
paragraphs: The Battle of the Denmark Strait was a naval engagement in the Second World War, which took place on 24 May 1941 between ships of the Royal Navy and the Kriegsmarine. The British battleship HMS Prince of Wales and the battlecruiser HMS Hood fought the German battleship Bismarck and the heavy cruiser Prinz Eugen, which were attempting to break out into the North Atlantic to attack Allied merchant shipping (Operation Rheinübung) through the Denmark Strait between Greenland and Iceland.

Less than 10 minutes after the British opened fire, a shell from Bismarck struck Hood near her aft ammunition magazines. Soon afterwards, Hood exploded and sank within three minutes, with the loss of all but three of her crew. Prince of Wales continued to exchange fire with Bismarck but suffered serious malfunctions in her main armament. The British battleship had only been completed in late March 1941, and used new quadruple gun turrets that were unreliable. Prince of Wales soon broke off the engagement.

Bitka na Monongaheli (znana tudi kot bitka na Braddockovem polju in bitka v divjini) je potekala 9. julija 1755, na začetku francosko-indijanske vojne, na Braddockovem polju v današnjem Braddocku v Pensilvaniji, 16 km vzhodno od Pittsburgha. Britanske sile generala Edwarda Braddocka, ki so se namenile zavzeti utrdbo Fort Duquesne, so premagale francoske in kanadske čete pod poveljstvom stotnika Daniela Liénarda de Beaujeuja z indijanskimi zavezniki.

Poraz je pomenil konec Braddockove odprave, s katero so Britanci upali zavzeti Fort Duquesne in pridobiti nadzor nad strateško pomembno deželo Ohio. V bitki sta padla tako Braddock kot Beaujeu. Braddock je bil v boju smrtno ranjen in je umrl med umikom blizu današnjega Uniontowna v Pensilvaniji; izrecno je prosil, naj njegov pokop nadzoruje George Washington, ki ga je spremljal na pohodu. Preostanek britanske kolone se je umaknil proti jugovzhodu. Fort Duquesne in okolica sta ostala v francoskih rokah, dokler ju leta 1758 niso zavzeli Britanci.

source.title: Battle of the Monongahela
paragraphs: The Battle of the Monongahela (also known as the Battle of Braddock's Field and the Battle of the Wilderness) took place on July 9, 1755, at the beginning of the French and Indian War at Braddock's Field in present-day Braddock, Pennsylvania, 10 miles (16 km) east of Pittsburgh. A British force under General Edward Braddock, moving to take Fort Duquesne, was defeated by a force of French and Canadian troops under Captain Daniel Liénard de Beaujeu with its American Indian allies.

The defeat marked the end of the Braddock Expedition, by which the British had hoped to capture Fort Duquesne and gain control of the strategic Ohio Country. Both Braddock and Beaujeu were killed in action during the battle. Braddock was mortally wounded in the fight and died during the retreat near present-day Uniontown, Pennsylvania. He specifically asked for George Washington, who accompanied him on the march, to oversee his burial. The remainder of the British column retreated south-eastwards. Fort Duquesne and the surrounding region remained in French hands until its capture in 1758.

Battle of the Plains of Abraham.headline: Bitka na Abrahamovi planoti
paragraphs: Bitka na Abrahamovi planoti, znana tudi kot prva bitka za Quebec (francosko: Bataille des Plaines d'Abraham, Première bataille de Québec), je bila prelomna bitka sedemletne vojne, katere severnoameriško bojišče Američani imenujejo francosko-indijanska vojna. Potekala je 13. septembra 1759 med britansko vojsko in kraljevo mornarico na eni ter francosko vojsko na drugi strani na quebeškem rtu, planoti tik pred obzidjem mesta Quebec, na zemlji, ki je prvotno pripadala kmetu Abrahamu Martinu, od tod ime kraja. V bitki je sodelovalo skupaj manj kot 10.000 vojakov, a se je izkazala za odločilni trenutek v spopadu med Francijo in Britanijo za usodo francoske kolonije Kanade ali Nove Francije in je vplivala na zgodovino Kanade.

source.title: Battle of the Plains of Abraham
paragraphs: The Battle of the Plains of Abraham, also known as the First Battle of Quebec (French: Bataille des Plaines d'Abraham, Première bataille de Québec), was a pivotal battle in the Seven Years' War—whose North American theatre is referred to by Americans as the French and Indian War. The battle, which took place on 13 September 1759, was fought by the British Army and Royal Navy against the French Army on the Promontory of Quebec, a plateau just outside the walls of Quebec City on land that was originally owned by a farmer named Abraham Martin, hence the name of the location. The battle involved fewer than 10,000 troops in total, but proved to be a deciding moment in the conflict between France and Britain over the fate of the French colony of Canada or New France, influencing the history of Canada.

Battle of the Rosebud.headline: Bitka pri Rosebudu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Rosebudu ali bitka pri potoku Rosebud je potekala 17. junija 1876 na ozemlju Montana med vojsko Združenih držav in njenimi zavezniki iz ljudstev Vran in Šošonov na eni strani ter silami, ki so jih sestavljali predvsem lakotski Siuji in severni Šajeni, na drugi strani, med veliko siujsko vojno leta 1876. Šajeni so jo imenovali bitka, v kateri je dekle rešilo brata, zaradi dogodka med bojem, v katerem je sodelovala Buffalo Calf Road Woman. Indijanci pod vodstvom Norega konja so zaustavili ofenzivo generala Georgea Crooka, ki je pred nadaljevanjem kampanje avgusta čakal na okrepitve.

source.title: Battle of the Rosebud
paragraphs: The Battle of the Rosebud or the Battle of Rosebud Creek took place on June 17, 1876, in the Montana Territory between the United States Army and its Crow and Shoshoni allies against a force consisting primarily of Lakota Sioux and Northern Cheyenne Indians during the Great Sioux War of 1876. The Cheyenne called it the Battle Where the Girl Saved Her Brother because of an incident during the fight involving Buffalo Calf Road Woman. General George Crook's offensive was stymied by the Indians, led by Crazy Horse, and he awaited reinforcements before resuming the campaign in August.

Bitka na reki Thames, znana tudi kot bitka pri Moraviantownu, je bila ameriška zmaga nad britanskimi silami in Tecumsehovo konfederacijo med vojno leta 1812. Potekala je 5. oktobra 1813 v Gornji Kanadi blizu današnjega Thamesvilla v Ontariu. Britanci so zaradi bitke izgubili nadzor nad zahodnim okrožjem Gornje Kanade. Tecumseh je padel, njegova konfederacija pa je razpadla.

source.title: Battle of the Thames
paragraphs: The Battle of the Thames, also known as the Battle of Moraviantown, was an American victory over British forces and Tecumseh's Confederacy during the War of 1812. The battle took place on October 5, 1813, in Upper Canada near what is now Thamesville, Ontario. The British lost control of the Western District of Upper Canada as a result of the battle. Tecumseh was killed, and his confederacy collapsed.

Bitka pri Washiti (imenovana tudi bitka pri reki Washita ali pokol pri Washiti) se je zgodila 27. novembra 1868, ko je 7. konjeniški polk ZDA podpolkovnika Georgea Armstronga Custerja napadel tabor južnih Šajenov poglavarja Črnega kotlička (Black Kettle) ob reki Washita (današnji nacionalni zgodovinski kraj bojišče Washita pri mestu Cheyenne v Oklahomi).

Šajenski tabor je bil najbolj osamljena skupina velikega zimskega taborišča številnih indijanskih plemenskih skupin ob reki, v katerem je skupaj živelo več tisoč ljudi. Custerjeve sile so vas napadle, ker so jo izvidniki našli po sledeh indijanske skupine, ki je napadla bele naseljence. Črni kotliček in njegovi ljudje so živeli v miru in so si mir prizadevali ohraniti. Custerjevi vojaki so poleg bojevnikov pobijali tudi ženske in otroke, zajeli pa so tudi veliko ujetnikov, ki so jim služili za talce in živi ščit. O številu Šajenov, ubitih v napadu, se prerekajo že od prvih poročil.
notes: Black Kettle rendered as Črni kotliček with the English name at first mention.

source.title: Battle of the Washita River
paragraphs: The Battle of the Washita River (also called Battle of the Washita or the Washita Massacre) occurred on November 27, 1868, when Lt. Col. George Armstrong Custer's 7th U.S. Cavalry attacked Black Kettle's Southern Cheyenne camp on the Washita River (the present-day Washita Battlefield National Historic Site near Cheyenne, Oklahoma).

The Cheyenne camp was the most isolated band of a major winter encampment along the river of numerous Native American tribal bands, totaling thousands of people. Custer's forces attacked the village because scouts had found it by tracking the trail of an Indian party that had raided white settlers. Black Kettle and his people had been at peace and were seeking peace. Custer's soldiers killed women and children in addition to warriors, although they also took many captives to serve as hostages and human shields. The number of Cheyenne killed in the attack has been disputed since the first reports.

Bitka v Wildernessu je potekala od 5. do 7. maja 1864 med ameriško državljansko vojno. Bila je prva bitka virginijske kopenske kampanje generalporočnika Ulyssesa S. Granta leta 1864 proti generalu Robertu E. Leeju in konfederacijski Severnovirginijski armadi. Boji so potekali na gozdnatem območju blizu Locust Grova v Virginiji, okoli 32 km zahodno od Fredericksburga. Obe vojski sta utrpeli velike izgube, skupaj skoraj 29.000 mož, kar je napovedovalo Grantovo izčrpavalno vojno proti Leejevi vojski in nazadnje proti konfederacijski prestolnici Richmondu v Virginiji. Bitka je bila taktično neodločena, saj se je Grant odlepil od sovražnika in nato nadaljeval ofenzivo.

source.title: Battle of the Wilderness
paragraphs: The Battle of the Wilderness was fought on May 5–7, 1864, during the American Civil War. It was the first battle of Lieutenant General Ulysses S. Grant's 1864 Virginia Overland Campaign against General Robert E. Lee and the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia. The fighting occurred in a wooded area near Locust Grove, Virginia, about 20 miles (32 km) west of Fredericksburg. Both armies suffered many casualties, nearly 29,000 in total, a harbinger of a war of attrition by Grant against Lee's army and eventually against the Confederate capital, Richmond, Virginia. The battle was tactically inconclusive, as Grant disengaged and then continued his offensive.

Battle of Ticonderoga (1759).headline: Bitka za Ticonderogo (1759)
paragraphs: Bitka za Ticonderogo je bil manjši spopad pri utrdbi Fort Carillon (pozneje preimenovani v Fort Ticonderoga) 26. in 27. julija 1759, med francosko-indijansko vojno. Britanska vojska z več kot 11.000 možmi pod poveljstvom generala sira Jefferyja Amhersta je topništvo postavila na vzpetino nad utrdbo, ki jo je branila posadka 400 Francozov pod poveljstvom brigadnega generala Françoisa-Charlesa de Bourlamaqua.

De Bourlamaque utrdbe ni branil, temveč je po navodilih generala Louisa-Josepha de Montcalma in guvernerja Nove Francije markiza de Vaudreuila umaknil svoje sile in skušal utrdbo razstreliti. Skladišče smodnika je bilo uničeno, zidovi pa niso bili huje poškodovani. Britanci so nato zasedli utrdbo, ki so jo odtlej imenovali Fort Ticonderoga, se lotili vrste izboljšav na tem območju in začeli graditi floto za vojaške operacije na jezeru Champlain.

source.title: Battle of Ticonderoga (1759)
paragraphs: The Battle of Ticonderoga was a minor confrontation at Fort Carillon (later renamed Fort Ticonderoga) on July 26 and 27, 1759, during the French and Indian War. A British military force of more than 11,000 men under the command of General Sir Jeffery Amherst moved artillery to high ground overlooking the fort, which was defended by a garrison of 400 Frenchmen under the command of Brigadier General François-Charles de Bourlamaque.

Rather than defend the fort, de Bourlamaque, operating under instructions from General Louis-Joseph de Montcalm and New France's governor, the Marquis de Vaudreuil, withdrew his forces, and attempted to blow up the fort. The fort's powder magazine was destroyed, but its walls were not severely damaged. The British then occupied the fort, which was afterwards known by the name Fort Ticonderoga. They embarked on a series of improvements to the area and began construction of a fleet to conduct military operations on Lake Champlain.

Bitka pri Tippecanoeju je potekala 7. novembra 1811 v Battle Groundu v Indiani med ameriškimi silami pod vodstvom tedanjega guvernerja ozemlja Indiana Williama Henryja Harrisona in plemenskimi silami, povezanimi s šonijskim voditeljem Tecumsehom in njegovim bratom Tenskwatawo (znanim kot »Prerok«), voditeljema zveze različnih plemen, ki so nasprotovala evropsko-ameriški naselitvi ameriške meje. Ko so se napetosti in nasilje stopnjevali, je guverner Harrison s približno 1000 možmi krenil nad glavno središče zveze v Prophetstownu, blizu sotočja rek Tippecanoe in Wabash.
notes: The pronunciation respelling is left out.

source.title: Battle of Tippecanoe
paragraphs: The Battle of Tippecanoe ( TIP-ə-kə-NOO) was fought on November 7, 1811, in Battle Ground, Indiana, between American forces led by then Governor William Henry Harrison of the Indiana Territory and tribal forces associated with Shawnee leader Tecumseh and his brother Tenskwatawa (commonly known as "The Prophet"), leaders of a confederacy of various tribes who opposed European-American settlement of the American frontier. As tensions and violence increased, Governor Harrison marched with an army of about 1,000 men to attack the confederacy's headquarters at Prophetstown, near the confluence of the Tippecanoe River and the Wabash River.

Battle of Tuyutí.headline: Bitka pri Tuyutíju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tuyutíju (portugalsko: Tuiuti) je bila paragvajska ofenziva v paragvajski vojni, namenjena taborišču trojne zveze pri Tuyutíju. Velja za najbolj krvavo bitko v zgodovini Južne Amerike. Končala se je z zmago zaveznikov, kar je še povečalo težave Paragvaja po izgubi flote v bitki pri Riachuelu.

Bitka je posebej pomembna v Braziliji, kjer ji pravijo »A Batalha dos Patronos« (bitka zavetnikov), saj so se v njej bojevali vojskini zavetniki pehote, konjenice in topništva. Bitka pri Tuyutíju je tudi dan pehote brazilske vojske, ker je v njej padel brigadni general Antônio de Sampaio (znan kot Brigadeiro Sampaio), zavetnik pehote, ko je vztrajal na čelu svoje oklepne divizije (Divisão Encouraçada, 3. divizija).
Novembra 1867 so zavezniki odbili še en paragvajski napad na svoje taborišče.

source.title: Battle of Tuyutí
paragraphs: The Battle of Tuyutí (Tuiuti in Portuguese) was a Paraguayan offensive in the Paraguayan War targeting the Triple Alliance encampment of Tuyutí. It is considered to be the bloodiest battle ever in South America. The result of the battle was an Allied victory, which added to the Paraguayan troubles after the loss of its fleet in the Battle of Riachuelo.

This battle is particularly important in Brazil, being nicknamed "A Batalha dos Patronos" (The Battle of the Patrons) since the Army's patrons of the Infantry, Cavalry and Artillery fought in it. The Battle of Tuyutí also marks the Brazilian Army's Infantry Day due to the loss of brigadier general Antônio de Sampaio (known as Brigadeiro Sampaio), patron of the Infantry, while holding his position at the head of his Divisão Encouraçada (Ironclad Division, the 3rd Division).
Another Paraguayan attack on the Allied camp was repelled in November 1867.

Battle of Vertières.headline: Bitka pri Vertièresu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Vertièresu (francosko: Bataille de Vertières, haitijsko kreolsko: Batay Vètyè) je bila zadnja velika bitka odprave na Saint-Domingue in zadnja faza haitijske revolucije. Potekala je 18. novembra 1803 med uporniško domorodno vojsko pod vodstvom Jeana Jacquesa Dessalinesa in Françoisa Capoisa ter francoskimi silami Donatiena de Rochambeauja, ki so si hotele znova pridobiti nadzor nad otokom.

Bitka je potekala pri Vertièresu, tik južno od Cap-Françaisa v departmaju Nord. Do konca oktobra 1803 so uporniki, ki so se bojevali proti francoskim ekspedicijskim četam, zavzeli že večji del Saint-Dominguea. Francozi so nadzorovali le še Môle St. Nicolas, ki ga je držal Noailles, in Cap-Français, kjer je bil francoski general Rochambeau s 5000 vojaki obkoljen.

source.title: Battle of Vertières
paragraphs: The Battle of Vertières (French: Bataille de Vertières; Haitian Creole: Batay Vètyè) was the last major battle of the Saint-Domingue expedition and the final phase of the Haitian Revolution. It was fought on 18 November 1803 between the rebel Indigenous Army under Jean Jacques Dessalines and François Capois and French forces under Donatien de Rochambeau, who were committed to regaining control of the island.

The battle took place at Vertières, situated just south of Cap-Français in the Nord department. By the end of October 1803, the rebels fighting the French expeditionary troops had already taken over most of Saint-Domingue. The only places controlled by the French forces were Môle St. Nicolas, held by Noailles, and Cap-Français, where, with 5,000 troops, French General Rochambeau was at bay.

Battle of Vuelta de Obligado.headline: Bitka pri Vuelta de Obligado
paragraphs: Bitka pri Vuelta de Obligado je potekala 20. novembra 1845 v vodah reke Parana, ob njenem desnem bregu na severu province Buenos Aires (Argentina), v okljuku, kjer se reka zoži in zavije, imenovanem Vuelta de Obligado, kjer danes stoji kraj Obligado v okrožju San Pedro.

Bil je spopad med provinco Buenos Aires, ki ji je vladal brigadir Juan Manuel de Rosas (za poveljnika obrambnih sil je imenoval generala Lucia Norberta Mansillo), in angleško-francosko eskadro, ki je posredovala pod pretvezo, da hoče umiriti spore med Buenos Airesom in Montevideom. Evropejci so hoteli Britaniji in Franciji zagotoviti neposredne trgovinske stike s provincami Santa Fe, Entre Ríos in Corrientes, mimo Buenos Airesa in ne da bi priznali Rosasovo pristojnost za zunanje odnose Argentinske konfederacije.

source.title: Battle of Vuelta de Obligado
paragraphs: The Battle of Vuelta de Obligado took place on 20 November 1845, in the waters of the Paraná River, on its right bank and in the north of the province of Buenos Aires (Argentina), in a bend where the river narrows and turns, known as Vuelta de Obligado, in what is today the town of Obligado, in San Pedro district.

It was a confrontation between the province of Buenos Aires, governed by Brigadier Juan Manuel de Rosas – who appointed General Lucio Norberto Mansilla as commander of the defense forces – and the Anglo-French squadron, whose intervention was carried out under the pretext of achieving pacification in the face of the problems existing between Buenos Aires and Montevideo. The Europeans intended to establish direct trade relations between Britain and France with the provinces of Santa Fe, Entre Ríos and Corrientes, without going through Buenos Aires or recognizing Rosas' authority as the person in charge of foreign relations for the Argentine Confederation.

Bitka pri Westportu, včasih imenovana »Gettysburg zahoda«, je bila bitka ameriške državljanske vojne, bojevana 23. oktobra 1864 v današnjem Kansas Cityju v Missouriju. Sile Unije pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Samuela R. Curtisa so odločilno premagale številčno šibkejšo konfederacijsko vojsko generalmajorja Sterlinga Pricea, jo prisilile k umiku in s tem obrnile tok njegove missourijske odprave. Bitka je končala zadnjo veliko konfederacijsko ofenzivo zahodno od Misisipija, vojska Združenih držav pa je do konca vojne trdno nadzorovala večji del Missourija. V spopadu, enem največjih zahodno od Misisipija, se je bojevalo več kot 30.000 vojakov.

source.title: Battle of Westport
paragraphs: The Battle of Westport, sometimes referred to as the "Gettysburg of the West", was a battle of the American Civil War fought on October 23, 1864, in modern Kansas City, Missouri. Union forces under Major General Samuel R. Curtis decisively defeated an outnumbered Confederate force under Major General Sterling Price, forcing his army to retreat and marking the turning point of his Missouri Expedition. The battle ended the last major Confederate offensive west of the Mississippi River, and for the remainder of the war the United States Army maintained solid control over most of Missouri. More than 30,000 troops fought in the clash, one of the largest west of the Mississippi River.

Battle of Williamsburg.headline: Bitka pri Williamsburgu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Williamsburgu, znana tudi kot bitka za Fort Magruder, je potekala 5. maja 1862 v okrožjih York in James City ter v Williamsburgu v Virginiji, v okviru polotoške kampanje ameriške državljanske vojne. Bila je prva prava bitka te kampanje: spopadlo se je skoraj 41.000 zveznih in 32.000 konfederacijskih vojakov, bitka pa je ostala neodločena in se je končala tako, da so konfederalci nadaljevali umik.

source.title: Battle of Williamsburg
paragraphs: The Battle of Williamsburg, also known as the Battle of Fort Magruder, took place on May 5, 1862, in York County, James City County, and Williamsburg, Virginia, as part of the Peninsula campaign of the American Civil War. It was the first pitched battle of the Peninsula campaign, in which nearly 41,000 Federals and 32,000 Confederates were engaged, fighting an inconclusive battle that ended with the Confederates continuing their withdrawal.

Battle of Wilson's Creek.headline: Bitka pri Wilson's Creeku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Wilson's Creeku, znana tudi kot bitka pri Oak Hillsu, je bila prva velika bitka na bojišču zahodno od Misisipija v ameriški državljanski vojni. Potekala je 10. avgusta 1861 blizu Springfielda v Missouriju.

source.title: Battle of Wilson's Creek
paragraphs: The Battle of Wilson's Creek, also known as the Battle of Oak Hills, was the first major battle of the Trans-Mississippi Theater of the American Civil War. It was fought on August 10, 1861, near Springfield, Missouri.

Battle of Yellow Tavern.headline: Bitka pri Yellow Tavernu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Yellow Tavernu je potekala 11. maja 1864 v okviru kopenske kampanje ameriške državljanske vojne. Konjenico Unije pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Philipa Sheridana so iz Grantove Potomaške armade odcepili za vpad na Richmond v Virginiji, kjer se je spopadla s poveljnikom konfederacijske konjenice generalmajorjem J. E. B. Stuartom. Konfederalci so bili številčno šibkejši, Stuart pa je bil smrtno ranjen.

source.title: Battle of Yellow Tavern
paragraphs: The Battle of Yellow Tavern was fought on May 11, 1864, as part of the Overland Campaign of the American Civil War. Union cavalry under Maj. Gen. Philip Sheridan was detached from Grant's Army of the Potomac to conduct a raid on Richmond, Virginia, and challenged Confederate cavalry commander Maj. Gen. J.E.B. Stuart. The Confederates were outnumbered, and Stuart was mortally wounded.

Battle of Yungay.headline: Bitka pri Yungayu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Yungayu (ali Yungaiu) je bila zadnja bitka vojne proti konfederaciji, bojevana 20. januarja 1839 blizu Yungaya v Peruju. Združena restavracijska vojska pod vodstvom čilskega generala Manuela Bulnesa, sestavljena predvsem iz Čilencev in 600 severnoperujskih disidentov, je na severu Peruja, 200 kilometrov severno od Lime, napadla sile Perujsko-bolivijske konfederacije pod vodstvom Andrésa de Santa Cruza.

Po šestih urah boja so restavratorji uničili konfederacijsko vojsko in končali vojno. Santa Cruz je odšel v izgnanstvo v Guayaquil v Ekvadorju. Nova perujska vlada je Čilu poravnala dolg iz osvobodilne odprave izpred desetletja in odlikovala čilske in perujske častnike. Perujskim častnikom, ki so služili konfederaciji, med njimi Guillermu Millerju, Marianu Necocheu, Luisu Joséju Orbegosu in Domingu Nietu, so prepovedali službo v perujski vojski.

source.title: Battle of Yungay
paragraphs: The Battle of Yungay (or Yungai) was the final battle of the War of the Confederation, fought on January 20, 1839, near Yungay, Peru. The United Restoration Army, led by Chilean General Manuel Bulnes, consisting mainly of Chileans and 600 North Peruvian dissidents, attacked the Peru-Bolivian Confederation forces led by Andrés de Santa Cruz in northern Peru, 200 kilometers (120 mi) north of Lima.

After six hours of fighting, the Restorers destroyed the Confederate Army, bringing the War of the Confederation to its end. Santa Cruz exiled himself in Guayaquil, Ecuador. The new Peruvian government paid its debt with Chile from the liberation expedition from a decade ago, and gave awards to Chilean and Peruvian officials. Peruvian officers who served under the Confederation, including Guillermo Miller, Mariano Necochea, Luis José Orbegoso, and Domingo Nieto, were banned from the Peruvian Army.

Baytown culture.headline: Kultura Baytown
paragraphs: Kultura Baytown je bila predkolumbovska indijanska kultura, ki je od leta 300 do 700 n. št. obstajala v dolini spodnjega toka Misisipija, z najdišči v vzhodnem Arkansasu, zahodnem Tennesseeju, Louisiani in zahodnem Misisipiju. Tipsko najdišče kulture je najdišče Baytown ob reki White v okrožju Monroe v Arkansasu. Spadala je v obdobje Baytown poznega gozdnega obdobja. Obstajala je hkrati z obalno kulturo Troyville in kulturo Troyville v Louisiani in Misisipiju (vse tri so se razvile iz hopewellskih ljudstev Marksville) ter s kulturo Fourche Maline, nasledila pa jo je kultura Plum Bayou. Ljudstva Baytown so gradila razpršena naselja, ljudje Troyville pa so še naprej gradili velika središča z zemeljskimi nasipi.

source.title: Baytown culture
paragraphs: The Baytown culture was a Pre-Columbian Native American culture that existed from 300 to 700 CE in the lower Mississippi River Valley, consisting of sites in eastern Arkansas, western Tennessee, Louisiana, and western Mississippi. The Baytown Site on the White River in Monroe County, Arkansas is the type site for culture. It was a Baytown Period culture during the Late Woodland period. It was contemporaneous with the Coastal Troyville and Troyville cultures of Louisiana and Mississippi (all three had evolved from the Marksville Hopewellian peoples) and the Fourche Maline culture and was succeeded by the Plum Bayou culture. Where the Baytown peoples built dispersed settlements, the Troyville people instead continued building major earthwork centers.

Bear River Massacre.headline: Pokol pri reki Bear
paragraphs: Pokol pri reki Bear je bil napad vojske Združenih držav na zimsko taborišče Šošonov 29. januarja 1863, v katerem je bilo po ocenah ubitih od 250 do 493 otrok, žensk in moških. Nekateri viri ga opisujejo kot največji množični umor ameriških staroselcev, ki ga je zagrešila ameriška vojska, in kot največji posamični primer genocida v zgodovini ZDA. Zgodil se je v današnjem okrožju Franklin v Idahu blizu današnjega mesta Preston. Po letih spopadov, ropanja hrane na kmetijah in rančih ter izrivanja Šošonov z zemlje njihovih prednikov je vojska Združenih držav napadla veliko šošonsko skupnost ob sotočju reke Bear in potoka Battle Creek na tedanjem jugovzhodu ozemlja Washington.

Polkovnik Patrick Edward Connor je v okviru odprave na reko Bear proti šošonskemu poglavarju Bear Hunterju vodil odred kalifornijskih prostovoljcev. Blizu svojih domov je bilo ubitih okoli 250 do 400 severnih Šošonov, otrok in odraslih, umrlo pa je 21 ameriških vojakov. Dogodek je znan tudi kot spopad na reki Bear, bitka na reki Bear in pokol v Boa Ogoi.

source.title: Bear River Massacre
paragraphs: The Bear River Massacre was a United States military attack that killed an estimated 250 to 493 children, women, and men at a Shoshone winter encampment on January 29, 1863. Some sources describe it as the largest mass murder of Native Americans by the US military and the largest single episode of genocide in US history. It took place in present-day Franklin County, Idaho near the present-day city of Preston on January 29, 1863. After years of skirmishes and food raids on farms and ranches, and settlers displacing Shoshone from their ancestral lands, the United States Army attacked a large Shoshone community at the confluence of the Bear River and Battle Creek in what was then southeastern Washington Territory.

Colonel Patrick Edward Connor led a detachment of California Volunteers as part of the Bear River Expedition against Shoshone chief Bear Hunter. Around 250 to 400 Northern Shoshone children and adults were killed near their homes, and 21 US soldiers died. The event is also known as the Engagement on the Bear River, the Battle of Bear River, and the Massacre at Boa Ogoi.

Beaver Wars.headline: Bobrove vojne
paragraphs: Bobrove vojne (v mohavščini: Tsianì kayonkwere), znane tudi kot irokeške vojne ali francosko-irokeške vojne (francosko: Guerres franco-iroquoises), so bile vrsta občasnih spopadov na območju Velikih jezer in reke sv. Lovrenca v Severni Ameriki od leta 1609 do 1701. V njih so se Haudenosauni (Irokezi), ki so jih podpirali Nizozemci in pozneje Angleži, bojevali proti sosednjim domorodnim narodom, kot so Wendati (Huroni), zavezniki Francozov.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Beaver Wars
paragraphs: The Beaver Wars (Mohawk: Tsianì kayonkwere, pronounced [d͡ʒanî gajũgwere]), also known as the Iroquois Wars or the French and Iroquois Wars (French: Guerres franco-iroquoises), were a series of intermittent conflicts fought in the Great Lakes and St. Lawrence River regions of North America from 1609 to 1701. The wars pitted the Haudenosaunee (Iroquois), supported by the Dutch and later the English, against neighboring Indigenous nations such as the Wendat (Huron), who were allied with the French.

Biological Weapons Convention.headline: Konvencija o biološkem orožju
paragraphs: Konvencija o biološkem orožju (BWC) ali konvencija o biološkem in toksinskem orožju (BTWC) je razorožitvena pogodba, ki dejansko prepoveduje biološko in toksinsko orožje, saj prepoveduje njegov razvoj, proizvodnjo, pridobivanje, prenos, kopičenje in uporabo. Polno ime pogodbe je Konvencija o prepovedi razvoja, proizvodnje in kopičenja bakteriološkega (biološkega) in toksinskega orožja ter o njegovem uničenju.

Konvencija je začela veljati 26. marca 1975 kot prva večstranska razorožitvena pogodba, ki je prepovedala proizvodnjo cele vrste orožja za množično uničevanje. Velja za nedoločen čas. Do maja 2025 je pogodbenic postalo 189 držav. Štiri nadaljnje države so jo podpisale, ne pa ratificirale, še štiri pa je niso niti podpisale niti k njej pristopile.

source.title: Biological Weapons Convention
paragraphs: The Biological Weapons Convention (BWC), or Biological and Toxin Weapons Convention (BTWC), is a disarmament treaty that effectively bans biological and toxin weapons by prohibiting their development, production, acquisition, transfer, stockpiling and use. The treaty's full name is the Convention on the Prohibition of the Development, Production and Stockpiling of Bacteriological (Biological) and Toxin Weapons and on their Destruction.

Having entered into force on 26 March 1975, the BWC was the first multilateral disarmament treaty to ban the production of an entire category of weapons of mass destruction. The convention is of unlimited duration. As of May 2025, 189 states have become party to the treaty. Four additional states have signed but not ratified the treaty, and another four states have neither signed nor acceded to the treaty.

Vojna Črnega sokola je bil spopad med Združenimi državami in ameriškimi staroselci pod vodstvom Črnega sokola (Black Hawk), voditelja ljudstva Sauk. Izbruhnila je, ko je Črni sokol s skupino Saukov, Meskwakijev (Lisic) in Kikapujev, znano kot »britanska skupina«, aprila 1832 iz indijanskega ozemlja Iowa prečkal Misisipi v ameriško zvezno državo Illinois. Njegovi nameni so bili nejasni, a je, kot kaže, upal, da bo znova pridobil zemljo, ki so si jo Združene države prilastile s sporno pogodbo iz St. Louisa leta 1804.

source.title: Black Hawk War
paragraphs: The Black Hawk War was a conflict between the United States and Native Americans led by Black Hawk, a Sauk leader. The war erupted after Black Hawk and a group of Sauks, Meskwakis (Fox), and Kickapoos, known as the "British Band", crossed the Mississippi River, to the U.S. state of Illinois, from Iowa Indian Territory in April 1832. Black Hawk's motives were ambiguous, but he was apparently hoping to reclaim land that was taken over by the United States in the disputed 1804 Treaty of St. Louis.

Bolivarska revolucija (špansko: Revolución bolivariana) je družbena revolucija in še trajajoč politični proces v Venezueli, ki ga je začel venezuelski predsednik Hugo Chávez, ustanovitelj Gibanja pete republike (MVR) in pozneje Združene socialistične stranke Venezuele (PSUV), nadaljevala pa sta ga njegova naslednika Nicolás Maduro in Delcy Rodríguez. Ime je dobila po Simónu Bolívarju, venezuelskem revolucionarnem voditelju iz začetka 19. stoletja, ki je imel v hispanskoameriških osamosvojitvenih vojnah vidno vlogo pri osvoboditvi večine severa Južne Amerike izpod španske oblasti. Po besedah Cháveza in drugih podpornikov skuša bolivarska revolucija zgraditi medameriško koalicijo za uresničevanje bolivarizma, nacionalizma in državno vodenega gospodarstva.

source.title: Bolivarian Revolution
paragraphs: The Bolivarian Revolution (Spanish: Revolución bolivariana) is a social revolution and ongoing political process in Venezuela that was started by Venezuelan President Hugo Chávez, the founder of the Fifth Republic Movement (MVR) and later the United Socialist Party of Venezuela (PSUV), and his successors Nicolás Maduro and Delcy Rodríguez. The Bolivarian Revolution is named after Simón Bolívar, an early 19th-century Venezuelan revolutionary leader, prominent in the Spanish American wars of independence in achieving the independence of most of northern South America from Spanish rule. According to Chávez and other supporters, the Bolivarian Revolution seeks to build an inter-American coalition to implement Bolivarianism, nationalism, and a state-led economy.

Bolivian War of Independence.headline: Bolivijska osamosvojitvena vojna
paragraphs: Bolivijska osamosvojitvena vojna (špansko: Guerra de Independencia de Bolivia, 1809–1825) se je začela z ustanovitvijo vladnih hunt v Sucreju in La Pazu po revoluciji v Chuquisaci in revoluciji v La Pazu. Te hunte, del Podkraljestva Río de la Plata, so kmalu zatem porazile perujske rojalistične sile. Po majski revoluciji leta 1810, ki je v Buenos Airesu odstavila podkralja in ustanovila lastno hunto, so ozemlje priključili Podkraljestvu Peru. Buenos Aires je nato v Gornji Peru poslal tri velike vojaške odprave pod vodstvom Juana Joséja Castellija, Manuela Belgrana in Joséja Rondeauja, a so rojalisti premagali vse tri. Spopad pa je prerasel v gverilsko vojno, vojno republiket, ki je rojalistom preprečila, da bi utrdili svojo navzočnost. Ko sta Simón Bolívar in Antonio José de Sucre v perujski osamosvojitvi premagala rojaliste, je Sucre vodil pohod, ki je rojaliste v Charcasu dokončno porazil, ko je zadnji rojalistični general Pedro Antonio Olañeta v bitki pri Tumusli doživel poraz in smrt od rok lastnih prebeglih vojakov. Neodvisnost Bolivije so razglasili 6. avgusta 1825.

source.title: Bolivian War of Independence
paragraphs: The Bolivian War of Independence (Spanish: Guerra de Independencia de Bolivia, 1809–1825) began with the establishment of government juntas in Sucre and La Paz after the Chuquisaca Revolution and La Paz revolution. These Juntas, part of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata, were defeated shortly after by Peruvian royalist forces. Following the May Revolution of 1810, which ousted the viceroy in Buenos Aires and established its own junta, the territory was incorporated into the Viceroyalty of Peru. Buenos Aires then sent three large military expeditions to Upper Peru, headed by Juan José Castelli, Manuel Belgrano and José Rondeau, but the royalists ultimately prevailed over each one. However, the conflict grew into a guerrilla war, the War of the Republiquetas, preventing the royalists from strengthening their presence. After Simón Bolívar and Antonio José de Sucre defeated the royalists in the Independence of Peru, Sucre led a campaign that was to defeat the royalists in Charcas for good when the last royalist general, Pedro Antonio Olañeta, suffered death and defeat at the hands of his own defected forces at the Battle of Tumusla. Bolivian independence was proclaimed on 6 August 1825.

Burbonska restavracija je bilo obdobje francoske zgodovine, ko se je po padcu Napoleona Bonaparta v letih 1814 in 1815 na oblast vrnila rodbina Burbonov. V Francijo, ki jo je francoska revolucija globoko spremenila, so se vrnili izgnani privrženci monarhije. Kraljestvo, izčrpano od napoleonskih vojn, je doživelo obdobje notranjega in zunanjega miru, stabilne gospodarske blaginje in začetkov industrializacije. Restavracijo je dejansko končala julijska revolucija leta 1830, med vladavino Karla X., brata pokojnega kralja Ludvika XVI.; sledili sta ji julijska monarhija in nazadnje druga francoska republika.

source.title: Bourbon Restoration in France
paragraphs: The Bourbon Restoration was the period of French history during which the House of Bourbon returned to power after the fall of Napoleon Bonaparte in 1814 and 1815. Exiled supporters of the monarchy returned to France, which had been profoundly changed by the French Revolution. Exhausted by the Napoleonic Wars, the kingdom experienced a period of internal and external peace, stable economic prosperity and the preliminaries of industrialisation. The July Revolution of 1830 effectively ended the restoration during the reign of Charles X, brother of the late King Louis XVI, leading to the July Monarchy and eventually the French Second Republic.

Bracamoros.headline: Bracamoros
paragraphs: Bracamoros (kečuansko: pukamuru, aguaruna: pakamuru, »poslikan obraz«; pisano tudi Pacamuros) je območje številnih izumrlih plemenskih skupin (med njimi tudi istoimenskega plemena) iz ekvadorskega in perujskega amazonskega deževnega gozda, v porečju reke Zamora (nekateri ga sicer umeščajo na območje rek Chinchipe in Marañón).
Območje je danes del nekdanje ekvadorske province Santiago Zamora (danes provinca Zamora-Chinchipe) ter perujskih provinc San Ignacio in Jaén v departmajih Cajamarca in Amazonas.

source.title: Bracamoros
paragraphs: Bracamoros (Quechua: pukamuru, Aguaruna: pakamuru, "painted face"; also written Pacamuros) is a region of numerous extinct tribal groups (which include a tribe of the same name) from the Ecuadorian and Peruvian Amazon rainforest, located in the watershed of the Zamora River (although it has also been identified as the region of the Chinchipe and Marañón Rivers).

The area is now part of the former Ecuadorian province of Santiago Zamora Province (today Zamora-Chinchipe Province) and the Peruvian provinces of San Ignacio and Jaén, within the departments of Cajamarca and Amazonas.

Brazilian Naval Revolts.headline: Brazilski mornariški upori
paragraphs: Brazilski mornariški upori (portugalsko: Revoltas da Armada, dobesedno »upor mornarice«) so bili oboroženi upori, ki sta jih vodila predvsem admirala Custódio José de Melo in Saldanha da Gama s floto uporniških ladij brazilske mornarice proti domnevno protiustavnemu vztrajanju predsednika Floriana Peixota na oblasti.

Upori so imeli več vzrokov: »osebne zamere v vladajoči eliti, trenja v odnosih med zvezo in zveznimi državami ter med predsednikom in kongresom, militarizem, vladno razsipnost, rivalstvo med vojsko in mornarico in nekaj ostankov monarhističnih čustev po strmoglavljenju cesarstva leta 1889«.
Združene države so proti upornikom podprle vlado na oblasti.

source.title: Brazilian Naval Revolts
paragraphs: The Brazilian Naval Revolts (Portuguese: Revoltas da Armada, lit. 'Navy's Revolt') were armed mutinies promoted mainly by admirals Custódio José de Melo and Saldanha da Gama and their fleet of rebel Brazilian navy ships against the claimed unconstitutional staying in power of president Floriano Peixoto.

The revolts had a number of causes: "personal animosities in the ruling elite; friction in federal-state relations and between the president and Congress; militarism; government extravagance; army navy rivalry; and some lingering monarchical sentiments following the overthrow of the empire in 1889."
The United States supported the incumbent government against the insurgents.

Brazilska vojna za neodvisnost (portugalsko: Guerra de Independência do Brasil) je bil oborožen spopad, ki je pripeljal do odcepitve Brazilije od Združenega kraljestva Portugalske, Brazilije in Algarvov. Potekala je v različnih pokrajinah Brazilije, med drugim v Bahii, Maranhãu, Pari, Piauíju in Cisplatini (današnji Urugvaj), pomorske bitke pa so se bile ob atlantski obali. Brazilske sile, sestavljene iz rednih enot, krajevnih milic in naglo zbrane flote, so premagale portugalske posadke in ustanovile Brazilsko cesarstvo pod cesarjem Pedrom I. Vojna se je formalno končala s pogodbo iz Ria de Janeira leta 1825, s katero je Portugalska priznala neodvisnost Brazilije.

source.title: Brazilian War of Independence
paragraphs: The Brazilian War of Independence (Portuguese: Guerra de Independência do Brasil) was an armed conflict that led to the separation of Brazil from the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves. The war was fought across various regions of Brazil, including Bahia, Maranhão, Pará, Piauí, and Cisplatina (present-day Uruguay), with naval battles occurring along the Atlantic coast. Brazilian forces, consisting of regular troops, local militias, and a hastily assembled fleet, defeated the Portuguese garrisons to establish the Empire of Brazil under emperor Pedro I. The war formally ended with the Treaty of Rio de Janeiro in 1825, in which Portugal recognized Brazil's independence.

Denarni sistem iz Bretton Woodsa je po sporazumu iz Bretton Woodsa leta 1944 do jamajških sporazumov leta 1976 določal pravila trgovinskih odnosov med 44 državami, med njimi Združenim kraljestvom, Združenimi državami, Kanado, evropskimi državami in Avstralijo. Bil je prvi primer v celoti izpogajanega denarnega reda, ki naj bi urejal denarne odnose med neodvisnimi državami. Države so morale zagotoviti zamenljivost svojih valut v ameriške dolarje, dolar pa je bil za tuje vlade in centralne banke zamenljiv v zlate palice. Sistem je predvideval tesnejše sodelovanje med državami, da bi preprečili prihodnja konkurenčna razvrednotenja, zato je ustanovil Mednarodni denarni sklad (IMF), ki je spremljal menjalne tečaje in državam s primanjkljajem v plačilni bilanci posojal rezervne valute. Po Barryju Eichengreenu je brettonwoodski sistem uspešno deloval zaradi treh dejavnikov: »nizke mednarodne mobilnosti kapitala, stroge finančne regulacije ter prevladujočega gospodarskega in finančnega položaja Združenih držav in dolarja«.

source.title: Bretton Woods system
paragraphs: The Bretton Woods system of monetary management established the rules for commercial relations among 44 countries, including the United Kingdom, United States, Canada, European countries, and Australia, after the 1944 Bretton Woods Agreement until the Jamaica Accords in 1976. The Bretton Woods system was the first example of a fully negotiated monetary order intended to govern monetary relations among independent states. The Bretton Woods system required countries to guarantee convertibility of their currencies into U.S. dollars with the dollar convertible to gold bullion for foreign governments and central banks. It envisioned greater cooperation among countries to prevent future competitive devaluations, and thus established the International Monetary Fund (IMF) to monitor exchange rates and lend reserve currencies to countries with balance of payments deficits. According to Barry Eichengreen, the Bretton Woods system operated successfully due to three factors: "low international capital mobility, tight financial regulation, and the dominant economic and financial position of the United States and the dollar".

Britanski invaziji na Río de la Plata sta bila dva neuspešna britanska poskusa, da bi prevzeli nadzor nad špansko kolonijo Podkraljestvo Río de la Plata ob istoimenskem estuariju v Južni Ameriki, na ozemlju današnje Argentine in Urugvaja. Invaziji sta potekali v letih 1806 in 1807, v okviru napoleonskih vojn oziroma vojne tretje koalicije, ko je bila Španija zaveznica napoleonske Francije. V argentinskem zgodovinopisju zaporedna poraza britanskih ekspedicijskih sil skupaj imenujejo Reconquista (»ponovna osvojitev«) in Defensa (»obramba«).

source.title: British invasions of the River Plate
paragraphs: The British invasions of the River Plate were two unsuccessful British attempts to seize control of the Spanish colony of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata, located around the Río de la Plata in South America – in present-day Argentina and Uruguay. The invasions took place between 1806 and 1807, as part of the Napoleonic Wars, War of the Third Coalition at a time when Spain was an ally of Napoleonic France. In Argentine historiography, the two successive defeats of the British expeditionary forces are known collectively as the Reconquista and the Defensa, respectively.

Cabanagem.headline: Cabanagem
paragraphs: Cabanagem (1835–1840) je bila ljudska revolucija in separatistično gibanje v tedanji provinci Grão-Pará v Brazilskem cesarstvu.

Med vzroki upora so bili skrajna revščina prebivalcev Pare, zatiralska oblast Brazilskega cesarstva in politična nepomembnost, v katero je bila provinca potisnjena po osamosvojitvi Brazilije. Elitni posestniki iz Grão-Pare so sicer živeli precej bolje, a so zamerili, da niso mogli sodelovati pri odločitvah osrednje vlade, v kateri so prevladovale province jugovzhoda in severovzhoda.

Ime »Cabanagem« se nanaša na vrsto koče, v kateri so živeli najrevnejši prebivalci ob vodnih poteh severne Brazilije, predvsem kabokli, osvobojeni sužnji in domorodci. Hoteli so več sodelovati pri vladnih odločitvah, njihov končni cilj pa je bil gospodarski razvoj Grão-Pare.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Cabanagem
paragraphs: The Cabanagem (Portuguese pronunciation: [kabaˈnaʒẽj]; 1835–1840) was a popular revolution and pro-separatist movement that occurred in the then province of Grão-Pará, Empire of Brazil.

Among the causes for this revolt were the extreme poverty of the Paraense people, oppression by the Empire of Brazil, and the political irrelevance to which the province was relegated after the independence of Brazil. The elite agriculturists of Grão-Pará, while living much better, resented their lack of participation in the central government's decision-making, which was dominated by the provinces of the Southeast and Northeast.

The name "Cabanagem" refers to the type of hut used by the poorest people living along the waterways of northern Brazil, principally caboclos, freed slaves, and indigenous people. Their goal was to be more involved in government decisions, ultimately seeking the economic development of Grão-Pará.

Caborn-Welborn culture.headline: Kultura Caborn-Welborn
paragraphs: Caborn-Welborn je bila predkontaktna in protozgodovinska severnoameriška kultura, ki jo arheologi opredeljujejo kot poznomisisipijsko kulturo, ki je zrasla iz poglavarstva Angel na območju današnje južne Indiane ali se razvila na njegovih ruševinah. Nastala je okoli leta 1400 in je izginila, kot kaže, okoli leta 1700 n. št. Bila je zadnja indijanska poselitev južne Indiane pred stikom z Evropejci. Ni jasno, katera skupina iz obdobja po stiku, če sploh katera, izhaja iz nje. Verjetno so bili to Taarsite, ki so jih Francozi leta 1682 omenili ob sotočju rek Wabash in Ohio, morda predniki nekaterih ljudstev, ki govorijo dhegiške siujske jezike, kot so Quapaw, Omaha, Ponca in Osage.

source.title: Caborn-Welborn culture
paragraphs: Caborn-Welborn was a precontact and proto-historic North American culture defined by archaeologists as a Late Mississippian cultural manifestation that grew out of – or built upon the demise of – the Angel chiefdom located in present-day southern Indiana. Caborn-Welborn developed around 1400 and seems to have disappeared around 1700 CE. The Caborn-Welborn culture was the last Native American occupation of southern Indiana prior to European contact. It remains unclear which post-contact Native group, if any, are their descendants. It's likely they were the Taarsite identified by the French in 1682 at the confluence of the Wabash and the Ohio, possibly ancestral to some portions of the Dhegihan Siouan speaking peoples, like the Quapaw, Omaha, Ponca and Osage.

Caddoan Mississippian culture.headline: Kadojska misisipijska kultura
paragraphs: Kadojska misisipijska kultura je bila prazgodovinska indijanska kultura, ki jo arheologi štejejo za različico misisipijske kulture. Njeni nosilci so poseljevali obsežno ozemlje, ki obsega današnjo vzhodno Oklahomo, zahodni Arkansas, severovzhodni Teksas, jugozahodni Missouri in severozahodno Louisiano v Združenih državah.

Arheološki dokazi potrjujejo, da se kultura od prazgodovine do danes ni pretrgala. Dokazano je, da so bili govorci kadojščine in sorodnih kadojskih jezikov v prazgodovini in ob prvem stiku z Evropejci neposredni predniki današnjega naroda Caddo v Oklahomi.

source.title: Caddoan Mississippian culture
paragraphs: The Caddoan Mississippian culture was a prehistoric Native American culture considered by archaeologists as a variant of the Mississippian culture. The Caddoan Mississippians covered a large territory, including what is now Eastern Oklahoma, Western Arkansas, Northeast Texas, Southwest Missouri and Northwest Louisiana of the United States.

Archaeological evidence has established that the cultural continuity is unbroken from prehistory to the present. The speakers of Caddo and related Caddoan languages in prehistoric times and at first European contact have been proved to be the direct ancestors of the modern Caddo Nation of Oklahoma.

Cades Pond culture.headline: Kultura Cades Pond
paragraphs: Kultura Cades Pond je arheološka kultura jugovzhodnega srednjega gozdnega obdobja na severu osrednje Floride, ki sega približno od leta 100 do 600 n. št.

source.title: Cades Pond culture
paragraphs: The Cades Pond culture is defined as a Middle Woodland Southeast period archaeological culture in north-central Florida, dating from around 100 to 600 CE.

Calima culture.headline: Kultura Calima
paragraphs: Kultura Calima (200 pr. n. št.–400 n. št.) je skupina predkolumbovskih kultur iz kolumbijske pokrajine Valle del Cauca.
Sestavljajo jo štiri družbe, ki so si v dolini sledile: kulture Ilama, Yotoco, Sonso in Malagana.
Najdbe kulture Calima hranita arheološki muzej Calima Darién in muzej zlata Calima.

source.title: Calima culture
paragraphs: Calima culture (200 BCE–400 CE) is a series of pre-Columbian cultures from the Valle del Cauca in Colombia.
The four societies that successively occupied the valley and make up Calima culture are the Ilama, Yotoco, Sonso, and Malagana cultures.
The Calima Darién Archaeological Museum and the Calima Gold Museum feature artifacts from the Calima culture.

Sporazuma iz Camp Davida sta politična sporazuma, ki sta ju egiptovski predsednik Anvar Sadat in izraelski premier Menahem Begin podpisala 17. septembra 1978 po dvanajstih dneh tajnih pogajanj v Camp Davidu, podeželskem počitniškem domovanju predsednika Združenih držav v Marylandu. Okvirna sporazuma so podpisali v Beli hiši, priča pa je bil predsednik Jimmy Carter. Drugi od njiju (Okvir za sklenitev mirovne pogodbe med Egiptom in Izraelom) je neposredno pripeljal do egiptovsko-izraelske mirovne pogodbe leta 1979. Zaradi sporazuma sta Sadat in Begin prejela skupno Nobelovo nagrado za mir za leto 1978. Prvi okvir (Okvir za mir na Bližnjem vzhodu), ki je obravnaval palestinska ozemlja, so napisali brez sodelovanja Palestincev, Združeni narodi pa so ga obsodili.

Sporazum je v velikem delu arabskega sveta sprožil široko nezadovoljstvo, saj so ga razumeli kot enostransko mirovno pobudo, ki je zanemarila ustanovitev palestinske države in naj bi nazadnje oslabila enotnost arabskega stališča.

source.title: Camp David Accords
paragraphs: The Camp David Accords were a pair of political agreements signed by Egyptian president Anwar Sadat and Israeli prime minister Menachem Begin on 17 September 1978, following twelve days of secret negotiations at Camp David, the country retreat of the president of the United States in Maryland. The two framework agreements were signed at the White House and were witnessed by President Jimmy Carter. The second of these frameworks (A Framework for the Conclusion of a Peace Treaty between Egypt and Israel) led directly to the 1979 Egypt–Israel peace treaty. Due to the agreement, Sadat and Begin received the shared 1978 Nobel Peace Prize. The first framework (A Framework for Peace in the Middle East), which dealt with the Palestinian territories, was written without participation of any Palestinians and was condemned by the United Nations.

The agreement sparked broad discontent throughout much of the Arab world, as it was perceived as a unilateral peace initiative that neglected the establishment of a Palestinian state, ultimately seen as weakening the cohesion of the Arab position.

Cañari.headline: Cañari
paragraphs: Cañari (v jeziku kičva: Kañari) so domorodna etnična skupina, ki tradicionalno poseljuje ozemlje današnjih provinc Azuay in Cañar v Ekvadorju. Izhajajo iz istoimenske neodvisne predkolumbovske plemenske zveze. Zgodovinsko ljudstvo je znano predvsem po odporu proti Inkovskemu imperiju. Inki so ga osvojili v začetku 16. stoletja, malo pred prihodom Špancev, Cañari pa so se nato s Španci povezali proti Inkom. Danes jih je, skupaj s številnimi mestici, več tisoč.
