Njihovi predniki so ozemlje več let branili pred številnimi inkovskimi vojskami. Túpac Yupanqui je osvojil Huancabambe, najjužnejše zaveznike Cañarov. Inkovski imperij je pod vodstvom Huayne Capaca z vojnami in porokami nazadnje osvojil njihovo ozemlje na severu. Cañari so se v obsežni imperij vključili le ohlapno: smeli so sami urejati svoje zadeve, za sporazumevanje z Inki pa so prevzeli nov jezik.

source.title: Cañari
paragraphs: The Cañari (in Kichwa: Kañari) are an indigenous ethnic group traditionally inhabiting the territory of the modern provinces of Azuay and Cañar in Ecuador. They are descended from the independent pre-Columbian tribal confederation of the same name. The historic people are particularly noted for their resistance against the Inca Empire. Eventually conquered by the Inca in the early 16th century shortly before the arrival of the Spanish, the Cañari later allied with the Spanish against the Inca. Today, the population of the Cañari, who include many mestizos, numbers in the thousands.

The earlier people defended their territory for many years against numerous Incan armies. Túpac Yupanqui conquered the Huancabambas, the most southern of the Cañari allies. Through wars and marriages, the Inca Empire under the lead of Huayna Capac to the north finally conquered their territory. The Cañari were loosely assimilated into the vast empire, allowed to manage their own affairs but adopting a new language for communicating with the Inca.

Capture of New Orleans.headline: Zavzetje New Orleansa
paragraphs: Zavzetje New Orleansa (25. aprila–1. maja 1862) med ameriško državljansko vojno je bilo prelomnica vojne, ki je pospešila zavzetje Misisipija. Ko se je Unija prebila mimo utrdb Jackson in St. Philip, je samo mesto zavzela brez odpora.

Mnogi prebivalci so zamerili sporno in konfliktno upravo mesta, ki jo je vodil vojaški guverner vojske ZDA. Zavzetje največjega konfederacijskega mesta je bilo velika prelomnica in dogodek mednarodnega pomena. Presenetilo je tudi mnoge konfederacijske generale, ki so napad pričakovali s severa, ne iz Mehiškega zaliva.

source.title: Capture of New Orleans
paragraphs: The capture of New Orleans (April 25 – May 1, 1862) during the American Civil War was a turning point in the war that precipitated the capture of the Mississippi River. Having fought past Forts Jackson and St. Philip, the Union was unopposed in its capture of the city itself.

Many residents resented the controversial and confrontational administration of the city by its U.S. Army military governor. This capture of the largest Confederate city was a major turning point and an event of international importance. It also caught many Confederate generals by surprise who had planned for an attack from the north instead of from the Gulf of Mexico.

Capulí culture.headline: Kultura Capulí
paragraphs: Kultura Capulí (ali kultura Nariño) je arheološka oznaka za skupino v predkolumbovski Južni Ameriki, ki je živela na andski planoti na območju današnjega severnega Ekvadorja (provinca Carchi) in južne Kolumbije (departma Nariño). V arheoloških plasteh je pred kulturama Piartal in Tuza in sega od okoli leta 800 do 1500 n. št. Za seboj je pustila bogato lončenino: značilni so črni okraski na temno rdeči podlagi s pravokotnimi geometrijskimi vzorci. Antropomorfni lončeni kipci so lahko izjemno izraziti. Ženske so upodobljene v ogrinjalu od pazduhe do gležnjev, moški v ledvenih predpasnikih, pogosto s predmetom, na primer bobnom ali živaljo. Te figure pogosto imenujejo coqueros, ker imajo v ustih kepe listov koke. Raziskovalci jih povezujejo s šamani in morda s pogrebnimi obredi.

source.title: Capulí culture
paragraphs: The Capulí culture (or Nariño culture) refers to an archaeological classification for a group in Pre-Columbian South America on the Andean plain in what is now northern Ecuador (Carchi Province) and southern Colombia (Nariño Department). The Capulí preceded the Piartal and Tuza cultures in the archaeological record ranging from around 800 to 1500 CE. The Capulí culture left a strong record through its pottery. The Capulí had distinctive black on dark red pottery with rectilinear geometric designs. The anthropomorphic pottery statues of the Capulí can be striking. Women are depicted with a wrap that extends from the armpit to the ankle while men have loincloths and are often shown with an object such as a drum or animal. These figures are often called coqueros because they are depicted with wads of coca leaves in their mouths. Scholars have associated the figures with shamans and possible funerary rituals.

Caral–Supe civilization.headline: Civilizacija Caral–Supe
paragraphs: Caral–Supe (znana tudi kot Caral in Norte Chico) je bila kompleksna predkolumbovska družba z do tridesetimi večjimi naselji na območju Caral na severnem osrednjem delu perujske obale. Civilizacija je cvetela med 4. in 2. tisočletjem pr. n. št.; prvo mesto, Huaricanga na območju Fortaleza, običajno datirajo okoli leta 3500 pr. n. št. Od leta 3100 pr. n. št. sta obsežna poselitev in skupna gradnja jasno vidni. To je trajalo do zatona okoli leta 1800 pr. n. št. Od začetka 21. stoletja velja za najstarejšo znano civilizacijo Novega sveta in za eno od šestih krajev, kjer je civilizacija v starem veku nastala samostojno.

Civilizacija je cvetela ob treh rekah, Fortalezi, Pativilci in Supeju, in v dolini vsake je veliko najdišč. Južneje je ob reki Huaura še več povezanih najdišč. Ime Caral–Supe izvira iz mesta Caral v dolini reke Supe, velikega in dobro raziskanega najdišča.

source.title: Caral–Supe civilization
paragraphs: Caral–Supe (also known as Caral and Norte Chico) was a complex pre-Columbian era society that included as many as thirty major population centers in what is now the Caral region of north-central coastal Peru. The civilization flourished between the 4th and 2nd millennia BCE, with the formation of the first city generally dated to around 3500 BCE, at Huaricanga, in the Fortaleza area. From 3100 BCE onward, large-scale human settlement and communal construction become clearly apparent. This lasted until a period of decline around 1800 BCE. Since the early 21st century, it has been recognized as the oldest-known civilization in the New World, and as one of the six sites where civilization separately originated in the ancient world.

This civilization flourished along three rivers, the Fortaleza, the Pativilca, and the Supe. These river valleys each have large clusters of sites. Farther south, there are several associated sites along the Huaura River. The name Caral–Supe is derived from the city of Caral in the Supe Valley, a large and well-studied site.

Caranqui culture.headline: Kultura Caranqui
paragraphs: Kultura Caranqui ali Cara je bila arheološka kultura, ki je v 1. tisočletju n. št. cvetela na ekvadorski obali, na območju današnje province Manabí.

source.title: Caranqui culture
paragraphs: The Caranqui culture or Cara was an archaeological culture which flourished in coastal Ecuador, in what is now Manabí Province, in the first millennium CE.

Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety.headline: Kartagenski protokol o biološki varnosti
paragraphs: Kartagenski protokol o biološki varnosti h Konvenciji o biološki raznovrstnosti je mednarodni sporazum o biološki varnosti, dopolnilo h Konvenciji o biološki raznovrstnosti (CBD), ki velja od leta 2003. Protokol skuša biološko raznovrstnost zaščititi pred morebitnimi tveganji gensko spremenjenih organizmov, ki so plod sodobne biotehnologije.

Protokol jasno določa, da morajo izdelki novih tehnologij temeljiti na previdnostnem načelu, državam v razvoju pa omogoča, da pretehtajo javno zdravje in gospodarske koristi. Državam na primer dovoljuje, da prepovejo uvoz gensko spremenjenih organizmov, če menijo, da ni dovolj znanstvenih dokazov o varnosti izdelka, izvoznikom pa nalaga, da označijo pošiljke gensko spremenjenega blaga, kot sta koruza ali bombaž.

source.title: Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety
paragraphs: The Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety to the Convention on Biological Diversity is an international agreement on biosafety as a supplement to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) effective since 2003. The Biosafety Protocol seeks to protect biological diversity from the potential risks posed by genetically modified organisms resulting from modern biotechnology.

The Biosafety Protocol makes clear that products from new technologies must be based on the precautionary principle and allow developing nations to balance public health against economic benefits. It will for example let countries ban imports of genetically modified organisms if they feel there is not enough scientific evidence that the product is safe and requires exporters to label shipments containing genetically altered commodities such as corn or cotton.

Casma–Sechin culture.headline: Kultura Casma–Sechin
paragraphs: Kultura Casma–Sechin (ali kompleks Sechin; ok. 3600–200 pr. n. št.) v Peruju označuje veliko skupino prazgodovinskih razvalin v dolinah reke Casma in njenega pritoka Sechin ter ob bližnji obali Tihega oceana. Med njimi so pomembna arheološka najdišča Sechin Bajo, Sechin Alto, Cerro Sechin, Mojeque (Pampa de las Llamas-Moxeke), Chankillo in Taukachi-Konkan ter več manjših. Večina teh celinskih najdišč leži v rečnih dolinah okoli 20 kilometrov od morja. Obalni najdišči Huaynuná in Las Haldas ležita okoli 20 kilometrov severno oziroma južno od ustja reke Casma.

Friz v Sechinu Bajo, datiran v leto 3600 pr. n. št., je najstarejši doslej odkriti primer monumentalne arhitekture v Amerikah. Če bodo to datacijo potrdila nova odkritja, je kultura Casma/Sechin morda nastala hkrati s civilizacijo Caral–Supe, ki danes velja za najstarejšo civilizacijo Amerik, ali celo pred njo.

source.title: Casma–Sechin culture
paragraphs: The Casma–Sechin culture (alternatively Sechin Complex) (c. 3600 BCE–200 BCE) of Peru refers to the large concentration of pre-historic ruins in the valleys of the Casma River and its tributary the Sechin River and along the nearby coast of the Pacific Ocean. The ruins include major archaeological sites such as Sechin Bajo, Sechin Alto, Cerro Sechin, Mojeque (Pampa de las Llamas-Moxeke), Chankillo, and Taukachi-Konkan, as well as other smaller sites. Most of these inland sites are found in the river valleys about 20 kilometres (12 miles) distant from the ocean. The seaside sites of Huaynuná and Las Haldas are found about 20 kilometres (12 miles) north and south of the mouth of the Casma River on the coast.

A frieze located at Sechin Bajo dated at 3600 BCE is the oldest example of monumental architecture discovered thus far in the Americas. This date, if confirmed by additional discoveries, means that the Casma/Sechin culture may have originated as early or earlier than the Caral–Supe civilization, currently considered the oldest civilization of the Americas.

Caste War of Yucatán.headline: Kastna vojna na Jukatanu
paragraphs: Kastna vojna na Jukatanu ali ba'atabil kichkelem Yúum (1847–1915) se je začela z uporom domorodnih Majev na polotoku Jukatan proti hispanskemu prebivalstvu, imenovanemu Yucatecos. Ti so politično in gospodarsko obvladovali pokrajino od španske osvojitve Jukatana in podjarmljenja Majev konec 16. stoletja. Upor je bil eden najuspešnejših sodobnih indijanskih uporov. Sledila je dolga vojna med silami Yucatecov s središčem na severozahodu Jukatana in neodvisnimi Maji na jugovzhodu.

source.title: Caste War of Yucatán
paragraphs: The Caste War of Yucatán or ba'atabil kichkelem Yúum (1847–1915) began with the revolt of Indigenous Maya people of the Yucatán Peninsula against Hispanic populations, called Yucatecos. The latter had held political and economic control of the region after the Spanish conquest of Yucatán and subjugation of the Maya people in the late 16th century. It was one of the most successful modern Native American revolts. A lengthy war ensued between the Yucateco forces based in the northwest of the Yucatán and the independent Maya in the southeast.

Castellammarese War.headline: Castellammareška vojna
paragraphs: Castellammareška vojna je bil krvav boj za oblast v ameriški mafiji med privrženci Joeja »The Bossa« Masserie in Salvatoreja Maranzana v New Yorku od 26. februarja 1930 do 15. aprila 1931. Spor je dobil ime po sicilskem mestu Castellammare del Golfo, kjer se je rodil Maranzano.

Maranzanova frakcija je zmagala in newyorške mafijske družine razdelila v pet družin. Maranzano se je razglasil za capo di tutti i capi (»šefa vseh šefov«). Septembra 1931 so ga umorili po ukazu Luckyja Luciana, ki je prek vodstvenega telesa, imenovanega Komisija, vzpostavil delitev oblasti in vsem mafijskim družinam dal enak položaj, da bi se v prihodnje izognili podobnim sporom.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Castellammarese War
paragraphs: The Castellammarese War (Italian pronunciation: [kaˌstɛllammaˈreːze, -eːse]) was a bloody power struggle for control of the American Mafia between partisans of Joe "The Boss" Masseria and Salvatore Maranzano in New York City from February 26, 1930, until April 15, 1931. The feud was named after the Sicilian town of Castellammare del Golfo, Maranzano's birthplace.

Maranzano's faction prevailed in the conflict and divided New York's crime families into the Five Families. Maranzano declared himself capo di tutti i capi ("boss of all bosses"). Maranzano was murdered in September 1931 on orders of Lucky Luciano, who established a power-sharing arrangement through a governing body called the Commission, giving equal stature to all Mafia families to avoid such feuds in the future.

Cauca culture.headline: Kultura Cauca
paragraphs: Kultura Cauca (800–1200 n. št.) je predkolumbovska kultura iz kolumbijske pokrajine Valle del Cauca, imenovana po reki Cauca. Srednja kultura Cauca sega v 9. in 10. stoletje n. št.
Njeno ozemlje je ležalo blizu današnjega mesta Popayán, v dolini reke Calima.

source.title: Cauca culture
paragraphs: Cauca culture (800–1200 CE) is a pre-Columbian culture from the Valle del Cauca in Colombia, named for the Cauca River. Middle Cauca culture dates from the 9 to 10th centuries CE.
Their territory was near the present day city of Popayán, in the Calima River Valley.

Cenepa War.headline: Vojna za Cenepo
paragraphs: Vojna za Cenepo (26. januarja–28. februarja 1995), znana tudi kot vojna za Alto Cenepa, je bil kratek in krajevno omejen vojaški spopad med Ekvadorjem in Perujem za nadzor nad območjem na ekvadorskem ozemlju (na vzhodni strani gorovja Cordillera del Cóndor, provinca Condorcanqui, regija Amazonas, Republika Ekvador) blizu meje med državama. Državi sta po ekvadorsko-perujski vojni leta 1941 podpisali mejno pogodbo, a se Ekvador pozneje ni strinjal z njeno uporabo na območjih Cenepa in Paquisha in jo je leta 1960 razglasil za nično. Večina bojev je potekala okoli povirja reke Cenepa.

source.title: Cenepa War
paragraphs: The Cenepa War (26 January – 28 February 1995), also known as the Alto Cenepa War, was a brief and localized military conflict between Ecuador and Peru, fought over control of an area in the Ecuadorian territory (i.e. in the eastern side of the Cordillera del Cóndor, Province of Condorcanqui, Región Amazonas, Republic of Ecuador) near the border between the two countries. The two nations had signed a border treaty following the Ecuadorian–Peruvian War of 1941, but Ecuador later disagreed with the treaty as it applied to the Cenepa and Paquisha areas, and in 1960 it declared the treaty null and void. Most of the fighting took place around the headwaters of the Cenepa River.

Centralistična republika Mehika (špansko: República Centralista de México), v angleški strokovni literaturi tudi Centralna republika, uradno Mehiška republika (República Mexicana), je bila unitarna politična ureditev, ki so jo v Mehiki vzpostavili 23. oktobra 1835 z novo ustavo, imenovano Siete Leyes (»sedem zakonov«), potem ko so konservativci razveljavili federalistično ustavo iz leta 1824 in končali prvo mehiško republiko. Trajala je do leta 1846, ko so ob začetku mehiško-ameriške vojne znova uveljavili ustavo iz leta 1824.
V tem obdobju sta prevladovala predsednika Santa Anna in Anastasio Bustamante.

source.title: Centralist Republic of Mexico
paragraphs: The Centralist Republic of Mexico (Spanish: República Centralista de México), or in the anglophone scholarship, the Central Republic, officially the Mexican Republic (Spanish: República Mexicana), was a unitary political regime established in Mexico on 23 October 1835, under a new constitution known as the Siete Leyes (lit. 'seven laws') after conservatives repealed the federalist Constitution of 1824 and ended the First Mexican Republic. It would ultimately last until 1846, when the Constitution of 1824 was restored at the beginning of the Mexican–American War.
Two presidents would predominate throughout this era: Santa Anna and Anastasio Bustamante.

Chachapoya culture.headline: Kultura Chachapoya
paragraphs: Chachapoye, imenovani tudi »bojevniki oblakov«, so bili andska kultura, ki je živela v oblačnih gozdovih južnega dela departmaja Amazonas v današnjem Peruju. Inkovski imperij je njihovo civilizacijo osvojil malo pred španskim osvajanjem v 16. stoletju. Ob prihodu konkvistadorjev so bili Chachapoye eno od mnogih ljudstev pod inkovsko oblastjo, čeprav so jih zaradi nenehnega upiranja inkovskim četam težko vključili v imperij.

source.title: Chachapoya culture
paragraphs: The Chachapoyas, also called the "Warriors of the Clouds," were a culture of the Andes living in the cloud forests of the southern part of the Department of Amazonas of present-day Peru. The Inca Empire conquered their civilization shortly before the Spanish conquest in the 16th century. At the time of the arrival of the conquistadores, the Chachapoyas were one of the many nations ruled by the Incas, although their incorporation had been difficult due to their constant resistance to Inca troops.

Chancay culture.headline: Kultura Chancay
paragraphs: Chancay je bila predšpanska arheološka civilizacija, ki se je približno od leta 1000 do 1470 n. št. razvila v dolinah Fortaleza, Pativilca, Supe, Huaura, Chancay, Chillón, Rimac in Lurín na osrednji perujski obali.

source.title: Chancay culture
paragraphs: The Chancay were a pre-Hispanic archeological civilization that developed between the valleys of Fortaleza, Pativilca, Supe, Huaura, Chancay, Chillón, Rimac and Lurín, on the central coast of Peru, from about 1000 to 1470 CE.

Chattanooška kampanja je bila vrsta manevrov in bitk oktobra in novembra 1863 med ameriško državljansko vojno. Potem ko je bila Cumberlandska armada Unije generalmajorja Williama S. Rosecransa septembra poražena v bitki pri Chickamaugi, je konfederacijska Tennesseejska armada generala Braxtona Bragga Rosecransa in njegove može oblegala, tako da je zasedla ključne vzpetine okoli Chattanooge v Tennesseeju. Generalmajor Ulysses S. Grant je prevzel poveljstvo nad silami Unije na zahodu, ki so jih zdaj združili v misisipijsko divizijo. Z njim so v Chattanoogo začele prihajati tudi močne okrepitve iz Misisipija in z vzhodnega bojišča. Grant je 18. oktobra Rosecransa razrešil poveljstva Cumberlandske armade in ga nadomestil z generalmajorjem Georgeem Henryjem Thomasom.

source.title: Chattanooga campaign
paragraphs: The Chattanooga campaign was a series of maneuvers and battles in October and November 1863, during the American Civil War. Following the defeat of Maj. Gen. William S. Rosecrans's Union Army of the Cumberland at the Battle of Chickamauga in September, the Confederate Army of Tennessee under Gen. Braxton Bragg besieged Rosecrans and his men by occupying key high terrain around Chattanooga, Tennessee. Maj. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant was given command of Union forces in the West which was now consolidated under the Division of the Mississippi. Significant reinforcements also began to arrive with him in Chattanooga from Mississippi and the eastern theater. On October 18, Grant removed Rosecrans from command of the Army of the Cumberland and replaced him with Major General George Henry Thomas.

Chilean Civil War of 1891.headline: Čilska državljanska vojna leta 1891
paragraphs: Čilska državljanska vojna leta 1891, imenovana tudi druga čilska državljanska vojna ali revolucija leta 1891, je od 16. januarja do 18. septembra 1891 potekala med silami, ki so podpirale kongres, in silami, ki so podpirale predsednika Joséja Manuela Balmacedo. V vojni sta se spopadli čilska kopenska vojska, ki je stala na predsednikovi strani, in čilska vojna mornarica, ki je podpirala kongres. Spopad se je končal s porazom kopenske vojske in predsedniških sil, predsednik Balmaceda pa je zaradi poraza naredil samomor. V čilskem zgodovinopisju vojna pomeni konec liberalne republike in začetek parlamentarne dobe.

source.title: Chilean Civil War of 1891
paragraphs: The Chilean Civil War of 1891, or the Second Chilean Civil War or Revolution of 1891, was a civil war in Chile fought between forces supporting Congress and forces supporting the President, José Manuel Balmaceda, from 16 January 1891 to 18 September 1891. The war saw a confrontation between the Chilean Army and the Chilean Navy, siding with the president and the Congress, respectively. This conflict ended with the defeat of the Chilean Army and the presidential forces, and with President Balmaceda committing suicide as a consequence of the defeat. In Chilean historiography the war marks the end of the Liberal Republic and the beginning of the Parliamentary Era.

Chilean War of Independence.headline: Čilska osamosvojitvena vojna
paragraphs: Čilska osamosvojitvena vojna (špansko: Guerra de la Independencia de Chile) je bil vojaški in politični dogodek, s katerim se je Čile osvobodil španske monarhije, končal kolonialno obdobje in začel oblikovati neodvisno republiko.

Razvila se je v okviru hispanskoameriških osamosvojitvenih vojn, vojaškega in političnega procesa, ki se je začel, ko so v hispanskoameriških kolonijah po tem, ko so Napoleonove sile leta 1808 ujele španskega kralja Ferdinanda VII., nastale samoupravne hunte. Zato so ustanovili tudi prvo vladno hunto Čila. Ta se je postopoma radikalizirala, kar je pripeljalo do vojaškega spopada med domoljubi, ki so si prizadevali za dokončno ločitev od španske krone, in rojalisti, ki so hoteli ohraniti enotnost s krono.

source.title: Chilean War of Independence
paragraphs: The Chilean War of Independence (Spanish: Guerra de la Independencia de Chile, 'War of Independence of Chile') was a military and political event that allowed the emancipation of Chile from the Spanish Monarchy, ending the colonial period and initiating the formation of an independent republic.

It developed in the context of the Spanish American Wars of independence, a military and political process that began after the formation of self-government juntas in the Spanish-American colonies, in response to the capture of King Ferdinand VII of Spain by Napoleonic forces in 1808. The First Government Junta of Chile was formed for that purpose. But then, it began to gradually radicalize, which caused a military struggle between Patriots, who were looking for a definitive separation from the Spanish Crown; and Royalists, who sought to maintain unity with the Crown.

Chimor.headline: Chimor
paragraphs: Chimor (tudi kraljestvo Chimor ali imperij Chimú) je bila politična tvorba kulture Chimú. Kultura je nastala okoli leta 900 n. št. kot naslednica močejske kulture, okoli leta 1470, petdeset let pred prihodom Špancev v pokrajino, pa jo je osvojil inkovski vladar Topa Inca Yupanqui. Chimor je bil največje kraljestvo poznega vmesnega obdobja in je obsegal 1000 kilometrov današnje perujske obale.

Po ustnem izročilu ljudstva Chimú se je zgodovina Chimorja začela, ko je Taycanamo na splavu iz balze z morja prispel v dolino Moche. Od tam so njegovi potomci, začenši s sinom Guacricurjem, osvajali okoliška območja. Guacricur je oblast Chimújev utrdil v spodnjem delu doline, Taycanamov vnuk Ñancempinco pa je kraljestvo razširil z osvojitvijo zgornjega dela. Ñançenpinco je začel širiti kraljestvo tudi severno in južno od dolin Moche.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out; both spellings of Ñancempinco are kept as in the source.

source.title: Chimor
paragraphs: Chimor (also Kingdom of Chimor or Chimú Empire) was the political grouping of the Chimú culture (Spanish pronunciation: [tʃiˈmu]). The culture arose about 900 CE, succeeding the Moche culture, and was later conquered by the Inca emperor Topa Inca Yupanqui around 1470, fifty years before the arrival of the Spanish in the region. Chimor was the largest kingdom in the Late Intermediate Period, encompassing 1,000 kilometres (620 mi) of modern-day Peruvian coastline.

According to Chimú oral history, the history of Chimor began with the arrival of Taycanamo in the Moche Valley from the sea on a balsa raft. From there, his descendants would conquer surrounding areas starting with his son Guacricur. Guacricur integrated Chimú's reign over the lower valley and Ñancempinco, Taycanamo's grandson, would expand the kingdom by conquering the upper valley. Ñançenpinco began further expansion both north and south of the Moche Valleys.

Kultura Chincha (ali kultura Ica-Chincha) je bila kultura Kinhajcev, domorodnega ljudstva, ki je živelo ob Tihem oceanu na jugozahodu Peruja. Kraljestvo Chincha in njegova kultura sta cvetela v poznem vmesnem obdobju (900–1450 n. št.), imenovanem tudi obdobje regionalnih držav predkolumbovskega Peruja. Okoli leta 1480 so Kinhajci postali del Inkovskega imperija. Sloveli so kot pomorski trgovci in živeli v veliki, rodovitni oazni dolini. Z njimi je povezana arheološka razvalina La Centinela blizu današnjega mesta Chincha Alta.

Kinhajce je osvojila Španija med špansko osvojitvijo Peruja, ki se je začela leta 1532. Množično so umirali zaradi evropskih bolezni in političnega kaosa, ki je spremljal špansko invazijo in ji sledil, njihovi potomci pa v pokrajini živijo še danes.

source.title: Chincha culture
paragraphs: The Chincha culture (or Ica-Chincha culture) was the culture of a Native Peruvian people living near the Pacific Ocean in southwest Peru. The Chincha Kingdom and their culture flourished in the Late Intermediate Period (900 AD–1450 AD), also known as the regional states period of pre-Columbian Peru. They became part of the Inca Empire around 1480. They were prominent as sea-going traders and lived in a large and fertile oasis valley. La Centinela is an archaeological ruin associated with the Chincha. It is located near the present-day city of Chincha Alta.

The Chincha were conquered by Spain during the Spanish conquest of Peru, which began in 1532. They died in large numbers from European diseases and the political chaos which accompanied and followed the Spanish invasion, although their modern descendants still live in the region today.

Chinchorro culture.headline: Kultura Chinchorro
paragraphs: Kultura Chinchorro je bila predkeramična kultura Južne Amerike, ki je trajala od 9100 do 3500 let pred sedanjostjo (od 7000 do 1500 pr. n. št.). Njeni nosilci so bili stalno naseljeni ribiči na pacifiški obali današnjega severnega Čila in južnega Peruja; naselitev je omogočila sladka voda v sicer sušni obalni pokrajini. Ljudstvo je slovelo po skrbnem mumificiranju in pogrebnih obredih. Okoli 4000 let pred sedanjostjo so na območje začeli prihajati vplivi z andske planote, ki so privedli do poljedelstva; mnogo pozneje se je znašlo pod vplivom Tiahunaškega imperija.
Leta 2021 so kulturo Chinchorro vpisali na Unescov seznam svetovne dediščine.

source.title: Chinchorro culture
paragraphs: The Chinchorro culture of South America was a preceramic culture that lasted from 9,100 to 3,500 years BP (7,000 to 1,500 BCE). The people forming the Chinchorro culture were sedentary fishermen inhabiting the Pacific coastal region of current northern Chile and southern Peru. Presence of fresh water in the arid region on the coast facilitated human settlement in this area. The Chinchorro were famous for their detailed mummification and funerary practices. The area of the Chinchorro culture started to receive influences from the Andean Plateau around 4,000 BP, which led to the adoption of agriculture. Much later, it came under the influence of the Tiwanaku Empire.
In 2021, the Chinchorro culture was included in the UNESCO World Heritage List.

Chiribaya culture.headline: Kultura Chiribaya
paragraphs: Kultura Chiribaya je cvetela blizu obale južnega Peruja in sosednjega Čila od leta 700 n. št. do španske naselitve konec 16. stoletja. Njena klasična faza je trajala od leta 1000 do 1360 n. št. Sestavljala so jo pomorska naselja vzdolž 220 kilometrov pacifiške obale in poljedelska naselja v notranjosti, v dolinah rek Osmore in Tambo v Peruju ter reke Lluta in doline Azapa v Čilu.

Spodnjo dolino reke Osmore, eno od središč kulture Chiribaya, so arheologi temeljito raziskali, saj so jo, kot kaže, kolonizirali tako imperija Wari in Tiwanaku kot pozneje ljudstvo Lupaca in Inkovski imperij. Ti visokogorski imperiji so se zanašali na nižje ležeče doline, ki so jih oskrbovale s poljskimi pridelki, kot sta koruza in čili.

source.title: Chiribaya culture
paragraphs: The Chiribaya culture flourished near the coast of southern Peru and adjacent Chile from 700 CE until Spanish settlement in the late 16th century. The classic phase of the Chiribaya culture was from 1000 CE until 1360 CE. The Chiribaya culture consisted of both maritime settlements along 220 kilometres (140 mi) of the Pacific Ocean coast and agricultural settlements inland in valleys of the Osmore and Tambo rivers in Peru and the Lluta river and Azapa Valley in Chile.

The lower Osmore valley, one of the centers of the Chiribaya culture, has been extensively studied by archaeologists because it appears to have been colonized by both the Wari and Tihuanco empires and the later Lupaca people and the Inca Empire. These highland empires relied on the lower-altitude valleys to supply them with agricultural products such as maize and chile peppers.

Chorrera culture.headline: Kultura Chorrera
paragraphs: Kultura ali tradicija Chorrera je poznoformativna domorodna kultura, ki je med letoma 1300 in 300 pr. n. št. cvetela v Ekvadorju. Bila je ena najbolj razširjenih kultur predkolumbovskega Ekvadorja, saj je segala od pacifiških nižin do andskega visokogorja in celo v južno Kolumbijo.

source.title: Chorrera culture
paragraphs: The Chorrera culture or Chorrera tradition is a Late Formative indigenous culture that flourished between 1300 BCE and 300 BCE in Ecuador. Chorrera culture was one of the most widespread cultures in pre-Columbian Ecuador, spanning the Pacific lowlands to the Andean highlands, and even into southern Colombia.

Ciboney.headline: Ciboney
paragraphs: Ciboney ali Siboney so bili domorodno ljudstvo Kube, haitijskega polotoka Tiburon in morda Jamajke. Po mnenju nekaterih raziskovalcev, med njimi Juliana Granberryja in Garyja Vesceliusa, so bili zahodna skupina Tainov, ki je v 15. in 16. stoletju živela na Kubi; njihovo narečje in kultura sta se razlikovala od klasičnih Tainov, ki so se s Hispaniole začeli priseljevati po letu 1450, čeprav je bil velik del njihovega ozemlja pod oblastjo vzhodnih poglavarjev. Drugi raziskovalci, med njimi L. Antonio Curet in Cayetano Coll y Toste, jih med Taine ne uvrščajo. Zaradi zmede v zgodovinskih virih so raziskovalci v 20. stoletju ime »Ciboney« uporabljali tudi za netainske Guanahatabeye na zahodu Kube in za različne arhaične kulture po Karibih, kar pa danes velja za zastarelo.
notes: The people's name is kept as Ciboney; no established Slovenian form was found.

source.title: Ciboney
paragraphs: The Ciboney ( or ), or Siboney, were an Indigenous people of Cuba, the Tiburon Peninsula of Haiti, and possibly Jamaica. According to some scholars, including Julian Granberry and Gary Vescelius, the Ciboney were a Western Taíno group living in Cuba during the 15th and 16th centuries, who had a dialect and culture distinct from the Classic Taíno who began migrating from Hispaniola after 1450, though much of the Ciboney territory was under the control of the eastern chiefs. Other scholars, including L. Antonio Curet and Cayetano Coll y Toste, do not classify the Ciboney as Taino. Confusion in the historical sources led 20th-century scholars to apply the name "Ciboney" to the non-Taíno Guanahatabey of western Cuba and various archaic cultures around the Caribbean, but this is deprecated.

Cisplatinska vojna je bil oborožen spopad v 1820. letih med Brazilskim cesarstvom in Združenimi provincami Río de la Plata za nadzor nad Bando Oriental, potem ko jo je Brazilija priključila kot provinco Cisplatina. Bojevali so se po osamosvojitvi Združenih provinc od Španije in Brazilije od Portugalske, vojna pa se je končala z neodvisnostjo Cisplatine kot Vzhodne države Urugvaj.

source.title: Cisplatine War
paragraphs: The Cisplatine War was an armed conflict fought in the 1820s between the Empire of Brazil and the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata over control of the Banda Oriental following its annexation by Brazil as the Cisplatina province. It was fought in the aftermath of the United Provinces' and Brazil's independence from Spain and Portugal, respectively, and resulted in the independence of Cisplatina as the Oriental State of Uruguay.

Classic Veracruz culture.headline: Klasična veracruška kultura
paragraphs: Klasična veracruška kultura (ali klasična kultura zalivske obale) označuje kulturno območje na severu in v osrednjem delu današnje mehiške zvezne države Veracruz, kjer je kultura obstajala približno od leta 100 do 1000 n. št., v klasičnem obdobju.

Glavno središče klasične veracruške kulture je bil El Tajín; med drugimi pomembnimi naselji so Higueras, Zapotal, Cerro de las Mesas, Nopiloa in Remojadas, zadnji dve pomembni keramični središči. Kultura je segala po zalivski obali od reke Pánuco na severu do reke Papaloapan na jugu.

Klasično veracruško kulturo včasih povezujejo s Totonaki, ki so to ozemlje poseljevali ob španski osvojitvi Azteškega imperija. Dokazov, da so bili Totonaki nosilci kulture klasičnega obdobja, pa je malo ali nič. Druga možnost za njeno etnojezikovno identiteto so Huasteki.

source.title: Classic Veracruz culture
paragraphs: Classic Veracruz culture (or Gulf Coast Classic culture) refers to a cultural area in the north and central areas of the present-day Mexican state of Veracruz, a culture that existed from roughly 100 to 1000 CE, or during the Classic era.

El Tajin was the major center of Classic Veracruz culture; other notable settlements include Higueras, Zapotal, Cerro de las Mesas, Nopiloa, and Remojadas, the latter two important ceramics centers. The culture spanned the Gulf Coast between the Pánuco River on the north and the Papaloapan River on the south.

The Classic Veracruz culture is sometimes associated with the Totonacs, who were occupying this territory at the time of the Spanish Conquest of the Aztec Empire. However, there is little or no evidence that the Totonacs were the originators of the Classic era culture. Another candidate for the ethnolinguistic identity is the Huastecs.

Cochise tradition.headline: Tradicija Cochise
paragraphs: Tradicija Cochise (tudi kultura Cochise) je južna od štirih arhaičnih tradicij ameriškega jugozahoda, na območju današnjih jugozahodnih Združenih držav.

Trajala je skoraj pet tisočletij, od okoli leta 5000 do okoli 200 pr. n. št. Njena najzgodnejša oblika je znana kot Sulphur Spring, precej bolje pa sta znani poznejši fazi Chiricahua in San Pedro. Ime je dobila po jezeru Cochise, nekdanjem jezeru na mestu današnje usedline Willcox Playa v okrožju Cochise v Arizoni. Kaže, da je bila prednica prazgodovinskih tradicij Mogollon (Mimbres) in Hohokam.

Tradicija Cochise je del kulture Picosa, ki zajema arhaični način življenja ljudi s treh območij s povezanimi najdbami in načinom življenja. Ime ji je v 1960. letih dala Cynthia Irwin-Williams po teh območjih: Pinto Basin (PI), tradiciji Cochise (CO) in San Jose (SA), skupaj »Picosa«.

source.title: Cochise tradition
paragraphs: The Cochise tradition (also Cochise culture) is the southern archeological tradition of the four Southwestern Archaic traditions, in the present-day Southwestern United States.

The Cochise tradition lasted nearly five millennia, from circa 5000 until circa 200 BC. Its earliest manifestation is known as Sulphur Spring; its two later phases, the Chiricahua and San Pedro, are much better known. The Cochise tradition was named after Lake Cochise, an ancient lake now found in the Willcox Playa of Cochise County, Arizona. The Cochise tradition appears to be ancestral to the prehistoric Mogollon (Mimbres) and Hohokam traditions.

The Cochise tradition is part of the Picosa culture, which encapsulates the Archaic lifestyles of people from three locations with interconnected artifacts and lifestyles. It was named by Cynthia Irwin-Williams in the 1960s for those areas: Pinto Basin (PI), Cochise tradition (CO), and San Jose (SA), which together are called "Picosa".

Coles Creek culture.headline: Kultura Coles Creek
paragraphs: Kultura Coles Creek je arheološka kultura poznega gozdnega obdobja v dolini spodnjega Misisipija na območju jugovzhodnih gozdov, ki je sledila kulturi Troyville. Obdobje pomeni pomembno prelomnico v kulturni zgodovini območja. Prebivalstvo se je močno povečalo, trdni dokazi pa kažejo vse izrazitejše kulturno in politično razslojevanje, zlasti proti koncu zaporedja Coles Creek. Čeprav se številne klasične značilnosti poglavarskih družb še niso pokazale, so do leta 1000 n. št. že začele nastajati preproste elitne politične skupnosti. Najdišča kulture Coles Creek so v Arkansasu, Louisiani in Misisipiju. Velja za prednico kulture Plaquemine.

source.title: Coles Creek culture
paragraphs: Coles Creek culture is a Late Woodland archaeological culture in the Lower Mississippi valley in the Southeastern Woodlands. It followed the Troyville culture. The period marks a significant change in the cultural history of the area. Population increased dramatically and there is strong evidence of a growing cultural and political hierarchization, especially by the end of the Coles Creek sequence. Although many of the classic traits of chiefdom societies are not yet manifested, by 1000 CE the formation of simple elite polities had begun. Coles Creek sites are found in Arkansas, Louisiana, and Mississippi. It is considered ancestral to the Plaquemine culture.

Colla Kingdom.headline: Kraljestvo Colla
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Colla (tudi Qolla ali Qulla), imenovano tudi poglavarstvo ali gospostvo (señorío), je bila politična skupnost v severozahodnem porečju jezera Titicaca. Bila je segmentarna družba z mnogimi rodovi in podskupinami.

Poglavarstvo Colla je bilo eno od ajmarskih kraljestev, ki so po padcu Tiwanakuja zasedla del planote Collao. Sredi 15. stoletja so imeli Colle obsežno ozemlje, eno največjih med ajmarskimi kraljestvi; tedaj ga je skupaj z drugimi političnimi tvorbami v regiji osvojil 9. sapa inka Pachakutiq Yupanqui Qhapaq, Intipchurin (»sin sonca«). Pogosto ga opisujejo kot mogočno, enotno državo, arheološki podatki pa kažejo bolj politično razdrobljeno pokrajino, posejano z obrambnimi utrdbami, imenovanimi pukare.

Bilo je eno najpomembnejših poglavarstev na altiplanu, obsegalo je 20.000 kvadratnih kilometrov in se sklicevalo na dediščino tiahunaške civilizacije. Ljudstvo Colla je govorilo puquinščino, ki je bila morda jezik Tiwanakuja pred njegovim propadom.

source.title: Colla Kingdom
paragraphs: The Colla, Qolla or Qulla Kingdom, chiefdom or Señorio was a polity established in the northwestern basin of lake Titicaca. It was a segmentary society, containing many lineages and subgroups.

The Colla chiefdom was one of the Aymara kingdoms that occupied part of the Collao plateau after the fall of Tiwanaku. In the mid-15th century the Collas possessed a vast territory, one of the largest of the Aymara kingdoms, which at the time the 9th Sapan Inka Pachakutiq Yupanqui Qhapaq the Intipchurin ("son of the sun"), conquered along with other political entities in the region. Often described as a powerful, unified state, archeological data indicates a more politically fragmented landscape, covered by defensive forts, called pukaras.

The Colla chiefdom was one of the most important altiplano chiefdoms, covering 20.000 square kilometres, and claiming heritage from the Tiwanaku civilisation. Linguistically, the Colla nation spoke Puquina, possibly the language of Tiwanaku prior to its collapse.

Colombia–Peru War.headline: Kolumbijsko-perujska vojna
paragraphs: Kolumbijsko-perujska vojna, imenovana tudi vojna za Leticio, je bil kratek oborožen spopad med Kolumbijo in Perujem za ozemlje v amazonskem deževnem gozdu, ki je trajal od 1. septembra 1932 do 24. maja 1933. Nazadnje sta se državi dogovorili, da si sporno območje razdelita.

Spopad je izviral iz mejne pogodbe z dne 24. marca 1922, s katero je okrožje Leticia pripadlo Kolumbiji, ki je tako dobila dostop do Amazonke. V okrožju so živeli večinoma Perujci, kar je med njimi netilo zamere in jih spodbudilo, da so skušali pogodbo spremeniti.

source.title: Colombia–Peru War
paragraphs: The Colombia–Peru War, also called the Leticia War, was a short-lived armed conflict between Colombia and Peru over territory in the Amazon rainforest that lasted from September 1, 1932, to May 24, 1933. In the end, an agreement was reached to divide the disputed area between both countries.

The conflict was rooted in the Boundary Treaty of March 24, 1922, which transferred the Leticia district to Colombia, giving Colombia access to the Amazon river. The district was mostly inhabited by Peruvians, which fueled grievances among Peruvians and led them to seek to modify the treaty.

Kolumbijski konflikt (špansko: Conflicto armado interno de Colombia, dobesedno »notranji oboroženi spopad v Kolumbiji«) se je začel 27. maja 1964 in je asimetrična vojna nizke intenzivnosti med kolumbijsko vlado, paravojaškimi skupinami, hudodelskimi združbami in skrajno levimi gverilskimi skupinami, ki se oboroženo bojujejo za večji vpliv na kolumbijskem ozemlju. Med najpomembnejšimi mednarodnimi udeleženci konflikta so multinacionalne družbe, Združene države, Kuba in mamilarska industrija.

Zgodovinske korenine ima v spopadih, znanih kot La Violencia (»nasilje«), ki jih je leta 1948 sprožil umor liberalnega političnega voditelja Jorgeja Eliécerja Gaitána, in v protikomunistični represiji na kolumbijskem podeželju v 1960. letih, po kateri so se liberalni in komunistični borci preoblikovali v Revolucionarne oborožene sile Kolumbije (FARC).

source.title: Colombian conflict
paragraphs: The Colombian conflict (Spanish: Conflicto armado interno de Colombia, lit. 'Colombian internal armed conflict') began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.

The conflict is historically rooted in the conflict known as La Violencia, which was triggered by the 1948 assassination of liberal political leader Jorge Eliécer Gaitán and in the aftermath of the anti-communist repression in rural Colombia in the 1960s that led Liberal and Communist militants to re-organize into the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC).

Po izročilu se je kolumbijska osamosvojitvena vojna začela 20. julija 1810, ko so v Santa Fe de Bogotá, prestolnici španskega kolonialnega Podkraljestva Nova Granada, ustanovili vladno hunto, politični upravni odbor, ki so ga večinoma vodili krajevni kolonisti. Hunta je odstavila vladajočega podkralja Nove Granade in vzpostavila samostojno vlado, ki je zahtevala suverenost nad vsem podkraljestvom.

Več drugih provinc Nove Granade, kot sta Cartagena in Socorro, pa je lastne samostojne vlade ustanovilo že tedne pred glavno hunto v Santa Fe de Bogotá, prvo hunto pa je 10. avgusta 1809 ustanovil Quito. Ti dogodki so navdihnili podobna avtonomistična gibanja po vsej Južni Ameriki in sprožili skoraj desetletni upor, ki se je končal z ustanovitvijo Republike Kolumbije, ki je obsegala današnjo Kolumbijo, celinski Ekvador, Panamo in Venezuelo ter dele severnega Peruja in severozahodne Brazilije. Kolumbija je bila prva španska kolonija v Južni Ameriki, ki je leta 1810 razglasila neodvisnost od Španije.

source.title: Colombian War of Independence
paragraphs: The Colombian War of Independence is traditionally held as having begun on July 20, 1810 when a government junta, a political governing board mostly headed by local colonists, was created in Santa Fe de Bogotá, the capital of the Spanish colonial Viceroyalty of New Granada. This junta overthrew the reigning viceroy of New Granada and established an autonomous government that claimed sovereignty over all of the Viceroyalty of New Granada.

However, various other provinces of New Granada, such as Cartagena and Socorro, had formed their own autonomous governments weeks before the main junta of Santa Fe de Bogotá, with Quito forming the first junta on August 10, 1809. These events inspired similar autonomist movements across South America, and triggered an almost decade-long rebellion culminating in the founding of the Republic of Colombia, which spanned present-day Colombia, mainland Ecuador, Panama, and Venezuela, along with parts of northern Peru and northwestern Brazil. Colombia was the first Spanish colony in South America to declare independence from Spain in 1810.

Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty.headline: Pogodba o celoviti prepovedi jedrskih poskusov
paragraphs: Pogodba o celoviti prepovedi jedrskih poskusov (CTBT) je večstranska pogodba, ki prepoveduje poskusne jedrske eksplozije in vse druge jedrske eksplozije, tako v civilne kot v vojaške namene, v vseh okoljih. Generalna skupščina Združenih narodov jo je sprejela 10. septembra 1996, a ni začela veljati, ker je niso ratificirale vse potrebne države. Pogodba bo ustanovila Organizacijo za pogodbo o celoviti prepovedi jedrskih poskusov, ki bo nadzorovala spremljanje, zdaj pa to opravlja pripravljalna komisija.

source.title: Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty
paragraphs: The Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT) is a multilateral treaty to ban nuclear weapons test explosions and any other nuclear explosions, for both civilian and military purposes, in all environments. It was adopted by the United Nations General Assembly on 10 September 1996, but has not entered into force, as it has not been ratified by all the required states. The treaty will establish the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty Organization to oversee monitoring, which is currently done by a Preparatory Commission.

Conquest of the Desert.headline: Osvajanje puščave
paragraphs: Osvajanje puščave (špansko: Conquista del desierto) je bil argentinski vojaški pohod, ki ga je v 1870. in 1880. letih vodil predvsem general Julio Argentino Roca, da bi Argentina zavladala Patagoniji, kjer so živela predvsem domorodna ljudstva. Pohod je argentinsko ozemlje razširil v Patagonijo in ustavil čilsko širjenje v tej pokrajini.

source.title: Conquest of the Desert
paragraphs: The Conquest of the Desert (Spanish: Conquista del desierto) was an Argentine military campaign directed mainly by General Julio Argentino Roca during the 1870s and 1880s with the intention of establishing dominance over Patagonia, inhabited primarily by Indigenous peoples. The Conquest of the Desert extended Argentine territories into Patagonia and ended Chilean expansion in the region.

Conservative Party (Mexico).headline: Konservativna stranka (Mehika)
paragraphs: Konservativna stranka (špansko: Partido Conservador) je bila politična frakcija v Mehiki med letoma 1830 in 1867, ki je po letu 1849 postala ohlapno organizirana politična stranka. Nasprotovala ji je Liberalna stranka, s katero se je spopadla v več državljanskih vojnah.

V različnih obdobjih in okoliščinah so konservativce imenovali escoceses, centralisti, rojalisti, imperialisti ali konservativci, povezovala pa jih je predvsem težnja po ohranitvi kolonialnih španskih vrednot, pri čemer niso nasprotovali gospodarskemu razvoju in posodobitvi države. Oporo so imeli v vojski, med veleposestniki (hacendados) in v katoliški cerkvi.

source.title: Conservative Party (Mexico)
paragraphs: The Conservative Party (Spanish: Partido Conservador) was a political faction in Mexico between 1830 and 1867, which became a loosely organized political party after 1849. They were opposed by, and fought several civil wars against, the Liberal Party.

At various times and under different circumstances they were known as escoceses, centralists, royalists, imperialists, or conservatives, but they tended to be united by the theme of preserving colonial Spanish values, while not being opposed to the economic development and modernization of the nation. Their base of support was the army, the hacendados, and the Catholic Church.

Constitutionalist Revolution.headline: Ustavna revolucija
paragraphs: Ustavna revolucija leta 1932 (znana tudi kot paulistska vojna ali brazilska državljanska vojna) je bila vstaja prebivalcev brazilske zvezne države São Paulo proti revoluciji leta 1930, s katero je predsedniški položaj prevzel Getúlio Vargas. Vargasa so podpirali ljudstvo, vojska in politična elita zveznih držav Minas Gerais, Rio Grande do Sul in Paraíba. Gibanje je zraslo iz krajevne zamere, ker je Vargas v začasni vladi vladal z dekreti, ne da bi ga vezala ustava. Revolucija leta 1930 je São Paulo prizadela, ker je spodkopala samostojnost, ki so jo brazilske zvezne države imele po ustavi iz leta 1891, preprečila nastop paulistskega guvernerja Júlia Prestesa (ki je bil leta 1930 izvoljen za predsednika Brazilije) in strmoglavila predsednika Washingtona Luísa, ki je bil guverner São Paula od leta 1920 do 1924. Ti dogodki so pomenili konec prve brazilske republike.

source.title: Constitutionalist Revolution
paragraphs: The Constitutionalist Revolution of 1932 (also known as the Paulista War or Brazilian Civil War) was the uprising by the population of the Brazilian state of São Paulo against the Revolution of 1930, when Getúlio Vargas assumed the nation's presidency. Vargas was supported by the people, the military and the political elite of Minas Gerais, Rio Grande do Sul and Paraíba. The movement grew out of local resentment over Vargas' rule by decree, unbound by a constitution, in a provisional government. The 1930 revolution affected São Paulo by eroding the autonomy that Brazilian states had under the 1891 constitution, preventing the inauguration of São Paulo governor Júlio Prestes (who had been elected president of Brazil in 1930 and overthrowing President Washington Luís, governor of São Paulo from 1920 to 1924. These events marked the end of the First Brazilian Republic.

Convention for the Suppression of the Tr.headline: Konvencija o zatiranju trgovine z ljudmi in izkoriščanja prostitucije drugih
paragraphs: Konvencijo o zatiranju trgovine z ljudmi in izkoriščanja prostitucije drugih je Generalna skupščina Združenih narodov sprejela 2. decembra 1949, veljati pa je začela 25. julija 1951. Preambula pravi:

Ker sta prostitucija in z njo povezano zlo trgovine z ljudmi zaradi prostitucije nezdružljiva z dostojanstvom in vrednostjo človekove osebnosti ter ogrožata blaginjo posameznika, družine in skupnosti.
Decembra 2013 je bilo pogodbenic konvencije 82 držav (glej zemljevid), nadaljnjih 13 držav pa jo je podpisalo, a še ni ratificiralo.

source.title: Convention for the Suppression of the Traffic in Persons and of the Exploitation of the Prostitution of Others
paragraphs: The Convention for the Suppression of the Traffic in Persons and of the Exploitation of the Prostitution of Others was approved by the United Nations General Assembly on 2 December 1949 and entered into force on 25 July 1951. The preamble states:

Whereas prostitution and the accompanying evil of the traffic in persons for the purpose of prostitution are incompatible with the dignity and worth of the human person and endanger the welfare of the individual, the family, and the community.
As of December 2013, 82 states were party to the convention (see map). An additional 13 states had signed the convention, but had not yet ratified it.

Konvencija o biološki raznovrstnosti (CBD), neuradno konvencija o biodiverziteti, je večstranska pogodba s tremi glavnimi cilji: ohranjanjem biološke raznovrstnosti (biodiverzitete), trajnostno rabo njenih sestavin ter pošteno in pravično delitvijo koristi, ki izhajajo iz genskih virov. Njen namen je razviti nacionalne strategije za ohranjanje in trajnostno rabo biološke raznovrstnosti, pogosto pa jo štejejo za ključni dokument o trajnostnem razvoju.

Konvencija je bila na voljo za podpis na vrhu Zemlje v Riu de Janeiru 5. junija 1992, veljati pa je začela 29. decembra 1993. Združene države so edina članica OZN, ki je ni ratificirala. Ima dva dopolnilna sporazuma, kartagenski in nagojski protokol.

source.title: Convention on Biological Diversity
paragraphs: The Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD), known informally as the Biodiversity Convention, is a multilateral treaty. The Convention has three main goals: the conservation of biological diversity (or biodiversity); the sustainable use of its components; and the fair and equitable sharing of benefits arising from genetic resources. Its objective is to develop national strategies for the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity, and it is often seen as the key document regarding sustainable development.

The Convention was opened for signature at the Earth Summit in Rio de Janeiro on 5 June 1992 and entered into force on 29 December 1993. The United States is the only UN member state which has not ratified the Convention. It has two supplementary agreements, the Cartagena Protocol and Nagoya Protocol.

Convention on International Civil Aviati.headline: Konvencija o mednarodnem civilnem letalstvu
paragraphs: Konvencija o mednarodnem civilnem letalstvu, znana tudi kot čikaška konvencija, je ustanovila Mednarodno organizacijo civilnega letalstva (ICAO), specializirano agencijo Združenih narodov (OZN), ki usklajuje mednarodni zračni promet. Konvencija določa pravila o zračnem prostoru, registraciji zrakoplovov, varnosti, zaščiti in trajnosti ter podrobno opredeljuje pravice podpisnic v zračnem prometu. Vsebuje tudi določbe o obdavčenju.

Dokument je 7. decembra 1944 v Chicagu podpisalo 52 držav. Potrebno 26. ratifikacijo je dobil 5. marca 1947, veljati pa je začel 4. aprila 1947, istega dne, ko je nastala ICAO. Oktobra istega leta je ICAO postala specializirana agencija Ekonomsko-socialnega sveta Združenih narodov (ECOSOC). Konvencijo so odtlej revidirali osemkrat (v letih 1959, 1963, 1969, 1975, 1980, 1997, 2000 in 2006).

source.title: Convention on International Civil Aviation
paragraphs: The Convention on International Civil Aviation, also known as the Chicago Convention, established the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), a specialized agency of the United Nations (UN) charged with coordinating international air travel. The convention establishes rules of airspace, aircraft registration, and safety, security, and sustainability, and details the rights of the signatories in relation to air travel. The convention also contains provisions pertaining to taxation.

The document was signed on December 7, 1944, in Chicago by 52 signatory states. It received the requisite 26th ratification on March 5, 1947, and went into effect on April 4, 1947, the same date that ICAO came into being. In October of the same year, ICAO became a specialized agency of the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC). The convention has since been revised eight times (in 1959, 1963, 1969, 1975, 1980, 1997, 2000, and 2006).

Convention on the Elimination of All For.headline: Konvencija o odpravi vseh oblik diskriminacije žensk
paragraphs: Konvencija o odpravi vseh oblik diskriminacije žensk (CEDAW) je mednarodna pogodba, ki jo je leta 1979 sprejela Generalna skupščina Združenih narodov.

Opisujejo jo kot mednarodno listino pravic žensk. Veljati je začela 3. septembra 1981, ratificiralo pa jo je 189 držav. Več kot petdeset držav jo je ratificiralo z nekaterimi izjavami, pridržki in ugovori, med njimi 38 držav, ki so zavrnile izvršilni 29. člen o načinih reševanja sporov glede razlage ali uporabe konvencije. Avstralija je v izjavi opozorila na omejitve moči osrednje vlade, ki izhajajo iz njene zvezne ustavne ureditve. Združene države in Palau sta konvencijo podpisali, ne pa ratificirali. Sveti sedež, Iran, Somalija, Sudan in Tonga je niso podpisali.
Odboru CEDAW trenutno predseduje Nahla Haidar.

source.title: Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women
paragraphs: The Convention on the Elimination of all Forms of Discrimination Against Women (CEDAW) is an international treaty adopted in 1979 by the United Nations General Assembly.

Described as an international bill of rights for women, it was instituted on 3 September 1981 and has been ratified by 189 states. Over fifty countries that have ratified the convention have done so subject to certain declarations, reservations, and objections, including 38 countries who rejected the enforcement article 29, which addresses means of settlement for disputes concerning the interpretation or application of the convention. Australia's declaration noted the limitations on central government power resulting from its federal constitutional system. The United States and Palau have signed, but not ratified the treaty. The Holy See, Iran, Somalia, Sudan, and Tonga are not signatories to CEDAW.
The CEDAW Chairperson position is currently held by Nahla Haidar.

Convention on the Political Rights of Wo.headline: Konvencija o političnih pravicah žensk
paragraphs: Konvencijo o političnih pravicah žensk je Generalna skupščina Združenih narodov odobrila na 409. plenarnem zasedanju 20. decembra 1952, sprejeta pa je bila 31. marca 1953.
Namen konvencije je kodificirati temeljni mednarodni standard političnih pravic žensk.

source.title: Convention on the Political Rights of Women
paragraphs: The Convention on the Political Rights of Women was approved by the United Nations General Assembly during the 409th plenary meeting, on 20 December 1952, and adopted on 31 March 1953.
The Convention's purpose is to codify a basic international standard for women's political rights.

Costa Rican Civil War.headline: Kostariška državljanska vojna
paragraphs: Kostariška državljanska vojna, doma imenovana vojna '48 ali revolucija '48 (špansko: Guerra del 48, Revolución del 48), je potekala od 12. marca do 24. aprila 1948. Sledila je predsedniškim volitvam 8. februarja 1948, na katerih je opozicijski kandidat Otilio Ulate premagal Rafaela Ángela Calderóna Guardio iz vladajoče stranke. Provladni poslanci, ki so imeli večino v zakonodajni skupščini, so trdili, da je bila Ulatejeva zmaga prirejena, in skupščina je 1. marca izglasovala razveljavitev volilnih izidov. To je sprožilo oboroženo vstajo proti vladi predsednika Teodora Picada, ki jo je vodil poslovnež José Figueres Ferrer, ki na volitvah ni sodeloval.

source.title: Costa Rican Civil War
paragraphs: The Costa Rican Civil War, domestically referred to as the War of '48 or the Revolution of '48 (Spanish: Guerra del 48; Revolución del 48), took place from 12 March to 24 April 1948. The conflict followed the presidential elections of 8 February 1948, in which opposition candidate Otilio Ulate defeated the ruling party's Rafael Ángel Calderón Guardia. The pro-government representatives who dominated the Legislative Assembly alleged that Ulate's victory was fraudulent, and on 1 March, the legislature voted to annul the results of the election. This triggered an armed uprising led by José Figueres Ferrer, a businessman who had not participated in the elections, against the government of President Teodoro Picado.

Cotocollao culture.headline: Kultura Cotocollao
paragraphs: Kultura Cotocollao je bila domorodna predkolumbovska kultura, ki je poseljevala dolino na območju današnjega Quita v Ekvadorju.

source.title: Cotocollao culture
paragraphs: The Cotocollao culture were an indigenous Pre-Columbian culture that inhabited the valley that is now the Quito area, in Ecuador.

Creek War.headline: Kriška vojna
paragraphs: Kriška vojna (tudi vojna Rdečih palic ali kriška državljanska vojna) je bil regionalni spopad med nasprotujočimi si indijanskimi frakcijami, evropskimi silami in Združenimi državami v začetku 19. stoletja. Začela se je kot spopad med plemeni Muskogijev, a so se vanjo hitro vpletle Združene države. Britanski trgovci in španski kolonialni uradniki na Floridi so Rdeče palice oskrbovali z orožjem in opremo, saj so si skupaj prizadevali preprečiti širjenje Združenih držav na območja pod svojim nadzorom.

source.title: Creek War
paragraphs: The Creek War (also the Red Stick War or the Creek Civil War) was a regional conflict between opposing Native American factions, European powers, and the United States during the early 19th century. The Creek War began as a conflict within the tribes of the Muscogee, but the United States quickly became involved. British traders and Spanish colonial officials in Florida supplied the Red Sticks with weapons and equipment due to their shared interest in preventing the expansion of the United States into regions under their control.

Cristero War.headline: Vojna kristerov
paragraphs: Vojna kristerov (špansko: La guerra cristera), znana tudi kot upor kristerov ali La Cristiada, je bil obsežen boj v osrednji in zahodni Mehiki od 3. avgusta 1926 do 21. junija 1929, ki je izbruhnil kot odziv na uveljavljanje sekularističnih in protiklerikalnih členov ustave iz leta 1917. Upor je sprožil izvršni odlok mehiškega predsednika Plutarca Elíasa Callesa o strogem izvajanju 130. člena ustave, izvedbeni akt, znan kot Callesov zakon. Calles je hotel omejiti moč katoliške cerkve v Mehiki in z njo povezanih organizacij ter zatreti ljudsko vernost.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Cristero War
paragraphs: The Cristero War (Spanish: La guerra cristera), also known as the Cristero Rebellion or La Cristiada [la kɾisˈtjaða], was a widespread struggle in central and western Mexico from 3 August 1926 to 21 June 1929 in response to the implementation of secularist and anticlerical articles of the 1917 Constitution. The rebellion was instigated as a response to an executive decree by Mexican President Plutarco Elías Calles to strictly enforce Article 130 of the Constitution, an implementing act known as the Calles Law. Calles sought to limit the power of the Catholic Church in Mexico and its affiliated organizations and to suppress popular religiosity.

Kastiljska krona, znana tudi kot krona Kastilije in Leóna, je bila srednjeveška politična tvorba na Iberskem polotoku, ki je nastala leta 1230 s tretjo in dokončno združitvijo kron, nekaj desetletij pozneje pa še parlamentov kraljestev Kastilije in Leóna, ko je tedanji kastiljski kralj Ferdinand III. zasedel izpraznjeni leonski prestol. Kot ločena enota je obstajala tudi po personalni uniji kastiljske in aragonske krone leta 1479, sklenjeni s poroko katoliških kraljev, vse do razglasitve dekretov Nueva Planta, ki jih je leta 1716 izdal Filip V.

source.title: Crown of Castile
paragraphs: The Crown of Castile, also known as the Crown of Castile and León, was a medieval polity in the Iberian Peninsula that formed in 1230 as a result of the third and definitive union of the crowns and, some decades later, the parliaments of the kingdoms of Castile and León upon the accession of the then Castilian king, Ferdinand III, to the vacant Leonese throne. It continued to exist as a separate entity after the personal union in 1479 of the crowns of Castile and Aragon with the marriage of the Catholic Monarchs up to the promulgation of the Nueva Planta decrees by Philip V in 1716.

Cundinamarca.headline: Cundinamarca
paragraphs: Cundinamarca je lahko:

source.title: Cundinamarca
paragraphs: Cundinamarca may refer to:

Cupisnique.headline: Kultura Cupisnique
paragraphs: Kultura Cupisnique je bila predkolumbovska domorodna kultura, ki je cvetela od ok. 1500 do 500 pr. n. št. na današnji severni pacifiški obali Peruja. Imela je značilen slog gradnje iz nežgane opeke (adobe). Njeni izdelki imajo skupne umetnostne sloge in verske simbole s kulturo Chavin, ki se je pozneje razvila na istem območju.

source.title: Cupisnique
paragraphs: The Cupisnique culture was a pre-Columbian indigenous culture that flourished from c. 1500 to 500 BC along what now is Peru's northern Pacific coast. The culture had a distinctive style of adobe clay architecture. Artifacts of the culture share artistic styles and religious symbols with the Chavin culture that arose in the same area at a later date.

Dakotska vojna leta 1862, znana tudi kot ameriško-dakotska vojna leta 1862, siujska vstaja, dakotska vstaja, siujski izbruh leta 1862, dakotski spopad ali vojna Malega vrana (Little Crow), je bil oborožen spopad med Združenimi državami in več vzhodnimi skupinami Dakotov, skupaj znanih kot Santee Siuji. Začela se je 18. avgusta 1862, ko so Dakoti, ki jim je grozila lakota in izgon, napadli agencijo Lower Sioux in naselja belcev v dolini reke Minnesota na jugozahodu Minnesote. Vojna je trajala pet tednov in zahtevala na stotine življenj naseljencev, na tisoče pa jih je pregnala. Po vojni so Dakote izgnali z njihove domovine in jih prisilno poslali v rezervate v Dakotah in Nebraski, zvezna država Minnesota pa je zaplenila in prodala vso njihovo preostalo zemljo v državi. Osemintrideset dakotskih mož so nato zaradi zločinov med spopadom obesili, kar je bila največja množična usmrtitev v zgodovini ZDA.

source.title: Dakota War of 1862
paragraphs: The Dakota War of 1862, also known as the U.S.-Dakota War of 1862, the Sioux Uprising, the Dakota Uprising, the Sioux Outbreak of 1862, the Dakota Conflict, or Little Crow's War, was an armed conflict between the United States and several eastern bands of Dakota collectively known as the Santee Sioux. It began on August 18, 1862, when the Dakota, who were facing starvation and displacement, attacked the Lower Sioux Agency and white settlements along the Minnesota River valley in southwest Minnesota. The war lasted for five weeks and resulted in the deaths of hundreds of settlers and the displacement of thousands more. In the aftermath, the Dakota people were exiled from their homelands, forcibly sent to reservations in the Dakotas and Nebraska, and the State of Minnesota confiscated and sold all their remaining land in the state. Thirty-eight Dakota men were subsequently hanged for crimes committed during the conflict in the largest mass execution in US history.

Diaguita.headline: Diaguiti
paragraphs: Diaguiti so domorodno ljudstvo Južne Amerike s čilskega Norte Chico in argentinskega severozahoda. Zahodni ali čilski Diaguiti so živeli predvsem v prečnih dolinah, ki se zajedajo v polsušne gore, vzhodni ali argentinski pa v provincah La Rioja in Catamarca ter v delu provinc Salta, San Juan in Tucumán. Izraz Diaguita je za ljudstva in arheološke kulture v začetku 20. stoletja prvi uporabil Ricardo E. Latcham.

Stari Diaguiti niso bili enotno ljudstvo: njihov jezik ali narečja so se razlikovali od doline do doline, politično pa so bili razdrobljeni na več poglavarstev. Obalni in celinski čilski Diaguiti so med seboj trgovali, o čemer pričajo arheološke najdbe školjčnih lupin v gornjih tokovih andskih dolin.

source.title: Diaguita
paragraphs: The Diaguita people are a South American Indigenous people native to the Chilean Norte Chico and the Argentine Northwest. Western or Chilean Diaguitas lived mainly in the Transverse Valleys that incise semi-arid mountains. Eastern or Argentine Diaguitas lived in the provinces of La Rioja and Catamarca and part of the provinces of Salta, San Juan and Tucumán. The term Diaguita was first applied to peoples and archaeological cultures by Ricardo E. Latcham in the early 20th century.

Ancient Diaguitas were not a unified people; the language or dialects used by them seems to have varied from valley to valley and they were politically fragmented into several chiefdoms. Coastal and inland Chilean Diaguitas traded, as evidenced by the archaeological findings of mollusc shells in the upper courses of Andean valleys.

Kultura Diquís (včasih pisano Diquis) je bila predkolumbovska domorodna kultura Kostarike, ki je cvetela od leta 700 do 1530 n. št. Beseda »diquís« v jeziku boruca pomeni »velike vode« ali »velika reka«. Kultura Diquís je bila del širše kulture Gran Chiriquí, ki je segala od južne Kostarike do zahodne Paname.

source.title: Diquis
paragraphs: The Diquis culture (sometimes spelled Diquís) was a pre-Columbian indigenous culture of Costa Rica that flourished from AD 700 to 1530. The word "diquís" means "great waters" or "great river" in the Boruca language. The Diquis formed part of the Greater Chiriqui culture that spanned from southern Costa Rica to western Panama.

Dominican Civil War.headline: Dominikanska državljanska vojna
paragraphs: Dominikanska državljanska vojna (špansko: Guerra Civil Dominicana), znana tudi kot aprilska revolucija (Revolución de Abril), je potekala med 24. aprilom in 3. septembrom 1965 v Santo Domingu v Dominikanski republiki. Začela se je, ko so civilni in vojaški podporniki strmoglavljenega demokratično izvoljenega predsednika Juana Boscha odstavili predsednika Donalda Reida Cabrala, ki ga je postavila vojska. Drugi udar je generala Elíasa Wessina y Wessina spodbudil, da je zbral dele vojske, zveste diktatorju Reidu (»lojaliste«), in začel oborožen pohod proti »konstitucionalističnim« upornikom.

Trditve, da uporniki uživajo komunistično podporo, so pripeljale do ameriške invazije (s kodnim imenom operacija Power Pack), ki se je pozneje spremenila v zasedbo države, ki jo je Organizacija ameriških držav izvajala z Medameriškimi mirovnimi silami. Čeprav so bili ameriški civilni in vojaški voditelji na videz nevtralni, so čete razporedili tako, da so pomagale Boschevim nasprotnikom.
Leta 1966 je Bosch na predsedniških volitvah izgubil proti Joaquínu Balaguerju. Tuje čete so odšle pozneje istega leta.

source.title: Dominican Civil War
paragraphs: The Dominican Civil War (Spanish: Guerra Civil Dominicana), also known as the April Revolution (Spanish: Revolución de Abril), took place between April 24 and September 3, 1965, in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic. It started when civilian and military supporters of the overthrown democratically elected president Juan Bosch ousted the militarily-installed president Donald Reid Cabral from office. The second coup prompted General Elías Wessin y Wessin to organize elements of the military loyal to the dictator Reid ("loyalists") and launch an armed campaign against the "constitutionalist" rebels.

Allegations of communist support for the rebels led to a United States invasion (codenamed Operation Power Pack), which later became an Organization of American States occupation of the country by the Inter-American Peace Force. Although ostensibly neutral, U.S. civilian and military leaders deployed troops in a way that aided the anti-Bosch forces.
In 1966, Bosch lost the presidential election to Joaquín Balaguer. Foreign troops left later that year.

Dominican Restoration War.headline: Dominikanska restavracijska vojna
paragraphs: Dominikanska restavracijska vojna (špansko: Guerra de la Restauración), v Španiji imenovana vojna za Santo Domingo (Guerra de Santo Domingo), je bila gverilska vojna v letih 1863–1865 v Dominikanski republiki med dominikanskimi nacionalisti in Španijo, ki je državo 17 let po njeni osamosvojitvi znova kolonizirala. Končala se je z umikom španskih sil z otoka.

Vojna se je začela, ko so dominikanske sile s Haitija prestopile mejo in se prebile skozi sovražnikove položaje na severu in v osrednjem delu države. Ko so v Santiagu postavile vlado, so gverilske operacije razširile na jug in vzhod. Obe strani sta skušali zavzeti ključno mesto nasprotnika, Dominikanci Santo Domingo, Španci Santiago, a je bil nadzor sporen vse do španskega umika.

source.title: Dominican Restoration War
paragraphs: The Dominican Restoration War or the Dominican War of Restoration (Spanish: Guerra de la Restauración), called War of Santo Domingo in Spain (Guerra de Santo Domingo), was a guerrilla war between 1863 and 1865 in the Dominican Republic between Dominican nationalists and Spain, the latter of which had recolonized the country 17 years after its independence. It ended with the withdrawal of Spanish forces from the island.

The war began with Dominican forces crossing the border from Haiti and pushing through enemy positions in the north and central regions. After setting up a government in Santiago, they expanded guerrilla operations in the south and east. Both sides sought to take the other's key city: Dominicans aimed for Santo Domingo, Spaniards for Santiago, but control remained contested until the Spanish withdrew.

Dominican War of Independence.headline: Dominikanska osamosvojitvena vojna
paragraphs: Dominikanska osamosvojitvena vojna (špansko: Guerra de Independencia Dominicana) je bila osamosvojitvena vojna, ki se je začela, ko je Dominikanska republika 27. februarja 1844 razglasila neodvisnost od Republike Haiti, in se je končala 24. januarja 1856. Pred vojno je bil otok Hispaniola 22 let združen, saj so leta 1822 na novo neodvisno državo, prej znano kot Generalna kapitanija Santo Domingo, združili z Republiko Haiti. Kreolski sloj v državi je leta 1821 strmoglavil špansko krono, leto pozneje pa se je država združila s Haitijem.

source.title: Dominican War of Independence
paragraphs: The Dominican War of Independence (Spanish: Guerra de Independencia Dominicana) was a war of independence that began when the Dominican Republic declared independence from the Republic of Haiti on February 27, 1844 and ended on January 24, 1856. Before the war, the island of Hispaniola had been united for 22 years when the newly independent nation, previously known as the Captaincy General of Santo Domingo, was unified with the Republic of Haiti in 1822. The criollo class within the country overthrew the Spanish crown in 1821 before unifying with Haiti a year later.

Dorset culture.headline: Kultura Dorset
paragraphs: Dorset je bila paleoeskimska kultura, ki je na severnoameriški Arktiki trajala od leta 500 pr. n. št. do obdobja med letoma 1000 in 1500 n. št.; sledila je kulturi Pre-Dorset, za njo pa so prišli ljudje Thule, predniki Inuitov. Kultura in ljudstvo sta dobila ime po rtu Dorset (danes Kinngait) v Nunavutu v Kanadi, kjer je zahodna znanost odkrila prve otipljive dokaze o njunem obstoju. Kulturo delijo na štiri faze, ker se tehnologije lova in izdelave orodja med njimi jasno razlikujejo. Med najdbami so značilne trikotne konice, oljne svetilke (qulliq) iz milnika in vbadala.

source.title: Dorset culture
paragraphs: The Dorset was a Paleo-Eskimo culture, lasting from 500 BCE to between 1000 CE and 1500 CE, that followed the Pre-Dorset and preceded the Thule people (proto-Inuit) in the North American Arctic. The culture and people are named after Cape Dorset (now Kinngait) in Nunavut, Canada, where the first physical evidence of its existence was found by western science. The culture has been defined as having four phases due to the distinct differences in the technologies relating to hunting and tool making. Artifacts include distinctive triangular end-blades, oil lamps (qulliq) made of soapstone, and burins.

Dummer's War.headline: Dummerjeva vojna
paragraphs: Dummerjeva vojna (1722–1725) je bila vrsta bitk med kolonijami Nove Anglije in konfederacijo Wabanaki (natančneje ljudstvi Mikmak, Wolastoqiyik, Penobscot in Abenaki), ki je bila zaveznica Nove Francije. Vzhodno bojišče vojne je bilo predvsem ob meji med Novo Anglijo, Akadijo in Novo Škotsko, zahodno pa na severu Massachusettsa in v Vermontu, na obmejnih območjih med Novo Francijo in Novo Anglijo.

source.title: Dummer's War
paragraphs: Dummer's War (1722–1725) was a series of battles between the New England Colonies and the Wabanaki Confederacy (specifically the Miꞌkmaq, Wolastoqiyik, Penobscot, and Abenaki), who were allied with New France. The eastern theater of the war was located primarily along the border between New England, Acadia, and Nova Scotia. The western theater was located in northern Massachusetts and Vermont in the frontier areas between New France and New England.

Ecuadorian War of Independence.headline: Ekvadorska osamosvojitvena vojna
paragraphs: Ekvadorska osamosvojitvena vojna, del hispanskoameriških osamosvojitvenih vojn v začetku 19. stoletja, je od leta 1809 do 1822 potekala med Španijo in več južnoameriškimi vojskami za oblast nad Kraljevo avdienco Quito (Real Audiencia de Quito), španskim kolonialnim upravnim območjem, iz katerega je pozneje nastala sodobna Republika Ekvador. Končala se je s porazom španskih sil v bitki pri Pichinchi 24. maja 1822, s katerim so se osamosvojila vsa ozemlja Kraljeve avdience Quito.

source.title: Ecuadorian War of Independence
paragraphs: The Ecuadorian War of Independence, part of the Spanish American wars of independence of the early 19th century, was fought from 1809 to 1822 between Spain and several South American armies over control of the Real Audiencia of Quito, a Spanish colonial jurisdiction which later became the modern Republic of Ecuador. The war ended with the defeat of the Spanish forces at the Battle of Pichincha on May 24, 1822, which brought about the independence of all the lands of the Real Audiencia of Quito.

Ecuadorian–Peruvian War.headline: Ekvadorsko-perujska vojna
paragraphs: Druga ekvadorsko-perujska vojna, navadno imenovana kar ekvadorsko-perujska vojna, doma pa vojna '41 (špansko: Guerra del 41), je bila južnoameriška vojna, ki je potekala od 5. julija do 2. oktobra 1941. Bila je prvi od treh vojaških spopadov med Ekvadorjem in Perujem v 20. stoletju.

Med vojno je Peru zasedel zahodno ekvadorsko provinco El Oro, dele andske province Loja in vse sporno amazonsko ozemlje. Čeprav je vojna potekala med drugo svetovno vojno, s tem spopadom ni bila povezana, saj nobene od držav niso podpirali niti zavezniki niti sile osi.

source.title: Ecuadorian–Peruvian War
paragraphs: The Second Ecuadorian–Peruvian War, usually called simply the Ecuadorian–Peruvian War, and known locally as the War of '41 (Spanish: Guerra del 41), was a South American war fought between 5 July to 2 October of 1941. It was the first of three military conflicts between Ecuador and Peru during the 20th century.

During the war, Peru occupied the western Ecuadorian province of El Oro, parts of the Andean province of Loja and all the Amazon disputed territory. Although the war took place during World War II, it is unrelated to that conflict, as neither country was supported by either the Allies or the Axis.

Brazilsko cesarstvo (portugalsko: Império do Brasil) je bila država 19. stoletja, ki je v grobem obsegala ozemlje današnje Brazilije in Urugvaja, dokler se ta ni leta 1828 osamosvojil. Bilo je predstavniška parlamentarna ustavna monarhija pod vladavino cesarjev Pedra I. in njegovega sina Pedra II.
