Brazilija, kolonija Kraljevine Portugalske, je postala sedež Portugalskega imperija leta 1808, ko je portugalski princ regent in poznejši kralj Ivan VI. pobegnil pred Napoleonovo invazijo na Portugalsko in se z vlado naselil v brazilskem mestu Rio de Janeiro. Ivan VI. se je pozneje vrnil na Portugalsko, Kraljevino Brazilijo pa je kot regentu prepustil svojemu najstarejšemu sinu in dediču Pedru. Pedro je 7. septembra 1822 razglasil neodvisnost Brazilije in bil po uspešni vojni proti očetovemu kraljestvu 12. oktobra razglašen za Pedra I., prvega brazilskega cesarja. Nova država je bila ogromna, redko poseljena in etnično raznolika.

source.title: Empire of Brazil
paragraphs: The Empire of Brazil (Portuguese: Império do Brasil) was a 19th-century state that broadly comprised the territories which form modern Brazil and Uruguay until the latter achieved independence in 1828. The empire's government was a representative parliamentary constitutional monarchy under the rule of Emperors Pedro I and his son Pedro II. A colony of the Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil became the seat of the Portuguese Empire in 1808, when the Portuguese Prince regent, later King Dom John VI, fled from Napoleon's invasion of Portugal and established himself and his government in the Brazilian city of Rio de Janeiro. John VI later returned to Portugal, leaving his eldest son and heir-apparent, Pedro, to rule the Kingdom of Brazil as regent. On 7 September 1822, Pedro declared the independence of Brazil and, after waging a successful war against his father's kingdom, was acclaimed on 12 October as Pedro I, the first Emperor of Brazil. The new country was huge, sparsely populated, and ethnically diverse.

Angleška čezmorska posest, včasih imenovana tudi Angleški imperij, je obsegala različna čezmorska ozemlja in kolonije, ki jih je Kraljevina Anglija osvojila ali kako drugače pridobila pred letom 1707, ko so akti o uniji Anglijo in Kraljevino Škotsko združili v Kraljevino Veliko Britanijo. Škoti so bili prej iz angleških čezmorskih posesti izključeni, po letu 1707 pa so lahko sodelovali v širitvi Britanskega imperija.

source.title: English overseas possessions
paragraphs: The English overseas possessions, sometimes referred to as the English Empire, comprised a variety of overseas territories and colonies that were conquered or otherwise acquired by the Kingdom of England before 1707 when the Acts of Union joined England with the Kingdom of Scotland and created of the Kingdom of Great Britain. Formerly Scots were excluded from English overseas possessions, but following 1707 they could participate in the expanding British Empire.

Epi-Olmec culture.headline: Epiolmeška kultura
paragraphs: Epiolmeška kultura je bila kulturno območje v osrednjem delu današnje mehiške zvezne države Veracruz. Zgoščena je bila v porečju reke Papaloapan in je obstajala v poznem formativnem obdobju, približno od leta 300 pr. n. št. do okoli 250 n. št. Nasledila je olmeško kulturo, od tod predpona »epi-« ali »po-«. Čeprav ni dosegla daljnosežnih dosežkov starejše kulture, je s prefinjenim koledarjem in pisavo dosegla raven kulturne zapletenosti, kakršne Olmeki niso poznali.

Največji epiolmeški središči sta bili Tres Zapotes in pozneje Cerro de las Mesas, a nobeno ni doseglo velikosti in pomena velikih olmeških mest pred njima niti El Tajína za njima. Med drugimi pomembnimi epiolmeškimi najdišči so El Mesón, Lerdo de Tejada, La Mojarra, Bezuapan in Chuniapan de Abajo.

source.title: Epi-Olmec culture
paragraphs: The Epi-Olmec culture was a cultural area in the central region of the present-day Mexican state of Veracruz. Concentrated in the Papaloapan River basin, a culture that existed during the Late Formative period, from roughly 300 BCE to roughly 250 CE. Epi-Olmec was a successor culture to the Olmec, hence the prefix "epi-" or "post-". Although Epi-Olmec did not attain the far-reaching achievements of that earlier culture, it did realize, with its sophisticated calendrics and writing system, a level of cultural complexity unknown to the Olmecs.

Tres Zapotes and eventually Cerro de las Mesas were the largest Epi-Olmec centers though neither would reach the size and importance of the great Olmec cities before them nor El Tajín after them. Other Epi-Olmec sites of note include El Mesón, Lerdo de Tejada, La Mojarra, Bezuapan, and Chuniapan de Abajo.

Upor v Escambrayju je bil oborožen spopad v gorovju Escambray od leta 1959 do 1965, v katerem se je več uporniških skupin bojevalo proti kubanski vladi Fidela Castra. Vojaško operacijo proti uporu je kubanska vlada imenovala boj proti razbojnikom (špansko: Lucha Contra Bandidos, LCB).

Uporniki so bili mešanica nekdanjih vojakov Batistovega režima, krajevnih kmetov in odpadlih nekdanjih gverilcev, ki so se med kubansko revolucijo s Castrom bojevali proti Batisti. Kubanske vladne sile so leta 1965 vse upornike odstranile.

source.title: Escambray rebellion
paragraphs: The Escambray rebellion was an armed conflict from 1959 to 1965 in the Escambray Mountains during which several insurgent groups fought against the Cuban government led by Fidel Castro. The military operation against the rebellion was called the Struggle Against Bandits (Spanish: Lucha Contra Bandidos, or LCB) by the Cuban government.

The rebels were a mix of former soldiers of the Batista regime, local farmers, and turncoat ex-guerrillas who had fought alongside Castro against Batista during the Cuban Revolution. The end result was the elimination of all insurgents by Cuban government forces in 1965.

Escazú Agreement.headline: Sporazum iz Escazúja
paragraphs: Regionalni sporazum o dostopu do informacij, udeležbi javnosti in pravnem varstvu v okoljskih zadevah v Latinski Ameriki in na Karibih, bolj znan kot sporazum iz Escazúja (špansko: Acuerdo de Escazú), je mednarodna pogodba, ki jo je podpisalo 24 latinskoameriških in karibskih držav in zadeva pravico do dostopa do okoljskih informacij, udeležbo javnosti pri okoljskem odločanju, okoljsko pravičnost ter zdravo in trajnostno okolje za sedanje in prihodnje rodove. Sporazum je odprt za 33 držav Latinske Amerike in Karibov. Ratificiralo ga je ali k njemu pristopilo 19 držav: Antigva in Barbuda, Argentina, Belize, Bolivija, Čile, Kolumbija, Dominika, Ekvador, Grenada, Gvajana, Mehika, Nikaragva, Panama, Sveti Vincencij in Grenadine, Sveti Krištof in Nevis, Sveta Lucija, Bahami, Trinidad in Tobago ter Urugvaj.

source.title: Escazú Agreement
paragraphs: The Regional Agreement on Access to Information, Public Participation and Justice in Environmental Matters in Latin America and the Caribbean, better known as the Escazú Agreement (Spanish: Acuerdo de Escazú), is an international treaty signed by 24 Latin American and Caribbean nations concerning the rights of access to information about the environment, public participation in environmental decision-making, environmental justice, and a healthy and sustainable environment for current and future generations. The agreement is open to 33 countries in Latin America and the Caribbean. It has been ratified or acceded by 19 countries: Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Belize, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Dominica, Ecuador, Grenada, Guyana, Mexico, Nicaragua, Panama, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, The Bahamas, Trinidad and Tobago and Uruguay.

Eva site.headline: Najdišče Eva
paragraphs: Najdišče Eva (40BN12) je prazgodovinsko indijansko najdišče v okrožju Benton v Tennesseeju na jugovzhodu Združenih držav. Leži ob starodavni strugi reke Tennessee in je bilo dolgo poseljeno v srednjem in poznem arhaičnem obdobju (ok. 6000–1000 pr. n. št.). Jasno ločene plasti odpadkov so raziskovalcem pomagale prepoznati tri različne arhaične kulture; najstarejšo so prvič opredelili prav na tem najdišču, zato jo še danes imenujejo »kultura Eva« ali »faza Eva«.

Najdišče je danes pod gladino jezera Kentucky, umetnega zbiralnika, ki je nastal, ko so reko Tennessee zajezili z jezom Kentucky. Arheologi Univerze v Tennesseeju so leta 1940, preden so reko zajezili, na najdišču izkopavali in zbrali razmeroma veliko podatkov. Podatke in najdbe sta analizirala antropologa Univerze v Tennesseeju Thomas Lewis in Madeline Kneburg Lewis, ki sta ugotovitve leta 1961 objavila v delu Eva, an Archaic Site (Eva, arhaično najdišče).

source.title: Eva site
paragraphs: The Eva site (40BN12) is a prehistoric Native American site in Benton County, Tennessee, in the Southeastern United States. Located along an ancient channel of the Tennessee River, the Eva site saw extensive periods of occupation during the Middle and Late Archaic period (c. 6000-1000 BC). The site's well-defined midden layers helped investigators identify three distinct Archaic cultures, the oldest of which was first identified at Eva and is still known as the "Eva culture" or the "Eva phase."

The Eva site is now submerged by Kentucky Lake, an artificial reservoir created by the impoundment of the Tennessee River by Kentucky Dam. In 1940, before the Tennessee River was dammed to form Kentucky Lake, University of Tennessee archaeologists conducted excavations at the Eva site and managed to extract a relatively large amount of data. The data and artifacts were analyzed by University of Tennessee anthropologists Thomas Lewis and Madeline Kneburg Lewis, who presented their findings in a 1961 publication entitled Eva, an Archaic Site.

Padec Tenochtitlána, prestolnice Mehikov, je bil pomemben dogodek španske osvojitve Mehikov. Zgodil se je leta 1521 po dolgih pogajanjih med krajevnimi frakcijami in španskim konkvistadorjem Hernánom Cortésom, ki so mu pomagali njegova prevajalka in spremljevalka La Malinche ter na tisoče domorodnih zaveznikov, zlasti tlaškalteških bojevnikov.

Čeprav so se Mehiki s koalicijo pod španskim vodstvom, ki so jo sestavljali predvsem Tlaškaltekci, spopadli v številnih bitkah, je neposredno do padca azteške civilizacije ter ropanja in nasilja nad preživelimi pripeljalo obleganje Tenochtitlána. Domorodno prebivalstvo je tedaj pustošila epidemija črnih koz, ki je pomorila velik del vodstva. Ker so bile črne koze v Španiji stoletja endemične, so Španci razvili pridobljeno odpornost in jih je epidemija razmeroma malo prizadela.
Osvojitev Mehikov je bila ključna stopnja španske kolonizacije Amerik.

source.title: Fall of Tenochtitlan
paragraphs: The fall of Tenochtitlan, the capital of the Mexica, was an important event in the Spanish conquest of the Mexica. It occurred in 1521 following extensive negotiations between local factions and Spanish conquistador Hernán Cortés. He was aided by La Malinche, his interpreter and companion, and by thousands of indigenous allies, especially Tlaxcaltec warriors.

Although numerous battles were fought between the Mexica and the Spanish-led coalition, which was composed mainly of Tlaxcaltec men, it was the siege of Tenochtitlan that directly led to the fall of the Aztec civilization and the ensuing sacking and violence against the survivors. The indigenous population at the time was devastated due to a smallpox epidemic, which killed much of its leadership. Because smallpox had been endemic in Spain for centuries, the Spanish had developed an acquired immunity and were affected relatively little in the epidemic.
The conquest of the Mexica was a critical stage in the Spanish colonization of the Americas.

Federativna zveza (špansko: Liga Federal), znana tudi kot Zveza svobodnih ljudstev (Liga de los Pueblos Libres), je bila kratkotrajna konfederacija provinc v Južni Ameriki. Od leta 1815 do 1820 je skušala vzpostaviti konfederalno ureditev za državo, ki je v vojni za neodvisnost proti Španskemu imperiju nastajala iz majske revolucije na delu današnjega Urugvaja, Argentine in Brazilije.

Ustanovil in vodil jo je José Gervasio Artigas. Leta 1815 je razglasila neodvisnost od španske krone in na kongres v Tucumánu poslala pokrajinske delegate z nespremenljivim ciljem: razglasiti popolno neodvisnost Združenih provinc Río de la Plata in ustanoviti konfederacijo enakopravnih provinc, katerih vlade bi bile neposredno odgovorne svojim ljudstvom po načelih neposredne demokracije. Kongres, ki je 9. julija 1816 razglasil neodvisnost Združenih provinc Južne Amerike, je delegate teh provinc iz formalnih razlogov zavrnil.

source.title: Federal League (1815–1820)
paragraphs: The Federal League (Spanish: Liga Federal), also known as the League of the Free Peoples (Liga de los Pueblos Libres), was a short lived confederation of provinces located in South America. From 1815 to 1820 it tried to establish a confederal organization for the State that was emerging from the May Revolution in the war of independence against the Spanish Empire in part of what is now Uruguay, Argentina and Brazil.

Founded and led by José Gervasio Artigas, it proclaimed independence from the Spanish Crown in 1815 and sent provincial delegates to the Congress of Tucumán with instructions regarding the nonnegotiable objective of declaring full independence for the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata and establishing a confederation of provinces, all of them on equal footing and the government of each being directly accountable to its peoples by direct democratic means of government. The delegates from these provinces were rejected on formalities from the Congress that declared the independence of the United Provinces of South America on July 9, 1816.

Zvezna republika Srednja Amerika (špansko: República Federal de Centro América), sprva znana kot Združene province Srednje Amerike (Provincias Unidas del Centro de América), je bila suverena država v Srednji Ameriki, ki je obstajala od leta 1823 do 1839 oziroma 1841. Sestavljalo jo je pet držav (Kostarika, Salvador, Gvatemala, Honduras in Nikaragva), od leta 1835 do 1839 pa še zvezni okraj. Glavno mesto je bilo do leta 1834 mesto Gvatemala, nato so sedež vlade preselili v San Salvador. Na severu je mejila na Mehiko, na jugu na Veliko Kolumbijo, na vzhodu pa na Kraljestvo Mosquitia in Britanski Honduras, ki si ju je zvezna republika lastila.

source.title: Federal Republic of Central America
paragraphs: The Federal Republic of Central America (Spanish: República Federal de Centro América), initially known as the United Provinces of Central America (Provincias Unidas del Centro de América), was a sovereign state in Central America that existed between 1823 and 1839/1841. The republic was composed of five states (Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, and Nicaragua), and a Federal District from 1835 to 1839. Guatemala City was its capital city until 1834, when the seat of government was relocated to San Salvador. The Federal Republic of Central America was bordered on the north by Mexico, on the south by Gran Colombia and on the east by the Kingdom of Mosquitia and British Honduras, both claimed by the federal republic.

Federal War.headline: Zvezna vojna
paragraphs: Zvezna vojna (špansko: Guerra Federal), znana tudi kot velika vojna ali petletna vojna, je bila državljanska vojna v Venezueli med konservativno in liberalno stranko zaradi monopola konservativcev nad vladnimi položaji in zemljiško posestjo ter njihove nepopustljivosti pri kakršnih koli reformah. Zato so liberalci, imenovani federalisti, iskali večjo samostojnost provinc, nekakšen nov federalizem za Venezuelo. Bila je največja in najbolj krvava državljanska vojna v Venezueli od osamosvojitve izpod Španije 5. julija 1811. V nasilju vojne ter zaradi lakote in bolezni je umrlo okoli sto tisoč ljudi, in to v državi z nekaj več kot milijonom prebivalcev.

Spopad je bil boj za oblast med konservativno vlado predsednika Juliána Castra, ki je marca 1858 odstavil svojega predhodnika Joséja Tadea Monagasa, in liberalno opozicijo pod vodstvom Ezequiela Zamore.

source.title: Federal War
paragraphs: The Federal War (Spanish: Guerra Federal) — also known as the Great War or the 5 Year War — was a civil war in Venezuela between the Conservative Party and the Liberal Party over the monopoly the Conservatives held over government positions and land ownership, and their intransigence in granting any reforms. This drove the Liberals – known as the Federalists – to look for greater autonomy for the provinces: a new federalism for Venezuela, as it were. It was the biggest and bloodiest civil war that Venezuela had since its independence from Spain on 5 July 1811. Around a hundred thousand people died in the violence of the war, or from hunger or disease, in a country with a population of just over a million people.

The conflict was a struggle for power between the conservative government of President Julián Castro, who had ousted his predecessor José Tadeo Monagas in March 1858, and the liberal opposition led by Ezequiel Zamora.

Fenijski juriši so bili vrsta vpadov, ki jih je Fenijsko bratstvo, irska republikanska organizacija s sedežem v Združenih državah, leta 1866 in znova v letih 1870–1871 izvedlo na vojaške utrdbe, carinske postojanke in druge cilje v Kanadi (do leta 1867 imenovani Britanska Severna Amerika). S posameznimi vpadi v Kanado je bratstvo hotelo britansko vlado prisiliti, da se umakne z Irske, a noben ni dosegel svojega cilja.

Oblasti Združenih držav so pripadnike bratstva aretirale in jim zaplenile orožje, a so se širila ugibanja, da so nekateri v ameriški vladi priprave fenijcev prezrli iz jeze, ker je Britanija med ameriško državljansko vojno pomagala Konfederaciji. Fenijski juriši so bili eden od dejavnikov, ki so pripeljali do kanadske konfederacije, saj so se province združile, da bi se zoperstavile grožnji vdorov.

source.title: Fenian raids
paragraphs: The Fenian raids were a series of incursions carried out by the Fenian Brotherhood, an Irish republican organization based in the United States, on military fortifications, customs posts, and other targets in Canada (called British North America until 1867) in 1866, and again from 1870 to 1871. A number of separate incursions by the Fenian Brotherhood into Canada were undertaken to bring pressure on the British government to withdraw from Ireland, although none of these raids achieved their aims.

While authorities in the United States arrested the men and confiscated the arms of the Fenian Brotherhood, there was speculation that some in the U.S. government ignored the preparations undertaken by the Fenians due to anger over British assistance to the Confederacy during the American Civil War. The Fenian raids were one of the factors that led to Canadian Confederation, as the provinces united to face the threat of invasions.

Prva bitka pri Bull Runu, ki so jo konfederacijske sile imenovale prva bitka pri Manassasu, je bila prva velika bitka ameriške državljanske vojne. Potekala je 21. julija 1861 v okrožju Prince William v Virginiji, tik severno od današnjega mesta Manassas in okoli trideset milj zahodno-jugozahodno od Washingtona. Vojska Unije se je počasi razporejala, zato so konfederacijske okrepitve imele čas, da so prispele z vlakom. Vsaka stran je imela okoli 18.000 slabo izurjenih in slabo vodenih vojakov. Bitka se je končala s konfederacijsko zmago, sile Unije pa so se po njej neurejeno umaknile.

source.title: First Battle of Bull Run
paragraphs: The First Battle of Bull Run, called the Battle of First Manassas by Confederate forces, was the first major battle of the American Civil War. The battle was fought on July 21, 1861, in Prince William County, Virginia, just north of what is now the city of Manassas and about thirty miles west-southwest of Washington, D.C. The Union army was slow in positioning themselves, allowing Confederate reinforcements time to arrive by rail. Each side had about 18,000 poorly trained and poorly led troops. The battle was a Confederate victory and was followed by a disorganized post-battle retreat of the Union forces.

First Battle of Kernstown.headline: Prva bitka pri Kernstownu
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Kernstownu je potekala 23. marca 1862 v okrožju Frederick in Winchestru v Virginiji kot uvodna bitka pohoda konfederacijskega generalmajorja Thomasa J. »Stonewalla« Jacksona po dolini Shenandoah med ameriško državljansko vojno.

Jackson je skušal zvezati sile Unije v dolini, ki jim je poveljeval generalmajor Nathaniel P. Banks, in je dobil napačne obveščevalne podatke, da je majhen odred polkovnika Nathana Kimballa ranljiv, v resnici pa je šlo za celotno pehotno divizijo, več kot dvakrat večjo od Jacksonovih sil. Njegov začetni konjeniški napad so odbili, zato ga je hitro okrepil z majhno pehotno brigado. Z drugima dvema brigadama je skušal prek Sandy Ridgea obkoliti desno krilo Unije. Brigada polkovnika Erastusa B. Tylerja je ta manever prestregla, in ko ji je na pomoč prišla Kimballova brigada, so konfederalce pregnali z bojišča. Unija jih ni učinkovito zasledovala.

source.title: First Battle of Kernstown
paragraphs: The First Battle of Kernstown was fought on March 23, 1862, in Frederick County and Winchester, Virginia, the opening battle of Confederate Maj. Gen. Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson's campaign through the Shenandoah Valley during the American Civil War.

Attempting to tie down the Union forces in the Valley, under the overall command of Maj. Gen. Nathaniel P. Banks, Jackson received incorrect intelligence that a small detachment under Col. Nathan Kimball was vulnerable, but it was in fact a full infantry division more than twice the size of Jackson's force. His initial cavalry attack was repelled, and he quickly reinforced it with a small infantry brigade. With his other two brigades, Jackson sought to envelop the Union right by way of Sandy Ridge. But Col. Erastus B. Tyler's brigade countered this movement, and, when Kimball's brigade moved to his assistance, the Confederates were driven from the field. There was no effective Union pursuit.

Prvo haitijsko cesarstvo, uradno Haitijsko cesarstvo (francosko: Empire d'Haïti, haitijsko kreolsko: Anpi an Ayiti), je bila volilna monarhija v Severni Ameriki. Haiti je bil pod francosko oblastjo, dokler ni 1. januarja 1804 razglasil neodvisnosti. Generalni guverner Haitija Jean-Jacques Dessalines je cesarstvo ustanovil 22. septembra 1804: ko so ga generali haitijske revolucionarne vojske razglasili za cesarja, je bil 6. oktobra kronan in privzel ime Jacques I. Ustava z dne 20. maja 1805 je določila ureditev cesarstva in državo razdelila na šest vojaških divizij, katerih poveljniki so bili neposredno odgovorni cesarju ali vrhovnemu poveljniku, ki ga je imenoval cesar. Določila je tudi nasledstvo: krona je bila volilna, vladajoči cesar pa je smel imenovati naslednika. Belcem, razen naturaliziranih Nemcev in Poljakov, je ustava prepovedala imeti lastnino v cesarstvu.

source.title: First Empire of Haiti
paragraphs: The First Empire of Haiti, officially known as the Empire of Haiti (French: Empire d'Haïti; Haitian Creole: Anpi an Ayiti), was an elective monarchy in North America. Haiti was controlled by France before declaring independence on 1 January 1804. The Governor-General of Haiti, Jean-Jacques Dessalines, created the empire on 22 September 1804. After being proclaimed emperor by the Generals of the Haitian Revolution Army, he held his coronation ceremony on 6 October and took the name Jacques I. The constitution of 20 May 1805 set out the way the empire was to be governed, with the country split into six military divisions. The general of each division corresponded directly with the emperor or the general in chief appointed by the emperor. The constitution also set out the succession to the throne, with the crown being elective and the reigning emperor having the power to appoint his successor. The constitution also banned white people, with the exception of naturalised Germans and Poles, from owning property inside the empire.

Mehiško cesarstvo (špansko: Imperio Mexicano) je bila ustavna monarhija in prva neodvisna vlada Mehike. Bilo je edino nekdanje podkraljestvo Španskega imperija, ki je po osamosvojitvi uvedlo monarhijo. Obstajalo je od leta 1821 do 1823 in je bilo ena redkih neodvisnih monarhij novega veka v Amerikah. Da bi ga ločili od poznejšega drugega mehiškega cesarstva (1864–1867) pod cesarjem Maksimilijanom, to obdobje običajno imenujejo prvo mehiško cesarstvo. Vodil ga je nekdanji častnik španske kraljeve vojske Agustín de Iturbide, ki je vladal kot Agustín I.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: First Mexican Empire
paragraphs: The Mexican Empire (Spanish: Imperio Mexicano, pronounced [imˈpeɾjo mexiˈkano] ) was a constitutional monarchy and the first independent government of Mexico. It was also the only former viceroyalty of the Spanish Empire to establish a monarchy after gaining independence. The empire existed from 1821 to 1823, making it one of the few modern-era independent monarchies in the Americas. To distinguish it from the later Second Mexican Empire (1864–1867) under Emperor Maximilian, this historical period is commonly referred to as the First Mexican Empire. The empire was led by former Royal Spanish military officer Agustín de Iturbide, who ruled as Agustín I.

Prva mehiška republika, znana tudi kot prva zvezna republika (špansko: Primera República Federal), je obstajala od leta 1824 do 1835. Bila je zvezna republika, ustanovljena z ustavo iz leta 1824, prvo ustavo neodvisne Mehike, uradno pa se je imenovala Združene mehiške države (Estados Unidos Mexicanos). Končala se je leta 1835, ko so jo konservativci pod vodstvom Antonia Lópeza de Santa Anne preoblikovali v unitarno državo, Centralistično republiko Mehiko.

Republiko je 1. novembra 1823 razglasila vrhovna izvršna oblast, nekaj mesecev po padcu Mehiškega cesarstva, ki mu je vladal cesar Agustín I., nekdanji rojalistični častnik, ki je prestopil na stran upornikov za neodvisnost. Zveza je bila uradno in pravno ustanovljena 4. oktobra 1824, ko je začela veljati zvezna ustava Združenih mehiških držav.

source.title: First Mexican Republic
paragraphs: The First Mexican Republic, known also as the First Federal Republic (Spanish: Primera República Federal), existed from 1824 to 1835. It was a federated republic, established by the Constitution of 1824, the first constitution of independent Mexico, and officially designated the United Mexican States (Spanish: Estados Unidos Mexicanos). It ended in 1835, when conservatives under Antonio López de Santa Anna transformed it into a unitary state, the Centralist Republic of Mexico.

The republic was proclaimed on 1 November 1823 by the Supreme Executive Power, months after the fall of the Mexican Empire ruled by emperor Agustin I, a former royalist military officer-turned-insurgent for independence. The federation was formally and legally established on 4 October 1824, when the Federal Constitution of the United Mexican States came into force.

Prvi izbirni protokol k Mednarodnemu paktu o državljanskih in političnih pravicah je mednarodna pogodba, ki za Mednarodni pakt o državljanskih in političnih pravicah (ICCPR) vzpostavlja mehanizem posamičnih pritožb. Generalna skupščina OZN ga je sprejela 16. decembra 1966, veljati pa je začel 23. marca 1976. Julija 2024 je imel 116 pogodbenic in 35 podpisnic. Tri države, ki so ga ratificirale (Belorusija, Jamajka ter Trinidad in Tobago), so protokol odpovedale.

source.title: First Optional Protocol to the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights
paragraphs: The First Optional Protocol to the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights is an international treaty establishing an individual complaint mechanism for the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR). It was adopted by the UN General Assembly on 16 December 1966, and entered into force on 23 March 1976. As of July 2024, it had 116 state parties and 35 signatories. Three of the ratifying states (Belarus, Jamaica and Trinidad and Tobago) have denounced the protocol.

Španska republika (špansko: República española), v zgodovinopisju imenovana prva španska republika (Primera República española), je bila politična ureditev, ki je v Španiji obstajala od 11. februarja 1873 do 29. decembra 1874.

Republika je nastala po abdikaciji kralja Amadeja 10. februarja 1873, naslednji dan pa jo je razglasila parlamentarna večina radikalcev, republikancev in demokratov. Obdobje so zaznamovale napetosti med federalističnimi in unitarnimi republikanci. Ukinili so obvezno vojaško službo, uredili otroško delo in odpravili suženjstvo v Portoriku. Vlada je podedovala vojno stanje: tretjo karlistično vojno, ki je trajala od leta 1872, in desetletno vojno na Kubi, ki je trajala od leta 1868; leta 1873 se jima je pridružil še kantonalni upor.

source.title: First Spanish Republic
paragraphs: The Spanish Republic (Spanish: República española), historiographically referred to as the First Spanish Republic (Spanish: Primera República española), was the political regime that existed in Spain from 11 February 1873 to 29 December 1874.

The Republic was founded after the abdication of King Amadeo on 10 February 1873. On the next day a republic was proclaimed by a parliamentary majority made up of radicals, republicans and democrats. The period was beset by tensions between federal republicans and unitary republicans. The period also saw the end of compulsory conscription, the regulation of child labor and the abolition of slavery in Puerto Rico. The government inherited a state of war, the so-called Third Carlist War, ongoing since 1872, and the Ten Years' War in Cuba, ongoing since 1868, to which was added the Cantonal Rebellion in 1873.

Football War.headline: Nogometna vojna
paragraphs: Nogometna vojna (špansko: guerra del fútbol), znana tudi kot 100-urna vojna, je bil kratek vojaški spopad med Salvadorjem in Hondurasom leta 1969. Napetosti med državama so sovpadle z izgredi na kvalifikacijski tekmi za svetovno prvenstvo v nogometu leta 1970, od tod vzdevek. Vojna se je začela 14. julija 1969, ko je salvadorska vojska napadla Honduras. Organizacija ameriških držav (OAS) je v noči na 18. julij izpogajala premirje, salvadorske čete pa so se umaknile v začetku avgusta.
Vojna je bila kratka, a je imela za obe državi hude posledice in je bila pomemben dejavnik, ki je desetletje pozneje sprožil salvadorsko državljansko vojno.

source.title: Football War
paragraphs: The Football War (Spanish: guerra del fútbol), also known as the Soccer War or the 100 Hour War, was a brief military conflict fought between El Salvador and Honduras in 1969. Existing tensions between the two countries coincided with rioting during a 1970 FIFA World Cup qualifier, hence its nickname. The war began on 14 July 1969 when the Salvadoran military launched an attack against Honduras. The Organization of American States (OAS) negotiated a cease-fire on the night of 18 July. Salvadoran troops were withdrawn in early August.
The war, while brief, had major consequences for both countries and was a major factor in starting the Salvadoran Civil War a decade later.

Fort Ancient.headline: Kultura Fort Ancient
paragraphs: Kultura Fort Ancient je indijanska arheološka kultura, ki sega v obdobje ok. 1000–1750 n. št. Njeni pripadniki so živeli v dolini reke Ohio, na območju od današnjega Ohia in zahodne Zahodne Virginije do severnega Kentuckyja in delov jugovzhodne Indiane. Obstajala je hkrati s sosednjo misisipijsko kulturo, a velja za ločeno »sestrsko kulturo«. Dokazi iz mitohondrijske DNK, zbrani na tem območju, kažejo, da kultura Fort Ancient ne izhaja neposredno iz starejše hopewellske kulture.

Materialni dokazi kažejo tudi, da so ljudstva Fort Ancient v Ohio prinesla gojenje koruze, drugi dokazi pa to kulturo povezujejo z Veliko kačjo gomilo (Great Serpent Mound). Leta 1999 sta Brad Lepper in Tod A. Frolking z radiokarbonskim datiranjem pokazala, da je tudi Aligatorjeva gomila v Granvillu iz obdobja Fort Ancient, ne iz domnevnega hopewellskega. Za obe gomili, kačjo in aligatorjevo, so sprva menili, da sta grobišči, izkazalo pa se je, da sta obredni podobi ljudstev Fort Ancient.

source.title: Fort Ancient
paragraphs: The Fort Ancient culture is a Native American archaeological culture that dates back to c. 1000–1750 CE. Members of the culture lived along the Ohio River valley, in an area running from modern-day Ohio and western West Virginia through to northern Kentucky and parts of southeastern Indiana. A contemporary of the neighboring Mississippian culture, Fort Ancient is considered to be a separate "sister culture". Mitochondrial DNA evidence collected from the area suggests that the Fort Ancient culture did not directly descend from the older Hopewell Culture.

Material evidence also suggests that the Fort Ancient peoples introduced maize agriculture to Ohio, and other evidence connects this culture to the Great Serpent Mound. In 1999, an archaeological study by Brad Lepper and Tod A. Frolking used radiocarbon testing to show that the Alligator Effigy Mound in Granville also dates to the Fort Ancient era, rather than the assumed Hopewell era. Both the Serpent and Alligator Mounds, first understood as burial locations, have been shown to be Fort Ancient ceremonial effigy sites.

Fort Walton culture.headline: Kultura Fort Walton
paragraphs: Kultura Fort Walton je izraz, s katerim arheologi označujejo poznoprazgodovinsko indijansko arheološko kulturo, ki je približno od leta 1200 do 1500 n. št. cvetela na jugovzhodu Severne Amerike in jo povezujejo z zgodovinskim ljudstvom Apalachee.

source.title: Fort Walton culture
paragraphs: The Fort Walton culture is the term used by archaeologists for a late prehistoric Native American archaeological culture that flourished in southeastern North America from approximately 1200~1500 CE and is associated with the historic Apalachee people.

France Antarctique.headline: Antarktična Francija
paragraphs: Antarktična Francija (francosko: France Antarctique, pisano tudi France antartique) je bila francoska kolonija v Riu de Janeiru v današnji Braziliji, ki je obstajala med letoma 1555 in 1567 in je nadzorovala obalo od Ria de Janeira do Cabo Fria. Kolonija je hitro postala zatočišče hugenotov, leta 1567 pa so jo Portugalci uničili.

source.title: France Antarctique
paragraphs: France Antarctique (also spelled France antartique) was a French colony in Rio de Janeiro, in modern-day Brazil, which existed between 1555 and 1567, and had control over the coast from Rio de Janeiro to Cabo Frio. The colony quickly became a haven for Huguenots, and was ultimately destroyed by the Portuguese in 1567.

Fremont culture.headline: Kultura Fremont
paragraphs: Kultura Fremont ali ljudstvo Fremont je predkolumbovska arheološka kultura, imenovana po reki Fremont v Utahu, kjer so njena najdišča odkrila tamkajšnja domorodna ljudstva, kot sta Navahi in Juti. V navaški kulturi slikarije na skalah pripisujejo ljudem, ki so živeli pred potopom. Reka Fremont je dobila ime po ameriškem raziskovalcu Johnu C. Frémontu. Ljudstvo je od leta 1 do 1301 n. št. (pred 2000–700 leti) poseljevalo območja današnjega Utaha ter delov Nevade, Idaha, Wyominga in Kolorada. Mejilo je na ljudstva prednikov Pueblov južno od sebe in živelo približno ob istem času, a se je od njih jasno razlikovalo.

source.title: Fremont culture
paragraphs: The Fremont culture or Fremont people is a pre-Columbian archaeological culture named after the Fremont River in Utah, where the culture's sites were discovered by local indigenous peoples like the Navajo and Ute. In Navajo culture, the pictographs are credited to people who lived before the flood. The Fremont River itself is named for American explorer John C. Frémont. It inhabited sites in what is now Utah and parts of Nevada, Idaho, Wyoming and Colorado from AD 1 to 1301 (2,000–700 years ago). It was adjacent to, roughly contemporaneous with, but distinctly different from the Ancestral Pueblo peoples located to their south.

French Louisiana.headline: Francoska Louisiana
paragraphs: Izraz Francoska Louisiana (francosko: Louisiane française, v louisianski kreolščini: Lwizyàn françé) označuje dve različni zgodovinski pokrajini:
prvič zgodovinsko Francosko Louisiano, obsežni osrednji del Severne Amerike, ki si ga je Francija lastila v 17. in 18. stoletju,
in drugič sodobno Francosko Louisiano, ki se razteza čez južno tretjino današnje zvezne države Louisiana in jo imenujejo tudi Akadija, dežela Cajunov ali kreolska dežela.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: French Louisiana
paragraphs: The term French Louisiana (French: Louisiane française [lwizjan fʁɑ̃sɛːz]; Louisiana Creole: Lwizyàn françé) refers to two distinct, historical regions:
First, to historic French Louisiana, comprising the massive, middle section of North America claimed by France during the 17th and 18th centuries; and,
Second, to modern French Louisiana, which stretches across the southern third of the present-day State of Louisiana, also called Acadia, Cajun Country, or Creole Country.

Gadsden Purchase.headline: Gadsdenov nakup
paragraphs: Gadsdenov nakup (špansko: Venta de La Mesilla, dobesedno »prodaja La Mesille«), znan tudi kot pogodba iz Mesille, je nakup 76.800 km² velikega ozemlja današnje južne Arizone in jugozahodne Nove Mehike, ki so ga Združene države pridobile od Mehike. Prvi osnutek sta 31. decembra 1853 podpisala ameriški poslanik v Mehiki James Gadsden in mehiški predsednik Antonio López de Santa Anna. Pogodba je začela veljati 8. junija 1854.

Nakup je obsegal zemljo južno od reke Gila in zahodno od Ria Grande, kjer so Združene države hotele zgraditi današnjo progo Sunset Route, čezcelinsko železnico, ki jo je družba Southern Pacific Railroad pozneje dokončala v letih 1881–1883. Na tem ozemlju je lahko proga potekala po bolj ravni in neposredni poti, kar je znižalo pričakovane stroške, omogočilo hitrejšo gradnjo in zlasti spodbudilo traso do južnega pristanišča. Nakup je tudi jasno določil sedanjo mejo med Mehiko in Združenimi državami.

source.title: Gadsden Purchase
paragraphs: The Gadsden Purchase (Spanish: Venta de La Mesilla, lit. 'La Mesilla sale'), also known as the Treaty of Mesilla, is the acquisition of a 29,640-square-mile (76,800 km2) region of present-day southern Arizona and southwestern New Mexico by the United States from Mexico. The first draft was signed on December 31, 1853, by James Gadsden, US Minister to Mexico, and by Antonio López de Santa Anna, president of Mexico. The treaty took effect on June 8, 1854.

The purchase included lands south of the Gila River and west of the Rio Grande, where the United States wanted to build what is now known as the Sunset Route, a transcontinental railroad which the Southern Pacific Railroad later completed in 1881–1883. These lands allowed the railroad to follow a flatter and more direct route, lowering its anticipated costs and allowing faster completion, and particularly encouraging a route to a southern port. The purchase also clearly defined the current Mexico–United States border.

Gettysburg campaign.headline: Kampanja za Gettysburg
paragraphs: Kampanja za Gettysburg je bil vojaški vdor glavne konfederacijske vojske pod poveljstvom generala Roberta E. Leeja v Pensilvanijo poleti 1863. Konfederacijska vojska je takrat prvič v vojni poskusila izvesti obsežen vdor v svobodno zvezno državo. Unija je od 1. do 3. julija pri Gettysburgu odločilno zmagala, z velikimi izgubami na obeh straneh. Lee se je z večino vojske uspel umakniti nazaj v Virginijo. Kampanja je bila prelomnica ameriške državljanske vojne: Leeja so odtlej vse bolj potiskali proti Richmondu, dokler se ni aprila 1865 vdal. Potomaški armadi Unije je poveljeval generalmajor Joseph Hooker, nato (od 28. junija) pa generalmajor George Meade.

source.title: Gettysburg campaign
paragraphs: The Gettysburg campaign was a military invasion of Pennsylvania by the main Confederate army under General Robert E. Lee in summer 1863. It was the first time during the war the Confederate Army attempted a full-scale invasion of a free state. The Union won a decisive victory at Gettysburg, July 1–3, with heavy casualties on both sides. Lee managed to escape back to Virginia with most of his army. It was a turning point in the American Civil War, with Lee increasingly pushed back toward Richmond until his surrender in April 1865. The Union Army of the Potomac was commanded by Maj. Gen. Joseph Hooker and then (from June 28) by Maj. Gen. George Meade.

Glacial Kame culture.headline: Kultura Glacial Kame
paragraphs: Kultura Glacial Kame je bila kultura arhaičnih ljudstev Severne Amerike, ki je od okoli leta 8000 do 1000 pr. n. št. poseljevala južni Ontario, Michigan, Ohio in Indiano. Ime je dobila po navadi, da so mrtve pokopavali na vrhovih prodnatih gričev, ki jih je odložil ledenik (kame). Med najpogostejšimi najdbami na njenih najdiščih so lupine morskih živali in izdelki iz samorodnega bakra (float copper).

source.title: Glacial Kame culture
paragraphs: The Glacial Kame culture was a culture of Archaic people in North America that occupied southern Ontario, Michigan, Ohio, and Indiana from around 8000 BC to 1000 BC. The name of this culture derives from its members' practice of burying their dead atop glacier-deposited gravel hills. Among the most common types of artifacts found at Glacial Kame sites are shells of marine animals and goods manufactured from a copper ore, known as float copper.

Gran Coclé.headline: Gran Coclé
paragraphs: Gran Coclé je arheološko kulturno območje na jugu predkolumbovske Srednje Amerike. Prej so ga imenovali Spodnja Srednja Amerika ali vmesno območje, a ta izraza danes veljata za zastarela. Območje se v glavnem ujema z današnjo panamsko provinco Coclé in je obsegalo več prepoznavnih domorodnih kultur, ki so jih arheologi okvirno razmejili po slogu lončenine. Slabo raziskano obdobje La Mula je trajalo od leta 150 pr. n. št. do leta 300 n. št., sledili sta mu obdobje Tonosí od leta 300 do 550 in obdobje Cubitá od leta 550 do 700. Na tem območju je približno od leta 1200 pr. n. št. do 16. stoletja očitno cvetela enotna domorodna kultura.

source.title: Gran Coclé
paragraphs: Gran Coclé is an archaeological culture area in the south of in pre-Columbian Central America. This area used to be referred to as Lower Central America or the Intermediate Area, but these terms are now seen as out-dated. The area largely coincides with the modern-day Panamanian province of Coclé, and consisted of a number of identifiable native cultures. Archaeologists have loosely designated these cultures by pottery style. The poorly studied La Mula period ranged from 150 BC to AD 300. It was followed by the Tonosi period, from AD 300 to AD 550, and by the Cubita period, from AD 550 to AD 700. A unified Native American culture appears to have flourished in this area from approximately 1200 BC until the 16th century.

Gran Colombia–Peru War.headline: Velikokolumbijsko-perujska vojna
paragraphs: Velikokolumbijsko-perujska vojna (špansko: Guerra grancolombo-peruana) v letih 1828 in 1829 je bil prvi mednarodni spopad Republike Peru, ki se je leta 1821 osamosvojila od Španije, in Velike Kolumbije, ki je obstajala med letoma 1819 in 1830.

source.title: Gran Colombia–Peru War
paragraphs: The Gran Colombian–Peruvian War (Spanish: Guerra grancolombo-peruana) of 1828 and 1829 was the first international conflict fought by the Republic of Peru, which had gained its independence from Spain in 1821, and Gran Colombia, that existed between 1819 and 1830.

Granadska konfederacija (špansko: Confederación Granadina) je bila kratkotrajna zvezna republika, ustanovljena leta 1858 z ustavno spremembo, ki je nadomestila Republiko Novo Granado. Obsegala je današnji državi Kolumbijo in Panamo ter dele severozahodne Brazilije. Po novi ustavni spremembi leta 1863 so jo nadomestile Združene države Kolumbije.

source.title: Granadine Confederation
paragraphs: The Granadine Confederation (Spanish: Confederación Granadina) was a short-lived federal republic established in 1858 as a result of a constitutional change replacing the Republic of New Granada. It consisted of the present-day nations of Colombia and Panama and parts of northwestern Brazil. In turn, the Granadine Confederation was replaced by the United States of Colombia after another constitutional change in 1863.

Grattanski poboj, imenovan tudi Grattanov spopad, je bil uvodni spopad prve siujske vojne, ki se je 19. avgusta 1854 zgodil med vojsko Združenih držav in lakotskimi siujskimi bojevniki. Dogodek se je zgodil vzhodno od utrdbe Fort Laramie na tedanjem ozemlju Nebraska, danes v okrožju Goshen v Wyomingu.

Majhen oddelek vojakov je vstopil v velik siujski tabor, da bi prijel moža, obtoženega, da je ubil naseljenčevo kravo, čeprav bi moral take zadeve po pogodbah reševati ameriški indijanski agent. Ko je eden od vojakov smrtno ustrelil poglavarja Matȟó Wayúhija (Zmagovitega medveda), so Lakote Sičangu ogenj vrnili in ubili 29 vojakov, med njimi poročnika Johna Grattana in civilnega tolmača.

source.title: Grattan massacre
paragraphs: The Grattan massacre, also referred to as the Grattan Fight, was the initial conflict of the First Sioux War, occurring on August 19, 1854, between the United States Army and the Lakota Sioux warriors. This event took place east of Fort Laramie, located in the Nebraska Territory, which is now part of Goshen County, Wyoming.

A small contingent of soldiers entered a large Sioux camp to apprehend an individual accused of killing a settler's cow, despite the fact that such issues were supposed to be resolved by the US Indian agent according to treaty agreements. After one of the soldiers fatally shot Chief Matȟó Wayúhi (Conquering Bear), the Sichangu Lakotas returned fire, resulting in the deaths of 29 soldiers, including Lieutenant John Grattan and a civilian interpreter.

Great Peace of Montreal.headline: Veliki mir v Montrealu
paragraphs: Veliki mir v Montrealu (francosko: La Grande paix de Montréal) je bila mirovna pogodba med Novo Francijo in 39 prvimi narodi Severne Amerike, ki je končala bobrove vojne. Podpisali so jo 4. avgusta 1701 guverner Nove Francije Louis-Hector de Callière in 1300 predstavnikov 39 domorodnih narodov.

Francozi, zavezniki Huronov in Algonkinov, so posredovali pri mirovnem sporazumu med svojimi zavezniki in šestimi narodi Haudenosaunee, navzočih pa je bilo več kot 1300 staroselcev, ki so zastopali več kot 40 narodov. Mir pa je bil krhek: vsesplošna vojna sicer ni izbruhnila, a so že v treh letih Odave napadli vas Haudenosaunee blizu francoske utrdbe na mestu današnjega Kingstona v Ontariu. Bojevniki so ob mrtvem bojevniku Haudenosaunee pustili huronski bojni kij, da bi izzvali nove boje.

Mir včasih imenujejo tudi velika poravnava leta 1701 (Grand Settlement), ki je ne gre zamenjevati z nepovezanim angleškim zakonom o nasledstvu iz leta 1701 (Act of Settlement). Pogosto mu pravijo tudi La Paix des Braves, »mir pogumnih«.

source.title: Great Peace of Montreal
paragraphs: The Great Peace of Montreal (French: La Grande paix de Montréal) was a peace treaty between New France and 39 First Nations of North America that ended the Beaver Wars. It was signed on August 4, 1701, by Louis-Hector de Callière, governor of New France, and 1300 representatives of 39 Indigenous nations.

The French, allied to the Hurons and the Algonquins, brokered a peace agreement between their allies and the Six Nations of the Haudenosaunee, with over 1,300 Native Americans present, representing over 40 nations. The peace was fragile, however; although all-out war did not break out, within only three years the Odawa attacked a Haudenosaunee village near a French fort in present-day Kingston, Ontario. The warriors planted a Huron club on a dead Haudenosaunee warrior to try to provoke new fighting.

This has sometimes been called the Grand Settlement of 1701, not to be confused with the unrelated Act of Settlement 1701 in England. It has often been referred to as La Paix des Braves, meaning "The Peace of the Braves".

Velika sjujska vojna leta 1876, znana tudi kot vojna za Črne hribe, je bila vrsta bitk in pogajanj v letih 1876 in 1877, v katerih se je zavezništvo lakotskih Siujev in severnih Šajenov spopadlo z Združenimi državami. Vzrok vojne je bila želja ameriške vlade, da bi si prisvojila Črne hribe. V njih so odkrili zlato, naseljenci so začeli vdirati na indijansko zemljo, Siuji in Šajeni pa se lastništvu niso hoteli odpovedati. Ameriška vojska in zgodovinarji v središče zgodbe tradicionalno postavljajo Lakote, predvsem zaradi njihovega števila, nekateri ameriški staroselci pa menijo, da so bili glavna tarča ameriškega pohoda Šajeni.
notes: The record's name follows the glossary (sjujska); elsewhere the people are Siuji, adjective siujski.

source.title: Great Sioux War of 1876
paragraphs: The Great Sioux War of 1876, also known as the Black Hills War, was a series of battles and negotiations that occurred in 1876 and 1877 in an alliance of Lakota Sioux and Northern Cheyenne against the United States. The cause of the war was the desire of the US government to obtain ownership of the Black Hills. Gold had been discovered in the Black Hills, settlers began to encroach onto Native American lands, and the Sioux and the Cheyenne refused to cede ownership. Traditionally, American military and historians place the Lakota at the center of the story, especially because of their numbers, but some Native Americans believe the Cheyenne were the primary target of the American campaign.

Grito de Dolores.headline: Krik iz Doloresa
paragraphs: Krik iz Doloresa (špansko: Grito de Dolores) je odjeknil 16. septembra 1810 v Doloresu v Mehiki, ko je rimskokatoliški duhovnik Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla pozvonil s cerkvenim zvonom in pozval k orožju, kar je sprožilo mehiško osamosvojitveno vojno. Domačini ga najpogosteje imenujejo El Grito de Independencia (»krik neodvisnosti«).

Vsako leto na predvečer dneva neodvisnosti mehiški predsednik krik ponovi z balkona Narodne palače v Ciudad de Méxicu in pri tem zvoni z istim zvonom, ki ga je leta 1810 uporabil Hidalgo. V domoljubnem govoru predsednik pokliče imena junakov, ki so padli v osamosvojitveni vojni, govor pa sklene s trikratnim vzklikom »¡Viva México!«, ki mu sledi mehiška državna himna.

source.title: Grito de Dolores
paragraphs: The Cry of Dolores (Spanish: Grito de Dolores) occurred in Dolores, Mexico, on 16 September 1810, when Roman Catholic priest Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla rang his church bell and gave the call to arms that triggered the Mexican War of Independence. The Cry of Dolores is most commonly known by the locals as El Grito de Independencia (The Independence Cry).

Every year on the eve of Independence Day, the president of Mexico re-enacts the cry from the balcony of the National Palace in Mexico City while ringing the same bell Hidalgo used in 1810. During the patriotic speech, the president calls out the names of the fallen heroes who died during the War of Independence and ends the speech by shouting "¡Viva México!" three times, followed by the Mexican National Anthem.

Guaraní War.headline: Gvaranijska vojna
paragraphs: Gvaranijska vojna (špansko in portugalsko: Guerra Guaranítica) leta 1756, imenovana tudi vojna sedmih redukcij, je potekala med gvaranijskimi plemeni sedmih jezuitskih misijonov in združenimi špansko-portugalskimi silami. Bila je posledica madridske pogodbe iz leta 1750, ki je določila razmejitveno črto med španskim in portugalskim kolonialnim ozemljem v Južni Ameriki.

Meja med državama je potekala po reki Urugvaj, zemlja vzhodno od reke pa je pripadla Portugalski. Sedem jezuitskih misijonov vzhodno od reke, znanih kot Misiones Orientales, naj bi razpustili in preselili na špansko, zahodno stran reke. Misijoni so se imenovali San Miguel, Santo Ángel, San Lorenzo Martir, San Nicolás, San Juan Bautista, San Luis Gonzaga in San Francisco de Borja. Bili so med najštevilčnejšimi v Južni Ameriki: po jezuitskem popisu je v njih živelo 26.362 prebivalcev, v okolici pa še veliko več.

source.title: Guaraní War
paragraphs: The Guaraní War (Spanish: Guerra Guaranítica, Portuguese: Guerra Guaranítica; literally, Guaranitic War) of 1756, also called the War of the Seven Reductions, took place between the Guaraní tribes of seven Jesuit Missions and joint Spanish-Portuguese forces. It was a result of the 1750 Treaty of Madrid, which set a line of demarcation between Spanish and Portuguese colonial territory in South America.

The boundary drawn up between the two nations was the Uruguay River, with Portugal possessing the land east of the river. The seven Jesuit missions east of the Uruguay River, known as the Misiones Orientales, were to be dismantled and relocated on the Spanish western side of the river. The seven missions were called San Miguel, Santo Ángel, San Lorenzo Martir, San Nicolás, San Juan Bautista, San Luis Gonzaga, and San Francisco de Borja. These missions were some of the most populous in South America with 26,362 inhabitants, according to a Jesuit census, and many more in the surrounding areas.

Gvatemalska državljanska vojna (špansko: Guerra civil de Guatemala) je od leta 1960 do 1996 potekala med gvatemalsko vlado in različnimi levičarskimi uporniškimi skupinami. Gvatemalske vladne sile so med vojno zagrešile genocid nad majevskim prebivalstvom, kršitve človekovih pravic civilistov pa so bile razširjene. Spopad je izhajal iz dolgotrajnih sporov o razdelitvi zemlje. Bogati Gvatemalci, večinoma evropskega porekla, in tuje družbe, kot je ameriška United Fruit Company, so imeli v rokah velik del zemlje, kar je vodilo v spore s podeželskimi kmeti, ki so zemljo obdelovali in so bili nesorazmerno pogosto domorodci.

Demokratične volitve v letih 1944 in 1951, med gvatemalsko revolucijo, so na oblast pripeljale priljubljene levičarske vlade, ki so skušale izboljšati delovne razmere in izvesti razdelitev zemlje. Državni udar leta 1954, ki so ga podprle Združene države, je na oblast postavil vojaški režim Carlosa Castilla Armasa, da bi preprečil reforme. Armasu je sledila vrsta desničarskih vojaških diktatorjev.

source.title: Guatemalan Civil War
paragraphs: The Guatemalan Civil War (Spanish: Guerra civil de Guatemala) was fought from 1960 to 1996 between the government of Guatemala and various leftist rebel groups. The Guatemalan government forces committed genocide against the Maya population of Guatemala during the civil war and there were widespread human rights violations against civilians. The context of the struggle was based on longstanding issues over land distribution. Wealthy Guatemalans, mainly of European descent, and foreign companies like the American United Fruit Company had control over much of the land leading to conflicts with the rural, disproportionately indigenous, peasants who worked the land.

Democratic elections in 1944 and 1951 which were during the Guatemalan Revolution had brought popular leftist governments to power, who sought to ameliorate working conditions and implement land distribution. A United States-backed coup d'état in 1954 installed the military regime of Carlos Castillo Armas to prevent reform. Armas was followed by a series of right-wing military dictators.

Obdobje gvatemalske zgodovine med udaroma proti Jorgeju Ubicu leta 1944 in Jacobu Árbenzu leta 1954 domačini imenujejo revolucija (špansko: La Revolución). Imenujejo ga tudi deset let pomladi, s čimer poudarjajo vrhunec predstavniške demokracije v Gvatemali v obdobju od leta 1944 do konca državljanske vojne leta 1996. Tedaj so izvedli družbene, politične in zlasti agrarne reforme, ki so vplivale na vso Latinsko Ameriko.

Od konca 19. stoletja do leta 1944 je Gvatemali vladala vrsta avtoritarnih vladarjev, ki so skušali gospodarstvo okrepiti s podporo izvozu kave. Manuel Estrada Cabrera je med letoma 1898 in 1920 ameriški družbi United Fruit Company, ki je trgovala s tropskim sadjem, podelil obsežne koncesije, mnogim domorodcem pa odvzel skupno zemljo. Pod Jorgejem Ubicom, ki je kot diktator vladal med letoma 1931 in 1944, se je ta proces okrepil, uvedli so stroge delovne predpise in policijsko državo.

source.title: Guatemalan Revolution
paragraphs: The period in the history of Guatemala between the coups against Jorge Ubico in 1944 and Jacobo Árbenz in 1954 is known locally as the Revolution (Spanish: La Revolución). It has also been called the Ten Years of Spring, highlighting the peak years of representative democracy in Guatemala from 1944 until the end of the civil war in 1996. It saw the implementation of social, political, and especially agrarian reforms that were influential across Latin America.

From the late 19th century until 1944, Guatemala was governed by a series of authoritarian rulers who sought to strengthen the economy by supporting the export of coffee. Between 1898 and 1920, Manuel Estrada Cabrera granted significant concessions to the United Fruit Company, an American corporation which traded in tropical fruit, and dispossessed many indigenous people of their communal lands. Under Jorge Ubico, who ruled as a dictator between 1931 and 1944, this process was intensified, with the institution of harsh labor regulations and a police state.

Haitian independence debt.headline: Haitijski osamosvojitveni dolg
paragraphs: Haitijski osamosvojitveni dolg (francosko: Dette d'Indépendance Haïtienne) izhaja iz sporazuma med Haitijem in Francijo iz leta 1825, s katerim je Francija v zameno za diplomatsko priznanje od Haitija zahtevala odškodnino 150 milijonov frankov v petih letnih obrokih po 30 milijonov za premoženje, izgubljeno med haitijsko revolucijo, vključno s haitijskimi sužnji. Haiti je moral za prvih 30 milijonov najeti posojilo, leta 1838 pa je Francija privolila, da preostali dolg zmanjša na 60 milijonov, plačljivih v 30 letih; zadnji obrok je bil plačan leta 1883. Po analizi časnika The New York Times iz leta 2022 pa je bil zaradi drugih posojil, najetih za odplačilo tega posojila, zadnji obrok upnikom dejansko plačan šele leta 1947. Ocenili so, da je bilo za odškodnino dejansko plačanih 112 milijonov frankov, kar po upoštevanju inflacije ustreza 560 milijonom dolarjev leta 2022.

source.title: Haitian independence debt
paragraphs: The Haitian independence debt (French: Dette d'Indépendance Haïtienne) involves an 1825 agreement between Haiti and France that included France demanding an indemnity of 150 million francs in five annual payments of 30 million to be paid by Haiti in claims over property, including Haitian slaves, that was lost through the Haitian Revolution in return for diplomatic recognition. Haiti was forced to take a loan for the first 30 million, and in 1838 France agreed to reduce the remaining debt to 60 million to be paid over 30 years, with the final payment paid in 1883. However, according to a 2022 The New York Times analysis, because of other loans taken to pay off this loan, the final payment to debtors was actually made in 1947. They approximated that 112 million francs was actually paid in indemnity, which is equivalent to $560 million in 2022 after adjusting for inflation.

Haitijska revolucija, znana tudi kot haitijska osamosvojitvena vojna, je bila oborožen spopad in vstaja zasužnjenih temnopoltih Afričanov proti francoski kolonialni oblasti v Saint-Domingueu, današnji suvereni državi Haiti. Revolucija je eden redkih znanih uporov sužnjev v zgodovini človeštva, ki je pripeljal do ustanovitve države, ki je bila hkrati brez suženjstva (ne pa brez prisilnega dela) in so ji vladali nekdanji zasužnjeni ujetniki.

source.title: Haitian Revolution
paragraphs: The Haitian Revolution, also known as the Haitian War of Independence, was an armed conflict and insurrection by enslaved Black Africans against French colonial rule in Saint-Domingue, now the sovereign state of Haiti. The revolution is one of the only known slave rebellions in human history that led to the founding of a state which was both free from slavery (though not from forced labour) and ruled by former enslaved captives.

Hay–Bunau-Varilla Treaty.headline: Pogodba Hay–Bunau-Varilla
paragraphs: Pogodba Hay–Bunau-Varilla (špansko: Tratado Hay-Bunau Varilla) je pogodba, ki sta jo 18. novembra 1903 podpisali Združene države in Panama in s katero sta ustanovili območje Panamskega prekopa ter omogočili poznejšo gradnjo Panamskega prekopa. Ime je dobila po glavnih pogajalcih, francoskem diplomatskem predstavniku Paname Philippu-Jeanu Bunau-Varilli in ameriškem zunanjem ministru Johnu Hayu.

source.title: Hay–Bunau-Varilla Treaty
paragraphs: The Hay–Bunau-Varilla Treaty (Spanish: Tratado Hay-Bunau Varilla) was a treaty signed on November 18, 1903, by the United States and Panama, which established the Panama Canal Zone and the subsequent construction of the Panama Canal. It was named after its two primary negotiators, Philippe-Jean Bunau-Varilla, the French diplomatic representative of Panama, and United States secretary of state John Hay.

Hay–Herrán Treaty.headline: Pogodba Hay–Herrán
paragraphs: Pogodba Hay–Herrán je pogodba, ki sta jo 22. januarja 1903 podpisala ameriški zunanji minister John M. Hay in kolumbijski diplomat Tomás Herrán. Če bi jo ratificirali, bi Združene države za 10 milijonov dolarjev in letno plačilo 250.000 dolarjev, oboje v zlatnikih, dobile v podaljšljiv 100-letni najem šest milj širok pas čez Panamsko ožino (tedaj del Kolumbije). Senat Združenih držav jo je ratificiral 14. marca, kolumbijski senat pa ne, zato ni začela veljati.

Poznejši opazovalci menijo, da se je to zgodilo predvsem zato, ker je Herrán pogodbo izpogajal skoraj brez nadzora vlade ali zakonodajalca. Omenjajo tudi, da se je mnogim politikom in kongresnikom ponujeni znesek zdel prenizek, saj so bile Združene države pripravljene za Novo družbo Panamskega prekopa z gradbeno opremo in izkopi plačati 40 milijonov dolarjev.

source.title: Hay–Herrán Treaty
paragraphs: The Hay–Herrán Treaty was a treaty signed on January 22, 1903, between United States Secretary of State John M. Hay and the diplomat Tomás Herrán of Colombia. Had it been ratified, it would have allowed the United States a renewable lease of 100 years on a six-mile-wide strip across the isthmus of Panama (then part of Colombia) for $10 million and an annual payment of $250,000, both payments being in gold coin. It was ratified by the United States Senate on March 14, but it was not ratified by the Senate of Colombia, so it had no effect.

It has been considered by later observers that this happened mainly because Herrán had negotiated the treaty with little government or legislative oversight. It has also been mentioned that many of the politicians and congressmen found the amount offered to fall short, considering that the United States was willing to pay $40 million for the New Panama Canal Company and its construction equipment and excavations.

High Seas Treaty.headline: Pogodba o odprtem morju
paragraphs: Sporazum v okviru Konvencije Združenih narodov o pomorskem mednarodnem pravu o ohranjanju in trajnostni rabi morske biološke raznovrstnosti na območjih zunaj nacionalne jurisdikcije ali sporazum BBNJ, splošno znan kot pogodba o odprtem morju, je pravno zavezujoč instrument za ohranjanje in trajnostno rabo morske biološke raznovrstnosti na območjih zunaj nacionalne jurisdikcije. Gre za sporazum v okviru Konvencije Združenih narodov o pomorskem mednarodnem pravu (UNCLOS). Besedilo so dokončali na medvladni konferenci v OZN 4. marca 2023, sprejeli pa 19. junija 2023. Da bi pogodba začela veljati, jo je moralo ratificirati najmanj 60 članic OZN. Maroko jo je 19. septembra 2025 ratificiral kot 60. država, s čimer je bila pot za začetek veljavnosti januarja 2026 odprta.

source.title: High Seas Treaty
paragraphs: The Agreement under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea on the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biological Diversity of Areas beyond National Jurisdiction or BBNJ Agreement, commonly known as the High Seas Treaty, is a legally binding instrument for the conservation and sustainable use of marine biological diversity of areas beyond national jurisdiction. It is an agreement under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS). The text was finalised during an intergovernmental conference at the UN on 4 March 2023 and adopted on 19 June 2023. For entering into force, the treaty needed to be ratified by at least 60 UN member states. On 19 September 2025, Morocco became the 60th country to ratify the agreement, setting the stage for its entry into force in January 2026.

Huanca.headline: Huanca
paragraphs: Huanca (tudi Wanca ali Wanka) so kečuansko ljudstvo v regiji Junín v osrednjem Peruju, v dolini reke Mantaro in njeni okolici.

source.title: Huanca
paragraphs: The Huancas, Wancas, or Wankas are a Quechua people living in the Junín Region of central Peru, in and around the Mantaro Valley.

Huastec civilization.headline: Huasteška civilizacija
paragraphs: Huasteška civilizacija (pisana tudi Huaxtec ali Wastek) je bila predkolumbovska civilizacija Mezoamerike na mehiški zalivski obali, na ozemlju, ki je obsegalo severni del zvezne države Veracruz in sosednja območja zveznih držav Hidalgo, Querétaro, San Luis Potosí in Tamaulipas. Huasteki so bili zgodnja veja majevskih ljudstev, ki se je preselila proti severu.

Med ohranjenimi ostanki huasteške civilizacije je več velikih arheoloških najdišč, dobro ohranjen tempelj in veliko kamnitih kipov. Do poznega postklasičnega obdobja (ok. 1200–1521 n. št.) so Huasteki razvili metalurgijo in izdelovali bakrove zlitine. Azteški imperij je huasteško pokrajino osvojil okoli 15. stoletja in od nje verjetno zahteval davek.

source.title: Huastec civilization
paragraphs: The Huastec civilization (sometimes spelled Huaxtec or Wastek) was a pre-Columbian civilization of Mesoamerica, occupying a territory on the Gulf coast of Mexico that included the northern portion of Veracruz state, and neighbouring regions of the states of Hidalgo, Querétaro, San Luis Potosí, and Tamaulipas. The Huastec people were an early offshoot of the Maya peoples that migrated northwards.

Surviving remains from the Huastec civilization include several large archaeological sites, a well-preserved temple, and a large amount of stone sculpture. By the Late Postclassic (c. AD 1200–1521), the Huastecs had developed metallurgy and were producing copper alloys. The Aztec Empire conquered the Huastec region around the 15th century, and probably demanded tribute payments.

Ichma culture.headline: Kultura Ichma
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Ichma (pisano tudi Ychma, Yschma, Ishma in drugače; v klasični kečuanščini ićhma, dobesedno »cinober«) ali kraljestvo Pachacamac je bila predinkovska domorodna politična skupnost, ki jo je pozneje vsrkal Inkovski imperij in jo preoblikoval v provinco (wanami). Inki so jo poznali kot Pachakamaq (Pachacamac), ne s prvotnim imenom Ichma.

Kraljestvo je ležalo južno od Lime v Peruju, v dolini reke Lurín, pozneje pa se je razširilo na sever v dolino reke Rímac. Kultura Ishma je nastala okoli leta 1100 n. št., po razpadu imperija Wari, samostojnost pa je ohranila do okoli leta 1469, ko jo je vsrkal Inkovski imperij.

Čeprav so prebivalci kraljestva živeli v puščavi, so imeli visok življenjski standard, saj so znali speljati številne namakalne kanale, kamor koli je segala rečna voda, in tako ohranjati obsežne sadovnjake in gozd.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Ichma culture
paragraphs: The Ichma kingdom (also written Ychma or Yschma, Ishma, among other spellings; Classical Quechua: ićhma, pronounced [ˈiʈʂ.ma], lit. 'vermillion') or Pachacamac kingdom was a pre-Inca indigenous polity later absorbed by the Inca Empire and reorganized as a wanami (province). For the Inca it was known as Pachakamaq (Pachacamac), rather than its original name of Ichma.

The Ichmay Kingdom was located south of Lima, Peru in the Lurín River valley; it later spread north into the Rímac River's valley. The Ishma culture was formed around 1100 AD following the breakup of the Wari Empire. Ishma autonomy lasted until around 1469 when they were absorbed into the Incan Empire.

Despite occupying a desert, the inhabitants of Ishma had a high standard of living, thanks to their expertise in devising multiple irrigation channels as far as the river waters could reach, to give life to an extensive orchard and forest.

Inca Civil War.headline: Inkovska državljanska vojna
paragraphs: Inkovska državljanska vojna, znana tudi kot inkovska dinastična vojna, inkovska nasledstvena vojna ali včasih vojna dveh bratov, je potekala med polbratoma Huáscarjem in Atahualpo, sinovoma Huayne Capaca, za nasledstvo inkovskega prestola. Izbruhnila je po smrti Huayne Capaca.

Začela se je leta 1529 in trajala do leta 1532. Vojno je začel Huáscar: imenovan za cesarja, je zahteval prestol in hotel premagati tekmeca Atahualpo. Atahualpa je bil v vojskovanju taktično boljši od brata in od mogočnih vojsk Cusca, ki jih je oče med vojaškim pohodom namestil na severu imperija. Viri se v podrobnostih razhajajo.

Po Atahualpovi zmagi so v pokrajino vdrle španske sile pod vodstvom Francisca Pizarra. Pizarro je Atahualpo nazadnje ujel in ga dal ubiti, potem ko je prejel odkupnino, ki naj bi bila za njegovo izpustitev. Inkovsko državljansko vojno štejejo za pomemben dejavnik, ki je omogočil špansko osvojitev Inkovskega imperija.

source.title: Inca Civil War
paragraphs: The Inca Civil War, also known as the Inca Dynastic War, the Inca War of Succession, or, sometimes, the War of the Two Brothers, was fought between half-brothers Huáscar and Atahualpa, sons of Huayna Capac, over succession to the throne of the Inca Empire. The war followed Huayna Capac's death.

It began in 1529, and lasted until 1532. Huáscar initiated the war; appointed as emperor and claiming the throne, he wanted to defeat Atahualpa's competition. Atahualpa was tactically superior to his brother in warcraft and to the mighty armies of Cusco, which their father had stationed in the north part of the empire during the military campaign. Accounts from sources all vary in the exact details.

Following Atahualpa's victory, Spanish forces led by Francisco Pizarro invaded this region. He ultimately captured and killed Atahualpa, after receiving a ransom that was purportedly to free him. The Inca Civil War has been characterized as an important factor in enabling the Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire.

Inconfidência Mineira (»zarota v Minas Geraisu«) je bilo neuspešno separatistično gibanje v kolonialni Braziliji leta 1789. Nastalo je zaradi prepleta zunanjih in notranjih vzrokov. Zunanji navdih je bila osamosvojitev trinajstih britanskih kolonij v Severni Ameriki po ameriški osamosvojitveni vojni, ki je navdušila izobraženo elito, zlasti v kapitaniji Minas Gerais.

Glavni notranji vzrok zarote je bil upad pridobivanja zlata v tej kapitaniji. Ker je bilo zlata vse manj, so rudarji vse teže izpolnjevali davčne obveznosti do portugalske krone (davek na zlato je znašal petino). Ko kapitanija ni mogla izpolniti kraljeve zahteve po zlatu, so ji naložili dodatni davek na zlato, imenovan derrama.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Inconfidência Mineira
paragraphs: The Inconfidência Mineira (Portuguese pronunciation: [ĩkõfiˈdẽsiɐ miˈnejɾɐ]; "Minas Gerais Conspiracy") was an unsuccessful separatist movement in Colonial Brazil in 1789. It was the result of a confluence of external and internal causes. The external inspiration was the independence of thirteen British colonies in North America following the American Revolutionary War, a development that impressed the intellectual elite of particularly the captaincy of Minas Gerais.

The main internal cause of the conspiracy was the decline of gold mining in that captaincy. As gold became less plentiful, the region's gold miners faced increasing difficulties in fulfilling tax obligations to the Portuguese crown (the tax over gold was one-fifth). When the captaincy could not satisfy the royal demand for gold, it was burdened with an additional tax on gold, called derrama.

Pogodba o jedrskih silah srednjega dosega (pogodba INF) je bila pogodba o nadzoru nad oborožitvijo med Združenimi državami in Sovjetsko zvezo (ter njeno naslednico, Rusko federacijo). Ameriški predsednik Ronald Reagan in generalni sekretar sovjetske komunistične partije Mihail Gorbačov sta jo podpisala 8. decembra 1987. Ameriški senat jo je odobril 27. maja 1988, Reagan in Gorbačov pa sta jo ratificirala 1. junija 1988.

Pogodba je prepovedala vse jedrske in konvencionalne balistične izstrelke, manevrirne izstrelke in lansirne naprave obeh držav s kopnega z dosegom od 1000 do 5500 km (»srednji doseg«) in od 500 do 1000 km (»krajši doseg«). Za izstrelke z zraka ali morja ni veljala. Do maja 1991 sta državi uničili 2692 izstrelkov, sledilo pa je 10 let preverjanj na kraju samem.

source.title: Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty
paragraphs: The Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty (INF Treaty) was an arms control treaty between the United States and the Soviet Union (and its successor state, the Russian Federation). US president Ronald Reagan and Soviet General Secretary Mikhail Gorbachev signed the treaty on 8 December 1987. The US Senate approved the treaty on 27 May 1988, and Reagan and Gorbachev ratified it on 1 June 1988.

The INF Treaty banned all of the two nations' nuclear and conventional ground-launched ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and missile launchers with ranges of 1,000–5,500 km (620–3,420 mi) ("intermediate-range") and 500–1,000 kilometers (310–620 mi) ("shorter-range"). The treaty did not apply to air- or sea-launched missiles. By May 1991, the nations had eliminated 2,692 missiles, followed by 10 years of on-site verification inspections.

Mednarodni pakt o državljanskih in političnih pravicah (ICCPR) je večstranska pogodba, ki države zavezuje k spoštovanju državljanskih in političnih pravic posameznikov, med njimi pravice do življenja, svobode veroizpovedi, svobode govora, svobode zbiranja, volilnih pravic ter pravice do poštenega postopka in sojenja. Generalna skupščina Združenih narodov ga je sprejela z resolucijo 2200A (XXI) 16. decembra 1966, veljati pa je začel 23. marca 1976 po petintrideseti ratifikaciji ali pristopu. Decembra 2025 je imel pakt 175 pogodbenic in še šest podpisnic brez ratifikacije, med njimi zlasti Kitajsko in Kubo; Severna Koreja je edina država, ki je poskušala odstopiti.

Pakt velja za prelomni dokument v zgodovini mednarodnega prava in človekovih pravic; skupaj z Mednarodnim paktom o ekonomskih, socialnih in kulturnih pravicah (ICESCR) in Splošno deklaracijo človekovih pravic (UDHR) sestavlja Mednarodno listino človekovih pravic.

source.title: International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights
paragraphs: The International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR) is a multilateral treaty that commits nations to respect individuals' civil and political rights, including the right to life, freedom of religion, freedom of speech, freedom of assembly, electoral rights and rights to due process and a fair trial. The United Nations General Assembly adopted it by Resolution 2200A (XXI) on 16 December 1966, and it entered into force on 23 March 1976 after its thirty-fifth ratification or accession. As of December 2025, the Covenant has 175 parties and six more signatories without ratification, most notably China and Cuba; North Korea is the only state that has tried to withdraw.

The ICCPR is considered a pivotal document in the history of international law and human rights, forming part of the International Bill of Human Rights, along with the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (ICESCR) and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR).

Israel–United Arab Emirates normalizatio.headline: Sporazum o normalizaciji odnosov med Izraelom in Združenimi arabskimi emirati
paragraphs: O sporazumu o normalizaciji odnosov med Izraelom in Združenimi arabskimi emirati, uradno mirovnem sporazumu Abrahamovih sporazumov: pogodbi o miru, diplomatskih odnosih in popolni normalizaciji med Združenimi arabskimi emirati in Državo Izrael, so se Združene države, Izrael in Združeni arabski emirati sprva dogovorili v skupni izjavi 13. avgusta 2020, uradno imenovani Abrahamovi sporazumi. ZAE so tako postali tretja arabska država, za Egiptom leta 1979 in Jordanijo leta 1994, ki je privolila v formalno normalizacijo odnosov z Izraelom, in prva država Perzijskega zaliva, ki je to storila. Hkrati je Izrael privolil, da zamrzne načrte za priključitev delov Zahodnega brega. Sporazum je normaliziral odnose med državama, ki so bili dolgo neuradni, a trdni. Podpisali so ga v Beli hiši 15. septembra 2020. Izraelska vlada ga je soglasno potrdila 12. oktobra, kneset pa ratificiral 15. oktobra. Parlament in vlada ZAE sta ga ratificirala 19. oktobra. Veljati je začel 5. januarja 2021.

source.title: Israel–United Arab Emirates normalization agreement
paragraphs: The Israel–United Arab Emirates normalization agreement, officially the Abraham Accords Peace Agreement: Treaty of Peace, Diplomatic Relations and Full Normalization Between the United Arab Emirates and the State of Israel, was initially agreed to in a joint statement by the United States, Israel and the United Arab Emirates on August 13, 2020, officially referred to as the Abraham Accords. The UAE thus became the third Arab country, after Egypt in 1979 and Jordan in 1994, to agree to formally normalize its relationship with Israel, as well as the first Persian Gulf country to do so. Concurrently, Israel agreed to suspend plans for annexing parts of the West Bank. The agreement normalized what had long been informal but robust foreign relations between the two countries. The agreement was signed at the White House on September 15, 2020. It was approved unanimously by the Israeli cabinet on October 12 and was ratified by the Knesset on October 15. The UAE parliament and cabinet ratified the agreement on October 19. The agreement went into effect on January 5, 2021.

Itza people.headline: Itzaji
paragraphs: Itzaji so majevska etnična skupina, potomci ljudstva Chanes iz pokrajine Chontal v Tabascu. V 10. stoletju so se preselili v Bacalar in na sever Jukatana, pozneje prišli v Champotón, v 15. stoletju pa so se naselili ob jezeru Petén Itzá, kjer so ostali neodvisni do leta 1697. V španskem kolonialnem obdobju in pozneje pod gvatemalsko vlado so bili žrtve zatiralne politike, ki je pospešila izumiranje njihove kulture in jezika, zato so izgubili velik del etnične identitete.

So ena najmanjših majevskih skupin z najmanj pripadniki: redki potomci živijo v kraju San José severno od jezera Petén Itzá v departmaju Petén v Gvatemali in so se močno prilagodili mestiški družbi, jezik kot materni govori le še 36 starejših ljudi.

source.title: Itza people
paragraphs: The Itza are a Maya ethnic group. They are descendants of the Chanes from the Chontal region of Tabasco. They migrated to Bacalar and northern Yucatán during the 10th century, later arriving to Champotón and finally in the 15th century settling around Lake Petén Itzá where they remained independent until 1697. During the Spanish colonial era and later by the Guatemalan government, the Itza were victims of repressive policies that accelerated the extinction of the Itza culture and language, leading to the loss of much of their ethnic identity.

They are one of the smallest Maya groups and have the lowest population; the few Itza descendants are settled in the town of San José, north of Lake Petén Itzá in the department of Petén, Guatemala, and are considered highly acculturated to mestizo society, with only 36 elderly people remaining as native speakers of the language.

Jacksonova kampanja v dolini, znana tudi kot kampanja v dolini Shenandoah leta 1862, je bil spomladanski pohod konfederacijskega generalmajorja Thomasa J. »Stonewalla« Jacksona leta 1862 po dolini Shenandoah v Virginiji med ameriško državljansko vojno.
