Pogodba o vesolju, uradno Pogodba o načelih delovanja držav pri raziskovanju in izkoriščanju vesolja, vključno z Luno in drugimi nebesnimi telesi, je večstranska pogodba, na kateri temelji mednarodno vesoljsko pravo.

Izpogajali in pripravili so jo pod okriljem Združenih narodov, za podpis pa je bila v Združenih državah, Združenem kraljestvu in Sovjetski zvezi odprta 27. januarja 1967; veljati je začela 10. oktobra 1967. Oktobra 2025 je imela 118 pogodbenic, med njimi vse večje vesoljske države, še 20 držav pa jo je podpisalo.

source.title: Outer Space Treaty
paragraphs: The Outer Space Treaty, formally called the Treaty on Principles Governing the Activities of States in the Exploration and Use of Outer Space, including the Moon and Other Celestial Bodies, is a multilateral treaty that forms the basis of international space law.

Negotiated and drafted under the auspices of the United Nations, it was opened for signature in the United States, the United Kingdom, and the Soviet Union on 27 January 1967, entering into force on 10 October 1967. As of October 2025, 118 countries are parties to the treaty—including all major spacefaring nations—and another 20 are signatories.

Kopenska kampanja, znana tudi kot Grantova kopenska kampanja, virginijska kampanja in kampanja v Wildernessu, je bila vrsta bitk, ki so maja in junija 1864, proti koncu ameriške državljanske vojne, potekale v Virginiji. Generalporočnik Ulysses S. Grant, vrhovni poveljnik vseh armad Unije, je vodil Potomaško armado pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Georgea G. Meada in druge sile proti Severnovirginijski armadi konfederacijskega generala Roberta E. Leeja. Grant je v kampanji utrpel hude izgube, zato jo nekateri štejejo za neodločeno, drugi pa za strateško zmago Unije. Leejevi vojski je namreč prizadejala sorazmerno večje izgube in jo v nekaj več kot osmih tednih z manevri prisilila v obleganje Richmonda in Petersburga v Virginiji.

source.title: Overland Campaign
paragraphs: The Overland Campaign, also known as Grant's Overland Campaign, the Virginia Campaign, and the Wilderness Campaign, was a series of battles fought in Virginia during May and June 1864, towards the end of the American Civil War. Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant, general-in-chief of all Union armies, directed the actions of the Army of the Potomac, commanded by Maj. Gen. George G. Meade, and other forces against Confederate Gen. Robert E. Lee's Army of Northern Virginia. Although Grant suffered severe losses during the campaign, causing some to view it as inconclusive on its own, others have viewed it as a strategic Union victory. It inflicted proportionately higher losses on Lee's army and maneuvered it into a siege at Richmond and Petersburg, Virginia, in just over eight weeks.

Paquisha War.headline: Vojna za Paquisho
paragraphs: Vojna za Paquisho, vojna za lažno Paquisho ali incident v Paquishi (špansko: Guerra de Paquisha, Conflicto del Falso Paquisha ali Incidente de Paquisha) je bil vojaški spopad med Ekvadorjem in Perujem januarja in februarja 1981 za nadzor nad tremi stražnimi postojankami. Peru je menil, da je bilo vprašanje rešeno že v ekvadorsko-perujski vojni leta 1941, Ekvador pa je trdil, da protokola iz Ria de Janeira ni mogoče izvesti, ker 78 km dolg odsek meje ni bil natančno določen.

Po incidentu sta obe strani okrepili vojaško navzočnost v gorovju Cordillera del Cóndor in dolini Cenepa, kar je sprožilo stopnjevanje napetosti in izzivanj, ki se je leta 1995 končalo z novim vojaškim spopadom, vojno za Cenepo.

Ime vojna za Paquisho je razširjeno v mednarodni skupnosti in v Ekvadorju, v Peruju pa je incident znan tudi kot vojna za lažno Paquisho (Conflicto del Falso Paquisha), občasno pa kot incident v Paquishi ali spopad na Alto Comaini (conflicto del Alto Comaina).

source.title: Paquisha War
paragraphs: The Paquisha War, Fake Paquisha War or Paquisha incident (Spanish: Guerra de Paquisha, Conflicto del Falso Paquisha o Incidente de Paquisha) was a military clash that took place between January and February 1981 between Ecuador and Peru over the control of three watchposts. While Peru felt that the matter was already decided in the Ecuadorian–Peruvian War of 1941, Ecuador claimed that the Rio de Janeiro Protocol was not executable because a 78 km section of the border was not precisely defined.

In the aftermath of the incident, both sides increased their military presence along the Cordillera del Cóndor area and Cenepa Valley, starting an escalating spiral of tension and provocation that finally resulted in another military confrontation in 1995, the Cenepa War.

While the name Paquisha War is widely used by the international community and Ecuador, in Spanish this incident is also known as the Falso Paquisha War (Conflicto del Falso Paquisha) in Peru and, occasionally, as the Paquisha Incident or the Upper Comaina Conflict (conflicto del Alto Comaina).

Paraguayan Civil War (1947).headline: Paragvajska državljanska vojna (1947)
paragraphs: Paragvajska državljanska vojna (znana tudi kot bosonoga revolucija in tretja paragvajska državljanska vojna) je bila državljanska vojna v Paragvaju, ki je trajala od 7. marca do 20. avgusta 1947.

source.title: Paraguayan Civil War (1947)
paragraphs: The Paraguayan Civil War (also known as the Barefoot Revolution and the Third Paraguayan Civil War) was a civil war in Paraguay that lasted from 7 March to 20 August 1947.

Pastry War.headline: Slaščičarska vojna
paragraphs: Slaščičarska vojna se je začela novembra 1838, ko so francoske pomorske sile blokirale mehiška pristanišča in zavzele utrdbo San Juan de Ulúa v Veracruzu. To je bil odgovor na obtožbe o slabem ravnanju s francoskimi državljani v Mehiki, med njimi s slaščičarjem, po katerem je vojna dobila ime; končala se je marca 1839 z mirom, ki ga je posredovala Britanija. V 1860. letih je sledila druga francoska intervencija v Mehiki.

source.title: Pastry War
paragraphs: The Pastry War began in November 1838 when French naval forces blockaded ports in Mexico, and captured San Juan de Ulúa in Veracruz. This was in response to allegations of mistreatment of French nationals in Mexico, including a pastry chef after whom the war was named, and ended in March 1839 with a British-brokered peace. A Second French intervention in Mexico followed in the 1860s.

Patent Cooperation Treaty.headline: Pogodba o sodelovanju na področju patentov
paragraphs: Pogodba o sodelovanju na področju patentov (PCT) je mednarodna pogodba patentnega prava, sklenjena leta 1970. Določa enoten postopek vlaganja patentnih prijav za zaščito izumov v vsaki od držav pogodbenic. Patentno prijavo, vloženo po PCT, imenujejo mednarodna prijava ali prijava PCT.

Prijavo PCT se vloži enkrat, pri sprejemnem uradu (RO) in v enem jeziku. Nato mednarodni organ za poizvedbe (ISA) opravi poizvedbo in poda pisno mnenje o patentabilnosti izuma, ki je predmet prijave. Po izbiri sledi predhodni preizkus, ki ga opravi mednarodni organ za predhodni preizkus (IPEA). Nazadnje zadeve, povezane s preizkusom prijave (če ga predvideva nacionalna zakonodaja) in podelitvijo patenta, vodijo pristojni nacionalni ali regionalni organi.

source.title: Patent Cooperation Treaty
paragraphs: The Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) is an international patent law treaty, concluded in 1970. It provides a unified procedure for filing patent applications to protect inventions in each of its contracting states. A patent application filed under the PCT is called an international application, or PCT application.

A single filing of a PCT application is made with a Receiving Office (RO) in one language. It then results in a search performed by an International Searching Authority (ISA), accompanied by a written opinion regarding the patentability of the invention, which is the subject of the application. It is optionally followed by a preliminary examination, performed by an International Preliminary Examining Authority (IPEA). Finally, the relevant national or regional authorities administer matters related to the examination of application (if provided by national law) and issuance of patent.

Polotoška kampanja ameriške državljanske vojne je bila velika operacija Unije na jugovzhodu Virginije od marca do julija 1862, prva obsežna ofenziva na vzhodnem bojišču. Operacija pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Georgea B. McClellana je bila amfibijski obhodni manever proti vojski Konfederativnih držav v severni Virginiji, s katerim naj bi zavzeli konfederacijsko prestolnico Richmond. Konfederacijski vohun Thomas Nelson Conrad je od dvojnega agenta na vojnem ministrstvu sicer dobil dokumente z McClellanovimi bojnimi načrti, a je bil McClellan sprva uspešen proti enako previdnemu generalu Josephu E. Johnstonu. Ko pa je na prizorišče stopil bojevitejši general Robert E. Lee, so se sedemdnevne bitke, ki so sledile, končale s ponižujočim porazom Unije.

source.title: Peninsula campaign
paragraphs: The Peninsula campaign (also known as the Peninsular campaign) of the American Civil War was a major Union operation launched in southeastern Virginia from March to July 1862, the first large-scale offensive in the Eastern Theater. The operation, commanded by Major General George B. McClellan, was an amphibious turning movement against the Confederate States Army in Northern Virginia, intended to capture the Confederate capital of Richmond. Despite the fact that Confederate spy Thomas Nelson Conrad had obtained documents describing McClellan's battle plans from a double agent in the War Department, McClellan was initially successful against the equally cautious General Joseph E. Johnston, but the emergence of the more aggressive General Robert E. Lee turned the subsequent Seven Days Battles into a humiliating Union defeat.

Pequot War.headline: Pekvotska vojna
paragraphs: Pekvotska vojna je bil spopad, ki se je začel leta 1636 in končal leta 1638 v Novi Angliji, med pekvotskim narodom in združenimi silami angleških kolonistov iz kolonij Massachusettski zaliv, Plymouth in Saybrook ter njihovih zaveznikov iz narodov Narragansett in Mohegan. Vojna se je končala z odločilnim porazom Pekvotov. V dogodku, imenovanem pokol v Mysticu, so angleški kolonisti iz kolonije Connecticut in njihovi zavezniki zažgali vas Pequot Fort, zaprli izhode in streljali na vse, ki so skušali pobegniti. Do konca vojne je bilo okoli 700 Pekvotov ubitih ali ujetih.

Na stotine pekvotskih ujetnikov so zasužnjili. Nekatere so obdržali v kolonijah v pokrajini, a so jih na splošno imeli za neprimerne sužnje in so bili manj zaželeni od zasužnjenih ljudi afriškega izvora. Zato so večino zasužnjenih Pekvotov nazadnje prodali kolonistom na Bermudih ali v Zahodni Indiji, v pokrajini pa jih je ostala le manjšina. Druge preživele so kot ujetnike razdelili med narode Narragansett in Mohegan.

source.title: Pequot War
paragraphs: The Pequot War was a conflict that took place in 1636 and ended in 1638 in New England, between the Pequot nation and a joint effort of the English colonists from the Massachusetts Bay, Plymouth, and Saybrook colonies and their allies from the Narragansett and Mohegan nations. The war concluded with the decisive defeat of the Pequot. In an event called the Mystic massacre, English colonists of the Connecticut Colony and their allies set the village of Pequot Fort ablaze, blocked the exits, and shot anyone trying to escape. By the end of the war, about 700 Pequots had been killed or taken into captivity.

Hundreds of Pequot prisoners were enslaved. While some of the enslaved persons were kept in the colonies of the region, they were generally deemed unfit as slaves and less desirable than enslaved people of African origin. Because of this, most of the enslaved Pequots were eventually sold to colonists in Bermuda or the West Indies, while a minority of the original numbers remained in the region. Other survivors were dispersed as captives to the Narragansett and Mohegan nations.

Perujsko-bolivijska konfederacija (špansko: Confederación Perú–Boliviana) je bila kratkotrajna država, ki je v Južni Ameriki obstajala med letoma 1836 in 1839. Bila je ohlapna konfederacija treh držav: Severnega Peruja, Južnega Peruja in Bolivijske republike. Severni in Južni Peru sta nastala z razdelitvijo Perujske republike po perujski državljanski vojni leta 1834 in vojni med Salaverryjem in Santa Cruzom v letih 1835–1836.

Meje konfederacije so se s časom spreminjale: leta 1838 je Bolivija zasedla in priključila nekatera sporna ozemlja na severu Argentine. Konfederaciji so pripadala tudi dejansko samostojna domorodna ozemlja, kot je bil Iquicha. Vse je bilo pod vrhovnim poveljstvom maršala Andrésa de Santa Cruza, ki je leta 1836 kot predsednik Bolivije prevzel položaj vrhovnega zaščitnika.

source.title: Peru–Bolivian Confederation
paragraphs: The Peru–Bolivian Confederation (Spanish: Confederación Perú–Boliviana) was a short-lived state that existed in South America between 1836 and 1839. The country was a loose confederation made up of three states: North Peru, South Peru, and the Bolivian Republic. North Peru and South Peru had emerged from the division of the Peruvian Republic due to the Peruvian Civil War of 1834 and the Salaverry-Santa Cruz War of 1835–36.

The geographical limits of the Confederation varied over time, with Bolivia occupying and incorporating certain disputed territories in northern Argentina in 1838. It also possessed de facto autonomous indigenous territories, such as Iquicha, all under the supreme command of Marshal Andrés de Santa Cruz, who assumed the position of Supreme Protector in 1836, while he was president of Bolivia.

Perujska vojna za neodvisnost (špansko: Guerra de Independencia del Perú) je bila vrsta vojaških spopadov v Peruju od leta 1809 do 1826. Kot del širših hispanskoameriških osamosvojitvenih vojn je pripeljala do razpada španskega Podkraljestva Peru in nastanka Peruja kot neodvisne države 28. julija 1821. Bitka pri Ayacuchu leta 1824 je zagotovila neodvisnost Peruja in dokončno končala špansko oblast v Južni Ameriki. Polno suverenost pa je Peru dosegel šele, ko je bilo konec vpliva Simóna Bolívarja in velikokolumbijske vojaške zasedbe. Bolívarjev načrt Andske federacije so opustili, zadnja velikokolumbijska posadka pa je 16. februarja 1827 Perujcem vrnila trdnjavo Real Felipe.

source.title: Peruvian War of Independence
paragraphs: The Peruvian War of Independence (Spanish: Guerra de Independencia del Perú) was a series of military conflicts in Peru from 1809 to 1826. Part of the broader Spanish American wars of independence, it led to the dissolution of the Spanish Viceroyalty of Peru and the emergence of Peru as an independent state on 28 July 1821. The Battle of Ayacucho in 1824 secured the independence of Peru and definitively ended Spanish rule in South America. However, Peru achieved full sovereignty only after the end of Simon Bolívar's influence and the Gran Colombian military occupation. His Federation of the Andes project was discarded and the last Gran Colombian garrison returned the Real Felipe Fortress to the Peruvians on 16 February 1827.

Pig War (1859).headline: Prašičja vojna (1859)
paragraphs: Prašičja vojna je bila konfrontacija leta 1859 med Združenimi državami in Združenim kraljestvom zaradi britansko-ameriške meje na otočju San Juan, med otokom Vancouver (danes Kanada) in ozemljem Washington (danes zvezna država Washington). Vojna, ki se tako imenuje, ker jo je sprožil ustreljeni prašič, je znana tudi kot prašičja epizoda, vojna za prašiča in krompir, mejni spor za San Juan in severozahodni mejni spor. Čeprav jo imenujejo »vojna«, ni bilo človeških žrtev na nobeni strani, le prašič.

source.title: Pig War (1859)
paragraphs: The Pig War was a confrontation in 1859 between the United States and the United Kingdom over the British–U.S. border in the San Juan Islands, between Vancouver Island (present-day Canada) and the Washington Territory (present-day State of Washington). The Pig War, so called because it was triggered by the shooting of a pig, is also called the Pig Episode, the Pig and Potato War, the San Juan Boundary Dispute, and the Northwestern Boundary Dispute. Despite being referred to as a "war", there were no human casualties on either side, only a pig.

Plan of Iguala.headline: Načrt iz Iguale
paragraphs: Načrt iz Iguale, znan tudi kot načrt treh jamstev (Plan Trigarante) ali akt o neodvisnosti Severne Amerike, je bil revolucionarni razglas, objavljen 24. februarja 1821, v zadnji fazi mehiške osamosvojitvene vojne proti Španiji. Načrt je določal, da bo Mehika postala ustavna monarhija z rimskim katolištvom kot edino uradno vero, v kateri bodo imeli tako peninsulares (ljudje, rojeni v Španiji in živeči v Mehiki) kot americanos (ljudje, rojeni v Mehiki, torej v Amerikah) enake politične in družbene pravice. Ime je dobil po mestu Iguala v današnji zvezni državi Guerrero.

source.title: Plan of Iguala
paragraphs: The Plan of Iguala, also known as the Plan of the Three Guarantees ("Plan Trigarante") or Act of Independence of North America, was a revolutionary proclamation promulgated on 24 February 1821, in the final stage of the Mexican War of Independence from Spain. The Plan stated that Mexico was to become a constitutional monarchy, whose sole official religion would be Roman Catholicism, in which both the Peninsulares (people born in Spain and residing in Mexico) and the Americanos (people born in Mexico, that is, the Americas) would enjoy equal political and social rights. It took its name from the city of Iguala in the modern-day state of Guerrero.

Plaquemine culture.headline: Kultura Plaquemine
paragraphs: Kultura Plaquemine je bila arheološka kultura (ok. 1200–1700 n. št.) s središčem v dolini spodnjega Misisipija. Na tem območju je imela dolgo zgodovino, ki sega prek starejših kultur Coles Creek (700–1200 n. št.) in Troyville (400–700 n. št.) do kulture Marksville (100 pr. n. št.–400 n. št.). Njeni potomci v zgodovinskem obdobju so bila ljudstva Natchez in sorodno ljudstvo Taensa. Tipsko najdišče kulture je najdišče Medora v Louisiani, med drugimi primeri pa so najdišča Anna, Emerald, Holly Bluff in Winterville v Misisipiju.

source.title: Plaquemine culture
paragraphs: The Plaquemine culture was an archaeological culture (circa 1200 to 1700 CE) centered on the Lower Mississippi River valley. It had a deep history in the area stretching back through the earlier Coles Creek (700–1200 CE) and Troyville cultures (400–700 CE) to the Marksville culture (100 BCE to 400 CE). The Natchez and related Taensa peoples were their historic period descendants. The type site for the culture is the Medora site in Louisiana; while other examples include the Anna, Emerald, Holly Bluff, and Winterville sites in Mississippi.

Platinska vojna (špansko: Guerra Platina, portugalsko: Guerra do Prata, Guerra contra Oribe e Rosas; 18. avgusta 1851–3. februarja 1852) je potekala med Argentinsko konfederacijo in zavezništvom Brazilskega cesarstva, Urugvaja ter argentinskih provinc Entre Ríos in Corrientes, z Republiko Paragvaj kot brazilsko sobojevnico in zaveznico. Vojna je bila del desetletja dolgega spora med Argentino in Brazilijo za vpliv nad Urugvajem in Paragvajem ter za prevlado v porečju Río de la Plata. Spopad je potekal v Urugvaju, na severovzhodu Argentine in na Río de la Plata. Notranje težave Urugvaja, med njimi dolgotrajna urugvajska državljanska vojna (La Guerra Grande, »velika vojna«), so bile pomemben dejavnik, ki je pripeljal do platinske vojne.

source.title: Platine War
paragraphs: The Platine War (Spanish: Guerra Platina, Portuguese: Guerra do Prata, Guerra contra Oribe e Rosas; 18 August 1851 – 3 February 1852) was fought between the Argentine Confederation and an alliance consisting of the Empire of Brazil, Uruguay, and the Argentine provinces of Entre Ríos and Corrientes, with the participation of the Republic of Paraguay as Brazil's co-belligerent and ally. The war was part of a decades-long dispute between Argentina and Brazil for influence over Uruguay and Paraguay, and hegemony over the Platine region (areas bordering the Río de la Plata). The conflict took place in Uruguay and northeastern Argentina, and on the Río de la Plata. Uruguay's internal troubles, including the longrunning Uruguayan Civil War (La Guerra Grande – "The Great War"), were heavily influential factors leading to the Platine War.

Plum Bayou culture.headline: Kultura Plum Bayou
paragraphs: Kultura Plum Bayou je predkolumbovska indijanska kultura, ki je od leta 650 do 1050 n. št., v poznem gozdnem obdobju, živela na vzhodu osrednjega Arkansasa. Arheologi so jo opredelili po najdišču gomil Plum Bayou, prej znanem kot Toltec Mounds, in jo poimenovali po bližnjem vodotoku.

source.title: Plum Bayou culture
paragraphs: Plum Bayou culture is a Pre-Columbian Native American culture that lived in what is now east-central Arkansas from 650–1050 CE, a time known as the Late Woodland Period. Archaeologists defined the culture based on the Plum Bayou Mounds site, previously known as Toltec Mounds, and named it for a local waterway.

Point Peninsula complex.headline: Kompleks Point Peninsula
paragraphs: Kompleks Point Peninsula je bila domorodna kultura v Ontariu in New Yorku, ki je obstajala od leta 600 pr. n. št. do 700 n. št., v srednjem gozdnem obdobju. Lončenina Point Peninsula se je v Kanadi pojavila okoli leta 600 pr. n. št., nato pa se je okoli leta 200 pr. n. št. razširila na jug, v dele Nove Anglije. Nekje med letoma 300 pr. n. št. in 1 n. št. se je pojavila v Mainu in »po vsem pomorskem polotoku«. Malo je dokazov, da bi se razvila iz starejše, debelejše lončenine, znane kot Vinette I, Adena Thick in podobno. Bila je nova tehnologija v Severni Ameriki in jo imenujejo tudi Vinette II. V primerjavi z dotedanjo debelejšo in manj okrašeno keramiko jo odlikuje »boljše oblikovanje gline, posode so tanjše, bolje žgane in s finejšim pustilom«. Od kod je ta tehnologija prišla, ni zanesljivo znano; njen izvor je »nekoliko problematičen«. Ljudstvo so domnevno oblikovale hopewellske tradicije iz doline reke Ohio. Ta vpliv je očitno usahnil okoli leta 250 n. št., nato pa pogrebnih obredov niso več izvajali.

source.title: Point Peninsula complex
paragraphs: The Point Peninsula complex was an indigenous culture located in Ontario and New York from 600 BCE to 700 CE (during the Middle Woodland period). Point Peninsula ceramics were first introduced into Canada around 600 BCE then spread south into parts of New England around 200 BCE. Some time between 300 BCE and 1 CE, Point Peninsula pottery first appeared in Maine, and "over the entire Maritime Peninsula." Little evidence exists to show that it was derived from the earlier, thicker pottery, known as Vinette I, Adena Thick, etc... Point Peninsula pottery represented a new kind of technology in North America and has also been called Vinette II. Compared to existing ceramics that were thicker and less decorated, this new pottery has been characterized by "superior modeling of the clay with vessels being thinner, better fired and containing finer grit temper." Where this new pottery technology originated is not known for sure. The origin of this pottery is "somewhat of a problem." The people are thought to have been influenced by the Hopewell traditions of the Ohio River valley. This influence seems to have ended about 250 CE, after which they no longer practiced burial ceremonialism.

Pontiaško vojno (znano tudi kot Pontiacova zarota ali Pontiacov upor) je leta 1763 začela zveza indijanskih ljudstev, ki je bila po francosko-indijanski vojni (1754–1763) nezadovoljna z britansko oblastjo na območju Velikih jezer. Bojevniki številnih narodov so se združili, da bi iz pokrajine pregnali britanske vojake in naseljence. Vojna je dobila ime po odavskem voditelju Pontiacu, najvidnejšem med številnimi domorodnimi voditelji v spopadu.

Vojna se je začela maja 1763, ko so Indijanci, zaskrbljeni zaradi politike britanskega generala Jefferyja Amhersta, napadli več britanskih utrdb in naselij. Uničili so devet utrdb, na stotine kolonistov je bilo ubitih ali ujetih, še veliko več pa jih je iz pokrajine pobegnilo. Sovražnosti so se končale, ko so uspešni pohodi britanske vojske leta 1764 v naslednjih dveh letih pripeljali do mirovnih pogajanj. Indijanci Britancev niso uspeli pregnati, a je vstaja britansko vlado spodbudila, da je spremenila politiko, ki je spopad izzvala.

source.title: Pontiac's War
paragraphs: Pontiac's War (also known as Pontiac's Conspiracy or Pontiac's Rebellion) was launched in 1763 by a confederation of Native Americans who were dissatisfied with British rule in the Great Lakes region following the French and Indian War (1754–1763). Warriors from numerous nations joined in an effort to drive British soldiers and settlers out of the region. The war is named after Odawa leader Pontiac, the most prominent of many Indigenous leaders in the conflict.

The war began in May 1763 when Native Americans, alarmed by policies imposed by British General Jeffery Amherst, attacked a number of British forts and settlements. Nine forts were destroyed, and hundreds of colonists were killed or captured, with many more fleeing the region. Hostilities came to an end after successful British Army expeditions in 1764 led to peace negotiations over the next two years. The Natives were unable to drive away the British, but the uprising prompted the British government to modify the policies that had provoked the conflict.

Poverty Point culture.headline: Kultura Poverty Point
paragraphs: Kultura Poverty Point je arheološka kultura prazgodovinskih domorodnih ljudstev, ki so približno od leta 1730 do 1350 pr. n. št. poseljevala del doline spodnjega Misisipija v Severni Ameriki in bližnje zalivske obale. Ime je dobila po svojem najbolj znanem arheološkem najdišču.
Arheologi so odkrili več kot 100 najdišč te kulture graditeljev gomil, ki je spletla tudi veliko trgovsko mrežo po velikem delu vzhodnega dela današnjih Združenih držav.

source.title: Poverty Point culture
paragraphs: The Poverty Point culture is the archaeological culture of prehistoric indigenous peoples who inhabited a portion of North America's lower Mississippi Valley and surrounding Gulf coast from about 1730 – 1350 BC. They are named after their best-known archeological site.

Archeologists have identified more than 100 sites belonging to this mound-builder culture, who also formed a large trading network throughout much of the eastern part of what is now the United States.

Predhodna mirovna konvencija je bila dvostranska pogodba, ki sta jo 27. avgusta 1828 po britanskem posredovanju podpisala Brazilsko cesarstvo in Združene province Río de la Plata; končala je cisplatinsko vojno in priznala neodvisnost Urugvaja.

Predhodna mirovna konvencija se imenuje po srečanjih predstavnikov Brazilskega cesarstva in Združenih provinc, predhodnice Argentine, ki so potekala od 11. do 27. avgusta 1828 v Riu de Janeiru v Braziliji. Konvencija oziroma pogodba je Urugvaju priznala neodvisnost od Brazilije in Argentine. Neodvisnost Urugvaja je bila dokončno zapečatena 4. oktobra istega leta, ko sta podpisnici v Montevideu pogodbo ratificirali.
notes: The glossary names the record Pogodba iz Montevidea, after the place of ratification; the text keeps the treaty's own name.

source.title: Preliminary Peace Convention (1828)
paragraphs: The Preliminary Peace Convention was a bilateral treaty signed on 27 August 1828 between the Empire of Brazil and the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata, after British mediation, that put an end to the Cisplatine War and recognized the independence of Uruguay.

Called the Preliminary Peace Convention as a result of the meetings held by representatives from the Empire of Brazil and the United Provinces — the predecessor state for Argentina — between 11 and 27 August 1828 in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. This convention, or treaty, accorded independence to Uruguay in respect to Brazil and Argentina. Uruguay's independence would be definitively sealed on 4 October of the same year when, in Montevideo, the signing nations ratified the treaty.

Primera Junta.headline: Prva hunta
paragraphs: Prva hunta (Primera Junta) ali Začasna vladna hunta provinc Río de la Plata (Junta Provisional Gubernativa de las Provincias del Río de la Plata) je najpogostejše ime prve vlade poznejše Argentine. Ustanovili so jo 25. maja 1810 kot plod dogodkov majske revolucije. Sprva so jo sestavljali le predstavniki Buenos Airesa. Ko so jo, kot je bilo predvideno, razširili s predstavniki drugih mest Podkraljestva Río de la Plata, so jo začeli imenovati velika hunta (Junta Grande) ali Začasna vladna hunta Buenos Airesa. Hunta je delovala v utrdbi El Fuerte (tam, kjer danes stoji Casa Rosada), ki je podkraljem od leta 1776 služila kot rezidenca.

source.title: Primera Junta
paragraphs: The Primera Junta ("First Junta"), or Junta Provisional Gubernativa de las Provincias del Río de la Plata ("Provisional Governing Junta of the Provinces of the Río de la Plata"), is the most common name given to the first government of what would eventually become Argentina. It was formed on 25 May 1810, as a result of the events of the May Revolution. The Junta initially only had representatives from Buenos Aires. When it was expanded, as expected, with the addition of representatives from the other cities of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata, it became popularly known instead as the Junta Grande (Grand Junta) or Junta Provisional Gubernativa de Buenos Aires. The Junta operated at El Fuerte (the fort, where the modern Casa Rosada stands), which had been used since 1776 as a residence by the viceroys.

Proclamation of the Republic (Brazil).headline: Razglasitev republike (Brazilija)
paragraphs: Razglasitev republike (portugalsko: Proclamação da República) je bil vojaški državni udar, s katerim so 15. novembra 1889 ustanovili prvo brazilsko republiko. Udar je odpravil ustavno monarhijo Brazilskega cesarstva in končal vladavino cesarja Pedra II.

Udar se je zgodil v Riu de Janeiru, tedanji prestolnici cesarstva, ko je skupina častnikov cesarske vojske pod vodstvom maršala Deodora da Fonsece brez nasilja izvedla državni udar ter odstavila cesarja Pedra II. in predsednika cesarskega ministrskega sveta, vikonta Ouro Preta.
Še istega dne so vzpostavili začasno vlado z maršalom Deodorom da Fonseco kot predsednikom republike in vodjo prehodne vlade.

source.title: Proclamation of the Republic (Brazil)
paragraphs: The Proclamation of the Republic (Portuguese: Proclamação da República) was a military coup d'état that established the First Brazilian Republic on November 15, 1889. It abolished the constitutional monarchy of the Empire of Brazil and ended the reign of Emperor Pedro II.

The coup took place in Rio de Janeiro, the capital of the Empire at the time, when a group of military officers of the Imperial Army, led by Marshal Deodoro da Fonseca, staged a coup d'état without the use of violence, deposing Emperor Pedro II and the President of the Council of Ministers of the Empire, the Viscount of Ouro Preto.
A provisional government was established that same day, with Marshal Deodoro da Fonseca as President of the Republic and head of the interim Government.

Protocol Relating to the Status of Refug.headline: Protokol o statusu beguncev
paragraphs: Protokol o statusu beguncev je ključna pogodba mednarodnega begunskega prava. Veljati je začel 4. oktobra 1967, pogodbenic pa je 146 držav.

Konvencija Združenih narodov o statusu beguncev iz leta 1951 je status begunca omejila na tiste, katerih okoliščine so nastale »zaradi dogodkov pred 1. januarjem 1951«, državam pogodbenicam pa je dala možnost, da to razlagajo kot »dogodke v Evropi« ali kot »dogodke v Evropi ali drugod«.

Protokol iz leta 1967 je odpravil obe omejitvi, časovno in zemljepisno. To je bilo potrebno v zgodovinskih okoliščinah begunskih tokov, ki jih je povzročila dekolonizacija. Madagaskar ter Sveti Krištof in Nevis sta pogodbenici le konvencije, Zelenortski otoki, Združene države Amerike in Venezuela pa le protokola.

source.title: Protocol Relating to the Status of Refugees
paragraphs: The Protocol Relating to the Status of Refugees is a key treaty in international refugee law. It entered into force on 4 October 1967, and 146 countries are parties.

The 1951 United Nations Convention Relating to the Status of Refugees restricted refugee status to those whose circumstances had come about "as a result of events occurring before 1 January 1951", as well as giving states party to the convention the option of interpreting this as "events occurring in Europe" or "events occurring in Europe or elsewhere".

The 1967 Protocol removed both the temporal and geographic restrictions. This was needed in the historical context of refugee flows resulting from decolonisation. Madagascar and Saint Kitts and Nevis are parties only to the convention, while Cape Verde, the United States of America and Venezuela are parties only to the protocol.

Pukara culture.headline: Kultura Pukara
paragraphs: Kultura Pukara ali Pucará je bila arheološka kultura, ki se je razvila v pokrajini Qullaw ob severozahodni obali jezera Titicaca. Zanjo je bila značilna hierarhija manjših središč in vasi, raztresenih po severnem delu porečja jezera. Ime je dobila po kraju Pukara, enem največjih naselij v pokrajini; današnje mestece Pucará leži pol milje vzhodno od arheološkega najdišča. Kultura nima nobene zveze s kamnitimi utrdbami pukarami, ki so jih v času Inkovskega imperija gradili po vseh Andih. Njen vpliv je segal na sever do doline Cuzca in na jug do Tiwanakuja. V formativnem obdobju je imela dve razvojni fazi: srednjo formativno (1400–550 pr. n. št.) in pozno formativno (550 pr. n. št.–400 n. št.).

source.title: Pukara culture
paragraphs: The Pukara or Pucará culture was an archaeological culture which developed in Qullaw, along the north-western shore of Lake Titicaca. It was characterized by a hierarchy of smaller centers and villages scattered throughout the northern basin of the Titicaca. The name originates from the town of Pukara, one of the largest settlements in the region. The modern town of Pucará is located half a mile to the east of the archaeological site. The Pukara culture is unrelated to the stone fortresses, pukaras, built across the Andes during the Inca Empire. Its sphere of influence reached as far north as the Cuzco Valley and as far south as Tiahuanaco. The culture had two phases of development within the Formative Period: the Middle Formative (1400 to 550 BC), and Late Formative (550 BC to 400 AD).

Quimbaya.headline: Quimbaya
paragraphs: Quimbaya so bili majhna starodavna domorodna skupina na območju današnje Kolumbije, znana po zlatarskih izdelkih s tehnično natančnostjo in podrobnimi vzorci. Večina izdelkov je iz zlitine tumbaga s 30 % bakra, ki jim daje barvo.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Quimbaya
paragraphs: The Quimbaya (/kɪmbaɪa/) were a small, ancient indigenous group in present-day Colombia noted for their gold work characterized by technical accuracy and detailed designs. The majority of the gold work is made in tumbaga alloy, with 30% copper, which colours the pieces.

Quitu culture.headline: Kultura Quitu
paragraphs: Quitu ali Quillaco so bila predkolumbovska domorodna ljudstva v Ekvadorju, ki so ustanovila Quito, današnjo prestolnico Ekvadorja. Ozemlju so vladala od leta 2000 pr. n. št. in so se obdržala vse obdobje regionalne integracije, dokler jih ni premagala inkovska invazija. Leta 1534 so središče napadli in osvojili Španci.

Quitu so živeli na goratem območju in so se naseljevali predvsem v dolinah. Okoli leta 800 n. št. so na planoti v okviru pogrebnih središč zgradili 20 metrov globoke grobnice na treh ravneh. Mrtvim so dali izjemno prefinjene pridatke iz tkanin, školjk in kovin ter pijačo in hrano za posmrtno življenje. Grobnice so odkrili v Quitovi četrti Florida, kjer so leta 2010 odprli Muzej Florida, ki razstavlja velik del njihovih zakladov.

source.title: Quitu culture
paragraphs: The Quitu or Quillaco were pre-Columbian indigenous peoples in Ecuador who founded Quito, which is the capital of present-day Ecuador. This people ruled the territory from 2000 BCE and persisted through the period known as the Regional Integration Period. They were overtaken by the invasion of the Inca. The Spanish invaded and conquered the center in 1534.

The Quitu occupied an area dominated by mountains, settling largely in the valleys. About 800 CE, they created three-level, 20-meter deep tombs as part of funerary centers on the plateau. The bodies were accompanied by highly refined grave goods of textiles, shells and metals, as well as drink and food for the afterlife. These tombs were discovered in the Florida neighborhood of Quito, and in 2010 the Museum of Florida opened to display many of their treasures.

Ragamuffin War.headline: Vojna raztrgancev
paragraphs: Vojna raztrgancev (portugalsko: Guerra dos Farrapos), znana tudi kot revolucija raztrgancev ali junaško desetletje, je bila republikanska vstaja, ki se je v obdobju regentstva začela na jugu Brazilije, s središčem v provinci Rio Grande do Sul, za nekaj časa pa se je razširila tudi v Santa Catarino. Začela se je 20. septembra 1835, ko so uporniške sile zavzele Porto Alegre, in se kmalu sprevrgla v širši spopad med brazilsko cesarsko vlado in koalicijo pod vodstvom Benta Gonçalvesa in Antônia de Sousa Neta, ki sta po zmagi upornikov v bitki pri Seivalu leta 1836 razglasila odcepitev province in ustanovitev Republike Riograndense.

source.title: Ragamuffin War
paragraphs: The Ragamuffin War (Portuguese: Guerra dos Farrapos), also known as the Ragamuffin Revolution or Heroic Decade, was a republican uprising that began in southern Brazil during the regency period, centered in the province of Rio Grande do Sul and, for a time, extending into Santa Catarina. It began on 20 September 1835, when rebel forces seized Porto Alegre, and soon turned into a wider confrontation between Brazil's imperial government and a coalition led by Bento Gonçalves and Antônio de Sousa Neto, who proclaimed the secession of the province and the creation of the Riograndense Republic following the rebel victory at the battle of Seival in 1836.

Upora v letih 1837–1838 (francosko: Rébellions de 1837) sta bili oboroženi vstaji, ki sta v letih 1837 in 1838 potekali v Spodnji in Gornji Kanadi. Obe je spodbudilo nezadovoljstvo, ker ni bilo političnih reform. Ključni skupni cilj je bila odgovorna vlada, ki so jo po teh dogodkih nazadnje tudi dosegli. Upora sta neposredno pripeljala do poročila lorda Durhama o razmerah v Britanski Severni Ameriki in do zakona o uniji iz leta 1840, ki je obe koloniji združil v provinco Kanado. Poročilo in poznejši razvoj sta nazadnje pripeljala do ustavnega zakona iz leta 1867, ki je ustvaril današnjo državo Kanado in njeno vlado.

Upor v Spodnji Kanadi je bil bolj razširjen in so ga bolj brutalno zatrli. Ko so zatrli upor v Gornji Kanadi, so se boji še mesece občasno nadaljevali. Mnogi uporniki so pobegnili v Združene države. Uporniški voditelj William Lyon Mackenzie je na otoku Navy na reki Niagari ustanovil kratkotrajno »Republiko Kanado«, a se je kmalu zatem umaknil iz oboroženega spopada.

source.title: Rebellions of 1837–1838
paragraphs: The Rebellions of 1837–1838 (French: Rébellions de 1837) were two armed uprisings that took place in Lower and Upper Canada in 1837 and 1838. Both rebellions were motivated by frustrations with lack of political reform. A key shared goal was responsible government, which was eventually achieved in the incidents' aftermath. The rebellions led directly to Lord Durham's Report on the Affairs of British North America and to the Act of Union 1840 which joined the two colonies into the Province of Canada. The report and subsequent developments eventually led to the Constitution Act, 1867, which created the contemporary country of Canada and its government.

The Lower Canada Rebellion was more widespread and was more brutally suppressed. After the Upper Canada Rebellion was suppressed, fighting continued sporadically for months. Many of the rebels fled to the United States. Rebel leader William Lyon Mackenzie established a short-lived "Republic of Canada" on Navy Island in the Niagara River but withdrew from armed conflict soon thereafter.

Recuay culture.headline: Kultura Recuay
paragraphs: Kultura Recuay je bila predkolumbovska kultura perujskega visokogorja, ki je cvetela od leta 200 pr. n. št. do 600 n. št. in je bila sorodna močejski kulturi s severne obale. Ime je dobila po okraju Recuay v provinci Recuay v perujski regiji Ancash.

source.title: Recuay culture
paragraphs: The Recuay culture was a pre-Columbian culture of highland Peru that flourished from 200 BCE to 600 CE and was related to the Moche culture of the north coast. It is named after the Recuay District, in the Recuay Province, in the Ancash Region of Peru.

Vojna Rdečega oblaka (imenovana tudi vojna za Bozeman ali vojna ob reki Powder) je bil oborožen spopad med zavezništvom ljudstev Lakota, severnih Šajenov in severnih Arapahov na eni strani ter Združenimi državami in narodom Vran na drugi, ki je od leta 1866 do 1868 potekal na ozemljih Wyoming in Montana. Bojevali so se za nadzor nad zahodno deželo ob reki Powder na današnjem severu osrednjega Wyominga in v Montani.

Evropski Američani so leta 1863 utrli Bozemanovo pot skozi osrčje tradicionalnega ozemlja Šajenov, Arapahov in Lakot. Bila je najkrajša in najlažja pot od utrdbe Fort Laramie in Oregonske poti do montanskih zlatih polj. Od leta 1864 do 1866 je po njej potovalo okoli 3500 rudarjev, priseljencev in drugih, ki so z Indijanci tekmovali za vse redkejše vire ob poti.

source.title: Red Cloud's War
paragraphs: Red Cloud's War (also referred to as the Bozeman War or the Powder River War) was an armed conflict between an alliance of the Lakota, Northern Cheyenne, and Northern Arapaho peoples against the United States and the Crow Nation that took place in the Wyoming and Montana territories from 1866 to 1868. The war was fought over control of the western Powder River Country in present-day north-central Wyoming and Montana.

In 1863, European Americans had blazed the Bozeman Trail through the heart of the traditional territory of the Cheyenne, Arapaho, and Lakota. It was the shortest and easiest route from Fort Laramie and the Oregon Trail to the Montana gold fields. From 1864 to 1866, the trail was traversed by about 3,500 miners, emigrant settlers and others, who competed with the Indians for the diminishing resources near the trail.

Red Ocher people.headline: Ljudstvo rdečega okra
paragraphs: Ljudstvo rdečega okra (Red Ocher) je bilo domorodno ljudstvo Severne Amerike. Za vrsto arheoloških najdišč na območju Gornjih Velikih jezer, širše doline reke Illinois in doline reke Ohio na ameriškem Srednjem zahodu so ugotovili, da sestavljajo pogrebni kompleks rdečega okra iz let 1000–400 pr. n. št., iz končnega arhaičnega in zgodnjega gozdnega obdobja. Gre za plitve grobove v peščenih slemenih ob rečnih dolinah, posute z rdečim okrom ali hidratiziranim železovim oksidom (FeH3O), z značilnimi najdbami, med katerimi so zakladi kremenovih konic, t. i. puranjih repov in različni izdelki iz obdelanega bakra. Puranji repi so velika kremenova rezila posebne vrste. Domnevajo, da je ljudstvo rdečega okra govorilo zgodnjo obliko algonkinskih jezikov.

Rdeči oker so v Severni Ameriki uporabljali že zelo dolgo: že v tradiciji Folsom v paleoindijanskem obdobju so ga kopali na nekaterih krajih v Novi Mehiki in Wyomingu. Ljudstvo, ki ga danes imenujemo ljudstvo rdečega okra, je prva prepoznala Univerza v Chicagu leta 1937.

source.title: Red Ocher people
paragraphs: The Red Ocher people were an indigenous people of North America. A series of archaeological sites located in the Upper Great Lakes, the Greater Illinois River Valley, and the Ohio River Valley in the American Midwest have been discovered to be a Red Ocher burial complex, dating from 1000 BC to 400 BC, the Terminal Archaic – Early Woodland period. Characterized as shallow burials located in sandy ridges along river valleys, covered in red ochre or hydrated iron oxide (FeH3O), they contain diagnostic artifacts that include caches of flint points, turkey-tails, and various forms of worked copper. Turkey-tails are large flint blades of a distinct type. It is believed that Red Ocher people spoke an ancestral form of the Algonquian languages.

Red ochre has a long history of use in North America; as early as the Folsom tradition during the Paleo-Indian period, certain localities in New Mexico and Wyoming were being mined for the substance. The people today known as Red Ocher were first identified by the University of Chicago in 1937.

Red Paint People.headline: Ljudstvo rdeče barve
paragraphs: Ljudstvo rdeče barve (Red Paint People) je predkolumbovska kultura, domača v Novi Angliji in atlantski Kanadi v Severni Ameriki, verjetno podskupina pomorskega arhaičnega kulturnega kompleksa.

source.title: Red Paint People
paragraphs: The Red Paint People are a Pre-Columbian culture indigenous to the New England and Atlantic Canada regions of North America, probably a subset of the Maritime Archaic cultural complex.

Upor Rdeče reke (francosko: Rébellion de la rivière Rouge), znan tudi kot odpor ob Rdeči reki, vstaja ob Rdeči reki ali prvi Rielov upor, je bilo zaporedje dogodkov, ki so leta 1869 pripeljali do tega, da so voditelj Métisov Louis Riel in njegovi privrženci v koloniji Red River ustanovili začasno vlado, v zgodnjih fazah nastajanja današnje kanadske province Manitoba. Prej je bilo to ozemlje, imenovano Rupertova dežela, ki ga je nadzorovala Hudsonova družba, preden so ga prodali.

source.title: Red River Rebellion
paragraphs: The Red River Rebellion (French: Rébellion de la rivière Rouge), also known as the Red River Resistance, Red River uprising, or First Riel Rebellion, was the sequence of events that led up to the 1869 establishment of a provisional government by Métis leader Louis Riel and his followers at the Red River Colony, in the early stages of establishing today's Canadian province of Manitoba. It had earlier been a territory called Rupert's Land and been under control of the Hudson's Bay Company before it was sold.

Reform War.headline: Reformna vojna
paragraphs: Reformna vojna (17. decembra 1857–11. januarja 1861) ali vojna za reformo (špansko: Guerra de Reforma), znana tudi kot triletna vojna (Guerra de los Tres Años) in mehiška državljanska vojna, je bil zapleten državljanski spopad v Mehiki med mehiškimi liberalci in konservativci, z regionalnimi razlikami, zaradi razglasitve ustave iz leta 1857. Imenujejo jo »najhujša državljanska vojna, ki je prizadela Mehiko med osamosvojitveno vojno 1810–1821 in revolucijo 1910–1920«. Potem ko so liberalci strmoglavili diktaturo konservativca Antonia Lópeza de Santa Anne, so sprejeli vrsto zakonov, ki so kodificirali njihov politični program in so jih vključili v novo ustavo. Ta je hotela omejiti politično moč izvršne oblasti ter politično, gospodarsko in kulturno moč katoliške cerkve. Med konkretnimi ukrepi so bili razlastitev cerkvenega premoženja, ločitev cerkve od države, zmanjšanje moči mehiške vojske z odpravo njenih posebnih privilegijev, krepitev posvetne države z javnim šolstvom in ukrepi za gospodarski razvoj države.

source.title: Reform War
paragraphs: The Reform War (17 December 1857 – 11 January 1861) or War of Reform (Spanish: Guerra de Reforma), also known as the Three Years' War (Spanish: Guerra de los Tres Años) and the Mexican Civil War, was a complex civil conflict in Mexico that was fought between Mexican liberals and conservatives with regional variations over the promulgation of the Constitution of 1857. It has been called the "worst civil war to hit Mexico between the War of Independence of 1810–21 and the Revolution of 1910–20." Following the liberals' overthrow of the dictatorship of the conservative Antonio López de Santa Anna, the liberals passed a series of laws that codified their political program that were incorporated into the new constitution. It aimed to limit the political power of the executive branch, as well as the political, economic, and cultural power of the Catholic Church. Specific measures were the expropriation of church property, the separation of church and state, reduction of the power of the Mexican Army by the elimination of its special privileges, the strengthening of the secular state through public educations, and measures to develop the nation economically.

Konvencijo o registraciji v vesolje izstreljenih predmetov (splošno znano kot konvencija ali sporazum o registraciji) je Generalna skupščina Združenih narodov sprejela leta 1974, veljati pa je začela leta 1976. Januarja 2026 jo je ratificiralo 78 držav.

Konvencija od držav zahteva, da Združenim narodom sporočijo podatke o tirnici vsakega vesoljskega predmeta. Register izstrelitev so Združeni narodi vodili že na podlagi resolucije Generalne skupščine iz leta 1962.

Konvencijo o registraciji in štiri druge pogodbe vesoljskega prava, med njimi Pogodbo o vesolju, sporazum o reševanju, konvencijo o odgovornosti in sporazum o Luni, upravlja Odbor Združenih narodov za miroljubno uporabo vesolja.

source.title: Registration Convention
paragraphs: The Convention on Registration of Objects Launched into Outer Space (commonly known as the Registration Convention or Registration Agreement) was adopted by the United Nations General Assembly in 1974 and went into force in 1976. As of January 2026, it has been ratified by 78 states.

The convention requires states to furnish the United Nations with details about the orbit of each space object. A registry of launchings was already being maintained by the United Nations as a result of a General Assembly Resolution in 1962.

The Registration Convention and four other space law treaties, including the Outer Space Treaty, the Rescue Agreement, the Liability Convention, and the Moon Agreement are administered by the United Nations Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space.

Republic of Baja California.headline: Republika Spodnja Kalifornija
paragraphs: Republika Spodnja Kalifornija (špansko: República de Baja California) je bila predlagana država v letih 1853 in 1854, potem ko je ameriškemu vodji zasebne vojske Williamu Walkerju spodletel vdor iz Arizone v Sonoro. Walker si je hotel prilastiti Sonoro, njegove zahteve pa so v Združenih državah uživale podporo tajkunov in popustljivost vlade.

source.title: Republic of Baja California
paragraphs: The Republic of Baja California, also known in Spanish as the República de Baja California, was a proposed state from 1853 to 1854, after American private military leader William Walker failed to invade Sonora from Arizona. Walker wanted to appropriate Sonora, and his claims had both the support of tycoons and government complacency in the United States.

Republika Nova Granada je bila centralistična unitarna republika, ki je od leta 1831 do 1858 obsegala predvsem današnjo Kolumbijo in Panamo ter manjše dele današnje Kostarike, Ekvadorja, Venezuele, Peruja in Brazilije. Nastala je po razpadu Velike Kolumbije leta 1830, ko sta se odcepila Ekvador in Venezuela. Leta 1858 so jo preimenovali v Granadsko konfederacijo.
Državno zastavo z barvami Velike Kolumbije v Velesovi razporeditvi so sprejeli 9. maja 1834 in jo uporabljali do 26. novembra 1861. Trgovska zastava je imela belo osemkrako zvezdo.

source.title: Republic of New Granada
paragraphs: The Republic of New Granada was a centralist unitary republic consisting primarily of present-day Colombia and Panama with smaller portions of today's Costa Rica, Ecuador, Venezuela, Peru and Brazil that existed from 1831 to 1858. The state was created after the dissolution of Gran Colombia in 1830 through the secession of Ecuador and Venezuela. In 1858, the state was renamed into the Granadine Confederation.
The national flag, with the Gran Colombian colours in Veles' arrangement, was adopted on 9 May 1834 and used until 26 November 1861. The merchant ensign had the eight-pointed star in white.

Republika Rio Grande (špansko: República del Río Grande) je ime, ki so ga angloameriški časopisi in poznejši zgodovinski spisi dali federalističnemu uporu ob spodnjem toku reke Rio Grande v letih 1838–1840. Hunta, ki se je 23. januarja 1840 sestala v Casa Blanci pod vodstvom Antonia Canalesa Rosilla, Jesúsa de Cárdenasa in drugih, ni priznala centralistične vlade v Ciudad de Méxicu in je postavila začasno vlado, dokler se ne bi sestala skupščina vseh mehiških zveznih držav. Upor se je končal s konvencijo v Camargu 6. novembra 1840, ki jo je ratificiral Canales in odobril general Mariano Arista.

Teksaški viri so gibanje obravnavali kot odcepitev po zgledu Republike Teksas. Dokumenti voditeljev upora pa tega imena ne uporabljajo in o odcepitvi ne govorijo; v njih stojijo izrazi frontera del norte, villas del norte in gobierno provisional.

source.title: Republic of the Rio Grande
paragraphs: The Republic of the Rio Grande (Spanish: República del Río Grande) is the name given in Anglo‐American newspapers, and in later histories, to a federalist revolt on the lower Rio Grande in 1838–1840. A junta at Casa Blanca on 23 January 1840, headed by Antonio Canales Rosillo, Jesús de Cárdenas, and others withheld recognition from the centralist government in Mexico City and set up a provisional government until a convention of all the states of Mexico could meet. The revolt ended with the convention of Camargo on 6 November 1840, ratified by Canales and approved by General Mariano Arista.

Texas accounts have treated the movement as a secession on the model of the Republic of Texas. The leaders' own papers do not use the name and do not speak of separation; they use frontera del norte, villas del norte and gobierno provisional.

Revolution of 1930.headline: Revolucija leta 1930
paragraphs: Revolucija leta 1930 (portugalsko: Revolução de 1930) je bila oborožena vstaja po vsej Braziliji, ki je končala staro republiko. Revolucija je predsednika Washingtona Luísa zamenjala s poraženim predsedniškim kandidatom in revolucionarnim voditeljem Getúliom Vargasom, končala politično prevlado štiri desetletja stare oligarhije in začela Vargasovo dobo.

Večji del poznega 19. in zgodnjega 20. stoletja je brazilsko politiko obvladovalo zavezništvo zveznih držav São Paulo in Minas Gerais. Predsedniški položaj se je med njima izmenjeval na vsakih volitvah do leta 1929, ko je predsednik Washington Luís razglasil, da bo njegov naslednik Júlio Prestes, prav tako iz São Paula. Kot odgovor na izdajo oligarhije so Minas Gerais, Rio Grande do Sul in Paraíba ustanovili liberalno zavezništvo, ki je podprlo opozicijskega kandidata Getúlia Vargasa, predsednika države Rio Grande do Sul.

source.title: Revolution of 1930
paragraphs: The Revolution of 1930 (Portuguese: Revolução de 1930) was an armed insurrection across Brazil that ended the Old Republic. The revolution replaced incumbent president Washington Luís with defeated presidential candidate and revolutionary leader Getúlio Vargas, concluding the political hegemony of a four-decade-old oligarchy and beginning the Vargas Era.

For most of the late 19th and early 20th centuries, Brazilian politics had been controlled by an alliance between the states of São Paulo and Minas Gerais. The presidency had alternated between them every election until 1929, when incumbent President Washington Luís declared his successor would be Júlio Prestes, also from São Paulo. In response to the betrayal of the oligarchy, Minas Gerais, Rio Grande do Sul, and Paraíba formed a Liberal Alliance backing opposition candidate Getúlio Vargas, president of Rio Grande do Sul.

Rio Protocol.headline: Protokol iz Ria de Janeira
paragraphs: Protokol o miru, prijateljstvu in mejah med Perujem in Ekvadorjem, na kratko protokol iz Ria de Janeira, je bil mednarodni sporazum, ki sta ga 29. januarja 1942 v Riu de Janeiru v Braziliji podpisala zunanja ministra Peruja in Ekvadorja, z Združenimi državami, Brazilijo, Čilom in Argentino kot porokinjami. Protokol naj bi dokončno razrešil dolgotrajni ozemeljski spor med državama in je uradno končal ekvadorsko-perujsko vojno v letih 1941–1942. Bil pa je nepopoln, zato je med Perujem in Ekvadorjem še dvakrat izbruhnila vojna, leta 1981 in 1995, preden sta državi podpisali mirovno deklaracijo iz Itamaratyja, ki je spor dokončno razrešila.

source.title: Rio Protocol
paragraphs: The Protocol of Peace, Friendship, and Boundaries between Peru and Ecuador, or Rio Protocol for short, was an international agreement signed in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, on January 29, 1942, by the foreign ministers of Peru and Ecuador, with the participation of the United States, Brazil, Chile, and Argentina as guarantors. The Protocol was intended to finally resolve the long-running territorial dispute between the two countries, and brought about the official end of the Ecuadorian–Peruvian War of 1941–1942. Nevertheless, the Protocol was incomplete, and war broke out between Peru and Ecuador twice more, in 1981 and in 1995, before the signing of the Itamaraty Peace Declaration which brought final resolution to the dispute.

Republika Riograndense, pogosto imenovana Republika Piratini (portugalsko: República Rio-Grandense ali República do Piratini), je bila dejanska država, ki se je odcepila od Brazilskega cesarstva in se je v grobem ujemala z današnjo zvezno državo Rio Grande do Sul. Razglasil jo je 11. septembra 1836 general Antônio de Sousa Neto, kar je bila neposredna posledica zmage oligarhičnih gavčovskih sil v bitki pri Seivalu (1836) med vojno raztrgancev (1835–1845). Leta 1843 je sprejela ustavo, priznali pa so jo le Združeno kraljestvo, Francija in Urugvaj.
notes: Ragamuffin War rendered as vojna raztrgancev (Guerra dos Farrapos); worth a reviewer's check.

source.title: Riograndense Republic
paragraphs: The Riograndense Republic, often called the Piratini Republic (Portuguese: República Rio-Grandense or República do Piratini), was a de facto state that seceded from the Empire of Brazil and roughly coincided with the present state of Rio Grande do Sul. It was proclaimed on 11 September 1836 by general Antônio de Sousa Neto as a direct consequence of the victory obtained by gaúcho oligarchic forces at the Battle of Seival (1836) during the Ragamuffin War (1835–1845). It had a constitution adopted in 1843 and was recognised only by the United Kingdom, France, and Uruguay.

Roerich Pact.headline: Roerichov pakt
paragraphs: Pogodba o zaščiti umetniških in znanstvenih ustanov ter zgodovinskih spomenikov ali Roerichov pakt je medameriška pogodba. Njena najpomembnejša zamisel je pravno priznanje, da je obramba kulturnih dobrin pomembnejša od uporabe ali uničenja kulture v vojaške namene in da ima zaščita kulture vedno prednost pred vsako vojaško nujnostjo.

source.title: Roerich Pact
paragraphs: The Treaty on the Protection of Artistic and Scientific Institutions and Historic Monuments or Roerich Pact is an inter-American treaty. The most important idea of the Roerich Pact is the legal recognition that the defense of cultural objects is more important than the use or destruction of that culture for military purposes, and the protection of culture always has precedence over any military necessity.

Sveti Krištof (angleško: Saint Kitts ali Saint Christopher) je otok v Zahodni Indiji. Zahodna stran otoka meji na Karibsko morje, vzhodna obala pa gleda na Atlantski ocean. Sveti Krištof in sosednji otok Nevis sestavljata eno državo, Federacijo Sveti Krištof in Nevis. Ločuje ju plitev, 3 kilometre širok preliv, imenovan The Narrows.

Na Svetem Krištofu sta sredi 1620. let nastali prvi britanska in francoska kolonija na Karibih. Skupaj z otokom Nevis je bil Sveti Krištof del Britanske Zahodne Indije, dokler se ni 19. septembra 1983 osamosvojil.
Otok spada med Privetrne otoke v Malih Antilih in leži okoli 2100 km jugovzhodno od Miamija na Floridi v ZDA. Meri okoli 168 km², dolg je približno 29 km, širok pa v povprečju okoli 8 km.

source.title: Saint Kitts
paragraphs: Saint Kitts, also known as Saint Christopher, is an island in the West Indies. The west side of the island borders the Caribbean Sea, and the eastern coast faces the Atlantic Ocean. Saint Kitts and the neighbouring island of Nevis constitute one country: the Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis. Saint Kitts and Nevis are separated by a shallow 3-kilometre (2 mi) channel known as "The Narrows".

Saint Kitts became home to the first Caribbean British and French colonies in the mid-1620s. Along with the island of Nevis, Saint Kitts was a member of the British West Indies until gaining independence on 19 September 1983.

The island is one of the Leeward Islands in the Lesser Antilles. It is situated about 2,100 km (1,300 mi) southeast of Miami, Florida, US. The land area of Saint Kitts is about 168 km2 (65 sq mi), being approximately 29 km (18 mi) long and on average about 8 km (5.0 mi) across.

Saladoid.headline: Saladoidna kultura
paragraphs: Saladoidna kultura je predkolumbovska domorodna kultura na ozemlju današnje Venezuele in Karibov, ki je cvetela od leta 500 pr. n. št. do 545 n. št. Njeni nosilci so živeli predvsem v nižinah ob reki Orinoko, nato pa so se po morju preselili na Male Antile in naprej v Portoriko.

source.title: Saladoid
paragraphs: The Saladoid culture is a pre-Columbian Indigenous culture of territory in present-day Venezuela and the Caribbean that flourished from 500 BCE to 545 CE. Concentrated along the lowlands of the Orinoco River, the people migrated by sea to the Lesser Antilles, and then to Puerto Rico.

Salinar culture.headline: Kultura Salinar
paragraphs: Salinar je arheološka kultura starega Peruja, ki se je razvila na obalnem območju Ancasha in La Libertada.

Ko je kultura Chavín na severni obali zamrla, so se manjša gospostva, ki so bila med seboj v stiku, združila v kulturo Salinar, ki se je začela med letoma 500 in 200 pr. n. št. in končala okoli leta 300 n. št. Ta kultura pomeni prehod med kulturo Chavín in vzponom močejske kulture. V tem času so razširili namakalne sisteme in močno povečali obdelovalne površine. Naselja so bila večinoma majhna in osamljena, nekatera najdišča pa so prave mestne velikosti, na primer Cerro Arena v dolini Moche, obsežno najdišče s približno 2000 kamnitimi stavbami na površini 2 km², kjer so bivalni predeli ter obredna in upravna središča. Ljudstvo je na najvišjih delih gričev gradilo utrdbe za zaščito naselij, kar kaže, da so v času te kulture potekale obsežne vojne, v katerih je sodelovalo vse prebivalstvo.

source.title: Salinar culture
paragraphs: Salinar is an archaeological culture of Ancient Peru that developed in the coastal area of Ancash and La Libertad.

When the Chavín culture declined, on the north coast, small lordships that were in contact united and formed the Salinar culture, which began between 500 and 200 BCE and ended around 300 CE. This culture is the one that marked the transition between the Chavin culture and the advent of the Mochica culture. During this time, irrigation systems were expanded, significantly increasing the agricultural area. The settlements were generally small and isolated, but there are sites of urban proportions, such as Cerro Arena in the Moche Valley, an extensive site with about 2000 stone structures distributed over a surface of 2 km2, where there are habitation areas, ceremonial and administrative centers. The culture built fortifications to protect the towns on the highest part of the hills, which indicates extensive wars during the existence of this culture, ones where all the people intervened.

Salvadorska državljanska vojna (špansko: guerra civil de El Salvador) je bila dvanajstletna državljanska vojna v Salvadorju med salvadorsko vlado, ki so jo podpirale Združene države, in Narodnoosvobodilno fronto Farabunda Martíja (FMLN), koalicijo levičarskih gverilskih skupin, ki so jo podpirale Kuba Fidela Castra, Nikaragva Daniela Ortege in Sovjetska zveza. Za začetek državljanske vojne splošno štejejo državni udar 15. oktobra 1979, ki so mu sledili vladni poboji protestnikov proti udaru. Vojna se je formalno končala šele po razpadu Sovjetske zveze, ko so 16. januarja 1992 v Ciudad de Méxicu podpisali mirovne sporazume iz Chapultepeca.

Po poročilih Združenih narodov (OZN) je vojna med letoma 1979 in 1992 zahtevala več kot 75.000 življenj, okoli 8000 ljudi pa je izginilo. Kršitve človekovih pravic, zlasti ugrabitve, mučenje in umori domnevnih simpatizerjev FMLN, ki so jih zagrešile državne varnostne sile in paravojaški odredi smrti, so bile vsesplošne.

source.title: Salvadoran Civil War
paragraphs: The Salvadoran Civil War (Spanish: guerra civil de El Salvador) was a twelve-year civil war in El Salvador that was fought between the government of El Salvador that was backed by the United States, against the Farabundo Martí National Liberation Front (FMLN), a coalition of left-wing guerrilla groups that was backed by Cuba under Fidel Castro, Daniel Ortega's Nicaragua and the Soviet Union. A coup on 15 October 1979 followed by government killings of anti-coup protesters is widely seen as the start of the civil war. The war did not formally end until after the collapse of the Soviet Union, when, on 16 January 1992 the Chapultepec Peace Accords were signed in Mexico City.

The United Nations (UN) reports that the war killed more than 75,000 people between 1979 and 1992, along with approximately 8,000 disappeared persons. Human rights violations, particularly the kidnapping, torture, and murder of suspected FMLN sympathizers by state security forces and paramilitary death squads, were pervasive.

San Agustín culture.headline: Kultura San Agustín
paragraphs: Kultura San Agustín je ena starodavnih predkolumbovskih kultur Kolumbije. Njeni začetki segajo vsaj v 4. tisočletje pr. n. št. Tu so našli več sto velikih monolitnih kipov.

Raziskave izvora in narave te kulture še potekajo. Kultura San Agustín je bila za svoj čas precej razvita v poljedelstvu, lončarstvu, zlatarstvu in kiparstvu. Njena najdišča ležijo večinoma v narodnem arheološkem parku Tierradentro (Parque Arqueológico Nacional de Tierradentro) in arheološkem parku San Agustín.

source.title: San Agustín culture
paragraphs: The San Agustín culture is one of the ancient Pre-Columbian cultures of Colombia. Its beginnings go back at least to the fourth millennium B.C. Several hundred large monolithic sculptures have been found here.

There is an ongoing scientific study into the culture's origins and nature. For its period, the San Agustín culture displays considerable development in agriculture, ceramics, goldsmithing, and sculptural art. The site of the culture lies mostly within the Parque Arqueológico Nacional de Tierradentro and the San Agustín Archaeological Park.

Santa Rosa–Swift Creek culture.headline: Kultura Santa Rosa–Swift Creek
paragraphs: Za kulturo Santa Rosa–Swift Creek so značilni razkošni obredni kompleksi, vse večja družbena in politična zapletenost, pokop v gomilah, stalna naselja, rast prebivalstva in vse večja odvisnost od gojenih rastlin. »Santa Rosa« se navezuje na arheološko najdišče na otoku Santa Rosa v okrožju Santa Rosa na Floridi, »Swift Creek« pa na arheološko najdišče ob potoku Swift Creek v okrožju Bibb v Georgii.

Iz kulture Deptford zgodnjega gozdnega obdobja se je na istem kraju razvila kultura Santa Rosa–Swift Creek. V grobnih gomilah so našli trgovsko blago, med drugim bakrene panove piščali, okraske za ušesa, kamnite uteži in kamnite naprsne ščitke. Ti kažejo, da je bilo območje do okoli leta 100 n. št. vključeno v hopewellsko interakcijsko sfero.

source.title: Santa Rosa–Swift Creek culture
paragraphs: The Santa Rosa–Swift Creek culture was characterized by the appearance of elaborate ceremonial complexes, increasing social and political complexity, mound burial, permanent settlements, population growth, and an increasing reliance on cultigens. "Santa Rosa" is associated with the archeological site Santa Rosa Island, Santa Rosa County, Florida. "Swift Creek" is associated with the archeological site near Swift Creek, Bibb County, Georgia.

The Early Woodland Deptford culture evolved in place to become the Santa Rosa–Swift Creek culture. Burial mounds have yielded trade items which include copper panpipes, ear ornaments, stone plummets, and stone gorgets. These show this area's incorporation within the Hopewellian Interaction Sphere by about AD 100.

Druga bitka pri Bull Runu ali druga bitka pri Manassasu je potekala od 28. do 30. avgusta 1862 v okrožju Prince William v Virginiji, med ameriško državljansko vojno. Bila je vrhunec severnovirginijske kampanje, ki jo je Severnovirginijska armada konfederacijskega generala Roberta E. Leeja vodila proti Virginijski armadi generalmajorja Unije Johna Popa, in precej večja bitka od prve bitke pri Bull Runu (ali prve bitke pri Manassasu), ki je 21. julija 1861 potekala na istem kraju.

source.title: Second Battle of Bull Run
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Bull Run or Battle of Second Manassas was fought August 28–30, 1862, in Prince William County, Virginia, as part of the American Civil War. It was the culmination of the Northern Virginia campaign waged by Confederate Gen. Robert E. Lee's Army of Northern Virginia against Union Maj. Gen. John Pope's Army of Virginia, and a battle of much larger scale and numbers than the First Battle of Bull Run (or First Manassas) fought on July 21, 1861, on the same ground.

Second Battle of Guararapes.headline: Druga bitka pri Guararapesu
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Guararapesu je bila druga in odločilna bitka pernambuške vstaje med nizozemskimi in portugalskimi silami februarja 1649 pri Jaboatão dos Guararapesu v Pernambucu. Poraz je Nizozemce prepričal, »da so Portugalci nevarni nasprotniki, česar dotlej niso hoteli priznati«. Nizozemci so v Braziliji ostali še do leta 1654, pogodbo pa so podpisali leta 1661.

source.title: Second Battle of Guararapes
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Guararapes was the second and decisive battle in the Insurrection of Pernambuco between Dutch and Portuguese forces in February 1649 at Jaboatão dos Guararapes in Pernambuco. The defeat convinced the Dutch "that the Portuguese were formidable opponents, something which they had hitherto refused to concede." The Dutch still retained a presence in Brazil until 1654 and a treaty was signed in 1661.

Drugo mehiško cesarstvo (špansko: Segundo Imperio mexicano), uradno Mehiško cesarstvo (Imperio Mexicano), je bila ustavna monarhija, ki so jo v Mehiki ob podpori drugega francoskega cesarstva ustanovili mehiški monarhisti. To obdobje pogosto imenujejo druga francoska intervencija v Mehiki. Francoski cesar Napoleon III. je s podporo mehiških konservativcev, duhovščine in plemstva hotel v Amerikah ustvariti monarhističnega zaveznika, ki bi uravnotežil vse večjo moč Združenih držav.

Mehiški monarhisti, ki so izgubili državljansko vojno proti mehiškim liberalcem, so prestol ponudili avstrijskemu nadvojvodi Maksimilijanu iz habsburško-lotarinške rodbine, ki je bil v sorodu z vladarji kolonialne Mehike. Njegov vzpon na prestol so potrdili s spornim referendumom. Njegova žena, belgijska princesa Šarlota iz saško-coburško-gotske rodbine, je postala mehiška cesarica, v Mehiki znana kot »Carlota«.

source.title: Second Mexican Empire
paragraphs: The Second Mexican Empire (Spanish: Segundo Imperio mexicano), officially known as the Mexican Empire (Spanish: Imperio Mexicano), was a constitutional monarchy established in Mexico by Mexican monarchists with the support of the Second French Empire. This period is often referred to as the Second French intervention in Mexico. The French Emperor, Napoleon III, with backing from Mexican conservatives, the clergy, and nobility, aimed to establish a monarchist ally in the Americas as a counterbalance to the growing power of the United States.

The throne of Mexico was offered by Mexican monarchists, who had lost a civil war against Mexican liberals, to Austrian Archduke Maximilian of the House of Habsburg-Lorraine, who had ancestral ties to the rulers of colonial Mexico. Maximilian's ascension was ratified through a controversial referendum. His wife, Belgian princess Charlotte of the House of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha, became the empress consort of Mexico, known locally as "Carlota".

Drugi izbirni protokol k Mednarodnemu paktu o državljanskih in političnih pravicah, ki si prizadeva za odpravo smrtne kazni, je dopolnilni sporazum k paktu. Nastal je 15. decembra 1989, veljati pa je začel 11. julija 1991. Decembra 2024 je imel 92 pogodbenic. Nazadnje ga je 19. decembra 2024 ratificirala Zambija.

source.title: Second Optional Protocol to the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights
paragraphs: The Second Optional Protocol to the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, aiming at the abolition of the death penalty, is a subsidiary agreement to the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights. It was created on 15 December 1989 and entered into force on 11 July 1991. As of December 2024, the Optional Protocol has 92 state parties. The most recent country to ratify was Zambia, on 19 December 2024.

Druga seminolska vojna, znana tudi kot floridska vojna, je bil spopad od leta 1835 do 1842 na Floridi med Združenimi državami in skupinami ljudi, skupaj znanih kot Seminoli, med katerimi so bili Kriki in temnopolti Seminoli ter druga zavezniška plemena. Bila je del vrste spopadov, imenovanih seminolske vojne. Drugo seminolsko vojno, ki ji pogosto pravijo kar seminolska vojna, štejejo za »najdaljši in najdražji indijanski spopad Združenih držav«. Po pogodbi iz Payne's Landinga leta 1832, ki je zahtevala izselitev Seminolov s Floride, so napetosti naraščale, dokler niso leta 1835 v Dadovem pokolu izbruhnile ostre sovražnosti. Ta spopad je uradno začel vojno, čeprav je bitki z Dadom predhodila vrsta incidentov. Seminoli in ameriške sile so se več kot šest let spopadali predvsem v manjših spopadih. Do leta 1842 je na Floridi ostalo le nekaj sto domorodcev. Mirovne pogodbe niso nikoli podpisali, a je polkovnik William Jenkins Worth 14. avgusta 1842 razglasil konec vojne.

source.title: Second Seminole War
paragraphs: The Second Seminole War, also known as the Florida War, was a conflict from 1835 to 1842 in Florida between the United States and groups of people collectively known as Seminoles, consisting of Creek and Black Seminoles as well as other allied tribes (see below). It was part of a series of conflicts called the Seminole Wars. The Second Seminole War, often referred to as the Seminole War, is regarded as "the longest and most costly of the Indian conflicts of the United States". After the Treaty of Payne's Landing in 1832 that called for the Seminoles' removal from Florida, tensions rose until fierce hostilities occurred in Dade's massacre in 1835. This engagement officially started the war although there were a series of incidents leading up to the Dade battle. The Seminoles and the U.S. forces engaged in mostly small engagements for more than six years. By 1842, only a few hundred native people remained in Florida. Although no peace treaty was ever signed, the war was declared over on August 14, 1842, by Colonel William Jenkins Worth.

Varnostna pogodba med Združenimi državami Amerike in Japonsko (japonsko: 日本国とアメリカ合衆国との間の安全保障条約, Nippon-koku to Amerika Gasshūkoku to no aida no anzen hoshō jōyaku) je bila pogodba, ki so jo predstavniki Združenih držav in Japonske podpisali 8. septembra 1951 v San Franciscu v Kaliforniji, skupaj s sanfranciško mirovno pogodbo, ki je končala drugo svetovno vojno v Aziji. Združene države so pogodbo Japonski vsilile kot pogoj za konec okupacije Japonske in obnovo njene suverenosti. Vzpostavila je dolgotrajno vojaško zavezništvo med državama.

source.title: Security Treaty between the United States and Japan
paragraphs: The Security Treaty between the United States and Japan (日本国とアメリカ合衆国との間の安全保障条約, Nippon-koku to Amerika Gasshūkoku to no aida no anzen hoshō jōyaku) was a treaty signed on September 8, 1951 in San Francisco, California, by representatives of the United States and Japan, in conjunction with the Treaty of San Francisco that ended World War II in Asia. The treaty was imposed on Japan by the United States as a condition for ending the occupation of Japan and restoring Japan's sovereignty as a nation. It established a long-lasting military alliance between the United States and Japan.

Seminolske vojne (znane tudi kot floridske vojne) so bile vrsta treh vojaških spopadov med Združenimi državami in Seminoli, ki so potekali na Floridi približno med letoma 1816 in 1858. Seminolsko pleme Floride spopad praviloma razume kot eno dolgo vojno, ne kot tri ločene. Tudi ko Seminoli niso bili v neposrednem spopadu z vojsko, so se namreč še vedno soočali z nasiljem in napadi ameriških naseljencev, krajevnih milic, predstavnikov oblasti in lovcev na sužnje.

source.title: Seminole Wars
paragraphs: The Seminole Wars (also known as the Florida Wars) were a series of three military conflicts between the United States and the Seminoles that took place in Florida between about 1816 and 1858. The Seminole Tribe of Florida tend to view the conflict as one long war as opposed to three separate wars. This happened because even when the Seminole were not in direct conflict with the Army, they still faced violence and aggression from American settlers, local militias, lawmen, and slave catchers.

Sedemdnevna bitka je bila vrsta sedmih bitk v sedmih dneh, od 25. junija do 1. julija 1862, blizu Richmonda v Virginiji med ameriško državljansko vojno. Konfederacijski general Robert E. Lee je Potomaško armado Unije pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Georgea B. McClellana odrinil od Richmonda in jo prisilil k umiku po Virginijskem polotoku. Vrsto bitk včasih napačno imenujejo sedemdnevna kampanja, v resnici pa je bila vrhunec polotoške kampanje, ne samostojna kampanja.

source.title: Seven Days Battles
paragraphs: The Seven Days Battles were a series of seven battles over seven days from June 25 to July 1, 1862, near Richmond, Virginia, during the American Civil War. Confederate General Robert E. Lee drove the Union army's Army of the Potomac, commanded by Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan, away from Richmond and into a retreat down the Virginia Peninsula. The series of battles is sometimes known erroneously as the Seven Days campaign, but it was actually the culmination of the Peninsula campaign, not a separate campaign in its own right.

Shays's Rebellion.headline: Shaysov upor
paragraphs: Shaysov upor je bila oborožena vstaja v zahodnem Massachusettsu in Worcestru, ki je izbruhnila zaradi dolžniške krize med prebivalci in proti vse večjim prizadevanjem državne vlade, da bi pobrala davke od posameznikov in njihovih obrti. Boji so v letih 1786 in 1787 potekali v okolici Springfielda. Raziskovalci so dolgo trdili, da je štiri tisoč upornikov, imenovanih šejsovci, ki so protestirali proti gospodarskim in državljanskim krivicam massachusettske vlade, vodil veteran osamosvojitvene vojne Daniel Shays. Do začetka 2020. let pa so raziskave pokazale, da je bila Shaysova vloga v protestih močno pretirana.

source.title: Shays's Rebellion
paragraphs: Shays's Rebellion was an armed uprising in Western Massachusetts and Worcester in response to a debt crisis among the citizenry and in opposition to the state government's increased efforts to collect taxes on both individuals and their trades. The fighting took place in the areas around Springfield during 1786 and 1787. Historically, scholars have argued that the four thousand rebels, called Shaysites, who protested against economic and civil rights injustices by the Massachusetts government were led by Revolutionary War veteran Daniel Shays.
