By the early 2020s, scholarship has suggested that Shays's role in the protests was significantly exaggerated.

Sherman's March to the Sea.headline: Shermanov pohod do morja
paragraphs: Shermanov pohod do morja, uradno imenovan kampanja za Savannah ali kar Shermanov pohod, je bil vojaški pohod ameriške državljanske vojne, ki ga je od 15. novembra do 21. decembra 1864 po Georgii vodil generalmajor vojske Združenih držav William T. Sherman. Začel se je 15. novembra, ko so Shermanove čete zapustile Atlanto, ki so jo sile Unije pod njegovim poveljstvom nedavno zavzele, in se končal z zavzetjem pristanišča Savannah 21. decembra. Po zgledu chevauchéeja srednjeveškega evropskega vojskovanja so njegove sile izvajale politiko »požgane zemlje« in uničevale vojaške cilje, industrijo, infrastrukturo in civilno lastnino ter tako hromile gospodarstvo in prometna omrežja Konfederacije.

Operacija je Konfederacijo izčrpala in pripomogla k njenemu končnemu propadu. Shermanova odločitev, da bo deloval globoko na sovražnem ozemlju brez oskrbovalnih poti, je bila za tisti čas nenavadna, njegov pohod »trde vojne« pa nekateri zgodovinarji štejejo za zgodnji primer totalne vojne v sodobnem vojskovanju.

source.title: Sherman's March to the Sea
paragraphs: Sherman's March to the Sea, officially known as the Savannah campaign, or simply Sherman's March, was a military campaign of the American Civil War conducted through Georgia from November 15 until December 21, 1864, by United States Army major general William T. Sherman. It began on November 15 with Sherman's troops leaving Atlanta, recently taken by Union forces under Sherman, and ended with the capture of the port of Savannah on December 21. Emulating the chevauchée of medieval European warfare, his forces followed a "scorched earth" policy, destroying military targets as well as industry, infrastructure, and civilian property, disrupting the Confederacy's economy and transportation networks.

The operation debilitated the Confederacy and helped lead to its eventual demise. Sherman's decision to operate deep within enemy territory without supply lines was unusual for its time, and his campaign of "hard war" is regarded by some historians as an early example of total war in modern warfare.

Sican culture.headline: Kultura Sicán
paragraphs: Kultura Sican (tudi Sicán) je ime, ki ga je arheolog Izumi Šimada dal kulturi, ki je približno med letoma 750 in 1375 n. št. poseljevala današnjo severno obalo Peruja. Po Šimadi Sican pomeni »Lunin tempelj«. Po perujski pokrajini jo imenujejo tudi kultura Lambayeque. Nasledila je močejsko kulturo, med arheologi in antropologi pa se še vedno krešejo mnenja, ali sta to res ločeni kulturi. Kulturo Sican po spremembah, ki jih kažejo arheološke najdbe, delijo na tri glavna obdobja.
notes: Izumi Shimada transcribed as Izumi Šimada.

source.title: Sican culture
paragraphs: The Sican (also Sicán) culture is the name that archaeologist Izumi Shimada gave to the culture that inhabited what is now the north coast of Peru between about 750 and 1375 CE. According to Shimada, Sican means "temple of the Moon". The Sican culture is also referred to as Lambayeque culture, after the name of the region in Peru. It succeeded the Moche culture. There is still controversy among archeologists and anthropologists over whether the two are separate cultures. The Sican culture is divided into three major periods based on cultural changes as evidenced in archeological artifacts.

Siege of Corinth.headline: Obleganje Corintha
paragraphs: Obleganje Corintha, znano tudi kot prva bitka pri Corinthu, je bil spopad ameriške državljanske vojne, ki je od 29. aprila do 30. maja 1862 potekal v Corinthu v Misisipiju. Skupina sil Unije pod vrhovnim poveljstvom generalmajorja Henryja W. Hallecka (ki je tedaj edinkrat v vojni poveljeval na bojišču) je mesec dni oblegala mesto, ki so ga branili konfederalci pod poveljstvom generala P. G. T. Beauregarda. Obleganje se je končalo tako, da so zvezne sile mesto zavzele.

source.title: Siege of Corinth
paragraphs: The siege of Corinth, also known as the first battle of Corinth, was an American Civil War engagement lasting from April 29 to May 30, 1862, in Corinth, Mississippi. A collection of Union forces under the overall command of Major General Henry W. Halleck (in his only field command of the war) engaged in a month-long siege of the city, whose Confederate occupants were commanded by General P.G.T. Beauregard. The siege resulted in the capture of the town by Federal forces.

Desetmesečno obleganje Cusca, ki ga je izvajala inkovska vojska pod poveljstvom sapa inke Manca Inca Yupanquija, se je začelo 6. maja 1536 in končalo marca 1537. Mesto je branila posadka španskih konkvistadorjev in indijanskih pomožnih enot pod vodstvom Hernanda Pizarra. Inki so z obleganjem upali obnoviti svoj imperij (1438–1533), a jim ni uspelo.

source.title: Siege of Cusco
paragraphs: The 10-month siege of Cusco by the Incan army under the command of Sapa Inca Manco Inca Yupanqui started on 6 May 1536 and ended in March 1537. The city was held by a garrison of Spanish conquistadors and Indian auxiliaries led by Hernando Pizarro. The Incans hoped to restore their empire (1438–1533) with this action, but it was ultimately unsuccessful.

Siege of Fort William Henry.headline: Obleganje utrdbe Fort William Henry
paragraphs: Obleganje utrdbe Fort William Henry (3.–9. avgusta 1757, francosko: Bataille de Fort William Henry) so izvedle francoske in indijanske sile pod vodstvom Louisa-Josepha de Montcalma proti britanski utrdbi Fort William Henry. Utrdbo na južnem koncu jezera George, na meji med britansko provinco New York in francosko provinco Kanado, je branila slabo podprta posadka britanskih rednih enot in provincialne milice pod vodstvom podpolkovnika Georgea Monroja.

Po več dneh obstreljevanja in naraščajočih izgubah se je Monro vdal Montcalmu, čigar sile so štele skoraj 2000 Indijancev različnih plemen. Pogoji vdaje so vključevali umik posadke v utrdbo Fort Edward, s posebnim določilom, da francoska vojska Britance med umikom z območja zaščiti pred Indijanci.

source.title: Siege of Fort William Henry
paragraphs: The siege of Fort William Henry (3–9 August 1757, French: Bataille de Fort William Henry) was conducted by a French and Indian force led by Louis-Joseph de Montcalm against the British-held Fort William Henry. This fort, located at the southern end of Lake George, on the frontier between the British Province of New York and the French Province of Canada, was garrisoned by a poorly supported force of British regulars and provincial militia led by Lieutenant Colonel George Monro.

After several days of bombardment and increasing casualty rates, Monro surrendered to Montcalm, whose force included nearly 2,000 Indians from various tribes. The terms of surrender included the withdrawal of the garrison to Fort Edward, with specific terms that the French military protect the British from the Indians as they withdrew from the area.

Obleganje Havane je bilo zavzetje španskega mesta Havana na Kubi leta 1762 v vojni med Britanijo in Španijo, ki je bila del širše sedemletne vojne. Ko je Španija s podpisom družinskega pakta s Francijo opustila dotedanjo nevtralnost, je Britanija januarja 1762 Španiji napovedala vojno. Britanska vlada se je odločila napasti pomembno špansko pomorsko oporišče Havano, da bi oslabila Špansko Zahodno Indijo in izboljšala varnost svojih ameriških kolonij. Sile kraljeve mornarice z eskadrami iz Britanije in Zahodne Indije, ki so spremljale 160 prevoznih ladij, so se Havani približale iz smeri, od koder tega nista pričakovala ne guverner Juan de Prado ne admiral Gutierre de Hevia; de Hevievo floto so ujele v havanskem pristanišču in čete izkrcale ob razmeroma majhnem odporu.

source.title: Siege of Havana
paragraphs: The siege of Havana was the capture of the Spanish-held city of Havana, Cuba in 1762 as part of the war between Britain and Spain which formed part of the larger Seven Years' War. After the Spanish abandoned their former policy of neutrality by signing the family compact with France, Britain declared war on Spain in January 1762. The British government decided to mount an attack on the important Spanish naval base of Havana, with the intention of weakening the Spanish West Indies and improving the security of its own American colonies. A Royal Navy force consisting of squadrons from Britain and the West Indies, escorting 160 troopships, were able to approach Havana from a direction that neither Governor Juan de Prado nor Admiral Gutierre de Hevia expected and were able to trap de Hevia's fleet in the Havana harbour and land their troops with relatively little resistance.

Siege of Louisbourg (1758).headline: Obleganje Louisbourga (1758)
paragraphs: Obleganje Louisbourga (8. junija–26. julija 1758) je med sedemletno vojno na otoku Cape Breton potekalo med napadalnimi britanskimi silami in branilci, francoskimi in mikmaškimi četami. Francozi so skušali okrepitve poslati po morju, a jim ni uspelo, saj so Britanci njihovo floto blokirali in premagali. Bitka je končala francosko kolonialno prevlado v atlantski Kanadi in pripeljala do britanskega pohoda za zavzetje Quebeca leta 1759 ter preostanka Nove Francije naslednje leto.

source.title: Siege of Louisbourg (1758)
paragraphs: The siege of Louisbourg (8 June – 26 July 1758) was fought during the Seven Years' War on Cape Breton Island between an attacking British force and defending French and Mi'kmaq troops. The French attempted to send reinforcements by sea, but were not able to as the fleet was blockaded and defeated by the British. The battle ended French colonial dominance in Atlantic Canada and led to the subsequent British campaign to capture Quebec in 1759 and the remainder of New France the following year.

Siege of Petersburg.headline: Obleganje Petersburga
paragraphs: Kampanja Richmond–Petersburg je bila vrsta bitk okoli Petersburga v Virginiji, ki so med ameriško državljansko vojno potekale od 9. junija 1864 do 25. marca 1865. Čeprav je bolj znana kot obleganje Petersburga, ni šlo za klasično vojaško obleganje, pri katerem mesto obkolijo z utrdbami, ki zaprejo vse dohode in izhode, niti ni bila omejena le na boje proti Petersburgu.

Kampanjo je sestavljalo devet mesecev jarkovskega vojskovanja, v katerem so sile Unije pod poveljstvom generalporočnika Ulyssesa S. Granta neuspešno napadle Petersburg in nato zgradile linije jarkov, ki so se nazadnje raztezale več kot 48 km, od vzhodnega obrobja Richmonda v Virginiji do vzhodnega in južnega obrobja Petersburga. Petersburg je bil ključen za oskrbo vojske konfederacijskega generala Roberta E. Leeja in konfederacijske prestolnice Richmonda. V poskusih, da bi presekali železnico Richmond–Petersburg, so izvedli številne vpade in bitke, zaradi mnogih pa so se linije jarkov še podaljšale.

source.title: Siege of Petersburg
paragraphs: The Richmond–Petersburg campaign was a series of battles around Petersburg, Virginia, fought from June 9, 1864, to March 25, 1865, during the American Civil War. Although it is more popularly known as the siege of Petersburg, it was not a classic military siege, in which a city is encircled with fortifications blocking all routes of ingress and egress, nor was it strictly limited to actions against Petersburg.

The campaign consisted of nine months of trench warfare in which Union forces commanded by Lieutenant General Ulysses S. Grant assaulted Petersburg unsuccessfully and then constructed trench lines that eventually extended over 30 miles (48 km) from the eastern outskirts of Richmond, Virginia, to around the eastern and southern outskirts of Petersburg. Petersburg was crucial to the supply of Confederate General Robert E. Lee's army and the Confederate capital of Richmond. Numerous raids were conducted and battles fought in attempts to cut off the Richmond and Petersburg Railroad. Many of these battles caused the lengthening of the trench lines.

Siege of Veracruz.headline: Obleganje Veracruza
paragraphs: Vojska Združenih držav se je 9. marca 1847, med mehiško-ameriško vojno, izkrcala z morja in oblegala ključno mehiško pristanišče Veracruz. Pristanišče se je vdalo dvajset dni pozneje, ameriške sile pa so nato krenile v notranjost, proti Ciudad de Méxicu.

source.title: Siege of Veracruz
paragraphs: On 9 March 1847, during the Mexican–American War, the United States military made an amphibious landing and besieged the key Mexican seaport of Veracruz. The port surrendered twenty days later. The U.S. forces then marched inland to Mexico City.

Siege of Vicksburg.headline: Obleganje Vicksburga
paragraphs: Obleganje Vicksburga (18. maja–4. julija 1863) je bila zadnja velika vojaška operacija kampanje za Vicksburg v ameriški državljanski vojni. Generalmajor Unije Ulysses S. Grant je s Tennesseejsko armado v vrsti manevrov prečkal Misisipi in konfederacijsko Misisipijsko armado pod vodstvom generalporočnika Johna C. Pembertona potisnil za obrambne črte okoli utrjenega mesta Vicksburg v Misisipiju, kar je pripeljalo do uspešnega obleganja in vdaje Konfederacije.

source.title: Siege of Vicksburg
paragraphs: The siege of Vicksburg (May 18 – July 4, 1863) was the final major military action in the Vicksburg campaign of the American Civil War. In a series of maneuvers, Union major general Ulysses S. Grant and his Army of the Tennessee crossed the Mississippi River and drove the Confederate Army of Mississippi, led by Lieutenant General John C. Pemberton, into the defensive lines surrounding the fortress city of Vicksburg, Mississippi, leading to the successful siege and Confederate surrender.

Bitka pri Yorktownu ali obleganje Yorktowna je potekala od 5. aprila do 4. maja 1862 v okviru polotoške kampanje ameriške državljanske vojne. Potomaška armada generalmajorja Unije Georgea B. McClellana je na pohodu iz utrdbe Fort Monroe pri Yorktownu za Warwickovo črto naletela na majhne konfederacijske sile generalmajorja Johna B. Magruderja. McClellan je ustavil pohod po polotoku proti Richmondu in se pripravil na obleganje.

source.title: Siege of Yorktown (1862)
paragraphs: The Battle of Yorktown or Siege of Yorktown was fought from April 5 to May 4, 1862, as part of the Peninsula campaign of the American Civil War. Marching from Fort Monroe, Union Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan's Army of the Potomac encountered Maj. Gen. John B. Magruder's small Confederate force at Yorktown behind the Warwick Line. McClellan suspended his march up the Peninsula toward Richmond and settled in for siege operations.

Enotna konvencija o mamilih iz leta 1961 (imenovana tudi enotna konvencija, konvencija iz leta 1961 ali C61) je mednarodna pogodba, sklenjena pod okriljem Združenih narodov, ki nadzoruje dejavnosti (gojenje, proizvodnjo, dobavo, trgovino, prevoz), povezane z določenimi mamili, in določa sistem predpisov (dovoljenja, ukrepi za zdravljenje, raziskave itd.) za njihovo medicinsko in znanstveno uporabo. Konvencija je ustanovila tudi Mednarodni odbor za nadzor mamil.

Enotno konvencijo so sprejeli leta 1961 in jo leta 1972 spremenili. Leta 2022 jo je v spremenjeni obliki ratificiralo 186 držav. Konvencijo sta pozneje dopolnili Konvencija o psihotropnih snoveh iz leta 1971, ki nadzoruje LSD, MDMA in druga psihoaktivna zdravila, ter Konvencija Združenih narodov proti nedovoljenemu prometu z mamili in psihotropnimi snovmi iz leta 1988; tri konvencije skupaj sestavljajo pravni okvir mednarodnega nadzora nad drogami.

source.title: Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs
paragraphs: The Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs, 1961 (also called the Single Convention, 1961 Convention, or C61) is an international treaty that controls activities (cultivation, production, supply, trade, transport) involving specific narcotic drugs and lays down a system of regulations (licenses, measures for treatment, research, etc.) for their medical and scientific uses, concluded under the auspices of the United Nations. The convention also establishes the International Narcotics Control Board.

The Single Convention was adopted in 1961 and amended in 1972. As of 2022, the Single Convention as amended has been ratified by 186 countries. The convention has since been supplemented by the 1971 Convention on Psychotropic Substances, which controls LSD, MDMA, and other psychoactive pharmaceuticals, and the 1988 United Nations Convention Against Illicit Traffic in Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances; the three conventions establish the legal framework for international drug control.

Stallings Island.headline: Otok Stallings
paragraphs: Otok Stallings je arheološko najdišče z velikim školjčnim kupom na reki Savannah blizu mesta Augusta v Georgii. Po njem sta dobili ime kultura Stallings iz poznega arhaičnega obdobja in lončenina Stallings s pustilom iz rastlinskih vlaken, najstarejša znana lončenina v Severni Ameriki. Leta 1961 so najdišče razglasili za nacionalni zgodovinski spomenik. Lončenino Stallings Island, najdeno na obali Georgie, so prej imenovali lončenina St. Simons, danes pa jo prepoznavajo kot lončenino Stallings Island.

source.title: Stallings Island
paragraphs: Stallings Island is an archeological site with a large shell midden, located in the Savannah River near Augusta, Georgia. The site is the namesake for the Stallings culture of the Late Archaic period and for Stallings fiber-tempered pottery, the oldest known pottery in North America. The site was declared a National Historic Landmark in 1961. Stallings Island pottery found in coastal Georgia was formerly called St. Simons pottery, but is now recognized as Stallings Island.

State of Buenos Aires.headline: Država Buenos Aires
paragraphs: Država Buenos Aires (špansko: Estado de Buenos Aires) je bila odcepljena republika, ki je nastala, ko so v provinci Buenos Aires 11. septembra 1852 strmoglavili vlado Argentinske konfederacije. Konfederacija je ni nikoli izrecno priznala, a je ostala neodvisna z lastno vlado in ustavo. Buenos Aires se je Argentinski konfederaciji znova pridružil po svoji zmagi v bitki pri Pavónu leta 1861.

source.title: State of Buenos Aires
paragraphs: The State of Buenos Aires (Spanish: Estado de Buenos Aires) was a secessionist republic resulting from the overthrow of the Argentine Confederation government in the Province of Buenos Aires on 11 September 1852. The State of Buenos Aires was never explicitly recognized by the Confederation; it remained, however, independent under its own government and constitution. Buenos Aires rejoined the Argentine Confederation after the former's victory at the Battle of Pavón in 1861.

Surinamese Civil War.headline: Surinamska državljanska vojna
paragraphs: Surinamska državljanska vojna, znana tudi kot surinamska notranja vojna (nizozemsko: Binnenlandse Oorlog), je bila državljanska vojna v vzhodnem Surinamu med letoma 1986 in 1992. V spopadu sta se bojevala predvsem Komando iz džungle, uporniška skupina, ki so jo sestavljali večinoma borci Saramaka (Maroni) in jo je vodil nekdanji vojak Ronnie Brunswijk, ter surinamska narodna vojska pod poveljstvom tedanjega načelnika vojske in dejanskega voditelja države Désija Bouterseja.

source.title: Surinamese Civil War
paragraphs: The Surinamese Civil War, also known as Surinamese Interior War (Dutch: Binnenlandse Oorlog), was a civil war fought in eastern Suriname between 1986 and 1992. The conflict primarily involved the Jungle Commando, a rebel group composed largely of Saramaka (Maroon) fighters and led by former soldier Ronnie Brunswijk, and the Surinamese National Army, commanded by then-army chief and de facto head of state Dési Bouterse.

Swift Creek culture.headline: Kultura Swift Creek
paragraphs: Kultura Swift Creek je bila arheološka kultura srednjega gozdnega obdobja na območju jugovzhodnih gozdov Severne Amerike, ki sega v obdobje okoli 100–800 n. št. Poseljevala je območja današnje Georgie, Alabame, Floride, Južne Karoline in Tennesseeja. Na Floridi obredne navade in pogrebne komplekse kulture Swift Creek strokovno imenujejo kompleks Yent-Green Point. Kultura je obstajala hkrati s hopewellsko kulturo in bila z njo v stiku, zato jo pogosto opisujejo kot »hopewellsko«. Njeno tipsko najdišče je bilo najdišče gomil Swift Creek v okrožju Bibb v Georgii, drugo pomembno najdišče te kulture v Georgii pa so gomile Leake.

source.title: Swift Creek culture
paragraphs: The Swift Creek culture was a Middle Woodland period archaeological culture in the Southeastern Woodlands of North America, dating to around 100-800 CE. It occupied the areas now part of Georgia, Alabama, Florida, South Carolina, and Tennessee. In Florida, Swift Creek ceremonial practices and burial complexes are referred to technically as the Yent-Green Point complex. The Swift Creek culture was contemporaneous with and interacted with the Hopewell culture; Swift Creek is often described as "Hopewellian." The type site for the Swift Creek culture was the Swift Creek mound site, which was located in Bibb County, Georgia. The Leake Mounds are another significant Swift Creek Culture site in Georgia.

Tecumsehova vojna je bil spopad med Združenimi državami in Tecumsehovo konfederacijo pod vodstvom šonijskega voditelja Tecumseha na ozemlju Indiana. Čeprav pogosto velja, da je vojna dosegla vrhunec z zmago Williama Henryja Harrisona v bitki pri Tippecanoeju leta 1811, se je v bistvu nadaljevala v vojno leta 1812 (v kateri se je Tecumseh postavil na britansko stran) in jo pogosto štejejo za del tega širšega boja. Trajala je še dve leti, do leta 1813, ko je Tecumseh padel v boju s Harrisonovo Severozahodno armado v bitki pri Moraviantownu v Gornji Kanadi, blizu današnjega Chathama v Ontariu, in je njegova konfederacija razpadla. Nekateri akademski zgodovinarji Tecumsehovo vojno štejejo za zadnji spopad dolgotrajnejšega vojaškega boja za nadzor nad območjem Velikih jezer v Severni Ameriki, ki je obsegal več vojn v več rodovih in ga imenujejo šestdesetletna vojna.

source.title: Tecumseh's War
paragraphs: Tecumseh's War was a conflict between the United States and Tecumseh's confederacy, led by the Shawnee leader Tecumseh in the Indiana Territory. Although the war is often considered to have climaxed with William Henry Harrison's victory at the Battle of Tippecanoe in 1811, Tecumseh's War essentially continued into the War of 1812 (during which Techumseh sided with the British) and is frequently considered a part of that larger struggle. The war lasted for two more years, until 1813, when Tecumseh died fighting Harrison's Army of the Northwest at the Battle of Moraviantown in Upper Canada, near present-day Chatham, Ontario, and his confederacy disintegrated. Tecumseh's War is viewed by some academic historians as the final conflict of a longer-term military struggle for control of the Great Lakes region of North America, encompassing a number of wars over several generations, referred to as the Sixty Years' War.
Tehuelči, imenovani tudi Aónikenk, so domorodno ljudstvo iz vzhodne Patagonije v Južni Ameriki. V 18. in 19. stoletju so bili pod vplivom Mapučev in so mnogi začeli rediti konje.

Nekoč nomadsko ljudstvo je zašlo v stisko, ko sta njegovo zemljo v 19. stoletju kolonizirali Argentina in Čile, kar je postopoma razkrojilo njegovo tradicionalno gospodarstvo. Še posebej so jih prizadela velika ovčarska posestva, ki so jih kolonisti ustanovili v Patagoniji. Stiki z evropskimi priseljenci so prinesli tudi nove nalezljive bolezni, ki so med plemeni Tehuelčev povzročile smrtonosne epidemije, saj niso imeli pridobljene odpornosti. Danes večina Tehuelčev živi v mestih in krajih argentinske Patagonije.

source.title: Tehuelche people
paragraphs: The Tehuelche people, also called the Aónikenk, are an Indigenous people from eastern Patagonia in South America. In the 18th and 19th centuries, the Tehuelche were influenced by the Mapuche people, and many adopted the domestic use of horses.

Once a nomadic people, the Tehuelche struggled as their lands were colonized in the 19th century by Argentina and Chile, which gradually disrupted their traditional economies. The colonial establishment of large sheep farming estates in Patagonia was particularly detrimental to the Tehuelche. Contact with ethnic European outsiders also introduced new infectious diseases, which caused deadly epidemics among Tehuelche tribes as they lacked acquired immunity. Today most Tehuelche reside in cities and towns of Argentine Patagonia.

Teuchitlán culture.headline: Kultura Teuchitlán
paragraphs: Kultura Teuchitlán je bila ena od več sorodnih kultur zahodne Mehike od poznega formativnega do klasičnega obdobja (350 pr. n. št.–450/500 n. št.). Živela je v dolinah Tequila v Jaliscu in je imela skupno navado, da so nekatere mrtve pokopavali v jaškastih grobnicah s komorami. Arheološko delo zadnjih nekaj desetletij je pokazalo, da zahodne Mehike ni poseljevala ena sama enotna kultura, ki so jo v preteklosti imenovali tradicija jaškastih grobnic in naj bi segala od Nayarita prek Jalisca do Colime. Zahodno Mehiko je namesto tega sestavljalo več kultur z nekaj izrazitimi skupnimi značilnostmi.

source.title: Teuchitlán culture
paragraphs: The Teuchitlán culture was one of several related cultures in West Mexico during the Late Formative to Classic period (350 BCE to 450/500 CE). Situated in the Tequila Valleys of Jalisco, the Teuchitlán culture shared in the tradition of burying some of their dead in shaft and chamber tombs. Archaeological work from the past few decades has demonstrated that West Mexico was not occupied by one homogeneous culture, historically referred to as the shaft tomb tradition, that stretched from Nayarit, Jalisco, and Colima. Instead, West Mexico was composed of multiple cultures with several distinct commonalities.
