Vojna tisočih dni (špansko: Guerra de los Mil Días) je bila državljanska vojna v Kolumbiji od 17. oktobra 1899 do 21. novembra 1902, sprva med liberalno stranko in vlado, ki jo je vodila nacionalna stranka, pozneje – ko je konservativna stranka odstavila nacionalno – pa med liberalci in konservativno vlado. Vzrok je bilo dolgotrajno ideološko vlečenje vrvi med federalizmom in centralizmom med kolumbijskimi liberalci, konservativci in nacionalisti po uveljavitvi ustave iz leta 1886 in političnem procesu, imenovanem Regeneración. Po predsedniških volitvah leta 1898 so se napetosti zaostrile, 17. oktobra 1899 pa so člani liberalne stranke v departmaju Santander razglasili uradno vstajo proti državni vladi. Sovražnosti so se začele šele 11. novembra, ko so liberalne frakcije skušale zavzeti mesto Bucaramanga, in prerasle v pravo vojno. Ta se je tri leta pozneje končala s podpisom pogodbe iz Neerlandie in pogodbe z ladje Wisconsin. Vojna se je končala z zmago konservativcev in jim zagotovila prevlado v kolumbijski politiki še nadaljnjih 28 let. Ureditve Kolumbije kot unitarne države od tedaj nihče ni postavil pod vprašaj.

source.title: Thousand Days' War
paragraphs: The Thousand Days' War (Spanish: Guerra de los Mil Días) was a civil war fought in Colombia from 17 October 1899 to 21 November 1902, at first between the Liberal Party and the government led by the National Party, and later – after the Conservative Party had ousted the National Party – between the liberals and the conservative government. Caused by the longstanding ideological tug-of-war of federalism versus centralism between the liberals, conservatives, and nationalists of Colombia following the implementation of the Constitution of 1886 and the political process known as the Regeneración, tensions ran high after the presidential election of 1898, and on 17 October 1899, official insurrection against the national government was announced by members of the Liberal Party in the Department of Santander. Hostilities did not begin until 11 November, when liberal factions attempted to take over the city of Bucaramanga, leading to active warfare. It would end three years later with the signing of the Treaty of Neerlandia and the Treaty of Wisconsin. The war resulted in a Conservative victory, and ensured the continued dominance of the Conservative Party in Colombian politics for another 28 years. Colombia's political structure as a unitary state has not been challenged since.

Thule people.headline: Ljudstvo Thule
paragraphs: Ljudstvo Thule ali protoinuiti so bili predniki vseh današnjih Inuitov in Jupikov. Do leta 1000 n. št. so se razvili na obali Aljaske in se razširili proti vzhodu prek severne Kanade, do 13. stoletja pa so dosegli Grenlandijo. Pri tem so izpodrinili ljudi starejše kulture Dorset, ki so prej živeli na tem območju. Ime »Thule« izvira iz kraja Thule, danes Pituffik (naselje so leta 1953 preselili in preimenovali v Qaanaaq), na severozahodu Grenlandije nasproti Kanade, kjer so arheološke ostanke tega ljudstva prvič našli na kupu odpadkov Comer's Midden.

Dokazi podpirajo domnevo, da so bili ljudje Thule (in v manjši meri Dorset) v stiku z Vikingi, ki so v 11. stoletju v okviru nordijske kolonizacije Severne Amerike dosegli obale Kanade. Vikinški viri ta ljudstva imenujejo Skrælingjar.
notes: The pronunciation respelling is left out.

source.title: Thule people
paragraphs: The Thule ( TOO-lee, also THOOL) or proto-Inuit were the precursors of all modern Inuit and Yupik peoples. They developed in coastal Alaska by 1000 CE and expanded eastward across northern Canada, reaching Greenland by the 13th century. In the process, they replaced people of the earlier Dorset culture who had previously inhabited the region. The appellation "Thule" originates from the location of Thule, now known as Pituffik (a settlement relocated and renamed Qaanaaq in 1953) in northwest Greenland, facing Canada, where the archaeological remains of the people were first found at Comer's Midden.

Evidence supports the idea that the Thule (and, to a lesser degree, the Dorset) were in contact with the Vikings, who had reached the shores of Canada in the 11th century as part of the Norse colonization of North America. In Viking sources, these peoples are called the Skrælingjar.

Tiwanaku (špansko: Tiahuanaco ali Tiahuanacu) je bila predkolumbovska politična skupnost v zahodni Boliviji s središčem v južnem delu porečja jezera Titicaca. Bila je ena najpomembnejših andskih civilizacij: njen vpliv je segal na ozemlje današnjega Peruja in Čila in je trajal približno od leta 600 do 1000. Prestolnica je bilo monumentalno mesto Tiwanaku sredi osrednjega območja države v južnem delu porečja jezera. Tam so jasni dokazi za obsežno poljedelstvo na dvignjenih poljih, ki so verjetno preživljala mestno prebivalstvo prestolnice. Raziskovalci razpravljajo, ali je ta polja upravljala birokratska država (od zgoraj navzdol) ali zveza skupnosti s krajevno samoupravo (od spodaj navzgor; pregled razprave v Janusek 2004: 57–73). Nekoč so Tiwanaku imeli za širok vojaški imperij, predvsem zaradi primerjav s poznejšim Inkovskim imperijem. Novejše raziskave pa kažejo, da je oznaka imperij ali celo država morda zavajajoča. Tiwanakuju namreč manjkajo številne značilnosti, s katerimi tradicionalno opredeljujejo starodavne države in imperije: na nobenem najdišču ni obrambne arhitekture ali sprememb v orožju, ni kneževskih grobov ali drugih sledi vladajoče dinastije, ni sledi cest ali postojank, ki bi jih vzdrževala država, in ni tržnic.

source.title: Tiwanaku polity
paragraphs: The Tiwanaku polity (Spanish: Tiahuanaco or Tiahuanacu) was a Pre-Columbian polity in western Bolivia based in the southern Lake Titicaca Basin. Tiwanaku was one of the most significant Andean civilizations. Its influence extended into present-day Peru and Chile and lasted from around 600 to 1000. Its capital was the monumental city of Tiwanaku, located at the center of the polity's core area in the southern Lake Titicaca Basin. This area has clear evidence for large-scale agricultural production on raised fields that probably supported the urban population of the capital. Researchers debate whether these fields were administered by a bureaucratic state (top-down) or through a federation of communities with local autonomy (bottom-up; see review of debate in Janusek 2004:57-73). Tiwanaku was once thought to be an expansive military empire, based mostly on comparisons to the later Inca Empire. However, recent research suggests that labelling Tiwanaku as an empire or even a state may be misleading. Tiwanaku is missing a number of features traditionally used to define archaic states and empires: there is no defensive architecture at any Tiwanaku site or changes in weapon technology, there are no princely burials or other evidence of a ruling dynasty, no evidence of state-maintained roads or outposts, and no markets.

Toledo War.headline: Toledska vojna
paragraphs: Toledska vojna (1835–1836), znana tudi kot vojna med Michiganom in Ohiem, je bil mejni spor med zvezno državo Ohio in sosednjim ozemljem Michigan za pas ozemlja okoli Toleda (Toledo Strip). Obe strani sta nadzor nad ustjem reke Maumee šteli za dragoceno gospodarsko prednost, saj je ponujal možnosti za celinski ladijski promet, na zahodu pa je bila dobra kmetijska zemlja.

source.title: Toledo War
paragraphs: The Toledo War (1835–1836), also known as the Michigan–Ohio War or Ohio–Michigan War, was a boundary dispute between the state of Ohio and the adjoining Michigan Territory over the Toledo Strip. Control of the Maumee River's mouth was seen by both parties as a valuable economic asset, due to the inland shipping opportunities that it offered and the good farmland to the west.

Torrijos–Carter Treaties.headline: Pogodbi Torrijos–Carter
paragraphs: Pogodbi Torrijos–Carter (špansko: Tratados Torrijos-Carter) sta pogodbi, ki so ju Združene države in Panama podpisale 7. septembra 1977 v Washingtonu in sta nadomestili pogodbo Hay–Bunau-Varilla iz leta 1903. Pogodbi sta Panami zagotovili nadzor nad Panamskim prekopom po letu 1999, s čimer se je končal nadzor nad prekopom, ki so ga ZDA imele od leta 1903. Imenujeta se po podpisnikih, ameriškem predsedniku Jimmyju Carterju in poveljniku panamske nacionalne garde generalu Omarju Torrijosu.

source.title: Torrijos–Carter Treaties
paragraphs: The Torrijos–Carter Treaties (Spanish: Tratados Torrijos-Carter) are two treaties signed by the United States and Panama in Washington, D.C., on September 7, 1977, which superseded the Hay–Bunau-Varilla Treaty of 1903. The treaties guaranteed that Panama would gain control of the Panama Canal after 1999, ending the control of the canal that the U.S. had exercised since 1903. The treaties are named after the two signatories, U.S. president Jimmy Carter and the commander of Panama's National Guard, General Omar Torrijos.

Totonac culture.headline: Totonaška kultura
paragraphs: Totonaška kultura je bila kultura mezoameriškega domorodnega ljudstva Totonakov, ki so živeli predvsem v Veracruzu in severni Puebli. Sprva so sestavljali zvezo mest, pozneje pa so bili, kot kaže, razdeljeni na tri gospostva: severno, južno in gorsko.
Gospodarstvo je temeljilo na poljedelstvu in trgovini. Imeli so velika mestna središča, kot so El Tajín (300–1200), ki pomeni vrhunec totonaške kulture, Papantla (900–1519) in Cempoala (900–1519).

Totonaška kultura je znana po raznoliki keramiki, kamnitih kipih, arhitekturi in napredni urbanistični zasnovi mest. Razvili so izdelavo kamnitih jarmov, palm, sekir, kač, nasmejanih obrazov in monumentalnih kipov iz blata.

source.title: Totonac culture
paragraphs: The Totonac culture or Totonec culture was a culture that existed among the indigenous Mesoamerican Totonac people who lived mainly in Veracruz and northern Puebla. Originally, they formed a confederation of cities, but, in later times, it seems that they were organized in three dominions: North, South and Serran.

Its economy was agricultural and commercial. They had large urban centers such as: El Tajín (300–1200), which represents the height of the Totonac culture, Papantla (900–1519) and Cempoala (900–1519).

The Totonac culture is known for their varied ceramics, the stone sculpture, the architecture and advanced urban conception of the cities. There were advances and forms made in the production of yokes, palms, axes, snakes, smiley faces and monumental mud sculptures.

Treaty of Amity and Commerce (United Sta.headline: Pogodba o prijateljstvu in trgovini (ZDA–Japonska)
paragraphs: Pogodba o prijateljstvu in trgovini med Japonsko in Združenimi državami (japonsko: 日米修好通商条約, Nichibei Shūkō Tsūshō Jōyaku), imenovana tudi Harrisova pogodba, je bila pogodba med Združenimi državami in šogunatom Tokugava, ki je za trgovino odprla pristanišče Kanagava in še štiri japonska mesta ter tujcem med drugimi trgovinskimi določili priznala eksteritorialnost. Podpisali so jo 29. julija 1858 na krovu ladje USS Powhatan v zalivu Edo (danes Tokio).

source.title: Treaty of Amity and Commerce (United States–Japan)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Amity and Commerce between Japan and the United States (日米修好通商条約, Nichibei Shūkō Tsūshō Jōyaku), also called the Harris Treaty was a treaty signed between the United States and Tokugawa Shogunate, which opened the ports of Kanagawa and four other Japanese cities to trade and granted extraterritoriality to foreigners, among a number of trading stipulations. It was signed on the deck of the USS Powhatan in Edo (now Tokyo) Bay on July 29, 1858.

Treaty of Córdoba.headline: Pogodba iz Córdobe
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Córdobe je ob koncu mehiške osamosvojitvene vojne potrdila neodvisnost Mehike od Španije. Podpisali so jo 24. avgusta 1821 v Córdobi v Veracruzu v Mehiki. Podpisnika sta bila poveljnik vojske treh jamstev Agustín de Iturbide in v imenu španske vlade visoki politični poglavar (jefe político superior) Juan O'Donojú. Pogodba ima 17 členov, ki so razvili predloge načrta iz Iguale. Je prvi dokument, v katerem španski (brez pooblastila) in mehiški uradniki sprejemajo svobodo poznejšega prvega mehiškega cesarstva, vendar je danes ne štejejo za ustanovni trenutek, saj te ideje pogosto pripisujejo kriku iz Doloresa (16. septembra 1810). Španska vlada je pogodbo zavrnila in to odločitev 13. in 14. februarja 1822 objavila v Madridu.

source.title: Treaty of Córdoba
paragraphs: The Treaty of Córdoba established Mexican independence from Spain at the conclusion of the Mexican War of Independence. It was signed on August 24, 1821 in Córdoba, Veracruz, Mexico. The signatories were the head of the Army of the Three Guarantees, Agustín de Iturbide, and, acting on behalf of the Spanish government, Jefe Político Superior Juan O'Donojú. The treaty has 17 articles, which developed the proposals of the Plan of Iguala. The Treaty is the first document in which Spanish (without authorization) and Mexican officials accept the liberty of what will become the First Mexican Empire, but it is not today recognized as the foundational moment, since these ideas are often attributed to the Grito de Dolores (September 16, 1810). The treaty was rejected by the Spanish government, publishing this determination in Madrid on February 13 and 14, 1822.

Treaty of Fort Laramie (1851).headline: Pogodba iz Fort Laramieja (1851)
paragraphs: Pogodbo iz Fort Laramieja iz leta 1851 so 17. septembra 1851 podpisali komisarji Združenih držav in predstavniki narodov Šajenov, Siujev, Arapahov, Vran, Asiniboinov, Mandanov, Hidats in Arikar. Pogodba, znana tudi kot pogodba iz Horse Creeka, je določila tradicionalne ozemeljske zahteve plemen.

Združene države so priznale, da je vsa zemlja, ki jo je zajemala pogodba, indijansko ozemlje, in niso zahtevale nobenega njenega dela. Meje, dogovorjene s pogodbo iz Fort Laramieja leta 1851, so v 20. stoletju uporabili pri reševanju več odškodninskih zahtevkov. Indijanci so naseljencem na Oregonski poti zagotovili varen prehod in na svojem ozemlju dovolili gradnjo cest in utrdb, v zameno pa so jim obljubili letno rento petdeset tisoč dolarjev za petdeset let. Pogodba je skušala tudi »vzpostaviti učinkovit in trajen mir« med osmimi plemeni, ki so si bila pogosto navzkriž.

source.title: Treaty of Fort Laramie (1851)
paragraphs: The Fort Laramie Treaty of 1851 was signed on September 17, 1851 between United States treaty commissioners and representatives of the Cheyenne, Sioux, Arapaho, Crow, Assiniboine, Mandan, Hidatsa, and Arikara Nations. Also known as Horse Creek Treaty, the treaty set forth traditional territorial claims of the tribes.

The United States acknowledged that all the land covered by the treaty was Indian territory and did not claim any part of it. The boundaries agreed to in the Fort Laramie Treaty of 1851 would be used to settle a number of claims cases in the 20th century. The Native Americans guaranteed safe passage for settlers on the Oregon Trail and allowed roads and forts to be built in their territories, in exchange for promises of an annuity in the amount of fifty thousand dollars for fifty years. The treaty also sought to "make an effective and lasting peace" among the eight tribes, who were often at odds with each other.

Treaty of Greenville.headline: Pogodba iz Greenvilla
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Greenvilla, Američanom znana tudi kot pogodba z Wyandoti in drugimi, uradno pa Mirovna pogodba med Združenimi državami Amerike in indijanskimi plemeni Wyandotov, Delavarov, Šonijev, Otav, Čipev, Potavatomijev, Miamijev, Eel Rivers, Wea, Kikapujev, Piankashawov in Kaskaskijev, je bila pogodba iz leta 1795 med Združenimi državami in domorodnimi narodi Severozahodnega ozemlja (danes Srednji zahod Združenih držav), med njimi ljudstvi Wyandot in Delaware, ki je na novo določila mejo med zemljo domorodnih ljudstev in ozemljem za naselitev ameriških skupnosti.

source.title: Treaty of Greenville
paragraphs: The Treaty of Greenville, also known to Americans as the Treaty with the Wyandots, etc., but formally titled A treaty of peace between the United States of America, and the tribes of Indians called the Wyandots, Delawares, Shawanees, Ottawas, Chippewas, Pattawatimas, Miamis, Eel Rivers, Weas, Kickapoos, Piankeshaws, and Kaskaskias was a 1795 treaty between the United States and indigenous nations of the Northwest Territory (now Midwestern United States), including the Wyandot and Delaware peoples, that redefined the boundary between indigenous peoples' lands and territory for United States community settlement.

Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo.headline: Pogodba iz Guadalupe Hidalga
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Guadalupe Hidalga je uradno končala mehiško-ameriško vojno (1846–1848). Podpisali so jo 2. februarja 1848 v mestu Guadalupe Hidalgo.

Po porazu svoje vojske in padcu prestolnice septembra 1847 se je Mehika začela pogajati o miru z ameriškim odposlancem Nicholasom Tristom. Pogodba je Mehiko zavezala, da odstopi 55 odstotkov svojega ozemlja, med drugim današnje zvezne države Kalifornijo, Nevado, Utah, večji del Arizone ter dele Nove Mehike, Kolorada in Wyominga. Mehika se je odpovedala tudi vsem zahtevam po Teksasu in priznala Rio Grande za južno mejo Teksasa.

Ameriška vlada je Mehiki v zameno plačala 15 milijonov dolarjev »v zameno za razširitev, ki so jo pridobile meje Združenih držav«, in privolila, da poplača dolgove mehiške vlade ameriškim državljanom. Mehičani na ozemljih, ki so jih priključile ZDA, so se lahko preselili znotraj novih mehiških meja ali pa dobili ameriško državljanstvo in polne državljanske pravice.

source.title: Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo
paragraphs: The Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo officially ended the Mexican–American War (1846–1848). It was signed on the 2nd of February 1848 in the town of Guadalupe Hidalgo.

After the defeat of its army and the fall of the capital in September 1847, Mexico entered into peace negotiations with the U.S. envoy, Nicholas Trist. The resulting treaty required Mexico to cede 55 percent of its territory including the present-day states of California, Nevada, Utah, most of Arizona, and parts of New Mexico, Colorado, and Wyoming. Mexico also relinquished all claims for Texas and recognized the Rio Grande as the southern boundary of Texas.

In turn, the U.S. government paid Mexico $15 million "in consideration of the extension acquired by the boundaries of the United States" and agreed to pay debts owed to U.S. citizens by the Mexican government. Mexicans in areas annexed by the U.S. could relocate within Mexico's new boundaries or receive U.S. citizenship and full civil rights.

Pogodba o medsebojnem sodelovanju in varnosti med Združenimi državami Amerike in Japonsko, bolj znana kot ameriško-japonska varnostna pogodba, v japonščini pa kot Anpo jōyaku ali kar Anpo, je pogodba, ki dovoljuje ameriška vojaška oporišča na japonskih tleh in obe državi zavezuje, da se branita, če je ena ali druga napadena »na ozemljih pod japonsko upravo«. Sčasoma je med Združenimi državami in Japonsko vzpostavila vojaško zavezništvo.

Sedanja pogodba, ki je začela veljati 23. junija 1960, je revidirala in nadomestila prejšnjo različico, podpisano leta 1951 skupaj s sanfranciško mirovno pogodbo, ki je končala drugo svetovno vojno v Aziji in okupacijo Japonske pod ameriškim vodstvom (1945–1952). Revizija pogodbe leta 1960 je bila na Japonskem izjemno sporna, splošno nasprotovanje njenemu sprejetju pa je pripeljalo do množičnih protestov Anpo, največjih ljudskih protestov v zgodovini Japonske.

source.title: Treaty of Mutual Cooperation and Security between the United States and Japan
paragraphs: The Treaty of Mutual Cooperation and Security between the United States and Japan, more commonly known as the U.S.–Japan Security Treaty in English and as the Anpo jōyaku or just Anpo in Japanese, is a treaty that permits the presence of U.S. military bases on Japanese soil, and commits the two nations to defend each other if one or the other is attacked "in the territories under the administration of Japan". Over time, it has established a military alliance between the United States and Japan.

The current treaty, which took effect on June 23, 1960, revised and replaced an earlier version of the treaty, which had been signed in 1951 in conjunction with the signing of the Treaty of San Francisco that terminated World War II in Asia as well as the U.S.-led occupation of Japan (1945–1952). The revision of the treaty in 1960 was a highly contentious process in Japan, and widespread opposition to its passage led to the massive Anpo protests, which were the largest popular protests in Japan's history.

Treaty of Nonsuch.headline: Pogodba iz Nonsucha
paragraphs: Pogodbo iz Nonsucha so 10. avgusta 1585 podpisali angleška kraljica Elizabeta I. in nizozemski uporniki, ki so se bojevali proti španski oblasti. Bila je prva mednarodna pogodba, ki jo je podpisala poznejša Nizozemska republika. Podpisali so jo v palači Nonsuch v Angliji.

source.title: Treaty of Nonsuch
paragraphs: The Treaty of Nonsuch was signed on 10 August 1585 by Elizabeth I of England and the Dutch rebels fighting against Spanish rule. It was the first international treaty signed by what would become the Dutch Republic. It was signed at Nonsuch Palace, England.

Treaty of Petrópolis.headline: Pogodba iz Petrópolisa
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Petrópolisa, podpisana 17. novembra 1903 v brazilskem mestu Petrópolis, je končala akrsko vojno med Bolivijo in Brazilijo za tedaj bolivijsko ozemlje Acre (danes zvezna država Acre), ki je bilo v času tedanjega razcveta kavčuka zaželeno obmejno ozemlje med državama.

Pogodba, ki jo je pripravil brazilski zunanji minister José Maria da Silva Paranhos, je Braziliji dala ozemlje Acre (191.000 km²), v zameno pa je Bolivija dobila več kot 3000 km² brazilskega ozemlja med rekama Abunã in Madeira, plačilo dveh milijonov britanskih funtov v dveh obrokih in obljubo železniške povezave med bolivijskim mestom Riberalta in brazilskim mestom Porto Velho, ki bi obšla brzice na reki Madeira.

source.title: Treaty of Petrópolis
paragraphs: The Treaty of Petrópolis, signed on November 17, 1903, in the Brazilian city of Petrópolis, ended the Acre War between Bolivia and Brazil over the then-Bolivian territory of Acre (today the Acre state), a desirable territory in Bolivia-Brazil border during the contemporary rubber boom.

The treaty, drafted by Brazilian foreign affairs minister José Maria da Silva Paranhos, gave Brazil the territory of Acre (191,000 km2), in exchange for over 3,000 km2 of Brazilian territory between the Abuna River and Madeira River, a monetary payment of two million British pounds, paid in two installments, and a pledge of a rail-link between the Bolivian city of Riberalta and the Brazilian city of Porto Velho, which would bypass the rapids on the Madeira.

Portsmouthska pogodba je formalno končala rusko-japonsko vojno v letih 1904–1905. Podpisali so jo 5. septembra 1905 po pogajanjih od 6. do 30. avgusta v pomorski ladjedelnici Portsmouth v Kitteryju v Mainu (tedaj del Portsmoutha v New Hampshiru) v Združenih državah. Ameriški predsednik Theodore Roosevelt je imel pri pogajanjih ključno vlogo in je za svoja prizadevanja dobil Nobelovo nagrado za mir, kot prvi Američan sploh. Pogodba je priznala japonsko prevlado v Koreji (ki je kmalu zatem postala protektorat Japonskega cesarstva), Japonski prepustila ruski najem polotoka Liaodong (iz katerega je nastalo najemno ozemlje Kwantung), nadzor nad južnomandžursko železnico, ki so jo zgradili Rusi, in južno polovico otoka Sahalin (Karafuto).

source.title: Treaty of Portsmouth
paragraphs: The Treaty of Portsmouth formally ended the 1904–1905 Russo-Japanese War. It was signed on September 5, 1905, after negotiations from August 6 to 30, at the Portsmouth Naval Shipyard in Kittery, Maine (then part of Portsmouth, New Hampshire), United States. U.S. President Theodore Roosevelt was instrumental in the negotiations and won the Nobel Peace Prize for his efforts, the first ever American recipient. The treaty recognized Japan's hegemony in Korea (which soon after became a protectorate of the Empire of Japan), awarded it Russia's lease on the Liaodong Peninsula (which became the Kwantung Leased Territory), control of the Russian-built South Manchuria Railway, and the southern half of the island of Sakhalin (Karafuto).

Pogodba iz Ria de Janeira je pogodba med Kraljevino Portugalsko in Brazilskim cesarstvom, podpisana 29. avgusta 1825, ki je Brazilijo priznala za neodvisno državo in formalno končala brazilsko vojno za neodvisnost.
Brazilski cesar je pogodbo ratificiral 24. avgusta 1825, portugalski kralj pa 15. novembra 1825, ko so si brazilski in portugalski diplomati v Lizboni izmenjali tudi listini o ratifikaciji.
Pogodba je začela veljati 15. novembra 1825 z izmenjavo ratifikacijskih listin. Na Portugalskem so jo razglasili istega dne, v Braziliji pa 10. aprila 1826.

source.title: Treaty of Rio de Janeiro (1825)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Rio de Janeiro is the treaty between the Kingdom of Portugal and the Empire of Brazil, signed August 29, 1825, which recognized Brazil as an independent nation, formally ending the Brazilian War of Independence.

The treaty was ratified by the Emperor of Brazil on August 24, 1825, and by the King of Portugal on November 15, 1825, and on that same date the two instruments of ratification were exchanged between Brazilian and Portuguese diplomats in Lisbon.
The Treaty entered into force on November 15, 1825, upon the exchange of the ratification documents. It was proclaimed in Portugal on that same date, and was proclaimed in Brazil on April 10, 1826.

Sanfranciška pogodba, imenovana tudi mirovna pogodba z Japonsko, je v imenu Združenih narodov obnovila miroljubne odnose med Japonsko in zavezniki, saj je končala pravno vojno stanje in vojaško okupacijo ter določila odškodnine za sovražna dejanja do druge svetovne vojne in med njo. Podpisalo jo je 49 držav 8. septembra 1951 v San Franciscu v Združenih državah, v operni hiši War Memorial. Italija in Kitajska nista bili povabljeni, slednja zaradi nesoglasij o tem, ali kitajsko ljudstvo zastopa Republika Kitajska ali Ljudska republika Kitajska. Povabljena ni bila niti Koreja, zaradi podobnega nesoglasja o tem, ali korejsko ljudstvo zastopa Južna ali Severna Koreja.

source.title: Treaty of San Francisco
paragraphs: The Treaty of San Francisco, also called the Treaty of Peace with Japan, re-established peaceful relations between Japan and the Allies on behalf of the United Nations by ending the legal state of war, military occupation and providing for redress for hostile actions up to and including World War II. It was signed by 49 nations on September 8, 1951, in San Francisco, United States, at the War Memorial Opera House. Italy and China were not invited, the latter due to disagreements on whether the Republic of China or the People's Republic of China represented the Chinese people. Korea was also not invited due to a similar disagreement on whether South Korea or North Korea represented the Korean people.

Treaty of the Bogue.headline: Pogodba iz Bogueja
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Bogueja (kitajsko: 虎門條約) je bila neenakopravna pogodba med Združenim kraljestvom in Kitajsko, sklenjena oktobra 1843 kot dopolnilo prejšnje nankinške pogodbe. Ključna določila so Britaniji priznala eksteritorialnost in status države z največjimi ugodnostmi.

source.title: Treaty of the Bogue
paragraphs: The Treaty of the Bogue (Chinese: 虎門條約) was an unequal treaty between the United Kingdom and China, concluded in October 1843 to supplement the previous Treaty of Nanking. The treaty's key provisions granted extraterritoriality and most favoured nation status to Britain.

Pogodba o prepovedi jedrskega orožja v Latinski Ameriki in na Karibih (splošno znana kot pogodba iz Tlatelolca) je mednarodna pogodba, ki določa jedrsko razorožitev Latinske Amerike in Karibov. Predlagal jo je mehiški predsednik Adolfo López Mateos, spodbujali pa so jo mehiški diplomati Alfonso García Robles, Ismael Moreno Pino in Jorge Castañeda kot odziv na kubansko raketno krizo (1962). García Robles je za prizadevanja za zmanjšanje jedrskega orožja leta 1982 prejel Nobelovo nagrado za mir.

source.title: Treaty of Tlatelolco
paragraphs: The Treaty for the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons in Latin America and the Caribbean (commonly known as the Treaty of Tlatelolco) is an international treaty that establishes the nuclear disarmament of Latin America and the Caribbean. It was proposed by Adolfo López Mateos, the President of Mexico, and promoted by the Mexican diplomats Alfonso García Robles, Ismael Moreno Pino and Jorge Castañeda as a response to the Cuban Missile Crisis (1962). For his efforts in favour of the reduction of nuclear weapons, García Robles was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 1982.

Treaty of Versailles (1768).headline: Versajska pogodba (1768)
paragraphs: Versajska pogodba je bila pogodba, ki sta jo 15. maja 1768 v Versaillesu sklenili Republika Genova in Francija in s katero je Genova Francozom prodala Korziko.

Korziki je Genova vladala od leta 1284. V 18. stoletju so si Korzičani začeli prizadevati za neodvisnost. Nemški pustolovec Theodor von Neuhoff je leta 1736 ob podpori Nizozemske republike in Velike Britanije za kratek čas postal korziški kralj. Leta 1755 so pod vodstvom Pasquala Paolija ustanovili pravo Korziško republiko, leta 1764 pa je Genova Francijo prosila, naj na otok pošlje vojake.

Genova v versajski pogodbi ni imela druge izbire, kot da Korziko zastavi Franciji za poplačilo svojih dolgov. Genova, ki je bila v zatonu, jih drugače ne bi mogla nikoli odplačati, niti ni bila sposobna zatreti korziškega boja za neodvisnost. Pogodba pa je določila tudi, da Francija Genovi vrne sosednji otok Capraia, ki ga je prej zasedla Korziška republika.

source.title: Treaty of Versailles (1768)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Versailles was a treaty concluded on 15 May 1768 at Versailles between the Republic of Genoa and France, in which Genoa sold Corsica to France.

Corsica had been ruled by Genoa since 1284. In the 18th century, Corsicans started to seek their independence. A German adventurer, Theodore von Neuhoff, briefly became King of Corsica in 1736, supported by the Dutch Republic and Great Britain. In 1755, a full-fledged Corsican Republic was founded under Pasquale Paoli, and in 1764 Genoa asked France to send troops to the island.

In the Treaty of Versailles, Genoa had no option but to put Corsica in pledge to France, to repay its debts. There was no chance that Genoa, which was in decline, could ever repay its debts otherwise, and Genoa was not capable of suppressing the Corsican struggle for independence. However, the treaty also established that France would return to Genoa the possession of neighboring Capraia island, previously occupied by the Corsican Republic.

Pogodba o prepovedi jedrskega orožja (TPNW) je prvi pravno zavezujoč mednarodni sporazum, ki celovito prepoveduje jedrsko orožje, s končnim ciljem njegove popolne odprave. Sprejeli so jo 7. julija 2017, za podpis je bila odprta 20. septembra 2017, veljati pa je začela 22. januarja 2021.

Pogodbenicam prepoveduje razvoj, preizkušanje, proizvodnjo, kopičenje, namestitev, prenos, uporabo jedrskega orožja in grožnjo z njim ter pomoč in spodbujanje pri prepovedanih dejavnostih. Za državo z jedrskim orožjem, ki pristopi k pogodbi, predvideva časovno omejen okvir pogajanj, ki naj bi pripeljala do preverjene in nepovratne odprave njenega jedrskega programa.

source.title: Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons
paragraphs: The Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons (TPNW), or the Nuclear Weapon Ban Treaty, is the first legally binding international agreement to comprehensively prohibit nuclear weapons, with the ultimate goal being their total elimination. It was adopted on 7 July 2017, opened for signature on 20 September 2017, and entered into force on 22 January 2021.

For those states that are party to it, the treaty prohibits the development, testing, production, stockpiling, stationing, transfer, use and threat of use of nuclear weapons, as well as assistance and encouragement to the prohibited activities. For a nuclear-armed state joining the treaty, it provides for a time-bound framework for negotiations leading to the verified and irreversible elimination of its nuclear weapons program.

Tripartite Convention.headline: Tristranska konvencija
paragraphs: Tristranska konvencija iz leta 1899 je končala drugo samoansko državljansko vojno in formalno razdelila samoansko otočje na nemško kolonijo in ozemlje Združenih držav.
Predhodnice tristranske konvencije iz leta 1899 so bile washingtonska konferenca leta 1887, berlinska pogodba leta 1889 in angleško-nemški sporazum o Samoi iz leta 1899.

source.title: Tripartite Convention
paragraphs: The Tripartite Convention of 1899 concluded the Second Samoan Civil War, resulting in the formal partition of the Samoan archipelago into a German colony and a United States territory.
Forerunners to the Tripartite Convention of 1899 were the Washington Conference of 1887, the Treaty of Berlin of 1889, and the Anglo-German Agreement on Samoa of 1899.

Troyville culture.headline: Kultura Troyville
paragraphs: Kultura Troyville je arheološka kultura na območjih Louisiane in Arkansasa v dolini spodnjega Misisipija na območju jugovzhodnih gozdov. Spadala je v obdobje Baytown in je trajala od leta 400 do 700 n. št., v poznem gozdnem obdobju. Obstajala je hkrati z obalno kulturo Troyville in kulturo Baytown (vse tri so se razvile iz hopewellskih ljudstev Marksville), nasledila pa jo je kultura Coles Creek. Ljudstva Baytown so gradila razpršena naselja, ljudje Troyville pa so še naprej gradili velika središča z zemeljskimi nasipi.

source.title: Troyville culture
paragraphs: The Troyville culture is an archaeological culture in areas of Louisiana and Arkansas in the Lower Mississippi valley in the Southeastern Woodlands. It was a Baytown Period culture and lasted from 400 to 700 CE during the Late Woodland period. It was contemporaneous with the Coastal Troyville and Baytown cultures (all three had evolved from the Marksville Hopewellian peoples) and was succeeded by the Coles Creek culture. Where the Baytown peoples built dispersed settlements, the Troyville people instead continued building major earthwork centers.

Tuskarorska vojna je od 10. septembra 1711 do 11. februarja 1715 potekala v Severni Karolini med ljudstvom Tuskarora in njegovimi zavezniki na eni strani ter evropsko-ameriškimi naseljenci, ljudstvom Yamasee in drugimi zavezniki na drugi. Veljala je za najbolj krvavo kolonialno vojno v Severni Karolini. Tuskarore so leta 1718 s kolonialnimi uradniki podpisali pogodbo in se naselili na rezerviranem zemljišču v okrožju Bertie v Severni Karolini. Vojna je spodbudila nadaljnje spopade s Tuskarorami in spremenila trgovino s sužnji v Severni in Južni Karolini.

Prva uspešna angleška naselbina v Severni Karolini je nastala leta 1653. Tuskarore so z naseljenci več kot 50 let živeli v miru, medtem ko je bila skoraj vsaka druga kolonija v Ameriki v kakšnem spopadu z Indijanci. Po vojni v začetku 18. stoletja se je večina Tuskaror preselila na sever, v New York. Pridružili so se petim narodom irokeške zveze Haudenosaunee, ki so vsi govorili irokeške jezike, kot šesti narod.

source.title: Tuscarora War
paragraphs: The Tuscarora War was fought in North Carolina from September 10, 1711, until February 11, 1715, between the Tuscarora people and their allies on one side and European American settlers, the Yamasee, and other allies on the other. This was considered the bloodiest colonial war in North Carolina. The Tuscarora signed a treaty with colonial officials in 1718 and settled on a reserved tract of land in Bertie County, North Carolina. The war incited further conflict on the part of the Tuscarora and led to changes in the slave trade of North and South Carolina.

The first successful English settlement of North Carolina had begun in 1653. The Tuscarora lived in peace with the settlers for more than 50 years, while nearly every other colony in America was involved in some conflict with Native Americans. After the early 18th century war, most of the Tuscarora migrated north to New York. They joined the Five Nations of the Haudenosaunee Confederacy, all Iroquoian-speaking peoples, as the sixth nation.

Konvencija Združenih narodov proti korupciji (UNCAC) je edina pravno zavezujoča mednarodna večstranska pogodba proti korupciji. Izpogajale so jo članice Združenih narodov (OZN), Generalna skupščina OZN jo je sprejela oktobra 2003, veljati pa je začela decembra 2005. Pogodba priznava pomen preventivnih in kaznovalnih ukrepov ter z določbami o mednarodnem sodelovanju in vračanju premoženjske koristi iz korupcije obravnava čezmejno naravo korupcije.

Kot sekretariat konvencije deluje Urad OZN za droge in kriminal (UNODC) na Dunaju. Cilj konvencije je zmanjšati različne oblike korupcije, ki lahko prestopajo državne meje, kot sta trgovanje z vplivom in zloraba oblasti, pa tudi korupcijo v zasebnem sektorju, kot sta poneverba in pranje denarja. Drugi cilj je okrepiti mednarodno sodelovanje držav pri kazenskem pregonu in v pravosodju z učinkovitimi pravnimi mehanizmi za mednarodno vračanje premoženja.

source.title: United Nations Convention Against Corruption
paragraphs: The United Nations Convention Against Corruption (UNCAC) is the only legally binding international anti-corruption multilateral treaty. Negotiated by member states of the United Nations (UN) it was adopted by the UN General Assembly in October 2003 and entered into force in December 2005. The treaty recognises the importance of both preventive and punitive measures, addresses the cross-border nature of corruption with provisions on international cooperation and on the return of the proceeds of corruption.

The UN Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) in Vienna serves as the Secretariat for the UNCAC. UNCAC's goal is to reduce various types of corruption that can occur across country borders, such as trading in influence and abuse of power, as well as corruption in the private sector, such as embezzlement and money laundering. Another goal of the UNCAC is to strengthen international law enforcement and judicial cooperation between countries by providing effective legal mechanisms for international asset recovery.

Konvencija Združenih narodov o pomorskem mednarodnem pravu (UNCLOS), imenovana tudi konvencija ali pogodba o pomorskem pravu, je mednarodna pogodba, ki določa pravni okvir za vse dejavnosti na morju in v pomorstvu. Oktobra 2024 je bilo pogodbenic 169 suverenih držav in Evropska unija. Nekatere države konvencije niso hotele priznati.

Konvencija je nastala na tretji konferenci Združenih narodov o pomorskem pravu (UNCLOS III), ki je potekala med letoma 1973 in 1982. Nadomestila je štiri pogodbe iz leta 1958, med njimi konvencijo o odprtem morju. Veljati je začela leta 1994, leto potem, ko jo je Gvajana ratificirala kot 60. država. Leta 2023 so dosegli dogovor o pogodbi o odprtem morju, ki naj bi postala instrument konvencije in naj bi varovala življenje v oceanih v mednarodnih vodah, z ukrepi, kot so zaščitena morska območja in presoje vplivov na okolje.

source.title: United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
paragraphs: The United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), also called the Law of the Sea Convention or the Law of the Sea Treaty, is an international treaty that establishes a legal framework for all marine and maritime activities. As of October 2024, 169 sovereign states and the European Union are parties to the convention. Some states have refused to recognise the convention.

The convention resulted from the third United Nations Conference on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS III), which took place between 1973 and 1982. UNCLOS replaced the four treaties of the 1958 Convention on the High Seas. UNCLOS came into force in 1994, a year after Guyana became the 60th nation to ratify the treaty. In 2023, agreement was reached on a High Seas Treaty to be added as an instrument of the convention, to protect ocean life in international waters. This would provide measures including marine protected areas and environmental impact assessments.

United States invasion of Grenada.headline: Invazija na Grenado leta 1983
paragraphs: Združene države in koalicija karibskih držav so 25. oktobra 1983 ob zori vdrle v otoško državo Grenado. Ameriška vojska je operacijo poimenovala Nujni bes (Urgent Fury), v nekaj dneh pa se je končala z vojaško zasedbo. Sprožili so jo spori v ljudski revolucionarni vladi, ki so pripeljali do hišnega pripora in usmrtitve nekdanjega voditelja in drugega predsednika vlade Grenade Mauricea Bishopa ter do ustanovitve Revolucionarnega vojaškega sveta s Hudsonom Austinom na čelu. Po invaziji so imenovali začasno vlado, decembra 1984 pa so potekale splošne volitve.
notes: The glossary dated this record 1993; it is corrected to 1983 in the names file.

source.title: United States invasion of Grenada
paragraphs: The United States and a coalition of Caribbean countries invaded the island nation of Grenada at dawn on 25 October 1983. It was codenamed Operation Urgent Fury by the U.S. military, and resulted in military occupation within a few days. It was triggered by strife within the People's Revolutionary Government, which led to the house arrest and execution of the previous leader and second Prime Minister of Grenada, Maurice Bishop, and to the establishment of the Revolutionary Military Council, with Hudson Austin as chairman. Following the invasion there was an interim government appointed, and then general elections held in December 1984.

Invazija Združenih držav Amerike na Panamo se je začela sredi decembra 1989 med predsedovanjem Georgea H. W. Busha. Njen namen je bil odstaviti dejanskega vladarja Paname generala Manuela Noriego, ki so ga ameriške oblasti iskale zaradi izsiljevanja in trgovine z mamili. Operacija s kodnim imenom Pravični razlog (Just Cause) se je končala konec januarja 1990 z Noriegovo vdajo. Panamske obrambne sile (PDF) so razpustili, izvoljeni predsednik Guillermo Endara pa je prisegel.

source.title: United States invasion of Panama
paragraphs: The United States invasion of Panama began in mid-December 1989 during the presidency of George H. W. Bush. The purpose of the invasion was to depose the de facto ruler of Panama, General Manuel Noriega, who was wanted by U.S. authorities for racketeering and drug trafficking. The operation, codenamed Operation Just Cause, concluded in late January 1990 with the surrender of Noriega. The Panama Defense Forces (PDF) were dissolved, and president-elect Guillermo Endara was sworn into office.

Združene države Kolumbije (špansko: Estados Unidos de Colombia) je ime, ki ga je Granadski konfederaciji po letih državljanske vojne leta 1863 dala ustava iz Rionegra (Constitución de Rionegro). Kolumbija je postala zvezna država iz devetih »suverenih držav«. Obsegala je današnji državi Kolumbijo in Panamo ter dele severozahodne Brazilije. Po nadaljnjih letih občasnih državljanskih vojn jo je leta 1886 nadomestila bolj centralistična Republika Kolumbija, predhodnica današnje Kolumbije.

source.title: United States of Colombia
paragraphs: The United States of Colombia (Spanish: Estados Unidos de Colombia) was the name adopted in 1863 by the Constitución de Rionegro for the Granadine Confederation, after years of civil war. Colombia became a federal state itself composed of nine "sovereign states." It comprised the present-day nations of Colombia and Panama and parts of northwestern Brazil. After several more years of intermittent civil wars, it was replaced by the more centralist Republic of Colombia in 1886, predecessor to modern Colombia.

Vicús culture.headline: Kultura Vicús
paragraphs: Kultura Vicús je bila pomembna zgodnja kultura v Peruju od leta 1000 oziroma 200 pr. n. št. do leta 300 oziroma 600 n. št. Njeni nosilci so živeli v regiji Piura na severni pacifiški obali Peruja. Upravno središče na griču Cerro Vicús, 170 metrov nad morjem, po katerem je kultura dobila ime, je bilo povezava z drugimi andskimi mesti severneje.

Najpomembnejša značilnost te kulture je poljedelstvo, temelj njenega gospodarskega razvoja. Znano je, da so z naprednimi namakalnimi sistemi gojili buče ali mate, koruzo in nekaj sadja. Te dejavnosti so dopolnjevali z živinorejo ali lovom. Ljudje Vicús so dobro poznali zlitine srebra, zlata in bakra ter so te kovine uporabljali celo za izdelavo poljedelskega orodja.
Glavno orodje nadzora in družbenega izkoriščanja, podprto s srditim militarizmom, je bil močan zbor plemiških bojevnikov, ki je obhodil ozemlje in uveljavljal vladarjeve ukaze.

source.title: Vicús culture
paragraphs: Vicús culture was an important early culture in Peru from 1000/200 BCE to 300/600 CE. They lived in the Piura region in the northern Pacific coast of Peru. Its administrative headquarters, located in the "Cerro Vicús", at an altitude of 170 meters above sea level, and which gives its name to this culture, served as a link with other Andean cities located further north.

The most important feature of this culture is agriculture, the basis for their economic development. It is known that they cultivated squash or mate, corn and some fruits, with advanced irrigation systems. These activities were complemented by livestock or hunting. The vicus, connoisseurs of the alloys of silver, gold and copper, even used these metals in the elaboration of their farming instruments.
The main instrument of control and social exploitation, backed by fierce militarism, was a strong contingent of noble warriors that scoured the domain to enforce the sovereign's mandates.

Virú culture.headline: Kultura Virú
paragraphs: Kultura Virú (znana tudi kot Gallinazo) je bila predkolumbovska, predinkovska kultura, ki je cvetela v dolini Virú na severozahodni obali Peruja. Z njo se okoli leta 200 pr. n. št. začne zgodnje vmesno obdobje Peruja. Kultura severne obale je imela središče v dolini Virú, segala pa je tudi v doline Moche in Santa. Dolina Virú leži v obalni pokrajini, ozkem pasu kopnega, ki ga na vzhodu omejujejo Andi, na zahodu pa Tihi ocean. Glavno mesto doline je bilo v tem obdobju mestno območje, imenovano najdišče skupine Gallinazo.

source.title: Virú culture
paragraphs: The Virú culture (alternatively known as the Gallinazo) was a pre-Columbian, pre-Inca culture that flourished in the Virú Valley on the northwest coast of Peru. It marks the start of the Early Intermediate Period of Peru, dating roughly around 200 BCE. This North Coast culture was based in the Virú Valley and extended into the Moche and Santa Valleys as well. The Virú Valley is on a coastal landscape which consists of a narrow land strip boarded by the Andes Mountains to its east and the Pacific Ocean to the west. The capital of the Virú valley during this time period was an urban area called the Gallinazo Group site.

Wari Empire.headline: Imperij Wari
paragraphs: Imperij Wari ali Huari je bila politična tvorba, ki je nastala okoli leta 600 n. št. v perujskem porečju Ayacucho in se razširila na velik del obalnega in visokogorskega Peruja. Imperij je trajal okoli 500 let, do leta 1100 n. št. Obstajal je ob istem času kot kultura Tiwanaku in nekoč so menili, da je iz nje izšel.

Leta 2008 so arheologi blizu današnjega Chiclaya našli predkolumbovsko mesto, severne razvaline Wari (imenovane tudi Cerro Pátapo), prvo obsežno naselje kulture Wari tako daleč na severu. Arheološka odkritja so se nadaljevala tudi v zadnjem desetletju: leta 2023 so arheologi v Arequipi odkrili 1200 let star obredni kompleks Wari. Z vsakim novim odkritjem lahko arheologi o kulturi imperija Wari sklepajo več.

source.title: Wari Empire
paragraphs: The Wari Empire or Huari Empire was a political formation that emerged in around 600 CE in Peru's Ayacucho Basin and grew to cover much of coastal and highland Peru. The empire lasted for about 500 years, until 1100 CE. It existed during the same era as the Tiwanaku culture, and at one time, was thought to have been derived from it.

In 2008, archeologists found a pre-Columbian city, the Northern Wari ruins (also called Cerro Pátapo) near modern Chiclayo. The find was the first extensive settlement related to the Wari culture discovered that far north. Archaeological discoveries have continued over the past decade. In 2023, archaeologists discovered a 1200-year-old Wari ritual complex in Arequipa. While more discoveries are being made regarding the Wari Empire, archaeologists are able to draw more conclusions about the Wari Empire's culture.

Western Mexico shaft tomb tradition.headline: Tradicija jaškastih grobnic zahodne Mehike
paragraphs: Tradicija jaškastih grobnic zahodne Mehike označuje skupek medsebojno povezanih kulturnih značilnosti v zahodnih mehiških zveznih državah Jalisco, Nayarit in v manjši meri v Colimi južno od njiju, ki sega približno v obdobje med letoma 300 pr. n. št. in 400 n. št., čeprav glede končnega datuma ni širokega soglasja. Skoraj vse predmete, povezane s to tradicijo, so odkrili roparji in so brez znanega izvora, zato je datiranje težavno.
Prvo večjo nedotaknjeno jaškasto grobnico te tradicije so odkrili šele leta 1993 v Huitzilapi v Jaliscu.

Sprva so jo imeli za purepeško, iz časa Aztekov, sredi 20. stoletja pa so nadaljnje raziskave pokazale, da so predmeti in grobnice več kot tisoč let starejši. Do nedavnega so bili izropani predmeti vse, kar so vedeli o ljudstvu in kulturi ali kulturah, ki so gradile jaškaste grobnice. Vedeli so tako malo, da je imela velika razstava teh predmetov leta 1998 podnaslov »Umetnost in arheologija neznane preteklosti«.

source.title: Western Mexico shaft tomb tradition
paragraphs: The Western Mexico shaft tomb tradition refers to a set of interlocked cultural traits found in the western Mexican states of Jalisco, Nayarit, and, to a lesser extent, Colima to its south, roughly dating to the period between 300 BCE and 400 CE, although there is not wide agreement on this end date. Nearly all of the artifacts associated with this shaft tomb tradition have been discovered by looters and are without provenance, making dating problematic.
The first major undisturbed shaft tomb associated with the tradition was not discovered until 1993 at Huitzilapa, Jalisco.

Originally regarded as of Purépecha origin, contemporary with the Aztecs, it became apparent in the middle of the 20th century, as a result of further research, that the artifacts and tombs were instead over a thousand years older. Until recently, the looted artifacts were all that was known of the people and culture or cultures that created the shaft tombs. So little was known, in fact, that a major 1998 exhibition highlighting these artifacts was subtitled: "Art and Archaeology of the Unknown Past".

Woodland period#Early Woodland period (1.headline: Zgodnje gozdno obdobje
paragraphs: Zgodnje gozdno obdobje (Early Woodland) je nadaljevalo številne težnje, ki so se začele v poznem in končnem arhaičnem obdobju: obsežno gradnjo gomil, regionalno značilne pogrebne komplekse, trgovino z eksotičnim blagom na velikem delu Severne Amerike v okviru t. i. interakcijskih sfer, prehrano iz divjih in udomačenih rastlin ter mobilno preživetje, pri katerem so manjše skupine izkoriščale sezonske vire, kot so oreški, ribe, školjke in divje rastline. Lončenina, ki so jo v arhaičnem obdobju izdelovali le v omejenih količinah, se je zdaj razširila po vsem vzhodnem notranjem delu, jugovzhodu in severovzhodu. Skrajni severovzhod, subarktika ter severozahod in Velike planjave so jo na splošno prevzeli nekoliko pozneje, okoli leta 200 pr. n. št.
notes: Woodland period rendered as gozdno obdobje with the English term at first mention; no established Slovenian term was found.

source.title: Woodland period
paragraphs: The Early Woodland period continued many trends begun during the Late and Terminal Archaic periods, including extensive mound-building, regional distinctive burial complexes, the trade of exotic goods across a large area of North America as part of interaction spheres, the reliance on both wild and domesticated plant foods, and a mobile subsistence strategy in which small groups took advantage of seasonally available resources such as nuts, fish, shellfish, and wild plants. Pottery, which had been manufactured during the Archaic period in limited amounts, was now widespread across the Eastern Interior, the Southeast, and the Northeast. The Far Northeast, the Sub-Arctic, and the Northwest/Plains regions widely adopted pottery somewhat later, about 200 BCE.

Woodland period#Late Woodland Period (50.headline: Pozno gozdno obdobje
paragraphs: Pozno gozdno obdobje je bilo čas, ko se je prebivalstvo očitno razpršilo, čeprav se ni zmanjšalo. Na večini območij sta močno upadli gradnja grobnih gomil in trgovina z eksotičnimi surovinami na velike razdalje. Hkrati sta lok in puščica postopoma izpodrinila sulico in metalec kopja (atlatl). Pravo intenzivno poljedelstvo se je začelo šele v naslednjem, misisipijskem obdobju, a je že začetek resnega obdelovanja zemlje močno dopolnil tradicionalno nabiranje rastlin.

source.title: Woodland period
paragraphs: The late Woodland period was a time of apparent population dispersal, although populations do not appear to have decreased. In most areas, the construction of burial mounds decreased markedly, as did the long-distance trade in exotic materials. At the same time, bow and arrow technology gradually overtook the use of the spear and atlatl. While full-scale intensive agriculture did not begin until the following Mississippian period, the beginning of serious cultivation greatly supplemented the traditional gathering of plants.

Woodland period#Middle Woodland Period (.headline: Srednje gozdno obdobje
paragraphs: Na začetku srednjega gozdnega obdobja so se naselbine preselile v notranjost celine. Z napredovanjem obdobja se je krajevna in medregionalna trgovina z eksotičnimi surovinami tako razmahnila, da je trgovska mreža zajela večino vzhodnih gozdov (Eastern Woodlands). Po vsem jugovzhodu in severno od reke Ohio so bile grobne gomile pomembnih ljudi zelo razkošne, z raznolikimi pogrebnimi pridatki, ki so bili pogosto tujega izvora. Med blagom, s katerim so trgovali, so bili baker iz nahajališč ob Gornjem jezeru, srebro z Gornjega jezera in zlasti iz Ontaria, galenit iz Missourija in Illinoisa, sljuda iz južnih Apalačev, roženec z različnih krajev, med drugim iz Ohia, Indiane in Illinoisa, pipni kamen iz Ohia in Illinoisa, aligatorski zobje od spodnjega toka Misisipija proti vzhodu do Floride, morske školjke, zlasti trobilke, z južne atlantske in zalivske obale, kalcedon z reke Knife v Severni Dakoti ter obsidian iz Yellowstona v Wyomingu.

source.title: Woodland period
paragraphs: The beginning of the Middle Woodland saw a shift of settlement to the Interior. As the Woodland period progressed, local and inter-regional trade of exotic materials greatly increased to the point where a trade network covered most of the Eastern Woodlands. Throughout the Southeast and north of the Ohio River, burial mounds of important people were very elaborate and contained a variety of mortuary gifts, many of which were not local. Among the traded materials were copper from the Lake Superior deposits; silver from Lake Superior and especially Ontario; galena from Missouri and Illinois; mica from the southern Appalachians; chert from various places including Ohio, Indiana, and Illinois; pipestone from Ohio and Illinois; alligator teeth from the lower Mississippi Valley eastward to Florida; marine shells, especially whelks, from the south Atlantic and Gulf coasts; Knife River chalcedony from North Dakota; and obsidian from Yellowstone in Wyoming.

Zapotec civilization.headline: Zapoteška civilizacija
paragraphs: Zapoteška civilizacija (v zapoteščini Be'ena'a, »ljudje, ki so prišli iz oblakov«; ok. 700 pr. n. št.–1521 n. št.) je domorodna predkolumbovska civilizacija, ki je cvetela v dolini Oaxaca v Mezoameriki. Arheološki dokazi kažejo, da je njihova kultura nastala pred najmanj 2500 leti. Na zapoteškem arheološkem najdišču v starodavnem mestu Monte Albán so monumentalne stavbe, igrišča za igro z žogo, grobnice in pridatki, med njimi fino izdelan zlat nakit. Monte Albán je bil eno prvih velikih mest v Mezoameriki in središče zapoteške države, ki je obvladovala velik del ozemlja današnje mehiške zvezne države Oaxaca. Današnji Zapoteki so njihovi potomci.

source.title: Zapotec civilization
paragraphs: The Zapotec civilization (Be'ena'a (Zapotec) "The People that came from the clouds"; c. 700 BC – AD 1521) is an indigenous pre-Columbian civilization that flourished in the Valley of Oaxaca in Mesoamerica. Archaeological evidence shows that their culture originated at least 2,500 years ago. The Zapotec archaeological site at the ancient city of Monte Albán has monumental buildings, ball courts, tombs and grave goods, including finely worked gold jewelry. Monte Albán was one of the first major cities in Mesoamerica. It was the center of a Zapotec state that dominated much of the territory which today is known as the Mexican state of Oaxaca. The Zapotec peoples are their modern descendants.
